    (he : ∀ x, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (localFieldLift period (fun y => e y) x))
    (hDe : MemLp (fun x => fderiv ℝ (localFieldLift period (fun y => e y) x) 0)
      2 (liftMeasure period))
    (hsym : ∀ x v w, ⟪K x v, w⟫_ℝ = ⟪v, K x w⟫_ℝ)
    {z : LiftL2 period} (hz : z ∈ divergenceFreeSpace period κ m)
    (C D B : ℝ≥0) (hC : ∀ x, ‖K x‖ ≤ C)
    (hD : ∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ (localFieldLift period K x) 0‖ ≤ D)
    (hzB : ∀ᵐ x ∂liftMeasure period, ‖z x‖ ≤ B) :
    |∫ x, ⟪K x (e x), fderiv ℝ (localFieldLift period (fun y => e y) x) 0
      (transportDirection κ m (z x))⟫_ℝ ∂liftMeasure period| ≤
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * D * ((|κ| + ‖m‖) * B) * ‖e‖ ^ 2

name: EulerNoncompactTransport.metric_transport_noncompact_by_parts
statement:
theorem metric_transport_noncompact_by_parts (κ : ℝ) (m : Vector3)
    (K : LiftDomain period → Vector3 →L[ℝ] Vector3) (e : LiftDomain period → Vector3)
    (hK : ∀ x, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (localFieldLift period K x))
    (he : ∀ x, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (localFieldLift period e x))
    (hsym : ∀ x v w, ⟪K x v, w⟫_ℝ = ⟪v, K x w⟫_ℝ)
    {z : LiftL2 period} (hz : z ∈ divergenceFreeSpace period κ m)
    (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hzB : ∀ᵐ x ∂liftMeasure period, ‖z x‖ ≤ B)
    (hE : Integrable (metricEnergy period K e) (liftMeasure period))
    (hT : Integrable (fun x => ⟪K x (e x), fderiv ℝ (localFieldLift period e x) 0
      (transportDirection κ m (z x))⟫_ℝ) (liftMeasure period))
    (hQ : Integrable (fun x => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ⟪(fderiv ℝ (localFieldLift period K x) 0
      (transportDirection κ m (z x))) (e x), e x⟫_ℝ) (liftMeasure period)) :
    (∫ x, ⟪K x (e x), fderiv ℝ (localFieldLift period e x) 0
      (transportDirection κ m (z x))⟫_ℝ ∂liftMeasure period) =
    -(∫ x, (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ⟪(fderiv ℝ (localFieldLift period K x) 0
      (transportDirection κ m (z x))) (e x), e x⟫_ℝ ∂liftMeasure period)

name: EulerPacketAlgebra.inversion_equation
statement:
theorem inversion_equation (β : ℝ) (V V₁ : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hV : ∀ x, x ≠ 0 → HasDerivAt V (V₁ x) x)
    (hV₁ : ∀ x, x ≠ 0 → HasDerivAt V₁
      (((2 / β - 2 * x ^ 2) * V x - 4 * x ^ 3 * V₁ x) / (1 + x ^ 4)) x)
    (y : ℝ) (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun z => V z⁻¹ / z)
      (-V y⁻¹ / y ^ 2 - V₁ y⁻¹ / y ^ 3) y ∧
    HasDerivAt (fun z => (1 + z ^ 4) * (-V z⁻¹ / z ^ 2 - V₁ z⁻¹ / z ^ 3))
      ((2 / β - 2 * y ^ 2) * (V y⁻¹ / y)) y

name: EulerPacketAlgebra.pairing_conserved
statement:
theorem pairing_conserved {n : Type*} [Fintype n]
    (M : ℝ → Matrix n n ℝ) (m v : ℝ → n → ℝ) (a b : ℝ)
    (hm : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, m t ⬝ᵥ m t ≠ 0)
    (hmd : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, ∀ i, HasDerivAt (fun s => m s i)
      ((-(M t).transpose *ᵥ m t) i) t)
    (hvd : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, ∀ i, HasDerivAt (fun s => v s i)
      ((-(M t *ᵥ v t) + (2 * (m t ⬝ᵥ (M t *ᵥ v t)) /
        (m t ⬝ᵥ m t)) • m t) i) t) :
    ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, m t ⬝ᵥ v t = m a ⬝ᵥ v a

name: EulerPacketAlgebra.scalar_equation
statement:
theorem scalar_equation (β : ℝ) (U V : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hU : ∀ t, HasDerivAt U
      (-2 * V t + 2 * (β * t ^ 2) *
        (((β * t ^ 2) + β) * V t + (-2 * β * t) * U t) /
          (1 + (β * t ^ 2) ^ 2)) t)
    (hV : ∀ t, HasDerivAt V (-U t) t) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => (1 + (β * s ^ 2) ^ 2) * deriv V s)
      (2 * (1 - β * (β * t ^ 2)) * V t) t

name: EulerPacketBridge.controlled_velocity_relative_error

    {σ Θ T e ε lam : ℝ} {F F₁ G G₁ Z Z₁ U V P Q N : ℝ → ℝ}
    {R A C : ℝ → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ}
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hσsmall : σ ≤ 1 / 4) (hΘ : 1 ≤ Θ)
    (hT0 : 0 ≤ T) (hT : T ≤ Θ) (he : 0 ≤ e) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hεe : ε ≤ e)
    (hlam : 0 ≤ lam) (hsmall : 8000000 * e * Θ ^ 21 ≤ 1)
    (hF : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → HasDerivAt F (F₁ t) t)
    (hG : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → HasDerivAt G (G₁ t) t)
    (hfluxF : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t →
      HasDerivAt (fun s => (1 + (σ ^ 2 * s ^ 2) ^ 2) * F₁ s)
        (2 * (1 - σ ^ 2 * (σ ^ 2 * t ^ 2)) * F t) t)
    (hfluxG : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t →
      HasDerivAt (fun s => (1 + (σ ^ 2 * s ^ 2) ^ 2) * G₁ s)
        (2 * (1 - σ ^ 2 * (σ ^ 2 * t ^ 2)) * G t) t)
    (hF0 : F 0 = 1) (hF₁0 : F₁ 0 = 0) (hG₁0 : G₁ 0 = 1)
    (hRc : ∀ i j, ContinuousOn (fun t => R t i j) (Icc 0 T))
    (hAc : ∀ i j, ContinuousOn (fun t => A t i j) (Icc 0 T))
    (hCc : ∀ i j, ContinuousOn (fun t => C t i j) (Icc 0 T))
    (hP : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, HasDerivAt P
      (R t 0 0 * P t + R t 0 1 * Q t + R t 0 2 * N t) t)
    (hQ : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, HasDerivAt Q
      (R t 1 0 * P t + R t 1 1 * Q t + R t 1 2 * N t) t)
    (hN : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, HasDerivAt N
      (R t 2 0 * P t + R t 2 1 * Q t + R t 2 2 * N t) t)
    (hU : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, HasDerivAt U
      (velocityFirstRhs (A t) (C t) ε (P t) (Q t) (N t) (U t) (V t)) t)
    (hV : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, HasDerivAt V
      (velocitySecondRhs (A t) (C t) ε (P t) (Q t) (N t) (U t) (V t)) t)
    (hRclose : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ i j, |R t i j - idealRayEntry (σ ^ 2) i j| ≤ 4 * e)
    (hAclose : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ i j, |A t i j - idealVelocityEntry (σ ^ 2) i j| ≤ 3 * e)
    (hCclose : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ i j, |C t i j - idealUnprojectedEntry i j| ≤ 5 * e)
    (hZ : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, HasDerivAt Z (Z₁ t) t)
    (hfluxZ : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
      HasDerivAt (fun s => (1 + (σ ^ 2 * s ^ 2) ^ 2) * Z₁ s)
        (2 * (1 - σ ^ 2 * (σ ^ 2 * t ^ 2)) * Z t) t)
    (hrayInitial : norm3 (P 0) (Q 0) (N 0 - 1) ≤ e)
    (hU0 : U 0 = -lam) (hV0 : V 0 = 1) (hZ0 : Z 0 = 1) (hZ₁0 : Z₁ 0 = lam) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
      |V t - Z t| + |U t + Z₁ t| ≤ 160000000 * e * Θ ^ 29 * (1 + lam) * F t

    (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (hβupper : β ≤ 1) (hΘ : 1 ≤ Θ) (hT0 : 0 ≤ T) (hT : T ≤ Θ)

    (hQ : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, HasDerivAt Q
      (R t 1 0 * P t + R t 1 1 * Q t + R t 1 2 * N t) t)
    (hN : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, HasDerivAt N
      (R t 2 0 * P t + R t 2 1 * Q t + R t 2 2 * N t) t)
    (hRclose : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ i j, |R t i j - idealRayEntry β i j| ≤ 4 * e)

          idealVelocityFirst β t U V| +

    (hF0 : F 0 = 1) (hF₁0 : F₁ 0 = 0) (hG₁0 : G₁ 0 = 1)

name: EulerPacketCoefficientControl.normalized_motion_errors
statement:
theorem normalized_motion_errors
    {a ε Θ G d β : ℝ} {B E : ℝ → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ}
    {h h₁ b₁ k₁ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (ha : 1 / 2 ≤ a) (hε : 0 < ε) (hΘ : 1 ≤ Θ) (hG : 1 ≤ G) (hd : 0 ≤ d)
    (hsmall : 16 * (ε * Θ * G ^ 2 + d) ≤ 1)
    (hB : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 Θ, ∀ i j, |B t i j| ≤ G)
    (hE : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 Θ, ∀ i j, |E t i j| ≤ d)
    (hb : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 Θ, HasDerivAt (fun s => B s 0 1) (b₁ t) t)
    (hk : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 Θ, HasDerivAt (fun s => B s 2 1) (k₁ t) t)
    (hbBound : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 Θ, |b₁ t| ≤ 2 * ε * G ^ 2)
    (hkBound : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 Θ, |k₁ t| ≤ 2 * ε * G ^ 2)
    (hShear : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 Θ, HasDerivAt h (h₁ t) t)
    (hShearBound : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 Θ, |h₁ t| ≤ (4 * ε * G) * |h t|)
    (hb0 : B 0 0 1 = a) (hk0 : B 0 2 1 = a * β) (hh0 : h 0 = a / ε ^ 2) :
    let e := 16 * (ε * Θ * G ^ 2 + d)
    ε ≤ e ∧ ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 Θ,
      (∀ i j, |ε * B t i j / a| ≤ e) ∧
      (∀ i j, |E t i j / a| ≤ e) ∧
      |ε ^ 2 * h t / a - 1| ≤ e ∧
      |B t 0 1 / a - 1| ≤ e ∧ |B t 2 1 / a - β| ≤ e

name: EulerPacketCoefficientControl.raw_frame_matrix_errors

    (hB : ∀ i j, |ε * B i j / a| ≤ e) (hE : ∀ i j, |E i j / a| ≤ e)
    (hH : |ε ^ 2 * h / a - 1| ≤ e) (hα : |B 0 1 / a - 1| ≤ e)
    (hκ : |B 2 1 / a - β| ≤ e) :
    (∀ i j, |scaledRayEntry a ε (parentEntry B E h) (frameSkew B) i j - idealRayEntry β i j| ≤ 4 * e) ∧
    (∀ i j, |scaledVelocityEntry a ε (parentEntry B E h) i j - idealVelocityEntry β i j| ≤ 3 * e) ∧
    (∀ j,
      |scaledVelocityEntry a ε (fun i j => parentEntry B E h i j + frameSkew B i j) 0 j -
        idealUnprojectedEntry 0 j| ≤ 5 * e ∧

    ρ ≤ 1 / 2 ∧ η ≤ 1 / 2 ∧ 210 * e * Θ ^ 2 ≤ 1 ∧ dE ≤ 1 ∧ dJ ≤ P₀ / 4 ∧
      4 * dJ + 16 * P₀ * dD + 16 * P₀ ^ 2 * dE ≤ 30000000 * K * e * Θ ^ 40 ∧

    (hZ : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → HasDerivAt Z (Z₁ t) t)
    (hfluxZ : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t →
      HasDerivAt (fun s => (1 + (σ ^ 2 * s ^ 2) ^ 2) * Z₁ s)
        (2 * (1 - σ ^ 2 * (σ ^ 2 * t ^ 2)) * Z t) t)
    (hZ0 : Z 0 = 1) (hZ₁0 : 0 ≤ Z₁ 0)
    (hP : |P - (y⁻¹) ^ 2| ≤ 800 * e * Θ ^ 5)
    (hQ : |Q + 2 * σ * y⁻¹| ≤ 800 * e * Θ ^ 5)
    (hN : |N - 1| ≤ 800 * e * Θ ^ 5)
    (hr : |r + Z₁ (y⁻¹ / σ) / Z (y⁻¹ / σ)| ≤ 10 * (K * e * Θ ^ 29))
    (hA : ∀ i j, |A i j - idealVelocityEntry (σ ^ 2) i j| ≤ 3 * e) :
    let w := velocityThird P Q N r 1
    let D := rayDenominator ε P Q N
    let E := velocityDirectionNormSq ε r w
    let J := velocityNumerator A P Q N r 1 w
    let S := frameCrossNumerator ε P Q N r w (rowAction A 0 r w) (rowAction A 1 r w) (rowAction A 2 r w)
    |J / (sqrt D * sqrt E) - 1| ≤
      y ^ 4 + σ ^ 2 * y ^ 2 + 8 * σ * y ^ 3 + 30000000 * K * e * Θ ^ 40 ∧
    |(y⁻¹) ^ 2 * S / (J * sqrt E) - 1| ≤ 1500 * σ + 30000000 * K * e * Θ ^ 40

name: EulerPacketFrameRenewal.equation30_target_ideal_quantities
statement:

      |J₀ / sqrt (1 + P₀ ^ 2) - 1| ≤ y ^ 4 + ε ^ 2 * y ^ 2 + 8 * ε * y ^ 3 ∧

theorem forced_variation_of_constants
    {D c u u₁ v v₁ Y Y₁ f g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (hu : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, HasDerivAt u (u₁ t) t)
    (hv : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, HasDerivAt v (v₁ t) t)
    (hfu : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, HasDerivAt (fun s => D s * u₁ s) (c t * u t) t)
    (hfv : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, HasDerivAt (fun s => D s * v₁ s) (c t * v t) t)
    (hY : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, HasDerivAt Y (Y₁ t + f t) t)
    (hfY : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b,
      HasDerivAt (fun s => D s * Y₁ s) (c t * Y t + D t * g t) t)
    (hDc : ContinuousOn D (Icc a b)) (hu₁c : ContinuousOn u₁ (Icc a b))
    (hv₁c : ContinuousOn v₁ (Icc a b))
    (hfc : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b)) (hgc : ContinuousOn g (Icc a b))
    (hW0 : u a * (D a * v₁ a) - (D a * u₁ a) * v a = 1) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc a b,
      let A := u a * (D a * Y₁ a) - (D a * u₁ a) * Y a +
        ∫ s in a..t, D s * (u s * g s - u₁ s * f s)
      let B := v a * (D a * Y₁ a) - (D a * v₁ a) * Y a +
        ∫ s in a..t, D s * (v s * g s - v₁ s * f s)
      Y t = v t * A - u t * B ∧ Y₁ t = v₁ t * A - u₁ t * B

name: EulerPacketPerturbation.forced_wronskian_derivative
statement:
theorem forced_wronskian_derivative
    {D c u u₁ Y Y₁ f g : ℝ → ℝ} {t : ℝ}
    (hu : HasDerivAt u (u₁ t) t)
    (hfu : HasDerivAt (fun s => D s * u₁ s) (c t * u t) t)
    (hY : HasDerivAt Y (Y₁ t + f t) t)
    (hfY : HasDerivAt (fun s => D s * Y₁ s) (c t * Y t + D t * g t) t) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => u s * (D s * Y₁ s) - (D s * u₁ s) * Y s)
      (D t * (u t * g t - u₁ t * f t)) t

name: EulerPacketPerturbation.forced_wronskian_integral
statement:
theorem forced_wronskian_integral
    {D c u u₁ Y Y₁ f g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (hu : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, HasDerivAt u (u₁ t) t)
    (hfu : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, HasDerivAt (fun s => D s * u₁ s) (c t * u t) t)
    (hY : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, HasDerivAt Y (Y₁ t + f t) t)
    (hfY : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b,
      HasDerivAt (fun s => D s * Y₁ s) (c t * Y t + D t * g t) t)
    (hDc : ContinuousOn D (Icc a b)) (hu₁c : ContinuousOn u₁ (Icc a b))
    (hfc : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b)) (hgc : ContinuousOn g (Icc a b)) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc a b,
      u t * (D t * Y₁ t) - (D t * u₁ t) * Y t =
        u a * (D a * Y₁ a) - (D a * u₁ a) * Y a +
          ∫ s in a..t, D s * (u s * g s - u₁ s * f s)

name: EulerPacketPerturbation.kernel_integral_bound
statement:
theorem kernel_integral_bound
    {K11 K12 K21 K22 f g U : ℝ → ℝ} {a b y0 y₁0 y y₁ C : ℝ}
    (hab : a ≤ b)
    (h11 : ContinuousOn K11 (Icc a b)) (h12 : ContinuousOn K12 (Icc a b))
    (h21 : ContinuousOn K21 (Icc a b)) (h22 : ContinuousOn K22 (Icc a b))
    (hfc : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b)) (hgc : ContinuousOn g (Icc a b))
    (hUc : ContinuousOn U (Icc a b)) (hUp : ∀ s ∈ Icc a b, 0 < U s)
    (hcol1 : ∀ s ∈ Icc a b, |K11 s| + |K21 s| ≤ C * (U b / U s))
    (hcol2 : ∀ s ∈ Icc a b, |K12 s| + |K22 s| ≤ C * (U b / U s))
    (hy : y = K11 a * y0 + K12 a * y₁0 + ∫ s in a..b, K11 s * f s + K12 s * g s)
    (hy₁ : y₁ = K21 a * y0 + K22 a * y₁0 + ∫ s in a..b, K21 s * f s + K22 s * g s) :
    |y| + |y₁| ≤ C * (U b / U a) * (|y0| + |y₁0|) +
      C * U b * ∫ s in a..b, (|f s| + |g s|) / U s

name: EulerPacketRay.ray_closeness_of_coefficient_error

    (hinitial : norm3 (P 0) (Q 0) (N 0 - 1) ≤ e) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,

EulerPacketRay.triangular_ray_difference_bound
statement:
theorem triangular_ray_difference_bound
    {β Θ T δ η : ℝ} {P Q N f g h : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (hβupper : β ≤ 1) (hΘ : 1 ≤ Θ) (hT0 : 0 ≤ T) (hT : T ≤ Θ)
    (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hsmall : 4 * Θ ^ 2 * δ * T ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hP : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, HasDerivAt P (-Q t + f t) t)
    (hQ : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, HasDerivAt Q (-2 * β * N t + g t) t)
    (hN : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, HasDerivAt N (h t) t)

    (hhc : ContinuousOn h (Icc 0 T))
    (hforcing : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, norm3 (f t) (g t) (h t) ≤ δ * norm3 (P t) (Q t) (N t))
    (hinitial : norm3 (P 0) (Q 0) (N 0 - 1) ≤ η) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, norm3 (P t - β * t ^ 2) (Q t + 2 * β * t) (N t - 1) ≤
      4 * Θ ^ 2 * η + 32 * δ * Θ ^ 5 * (1 + η)

name: EulerPacketRay.triangular_ray_formula
statement:
theorem triangular_ray_formula
    {β T : ℝ} {P Q N f g h : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hP : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, HasDerivAt P (-Q t + f t) t)
    (hQ : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, HasDerivAt Q (-2 * β * N t + g t) t)
    (hN : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, HasDerivAt N (h t) t)
    (hfc : ContinuousOn f (Icc 0 T)) (hgc : ContinuousOn g (Icc 0 T))
    (hhc : ContinuousOn h (Icc 0 T)) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
      P t = P 0 - t * Q 0 + β * t ^ 2 * N 0 +
        ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t, f s - (t - s) * g s + β * (t - s) ^ 2 * h s ∧
      Q t = Q 0 - 2 * β * t * N 0 +
        ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t, g s - 2 * β * (t - s) * h s ∧
      N t = N 0 + ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t, h s

name: EulerPacketStage.controlled_stage_references
statement:
theorem controlled_stage_references
    {σ Θ T e ε lam : ℝ} {U V P Q N : ℝ → ℝ} {R A C : ℝ → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ}
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hσsmall : σ ≤ 1 / 4) (hΘ : 1 ≤ Θ)
    (hT0 : 0 ≤ T) (hT : T ≤ Θ) (he : 0 ≤ e) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hεe : ε ≤ e)
    (hlam : 0 ≤ lam) (hsmall : 1000000 * stabilityConstant * e * Θ ^ 40 ≤ 1)
    (hRc : ∀ i j, ContinuousOn (fun t => R t i j) (Icc 0 T))
    (hAc : ∀ i j, ContinuousOn (fun t => A t i j) (Icc 0 T))
    (hCc : ∀ i j, ContinuousOn (fun t => C t i j) (Icc 0 T))
    (hP : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, HasDerivAt P
      (R t 0 0 * P t + R t 0 1 * Q t + R t 0 2 * N t) t)
    (hQ : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, HasDerivAt Q
      (R t 1 0 * P t + R t 1 1 * Q t + R t 1 2 * N t) t)
    (hN : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, HasDerivAt N
      (R t 2 0 * P t + R t 2 1 * Q t + R t 2 2 * N t) t)
    (hU : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, HasDerivAt U
      (velocityFirstRhs (A t) (C t) ε (P t) (Q t) (N t) (U t) (V t)) t)
    (hV : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, HasDerivAt V
      (velocitySecondRhs (A t) (C t) ε (P t) (Q t) (N t) (U t) (V t)) t)
    (hRclose : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ i j, |R t i j - idealRayEntry (σ ^ 2) i j| ≤ 4 * e)
    (hAclose : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ i j, |A t i j - idealVelocityEntry (σ ^ 2) i j| ≤ 3 * e)
    (hCclose : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ i j, |C t i j - idealUnprojectedEntry i j| ≤ 5 * e)
    (hrayInitial : norm3 (P 0) (Q 0) (N 0 - 1) ≤ e)
    (hU0 : U 0 = -lam) (hV0 : V 0 = 1) :
    ∃ F F₁ Z Z₁ : ℝ → ℝ,
      F 0 = 1 ∧ F₁ 0 = 0 ∧ Z 0 = 1 ∧ Z₁ 0 = lam ∧
      (∀ t, HasDerivAt F (F₁ t) t) ∧ (∀ t, HasDerivAt Z (Z₁ t) t) ∧
      (∀ t, HasDerivAt (fun s => (1 + (σ ^ 2 * s ^ 2) ^ 2) * F₁ s)
        (2 * (1 - σ ^ 2 * (σ ^ 2 * t ^ 2)) * F t) t) ∧
      (∀ t, HasDerivAt (fun s => (1 + (σ ^ 2 * s ^ 2) ^ 2) * Z₁ s)
        (2 * (1 - σ ^ 2 * (σ ^ 2 * t ^ 2)) * Z t) t) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, |V t - Z t| + |U t + Z₁ t| ≤
        160000000 * e * Θ ^ 29 * (1 + lam) * F t) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 1 T, 0 < V t ∧
        |V t / Z t - 1| ≤ stabilityConstant * e * Θ ^ 29 ∧
        |U t / V t + Z₁ t / Z t| ≤ 10 * (stabilityConstant * e * Θ ^ 29))

name: EulerPacketStage.early_forward_exponential_suppression
statement:
theorem early_forward_exponential_suppression
    {σ Θ T lam δ : ℝ} {F F₁ Z Z₁ U V : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hσsmall : σ ≤ 1 / 4) (_hΘ : 1 ≤ Θ) (hT : T ≤ Θ)
    (hTtarget : 1 / σ ≤ T) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hδsmall : 4 * exp 6 * δ ≤ 1)
    (hF : ∀ t, HasDerivAt F (F₁ t) t) (hZ : ∀ t, HasDerivAt Z (Z₁ t) t)
    (hfluxF : ∀ t, HasDerivAt (fun s => (1 + (σ ^ 2 * s ^ 2) ^ 2) * F₁ s)
      (2 * (1 - σ ^ 2 * (σ ^ 2 * t ^ 2)) * F t) t)
    (hfluxZ : ∀ t, HasDerivAt (fun s => (1 + (σ ^ 2 * s ^ 2) ^ 2) * Z₁ s)
      (2 * (1 - σ ^ 2 * (σ ^ 2 * t ^ 2)) * Z t) t)
    (hF0 : F 0 = 1) (hF₁0 : F₁ 0 = 0) (hZ0 : Z 0 = 1) (hZ₁0 : Z₁ 0 = lam)
    (herror : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, |V t - Z t| + |U t + Z₁ t| ≤ δ * (1 + lam) * F t) :
    0 < V T ∧ ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 1,
      (|U s| + |V s|) / V T ≤ 84 * exp 9 * Θ * exp (-(1 / (4 * σ)))

name: EulerPacketUniformScaleChoice.uniform_source_cost_tsum_bound
statement:
theorem uniform_source_cost_tsum_bound
    (J d B N : ℕ) (hJ : 1 ≤ J) (hdJ : d < J)

    (hlarge : (4 * (|C| + |p| + 2 * |q|) / b) ^ 2 * (J : ℝ) ^ (2 * N + 2) ≤ x 0) :

name: EulerPacketUniformScaleSums.polynomial_scale_geometric_lower
statement:
theorem polynomial_scale_geometric_lower
    (J A : ℕ) (hJ : 1 ≤ J) (hJA : (2 : ℝ) ^ (A + 1) ≤ (J : ℝ) ^ 2)
    (x : ℕ → ℝ) (hx0 : 0 < x 0)
    (hx : ∀ n, x (n + 1) = ((J + n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 * x n) :
    ∀ n, (2 : ℝ) ^ n * (x 0 / (J : ℝ) ^ A) ≤ x n / ((J + n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ A

name: EulerPacketUniformScaleSums.source_exponential_bound_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem source_exponential_bound_tendsto_zero (J A : ℕ) (hJ : 1 ≤ J)
    (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) :
    Tendsto (fun X : ℝ => exp (-b * (X / (J : ℝ) ^ A)) /
      (1 - exp (-b * (X / (J : ℝ) ^ A)))) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: EulerPacketUniformScaleSums.source_exponential_geometric_majorant
statement:
theorem source_exponential_geometric_majorant
    (J A : ℕ) (hJ : 1 ≤ J) (hJA : (2 : ℝ) ^ (A + 1) ≤ (J : ℝ) ^ 2)
    (x : ℕ → ℝ) (hx0 : 0 < x 0)
    (hx : ∀ n, x (n + 1) = ((J + n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 * x n)
    (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) (n : ℕ) :
    exp (-b * (x n / ((J + n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ A)) ≤
      exp (-b * (x 0 / (J : ℝ) ^ A)) * exp (-b * (x 0 / (J : ℝ) ^ A)) ^ n

name: EulerPacketUniformScaleSums.source_exponential_tsum_bound
statement:
theorem source_exponential_tsum_bound
    (J A : ℕ) (hJ : 1 ≤ J) (hJA : (2 : ℝ) ^ (A + 1) ≤ (J : ℝ) ^ 2)
    (x : ℕ → ℝ) (hx0 : 0 < x 0)
    (hx : ∀ n, x (n + 1) = ((J + n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 * x n)
    (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) :
    (∑' n, exp (-b * (x n / ((J + n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ A))) ≤
      exp (-b * (x 0 / (J : ℝ) ^ A)) / (1 - exp (-b * (x 0 / (J : ℝ) ^ A)))

name: EulerPressureGevrey.pressure_gevrey_majorant
statement:
theorem pressure_gevrey_majorant {directions : Fin 4 → LiftTangent}
    {s : ℕ} {A : SmoothCoefficient period} {f : LiftL2 period}
    (K : CoefficientJet period directions s A) (J : SpatialJet period directions s f)
    (κ : ℝ) (m : Vector3) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hpos : ∀ x v, c * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪A.coefficient x v, v⟫_ℝ)
    (M Rc R : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hcM : c⁻¹ ≤ M) (hRc : 0 ≤ Rc)
    (hR : 2 * M * (Rc + 1) ≤ R) (d : ℕ)
    (hcoeff : ∀ l, 1 ≤ l → l ≤ s → boundLevel period K l ≤ majorant Rc 0 l)
    (hsource : ∀ n ≤ s, levelNorm period J n ≤ majorant R d n) (n : ℕ) :
    levelNorm period (J.solvePressure K κ m c hc hpos) n ≤ majorant R (d + 1) n

theorem pressure_word_sum_majorant {directions : Fin 4 → LiftTangent}

    (K : CoefficientJet period directions s A) (J : SpatialJet period directions s f)
    (κ : ℝ) (m : Vector3) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hpos : ∀ x v, c * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪A.coefficient x v, v⟫_ℝ)
    (M Rc R : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hcM : c⁻¹ ≤ M) (hRc : 0 ≤ Rc)
    (hR : 2 * M * (Rc + 1) ≤ R) (d : ℕ)
    (hcoeff : ∀ l, 1 ≤ l → l ≤ s → boundLevel period K l ≤ majorant Rc 0 l)
    (hsource : ∀ n ≤ s, levelNorm period J n ≤ majorant R d n) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ w : Fin n → Fin 4, ‖(J.solvePressure K κ m c hc hpos).word w‖) ≤ majorant R (d + 1) n

name: EulerPressureJetIdentities.SpatialJet.map_word
statement:
theorem map_word {s n : ℕ} {f : LiftL2 period}
    (J : EulerSpatialSobolevInverse.SpatialJet period directions s f)
    (L : LiftL2 period →L[ℝ] LiftL2 period)
    (hL : ∀ a f, translation period a (L f) = L (translation period a f))
    (w : Fin n → Fin 4) : (map L hL J).word w = L (J.word w)

name: EulerPressureJetIdentities.SpatialJet.pressure_word_inverse
statement:
theorem pressure_word_inverse {s n : ℕ} {A : SmoothCoefficient period}
    {f : LiftL2 period} (K : CoefficientJet period directions s A)
    (J : EulerSpatialSobolevInverse.SpatialJet period directions s f)
    (κ : ℝ) (m : Vector3) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hpos : ∀ x v, c * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪A.coefficient x v, v⟫_ℝ)
    (hn : n ≤ s) (w : Fin n → Fin 4) :
    (J.solvePressure K κ m c hc hpos).word w = A.pressure κ m c hc hpos
      (J.word w - ((EulerSpatialSobolevInverse.SpatialJet.multiply K
        (J.solvePressure K κ m c hc hpos)).word w -
          A.operator ((J.solvePressure K κ m c hc hpos).word w)))

name: EulerPressureJetIdentities.SpatialJet.pressure_word_norm_le
statement:
theorem pressure_word_norm_le {s n : ℕ} {A : SmoothCoefficient period}
    {f : LiftL2 period} (K : CoefficientJet period directions s A)
    (J : EulerSpatialSobolevInverse.SpatialJet period directions s f)
    (κ : ℝ) (m : Vector3) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hpos : ∀ x v, c * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪A.coefficient x v, v⟫_ℝ)
    (hn : n ≤ s) (w : Fin n → Fin 4) :
    ‖(J.solvePressure K κ m c hc hpos).word w‖ ≤ c⁻¹ *
      (‖J.word w‖ + ‖(EulerSpatialSobolevInverse.SpatialJet.multiply K
        (J.solvePressure K κ m c hc hpos)).word w -
          A.operator ((J.solvePressure K κ m c hc hpos).word w)‖)

theorem pressure_word_projected_equation {s n : ℕ} {A : SmoothCoefficient period}

name: EulerPressureSpatialRegularity.coefficientOperator_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem coefficientOperator_hasDerivAt
    (A A' : ℝ → α → V →L[ℝ] V)
    (hA : ∀ t, AEStronglyMeasurable (A t) μ)
    (hA' : AEStronglyMeasurable (A' 0) μ)
    (C D L : ℝ≥0) (hAb : ∀ t x, ‖A t x‖ ≤ C) (hDb : ∀ x, ‖A' 0 x‖ ≤ D)
    (hder : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => A s x) (A' t x) t)
    (hLip : ∀ t x, ‖A' t x - A' 0 x‖ ≤ L * |t|) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => coefficientOperator (A t) (hA t) C (hAb t))
      (coefficientOperator (A' 0) hA' D hDb) 0

name: EulerPressureSpatialRegularity.coefficientOperator_remainder_norm
statement:
theorem coefficientOperator_remainder_norm
    (A B D : α → V →L[ℝ] V)
    (hA : AEStronglyMeasurable A μ) (hB : AEStronglyMeasurable B μ)
    (hD : AEStronglyMeasurable D μ) (CA CB CD R : ℝ≥0)
    (hAb : ∀ x, ‖A x‖ ≤ CA) (hBb : ∀ x, ‖B x‖ ≤ CB) (hDb : ∀ x, ‖D x‖ ≤ CD)
    (t : ℝ) (hR : ∀ x, ‖A x - B x - t • D x‖ ≤ R) :
    ‖coefficientOperator A hA CA hAb - coefficientOperator B hB CB hBb -
      t • coefficientOperator D hD CD hDb‖ ≤ R

name: EulerPressureSpatialRegularity.coefficientOperator_translation
statement:
theorem coefficientOperator_translation (a : LiftDomain period)
    (A : LiftDomain period → Vector3 →L[ℝ] Vector3)
    (hA : AEStronglyMeasurable A (liftMeasure period))
    (C : ℝ≥0) (hAb : ∀ x, ‖A x‖ ≤ C) (f : LiftL2 period) :
    translation period a (coefficientOperator A hA C hAb f) =
      coefficientOperator (translatedCoefficient period a A)
        (translatedCoefficient_measurable period a A hA) C (fun x => hAb (x + a))
        (translation period a f)

name: EulerPressureSpatialRegularity.directionalDerivative_line_lipschitz
statement:
theorem directionalDerivative_line_lipschitz
    {V W : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V]

name: EulerPressureSpatialRegularity.liftedPressure_equation
statement:
theorem liftedPressure_equation (κ : ℝ) (m : Vector3)
    (A : LiftDomain period → Vector3 →L[ℝ] Vector3)
    (hA : AEStronglyMeasurable A (liftMeasure period))
    (C : ℝ≥0) (hAb : ∀ x, ‖A x‖ ≤ C) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hpos : ∀ x v, c * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪A x v, v⟫_ℝ) (f : LiftL2 period) :
    gradientProjection period κ m
      (coefficientOperator A hA C hAb (liftedPressure period κ m A hA C hAb c hc hpos f)) =
      gradientProjection period κ m f

name: EulerPressureSpatialRegularity.liftedPressure_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem liftedPressure_hasDerivAt (κ : ℝ) (m : Vector3)
    (A A' : ℝ → LiftDomain period → Vector3 →L[ℝ] Vector3)
    (hA : ∀ t, AEStronglyMeasurable (A t) (liftMeasure period))
    (hA' : AEStronglyMeasurable (A' 0) (liftMeasure period))
    (C D L : ℝ≥0) (hAb : ∀ t x, ‖A t x‖ ≤ C) (hDb : ∀ x, ‖A' 0 x‖ ≤ D)
    (hder : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => A s x) (A' t x) t)
    (hLip : ∀ t x, ‖A' t x - A' 0 x‖ ≤ L * |t|)
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hpos : ∀ t x v, c * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪A t x v, v⟫_ℝ)
    (f : ℝ → LiftL2 period) (f' : LiftL2 period) (hf : HasDerivAt f f' 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => liftedPressure period κ m (A t) (hA t) C (hAb t) c hc
      (hpos t) (f t))
      (liftedPressure period κ m (A 0) (hA 0) C (hAb 0) c hc (hpos 0)
        (f' - coefficientOperator (A' 0) hA' D hDb
          (liftedPressure period κ m (A 0) (hA 0) C (hAb 0) c hc (hpos 0) (f 0)))) 0

name: EulerPressureSpatialRegularity.liftedPressure_mem
statement:
theorem liftedPressure_mem (κ : ℝ) (m : Vector3)
    (A : LiftDomain period → Vector3 →L[ℝ] Vector3)

    (C : ℝ≥0) (hAb : ∀ x, ‖A x‖ ≤ C) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)

name: EulerPressureSpatialRegularity.liftedPressure_translation
statement:
theorem liftedPressure_translation (κ : ℝ) (m : Vector3) (a : LiftDomain period)
    (A : LiftDomain period → Vector3 →L[ℝ] Vector3)
    (hA : AEStronglyMeasurable A (liftMeasure period))
    (C : ℝ≥0) (hAb : ∀ x, ‖A x‖ ≤ C) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hpos : ∀ x v, c * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪A x v, v⟫_ℝ) (f : LiftL2 period) :
    translation period a (liftedPressure period κ m A hA C hAb c hc hpos f) =
      liftedPressure period κ m (translatedCoefficient period a A)
        (translatedCoefficient_measurable period a A hA) C (fun x => hAb (x + a)) c hc
        (fun x v => hpos (x + a) v) (translation period a f)

name: EulerPressureSpatialRegularity.liftedPressure_unique
statement:
theorem liftedPressure_unique (κ : ℝ) (m : Vector3)
    (A : LiftDomain period → Vector3 →L[ℝ] Vector3)
    (hA : AEStronglyMeasurable A (liftMeasure period))
    (C : ℝ≥0) (hAb : ∀ x, ‖A x‖ ≤ C) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)

    (heq : gradientProjection period κ m (coefficientOperator A hA C hAb p) =
      gradientProjection period κ m f) :
    p = liftedPressure period κ m A hA C hAb c hc hpos f

name: EulerPressureSpatialRegularity.pressure_translation_derivative_norm
statement:
theorem pressure_translation_derivative_norm (κ : ℝ) (m : Vector3) (a : LiftTangent)
    (A : LiftDomain period → Vector3 →L[ℝ] Vector3)
    (hA : AEStronglyMeasurable A (liftMeasure period))
    (hAs : ∀ x, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (localFieldLift period A x))
    (C D M : ℝ≥0) (hAb : ∀ x, ‖A x‖ ≤ C)
    (hDA : ∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ (localFieldLift period A x) 0‖ ≤ D)
    (hDDA : ∀ x y, ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (localFieldLift period A x)) y‖ ≤ M)
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hpos : ∀ x v, c * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪A x v, v⟫_ℝ)
    (f f' : LiftL2 period)
    (hf : HasDerivAt (fun t => translation period (translationPath period a t) f) f' 0) :
    ‖deriv (fun t => translation period (translationPath period a t)
      (liftedPressure period κ m A hA C hAb c hc hpos f)) 0‖ ≤
        c⁻¹ * (‖f'‖ + (D : ℝ) * ‖a‖ *
          ‖liftedPressure period κ m A hA C hAb c hc hpos f‖)

name: EulerPressureSpatialRegularity.pressure_translation_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem pressure_translation_hasDerivAt (κ : ℝ) (m : Vector3) (a : LiftTangent)
    (A : LiftDomain period → Vector3 →L[ℝ] Vector3)
    (hA : AEStronglyMeasurable A (liftMeasure period))
    (hAs : ∀ x, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (localFieldLift period A x))
    (C D M : ℝ≥0) (hAb : ∀ x, ‖A x‖ ≤ C)
    (hDA : ∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ (localFieldLift period A x) 0‖ ≤ D)
    (hDDA : ∀ x y, ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (localFieldLift period A x)) y‖ ≤ M)
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hpos : ∀ x v, c * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪A x v, v⟫_ℝ)
    (f f' : LiftL2 period)
    (hf : HasDerivAt (fun t => translation period (translationPath period a t) f) f' 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => translation period (translationPath period a t)
      (liftedPressure period κ m A hA C hAb c hc hpos f))
      (liftedPressure period κ m A hA C hAb c hc hpos
        (f' - coefficientOperator (translatedCoefficientDerivative period a A 0)
          (translatedCoefficientDerivative_measurable period a A hAs) (D * ‖a‖₊)
          (fun x => translatedCoefficientDerivative_bound period a A D hDA x)
          (liftedPressure period κ m A hA C hAb c hc hpos f))) 0

name: EulerRealCylinder.real_cylinder_H6_algebra
statement:

name: EulerRealMixedTransport.coordinate_vectorCommutator
statement:
theorem coordinate_vectorCommutator {n : ℕ} (w : Fin n → Fin 4) (q : ℕ) (i : Fin q)

name: EulerRealMixedTransport.real_word_commutator_memLp

name: EulerRealMixedTransport.real_word_transport_commutator_L2
statement:
theorem real_word_transport_commutator_L2 {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≤ 6) (w : Fin n → Fin 4)

    (hhL2 : ∀ r ≤ 5, ∀ v : Fin r → Fin 4, MemLp (iteratedFieldDerivative period v h) 2 (liftMeasure period)) :

name: EulerRealMixedTransport.vector_word_transport_commutator_L2

    (hhL2 : ∀ r ≤ 5, ∀ v : Fin r → Fin 4, MemLp (iteratedFieldDerivative period v h) 2 (liftMeasure period)) :

name: EulerRepresentativeMetricEvolution.liftedTransport_ae
statement:
theorem liftedTransport_ae (κ : ℝ) (m : Vector3) (g : LiftDomain period → Vector3) (z : LiftL2 period)
    (hDe : MemLp (fun x => fderiv ℝ (localFieldLift period g x) 0)
      2 (liftMeasure period)) (B : ℝ≥0)
    (hzB : ∀ᵐ x ∂liftMeasure period, ‖z x‖ ≤ B) :
    liftedTransport period κ m g z hDe B hzB =ᵐ[liftMeasure period]
      fun x => fderiv ℝ (localFieldLift period g x) 0
        (transportDirection κ m (z x))

name: EulerRepresentativeMetricEvolution.lifted_regularized_energy_evolution
statement:
theorem lifted_regularized_energy_evolution (κ : ℝ) (m : Vector3)
    (K : ℝ → LiftDomain period → Vector3 →L[ℝ] Vector3)
    (hKm : ∀ t, AEStronglyMeasurable (K t) (liftMeasure period))
    (C : ℝ≥0) (hC : ∀ t x, ‖K t x‖ ≤ C)
    (e : ℝ → LiftL2 period) (t δ c : ℝ)
    (K' : LiftL2 period →L[ℝ] LiftL2 period) (e' z p forcing : LiftL2 period)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hKt : HasDerivAt (metricFamily period K hKm C hC) K' t) (het : HasDerivAt e e' t)
    (hKs : ∀ x, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (localFieldLift period (K t) x))
    (g : LiftDomain period → Vector3)
    (hrep : (e t : LiftDomain period → Vector3) =ᵐ[liftMeasure period] g)
    (hes : ∀ x, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (localFieldLift period g x))
    (hDe : MemLp (fun x => fderiv ℝ (localFieldLift period g x) 0)
      2 (liftMeasure period))
    (hsym : ∀ x v w, ⟪K t x v, w⟫_ℝ = ⟪v, K t x w⟫_ℝ)
    (hpos : ∀ x v, c ^ 2 * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪K t x v, v⟫_ℝ)
    (G : LiftDomain period → Vector3 →L[ℝ] Vector3)
    (hGm : AEStronglyMeasurable G (liftMeasure period)) (E : ℝ≥0) (hG : ∀ x, ‖G x‖ ≤ E)
    (hKG : ∀ x v, K t x (G x v) = v)
    (hep : e t ∈ divergenceFreeSpace period κ m) (hp : p ∈ gradientSpace period κ m)
    (hz : z ∈ divergenceFreeSpace period κ m) (D B : ℝ≥0)
    (hD : ∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ (localFieldLift period (K t) x) 0‖ ≤ D)
    (hzB : ∀ᵐ x ∂liftMeasure period, ‖z x‖ ≤ B)
    (heq : e' + liftedTransport period κ m g z hDe B hzB +
      coefficientOperator G hGm E hG p = forcing) :
    deriv (fun s => Real.sqrt (⟪metricFamily period K hKm C hC s (e s), e s⟫_ℝ + δ ^ 2)) t ≤
      ((‖K'‖ + (D : ℝ) * ((|κ| + ‖m‖) * B)) / (2 * c ^ 2)) *
        Real.sqrt (⟪metricFamily period K hKm C hC t (e t), e t⟫_ℝ + δ ^ 2) +
      ((C : ℝ) / c) * ‖forcing‖

name: EulerRepresentativeMetricEvolution.metric_transport_inner_bound
statement:
theorem metric_transport_inner_bound (κ : ℝ) (m : Vector3)
    (K : LiftDomain period → Vector3 →L[ℝ] Vector3)
    (hKm : AEStronglyMeasurable K (liftMeasure period))
    (e : LiftL2 period) (g : LiftDomain period → Vector3) (z : LiftL2 period)
    (hrep : (e : LiftDomain period → Vector3) =ᵐ[liftMeasure period] g)
    (hK : ∀ x, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (localFieldLift period K x))
    (he : ∀ x, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (localFieldLift period g x))
    (hDe : MemLp (fun x => fderiv ℝ (localFieldLift period g x) 0)
      2 (liftMeasure period))
    (hsym : ∀ x v w, ⟪K x v, w⟫_ℝ = ⟪v, K x w⟫_ℝ)
    (hz : z ∈ divergenceFreeSpace period κ m)
    (C D B : ℝ≥0) (hC : ∀ x, ‖K x‖ ≤ C)
    (hD : ∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ (localFieldLift period K x) 0‖ ≤ D)
    (hzB : ∀ᵐ x ∂liftMeasure period, ‖z x‖ ≤ B) :
    |⟪coefficientOperator K hKm C hC e, liftedTransport period κ m g z hDe B hzB⟫_ℝ| ≤
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * D * ((|κ| + ‖m‖) * B) * ‖e‖ ^ 2

name: EulerRepresentativeMetricEvolution.metric_transport_inner_eq
statement:
theorem metric_transport_inner_eq (κ : ℝ) (m : Vector3)
    (K : LiftDomain period → Vector3 →L[ℝ] Vector3)
    (hKm : AEStronglyMeasurable K (liftMeasure period)) (C : ℝ≥0) (hC : ∀ x, ‖K x‖ ≤ C)
    (e : LiftL2 period) (g : LiftDomain period → Vector3) (z : LiftL2 period)
    (hrep : (e : LiftDomain period → Vector3) =ᵐ[liftMeasure period] g)
    (hDe : MemLp (fun x => fderiv ℝ (localFieldLift period g x) 0)
      2 (liftMeasure period)) (B : ℝ≥0)
    (hzB : ∀ᵐ x ∂liftMeasure period, ‖z x‖ ≤ B) :
    ⟪coefficientOperator K hKm C hC e, liftedTransport period κ m g z hDe B hzB⟫_ℝ =
      ∫ x, ⟪K x (g x), fderiv ℝ (localFieldLift period g x) 0
        (transportDirection κ m (z x))⟫_ℝ ∂liftMeasure period

name: EulerScale.initial_increment_majorants_summable
statement:
theorem initial_increment_majorants_summable (J : ℕ) (hJ : 2 ≤ J)
    (Cbase Cstar : ℝ) (hCbase : 1 ≤ Cbase) (hCstar : 0 ≤ Cstar)
    (x : ℕ → ℝ) (hx0 : 1 ≤ x 0)
    (hx : ∀ n, x (n + 1) = ((J + n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 * x n)
    (m C b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) :
    Summable (fun n => Real.exp (-b * x n +
      m * (x n / ((J + n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) +
      m * (x n / ((J + n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (7 / 2 : ℝ)) +
      C * Real.log (sourceParameterAggregate J Cbase Cstar x n))) ∧
    Summable (fun n => Real.exp (-2 * (x n / ((J + n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) +
      m * (x n / ((J + n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (7 / 2 : ℝ)) +
      C * Real.log (sourceParameterAggregate J Cbase Cstar x n)))

name: EulerScale.polynomial_log_over_growth_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem polynomial_log_over_growth_tendsto_zero (J : ℕ) (hJ : 1 ≤ J) (x : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hx0 : 0 < x 0) (hx : ∀ n, x (n + 1) = ((J + n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 * x n)
    (A : ℕ) :
    Tendsto (fun n => ((J + n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ A * Real.log (x n) / x n) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: EulerScale.polynomial_over_growth_summable
statement:
theorem polynomial_over_growth_summable (J : ℕ) (hJ : 1 ≤ J) (x : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hx0 : 0 < x 0) (hx : ∀ n, x (n + 1) = ((J + n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 * x n)

name: EulerScale.polynomial_stage_log_over_growth_summable

theorem polynomial_stage_log_over_growth_summable (J : ℕ) (hJ : 1 ≤ J) (x : ℕ → ℝ)

name: EulerScale.quadratic_growth_one_le
statement:
theorem quadratic_growth_one_le (J : ℕ) (hJ : 1 ≤ J) (x : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hx0 : 1 ≤ x 0) (hx : ∀ n, x (n + 1) = ((J + n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 * x n) :

name: EulerScale.quadratic_growth_pos
statement:
theorem quadratic_growth_pos (J : ℕ) (hJ : 1 ≤ J) (x : ℕ → ℝ)

name: EulerScale.sourceParameterAggregate_eq
statement:
theorem sourceParameterAggregate_eq (J : ℕ) (hJ : 1 ≤ J) (Cbase Cstar : ℝ)
    (hCbase : 0 < Cbase) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (hxp : ∀ n, 0 < x n) (n : ℕ) :
    sourceParameterAggregate J Cbase Cstar x n = Cbase +
      Real.exp (Cstar * x n / ((J - 1 + n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 4) +
      Real.exp (x n / ((J + n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (7 / 2 : ℝ)) +
      Real.exp (x n / ((J + n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 3) +
      Real.exp (x n / ((J + n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 5) +
      Real.exp (x n / ((J - 1 + n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 7) +
      ((J + n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 * x n + x n

name: EulerScale.sourceParameterExponent_nonneg
statement:
theorem sourceParameterExponent_nonneg (J : ℕ) (hJ : 2 ≤ J)
    (Cbase Cstar : ℝ) (hCbase : 1 ≤ Cbase) (hCstar : 0 ≤ Cstar)
    (x : ℕ → ℝ) (hx0 : 1 ≤ x 0)
    (hx : ∀ n, x (n + 1) = ((J + n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 * x n) :
    ∀ i n, 0 ≤ sourceParameterExponent J Cbase Cstar x i n

name: EulerScale.sourceParameterExponent_relative_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem sourceParameterExponent_relative_tendsto_zero (J : ℕ) (hJ : 2 ≤ J)
    (Cbase Cstar : ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (hx0 : 0 < x 0)
    (hx : ∀ n, x (n + 1) = ((J + n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 * x n) :
    ∀ i, Tendsto (fun n => sourceParameterExponent J Cbase Cstar x i n *
      (((J + n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 / x n)) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: EulerScale.source_parameters_separated
statement:
theorem source_parameters_separated (J : ℕ) (hJ : 2 ≤ J)
    (Cbase Cstar : ℝ) (hCbase : 1 ≤ Cbase) (hCstar : 0 ≤ Cstar)
    (x : ℕ → ℝ) (hx0 : 1 ≤ x 0)
    (hx : ∀ n, x (n + 1) = ((J + n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 * x n) :
    Tendsto (fun n => Real.log (sourceParameterAggregate J Cbase Cstar x n) /
      (x n / ((J + n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2)) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: EulerScale.stage_inv_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem stage_inv_tendsto_zero (J : ℕ) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (((J + n : ℕ) : ℝ))⁻¹) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: EulerScale.stage_sq_div_predecessor_power_tendsto_zero

theorem stage_sq_div_predecessor_power_tendsto_zero (J : ℕ) (hJ : 2 ≤ J)
    (A : ℕ) (hA : 3 ≤ A) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ((J + n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 / ((J - 1 + n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ A)

name: EulerScale.stage_sq_div_real_power_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem stage_sq_div_real_power_tendsto_zero (J : ℕ) (hJ : 1 ≤ J)

name: EulerSetIntegralL2.euclideanCover_neg

theorem mollify_setIntegral (n : ℕ) (f : LiftL2 period) (s : Set (LiftDomain period))

        ∂liftMeasure period

theorem setIntegralL2_apply (s : Set X) (hs : MeasurableSet s) (hμs : μ s ≠ ⊤)

name: EulerSmoothLimit.compactSupport_sum

name: EulerSmoothLimit.divergence_free_sum
statement:
theorem divergence_free_sum (f : ℕ → Space → Space) (v : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ n, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (f n)) (hv : ∀ k, Summable (v k))
    (hb : ∀ k n x, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (f n) x‖ ≤ v k n)
    (hdiv : ∀ n x, divergence (f n) x = 0) :
    ∀ x, divergence (fun y => ∑' n, f n y) x = 0

name: EulerSmoothLimit.divergence_sum
statement:
theorem divergence_sum (f : ℕ → Space → Space) (v : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ n, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (f n)) (hv : ∀ k, Summable (v k))

name: EulerSmoothLimit.finite_energy_sum
statement:
theorem finite_energy_sum (f : ℕ → Space → Space) (v : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)

name: EulerSmoothLimit.iterated_derivative_sum
statement:
theorem iterated_derivative_sum (f : ℕ → Space → Space) (v : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)

theorem memLp_iterated_derivative_sum (f : ℕ → Space → Space) (v : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)

name: EulerSmoothLimit.memLp_sum
statement:
theorem memLp_sum (f : ℕ → Space → Space) (v : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)

name: EulerSmoothLimit.odd_sum
statement:
theorem odd_sum (f : ℕ → Space → Space) (hodd : ∀ n x, f n (-x) = -f n x) :
    ∀ x, (∑' n, f n (-x)) = -(∑' n, f n x)

name: EulerSmoothLimit.smooth_compact_solenoidal_limit
statement:
theorem smooth_compact_solenoidal_limit (f : ℕ → Space → Space) (v : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ n, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (f n)) (hv : ∀ k, Summable (v k))
    (hb : ∀ k n x, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (f n) x‖ ≤ v k n)
    (K : Set Space) (hK : IsCompact K) (hsupp : ∀ n, Function.support (f n) ⊆ K)
    (hdiv : ∀ n x, divergence (f n) x = 0) :
    ∃ u : Space → Space,
      (∀ x, HasSum (fun n => f n x) (u x)) ∧
      TendstoUniformly (fun N x => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f n x) u atTop ∧
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ u ∧ tsupport u ⊆ K ∧ HasCompactSupport u ∧
      MemLp u 2 volume ∧ Integrable (fun x => ‖u x‖ ^ 2) volume ∧
      (∀ x, divergence u x = 0) ∧
      (∀ k x, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k u x = ∑' n, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (f n) x)

name: EulerSmoothPressureRepresentative.exists_smooth_pressure
statement:
theorem exists_smooth_pressure (A : SmoothCoefficient period) (f : LiftL2 period)
    (K : ∀ s : ℕ, CoefficientJet period standardDirection s A)
    (J : ∀ s : ℕ, SpatialJet period standardDirection s f)
    (κ : ℝ) (m : Vector3) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hpos : ∀ x v, c * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ inner ℝ (A.coefficient x v) v) :
    ∃ p : LiftDomain period → Vector3,
      (∀ x, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (localFieldLift period p x)) ∧
      (A.pressure κ m c hc hpos f : LiftDomain period → Vector3) =ᵐ[liftMeasure period] p

name: EulerSmoothPressureRepresentative.exists_smooth_representative

      (U : LiftDomain period → Vector3) =ᵐ[liftMeasure period] g

name: EulerSmoothSobolev.coordinateDerivative_H2_le_H3

theorem coordinateDerivative_H2_le_H3 (i : Fin 3) (f : Domain 3 → F)

theorem coordinateDerivative_smooth (i : Fin 3) (f : Domain 3 → F) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) :

statement:

name: EulerSmoothSobolev.derivativeMagnitude_nonneg

name: EulerSmoothSobolev.fourier_pureDerivative_norm

theorem fourier_pureDerivative_norm (d n : ℕ) (v : Domain d)

name: EulerSmoothSobolev.localize_apply
statement:

name: EulerSmoothSobolev.localize_pureDerivative_L2_le
statement:
theorem localize_pureDerivative_L2_le (n : ℕ) (i : Fin 3) (f : Domain 3 → F)

    ‖(pureDerivative 3 n (EuclideanSpace.single i 1) (localize f hf x)).toLp 2‖ ≤

name: EulerSmoothSobolev.localize_tensor_bound

name: EulerSmoothSobolev.normLp_le_sum
statement:
theorem normLp_le_sum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (d : ℕ) (f : 𝓢(Domain d, F))

name: EulerSmoothSobolev.pointwise_le_L2_second_derivatives
statement:

name: EulerSmoothSobolev.real_smooth_fderiv_le_H3

name: EulerSmoothSobolev.smooth_fderiv_le_H3

name: EulerSmoothTensorLimit.cylinder_smooth_of_uniformCauchy_words
statement:

name: EulerSobolev.smooth_compact_solenoidal_limit_of_sobolev
statement:
theorem smooth_compact_solenoidal_limit_of_sobolev
    (f : ℕ → Space → Space) (hf : ∀ n, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (f n))
    (hc : ∀ n, HasCompactSupport (f n))
    (hSob : ∀ k : ℕ, Summable (fun n =>
      compactSobolevNorm 3 3 (2 + k) (f n) (hf n) (hc n)))
    (K : Set Space) (hK : IsCompact K) (hsupp : ∀ n, Function.support (f n) ⊆ K)
    (hdiv : ∀ n x, divergence (f n) x = 0) :
    ∃ u : Space → Space,
      (∀ x, HasSum (fun n => f n x) (u x)) ∧
      TendstoUniformly (fun N x => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f n x) u atTop ∧
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ u ∧ tsupport u ⊆ K ∧ HasCompactSupport u ∧
      MemLp u 2 volume ∧ Integrable (fun x => ‖u x‖ ^ 2) volume ∧
      (∀ x, divergence u x = 0) ∧
      (∀ k x, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k u x = ∑' n, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (f n) x)

name: EulerSobolevBreakdown.no_gradient_escape_from_sobolev_energy
statement:
theorem no_gradient_escape_from_sobolev_energy
    (u : ℝ → Space → Space) (U : ℕ → ℝ → Space → Space)
    (X X' : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (ε times : ℕ → ℝ) (C S : ℝ)
    (hC : 0 < C) (hS : 0 ≤ S) (hε : ∀ n, 0 < ε n)
    (hεlim : Tendsto ε atTop (nhds 0))
    (hu : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 S, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (u t))
    (hU : ∀ n t, t ∈ Icc 0 S → ContDiff ℝ ∞ (U n t))
    (hL2 : ∀ n t, t ∈ Icc 0 S → ∀ j ≤ 3,
      MemLp (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun x => U n t x - u t x)) 2 volume)
    (hmajor : ∀ n t, t ∈ Icc 0 S →
      realTensorSobolevNorm 3 3 (fun x => U n t x - u t x) ≤ X n t)
    (hcont : ∀ n, ContinuousOn (X n) (Icc 0 S))
    (hinit : ∀ n, X n 0 ≤ ε n)
    (hder : ∀ n t, t ∈ Ico 0 S → HasDerivAt (X n) (X' n t) t)
    (hineq : ∀ n t, t ∈ Ico 0 S → X' n t ≤ C * (X n t + (X n t) ^ 2))
    (href : ContinuousOn (fun t => fderiv ℝ (u t) 0) (Icc 0 S))
    (ht : ∀ n, times n ∈ Icc 0 S) :
    ¬ Tendsto (fun n => ‖fderiv ℝ (U n (times n)) 0‖) atTop atTop

name: EulerSobolevProducts.directional_product
statement:
theorem directional_product (d n : ℕ) (v : Domain d) (f g : 𝓢(Domain d, ℂ)) :
    directional d n v (product d f g) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose j : ℂ) •

name: EulerSobolevProducts.directional_product_L2_le

    ‖(directional d n v (product d f g)).toLp 2‖ ≤

name: EulerSobolevProducts.normLp_le_sum

name: EulerSobolevTransport.transport_commutator_L2

    (hpos : ∀ x v, c * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪A.coefficient x v, v⟫_ℝ)

statement:
theorem localized_boundary_lower_bound {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (M A R : E →L[ℝ] E) (Be Bc C₁ C₂ r L : ℝ)
    (hBc : 0 ≤ Bc) (hC : 0 ≤ L - Bc * C₁)
    (hA : ∀ z, 0 ≤ ⟪A z, z⟫_ℝ)
    (hM : ∀ z, -Be * ‖z‖ ^ 2 - Bc * ‖R z‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪M z, z⟫_ℝ)
    (hR : ∀ z, ‖R z‖ ^ 2 ≤ C₁ * ⟪A z, z⟫_ℝ + C₂ * r ^ 3 * ‖z‖ ^ 2)
    (z : E) :
    -(Be + C₂ * Bc * r ^ 3) * ‖z‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ⟪M z, z⟫_ℝ + L * ⟪A z, z⟫_ℝ

name: EulerTerminalEnergy.mean_form_coercive
statement:
theorem mean_form_coercive {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    (η v : ℝ → E) (H : ℝ → E →L[ℝ] E) (M A : E →L[ℝ] E)
    (S K B L : ℝ) (hS0 : 0 ≤ S) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hsmall : K * S ^ 2 / 2 + B * S ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hv : ContinuousOn v (Icc 0 S)) (hH : ContinuousOn H (Icc 0 S))
    (hη : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 S, HasDerivAt η (v t) t) (hS : η S = 0)
    (hpot : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 S, ∀ z, ⟪H t z, z⟫_ℝ ≤ K * ‖z‖ ^ 2)
    (hboundary : ∀ z, -B * ‖z‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪M z, z⟫_ℝ + L * ⟪A z, z⟫_ℝ) :
    (∫ t in 0..S, ‖v t‖ ^ 2) / 2 ≤
      (∫ t in 0..S, ‖v t‖ ^ 2 - ⟪H t (η t), η t⟫_ℝ) +
        ⟪M (η 0), η 0⟫_ℝ + L * ⟪A (η 0), η 0⟫_ℝ

name: EulerVectorCalculus.partialDerivative_linearPotential
statement:
theorem partialDerivative_linearPotential (L : Space →L[ℝ] Space) (i j : Fin 3)
    (x : Space) :

      -((EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ) : Space) (i + 1) * (L x) (i + 2) +
        x (i + 1) * (L (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) (i + 2) -
        ((EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ) : Space) (i + 2) * (L x) (i + 1) +
        x (i + 2) * (L (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) (i + 1))) / 3

name: EulerVectorCylinder.cylinder_H6_scalar_vector_product
statement:
theorem cylinder_H6_scalar_vector_product (q : ℕ) (f : LiftDomain period → ℝ)
    (g : LiftDomain period → Domain q)
    (hf : ∀ x, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (localFieldLift period f x))
    (hg : ∀ x, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (localFieldLift period g x))
    (hfL2 : ∀ j ≤ 6, ∀ v : Fin j → Fin 4, MemLp (iteratedFieldDerivative period v f) 2 (liftMeasure period))
    (hgL2 : ∀ j ≤ 6, ∀ v : Fin j → Fin 4, MemLp (iteratedFieldDerivative period v g) 2 (liftMeasure period)) :
    liftSobolevNorm period 6 (fun x => f x • g x) ≤
      ((q : ℝ) * (5461 * 128 * lowDerivativeConstant period)) *
        liftSobolevNorm period 6 f * liftSobolevNorm period 6 g

name: EulerWeightedConvolution.external_commutator_sum
statement:
theorem external_commutator_sum (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (N : ℕ) (a b : ℕ → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ n, 0 ≤ a n) (hb : ∀ n, 0 ≤ b n) :
    (∑ n ∈ range (N + 1), ∑ l ∈ range n,
      weight ρ n * (n.choose (l + 1) : ℝ) * a (l + 1) * b (n - l)) ≤
      ρ⁻¹ * (∑ l ∈ range (N + 1), weight ρ l * a l) *
        (∑ j ∈ range (N + 1), (j : ℝ) * weight ρ j * b j)

name: EulerWeightedConvolution.external_commutator_term
statement:
theorem external_commutator_term (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (j l : ℕ) (hl : 1 ≤ l)
    (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    weight ρ (j + l) * ((j + l).choose l : ℝ) * a * b ≤
      ρ⁻¹ * (weight ρ l * a) * (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * weight ρ (j + 1) * b)

name: EulerWeightedConvolution.shifted_source_sum
statement:
theorem shifted_source_sum (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (N : ℕ) (a b : ℕ → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ n, 0 ≤ a n) (hb : ∀ n, 0 ≤ b n) :
    (∑ n ∈ range N, ∑ l ∈ range (n + 1),
      ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * weight ρ (n + 1) * (n.choose l : ℝ) * a l * b (n - l + 1)) ≤
      2 * (∑ l ∈ range (N + 1), weight ρ l * a l) *
        (∑ j ∈ range (N + 1), (j : ℝ) * weight ρ j * b j)

name: EulerWeightedConvolution.shifted_source_term
statement:
theorem shifted_source_term (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (j l : ℕ)
    (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    ((j + l + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * weight ρ (j + l + 1) * ((j + l).choose l : ℝ) * a * b ≤
      (weight ρ l * a) * (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * weight ρ (j + 1) * b)

name: EulerWeightedConvolution.shifted_triangular_sum_le_product
statement:
theorem shifted_triangular_sum_le_product (N : ℕ) (a b : ℕ → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ n, 0 ≤ a n) (hb : ∀ n, 0 ≤ b n) :
    (∑ n ∈ range N, ∑ l ∈ range (n + 1), a l * b (n - l + 1)) ≤
      2 * (∑ l ∈ range (N + 1), a l) * (∑ j ∈ range (N + 1), b j)

name: EulerWeightedConvolution.triangular_sum_le_product
statement:
theorem triangular_sum_le_product (N : ℕ) (a b : ℕ → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ n, 0 ≤ a n) (hb : ∀ n, 0 ≤ b n) :
    (∑ n ∈ range (N + 1), ∑ l ∈ range n, a (l + 1) * b (n - l)) ≤
      (∑ l ∈ range (N + 1), a l) * (∑ j ∈ range (N + 1), b j)

name: EulerWeightedEnergy.finite_weighted_energy_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem finite_weighted_energy_hasDerivAt
    (ρ : ℝ → ℝ) (ρ' t : ℝ) (hρ : HasDerivAt ρ ρ' t) (hpos : 0 < ρ t)
    (E : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (E' : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ)
    (hE : ∀ n ∈ range (N + 1), HasDerivAt (E n) (E' n) t) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => ∑ n ∈ range (N + 1), weight (ρ s) n * E n s)
      ((∑ n ∈ range (N + 1), weight (ρ t) n * E' n) +
        (ρ' / ρ t) * ∑ n ∈ range (N + 1), (n : ℝ) * weight (ρ t) n * E n t) t

name: EulerWeightedEnergy.weight_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem weight_hasDerivAt (ρ : ℝ → ℝ) (ρ' t : ℝ) (hρ : HasDerivAt ρ ρ' t)
    (hpos : 0 < ρ t) (n : ℕ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => weight (ρ s) n)
      ((ρ' / ρ t) * (n : ℝ) * weight (ρ t) n) t

name: EulerWeightedPressure.geometric_lower_triangle
statement:
theorem geometric_lower_triangle (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hhalf : q ≤ 1 / 2)
    (N : ℕ) (b : ℕ → ℝ) (hb : ∀ n, 0 ≤ b n) :
    (∑ n ∈ range (N + 1), ∑ l ∈ range n, q ^ (l + 1) * b (n - (l + 1))) ≤
      (2 * q) * ∑ j ∈ range (N + 1), b j

name: EulerWeightedPressure.lower_triangle_sum_le_product
statement:
theorem lower_triangle_sum_le_product (N : ℕ) (a b : ℕ → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ n, 0 ≤ a n) (hb : ∀ n, 0 ≤ b n) :
    (∑ n ∈ range (N + 1), ∑ l ∈ range n, a (l + 1) * b (n - (l + 1))) ≤
      (∑ l ∈ range (N + 1), a l) * (∑ j ∈ range (N + 1), b j)

name: EulerWeightedPressure.pressure_shifted_weighted_bound
statement:
theorem pressure_shifted_weighted_bound (period : ℝ) [Fact (0 < period)]
    {directions : Fin 4 → LiftTangent} {s : ℕ}
    {A : SmoothCoefficient period} {f : LiftL2 period}
    (K : CoefficientJet period directions s A) (J : SpatialJet period directions s f)
    (κ : ℝ) (m : Vector3) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hpos : ∀ x v, c * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ inner ℝ (A.coefficient x v) v)
    (ρ Rc M : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hRc : 0 ≤ Rc) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hcM : c⁻¹ ≤ M)
    (hsmall : 4 * M * (ρ * Rc) ≤ 1)
    (hcoeff : ∀ l, 1 ≤ l → l ≤ s → boundLevel period K l ≤ majorant Rc 0 l) :
    (∑ n ∈ range (s + 1), ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * weight ρ (n + 1) *
      levelNorm period (J.solvePressure K κ m c hc hpos) n) ≤
      2 * M * ∑ n ∈ range (s + 1), ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * weight ρ (n + 1) *
        levelNorm period J n

name: EulerWeightedPressure.shifted_weight_kernel
statement:
theorem shifted_weight_kernel (ρ Rc : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hRc : 0 ≤ Rc)
    (j l : ℕ) (Z : ℝ) (hZ : 0 ≤ Z) :
    ((j + l + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * weight ρ (j + l + 1) * ((j + l).choose l : ℝ) *
      (Rc ^ l * (l.factorial : ℝ) ^ 2) * Z ≤
    (ρ * Rc) ^ l * (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * weight ρ (j + 1) * Z)

name: EulerWeightedPressure.shifted_weighted_inverse
statement:
theorem shifted_weighted_inverse (ρ Rc M : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hRc : 0 ≤ Rc)
    (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hsmall : 4 * M * (ρ * Rc) ≤ 1)
    (N : ℕ) (A F Z : ℕ → ℝ) (_hF : ∀ n, 0 ≤ F n) (hZ : ∀ n, 0 ≤ Z n)
    (hA : ∀ l, 1 ≤ l → l ≤ N → A l ≤ Rc ^ l * (l.factorial : ℝ) ^ 2)
    (hrec : ∀ n ≤ N, Z n ≤ M * (F n + ∑ l ∈ range n,
      (n.choose (l + 1) : ℝ) * A (l + 1) * Z (n - (l + 1)))) :
    (∑ n ∈ range (N + 1), ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * weight ρ (n + 1) * Z n) ≤
      2 * M * ∑ n ∈ range (N + 1), ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * weight ρ (n + 1) * F n

    (∑ r ∈ Finset.range (q + 1), leibnizConvolution A B r) ≤

        (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (q + 1), B j)

EulerH6Pressure.multiply_base_block_bound

theorem multiply_base_block_bound {s q : ℕ} {A : SmoothCoefficient period} {f : LiftL2 period}

statement:
theorem triangle_sum_le_product (q : ℕ) (A B : ℕ → ℝ)

    (∑ r ∈ Finset.range (q + 1), ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), A l * B (r - l)) ≤
      (∑ l ∈ Finset.range (q + 1), A l) * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (q + 1), B j)

statement:
theorem commutatorBlock_bound {s q n : ℕ} {A : SmoothCoefficient period} {f : LiftL2 period}

name: EulerH6Pressure.commutatorBlock_nonneg
EulerH6Pressure.commutatorBlock_succ_le
statement:
theorem commutatorBlock_succ_le {s q n : ℕ} {A : SmoothCoefficient period} {f : LiftL2 period}
    (K : EulerSpatialSobolevInverse.CoefficientJet period directions (s + 1) A)
    (J : EulerSpatialSobolevInverse.SpatialJet period directions (s + 1) f) (h : n + q ≤ s) :
    commutatorBlock K J q (n + 1) ≤
      match K, J with
      | .succ _ lowerA _, .succ _ lowerF _ =>
          ∑ i, (commutatorBlock K.truncate (lowerF i) q n +
            blockNorm period (EulerSpatialSobolevInverse.SpatialJet.multiply (lowerA i) J.truncate) q n)

name: EulerH6Pressure.pressure_block_inverse
statement:
theorem pressure_block_inverse {s q n : ℕ} {A : SmoothCoefficient period} {f : LiftL2 period}
    (K : EulerSpatialSobolevInverse.CoefficientJet period directions s A)
    (J : EulerSpatialSobolevInverse.SpatialJet period directions s f)
    (κ : ℝ) (m : Vector3) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hpos : ∀ x v, c * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪A.coefficient x v, v⟫_ℝ)
    (hq : q ≤ s) (h : n + q ≤ s) :
    blockNorm period (J.solvePressure K κ m c hc hpos) q n ≤
      (CoefficientJet.restrict K q hq).pressureConstant c *
        (blockNorm period J q n + commutatorBlock K (J.solvePressure K κ m c hc hpos) q n)

name: EulerH6Pressure.pressure_block_recurrence
statement:
theorem pressure_block_recurrence {s q n : ℕ} {A : SmoothCoefficient period} {f : LiftL2 period}
    (K : EulerSpatialSobolevInverse.CoefficientJet period directions s A)
    (J : EulerSpatialSobolevInverse.SpatialJet period directions s f)
    (κ : ℝ) (m : Vector3) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hpos : ∀ x v, c * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪A.coefficient x v, v⟫_ℝ)
    (hq : q ≤ s) (h : n + q ≤ s) (M : ℝ)
    (hM : (CoefficientJet.restrict K q hq).pressureConstant c ≤ M) :
    blockNorm period (J.solvePressure K κ m c hc hpos) q n ≤
      M * (blockNorm period J q n + ∑ l ∈ Finset.range n,
        (n.choose (l + 1) : ℝ) * coefficientBlock period K q (l + 1) *
          blockNorm period (J.solvePressure K κ m c hc hpos) q (n - (l + 1)))

name: EulerH6Pressure.pressure_shifted_Hq_bound
statement:
theorem pressure_shifted_Hq_bound {s q : ℕ} {A : SmoothCoefficient period} {f : LiftL2 period}
    (K : EulerSpatialSobolevInverse.CoefficientJet period directions s A)
    (J : EulerSpatialSobolevInverse.SpatialJet period directions s f)
    (κ : ℝ) (m : Vector3) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hpos : ∀ x v, c * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪A.coefficient x v, v⟫_ℝ)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : N + q ≤ s) (hq : q ≤ s)
    (ρ Rc M : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hRc : 0 ≤ Rc) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (hbase : (CoefficientJet.restrict K q hq).pressureConstant c ≤ M)
    (hsmall : 4 * M * (ρ * Rc) ≤ 1)
    (hcoeff : ∀ l, 1 ≤ l → l ≤ N →
      coefficientBlock period K q l ≤ Rc ^ l * (l.factorial : ℝ) ^ 2) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * EulerPacketWeights.weight ρ (n + 1) *
      blockNorm period (J.solvePressure K κ m c hc hpos) q n) ≤
      2 * M * ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * EulerPacketWeights.weight ρ (n + 1) *
        blockNorm period J q n

name: EulerH6Pressure.pressure_sobolevSize_bound
statement:
theorem pressure_sobolevSize_bound {q : ℕ} {A : SmoothCoefficient period} {f : LiftL2 period}
    (K : EulerSpatialSobolevInverse.CoefficientJet period directions q A)
    (J : EulerSpatialSobolevInverse.SpatialJet period directions q f)
    (κ : ℝ) (m : Vector3) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hpos : ∀ x v, c * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪A.coefficient x v, v⟫_ℝ) :
    sobolevSize period (directions := directions) q (A.pressure κ m c hc hpos f) ≤
      K.pressureConstant c * sobolevSize period (directions := directions) q f

name: EulerH6Pressure.pressureConstant_polynomial
statement:
theorem pressureConstant_polynomial {q : ℕ} {A : SmoothCoefficient period}
    (K : EulerSpatialSobolevInverse.CoefficientJet period directions q A)
    (c L : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hL : 1 ≤ L) (hcL : c⁻¹ ≤ L)
    (hcoeff : ∀ r ≤ q, boundLevel period K r ≤ L) :
    K.pressureConstant c ≤ (9 * L) ^ (3 ^ q)

name: EulerH6Pressure.pressure_shifted_Hq_polynomial_bound
statement:
theorem pressure_shifted_Hq_polynomial_bound {s q : ℕ} {A : SmoothCoefficient period} {f : LiftL2 period}
    (K : EulerSpatialSobolevInverse.CoefficientJet period directions s A)
    (J : EulerSpatialSobolevInverse.SpatialJet period directions s f)
    (κ : ℝ) (m : Vector3) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hpos : ∀ x v, c * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪A.coefficient x v, v⟫_ℝ)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : N + q ≤ s) (L ρ Rc : ℝ)
    (hL : 1 ≤ L) (hcL : c⁻¹ ≤ L) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hRc : 0 ≤ Rc)
    (hbasecoeff : ∀ r ≤ q, boundLevel period K r ≤ L)
    (hsmall : 4 * (9 * L) ^ (3 ^ q) * (ρ * Rc) ≤ 1)
    (hcoeff : ∀ l, 1 ≤ l → l ≤ N →
      coefficientBlock period K q l ≤ Rc ^ l * (l.factorial : ℝ) ^ 2) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * EulerPacketWeights.weight ρ (n + 1) *
      blockNorm period (J.solvePressure K κ m c hc hpos) q n) ≤
      2 * (9 * L) ^ (3 ^ q) * ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
        ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * EulerPacketWeights.weight ρ (n + 1) * blockNorm period J q n

theorem product_wordSobolevNorm_bound (q n : ℕ)

    (f : LiftDomain period → ℝ) (g : LiftDomain period → Vector3)

    (eLpNorm (scalarCommutator period w f (iteratedFieldDerivative period v g)) 2 (liftMeasure period)).toReal ≤

    MemLp (scalarCommutator period w f g) 2 (liftMeasure period) ∧

name: EulerBaseTransportCommutator.scalarCommutator_recurrence
statement:
theorem scalarCommutator_recurrence {n : ℕ} (w : Fin (n+1) → Fin 4)
    (f : LiftDomain period → ℝ) (g : LiftDomain period → Vector3)
    (hf : ∀ x, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (localFieldLift period f x))
    (hg : ∀ x, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (localFieldLift period g x)) :
    scalarCommutator period w f g =
      iteratedFieldDerivative period (Fin.init w)
        (fun x => fieldDerivative period (standardDirection (w (Fin.last n))) f x • g x) +
      scalarCommutator period (Fin.init w) f (fieldDerivative period (standardDirection (w (Fin.last n))) g)

theorem classical_metric_heat_bound (K : SmoothCoefficient period) (f : LiftL2 period)
    (J : SpatialJet period standardDirection 2 f) (g : LiftDomain period → Vector3)
    (hrep : (f : LiftDomain period → Vector3) =ᵐ[liftMeasure period] g)
    (hg : ∀ x, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (localFieldLift period g x))
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hpos : ∀ x v, c ^ 2 * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪K.coefficient x v, v⟫_ℝ) :
    (∫ x, ⟪K.coefficient x (g x), classicalLaplacian period g x⟫_ℝ ∂liftMeasure period) ≤
      -(c ^ 2 / 2) * ∑ i : Fin 4, ‖J.word (fun _ : Fin 1 => i)‖ ^ 2 +
      (2 * (K.firstBound : ℝ) ^ 2 / c ^ 2) * ‖f‖ ^ 2

theorem family_energy_derivative_bound (K K' : H →L[ℝ] H)
    (e transport forcing lap : ι → H) (B C ν : ℝ)
    (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hν : 0 ≤ ν)
    (ht : ∀ i, |⟪K (e i), transport i⟫_ℝ| ≤ B * ‖e i‖ ^ 2)
    (hheat : ∀ i, ⟪K (e i), lap i⟫_ℝ ≤ C * ‖e i‖ ^ 2) :
    (∑ i, (⟪K' (e i), e i⟫_ℝ + 2 * ⟪K (e i), forcing i + ν • lap i⟫_ℝ -
      2 * ⟪K (e i), transport i⟫_ℝ)) ≤
      (‖K'‖ + 2 * B + 2 * ν * C) * familySquaredNorm e +
        2 * ‖K‖ * familyNorm e * familyNorm forcing

name: EulerFiniteMetricEnergy.family_energy_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem family_energy_hasDerivAt (K : ℝ → H →L[ℝ] H) (e : ι → ℝ → H)
    (t ν : ℝ) (K' : H →L[ℝ] H) (e' transport pressure forcing lap : ι → H)
    (hK : HasDerivAt K K' t) (he : ∀ i, HasDerivAt (e i) (e' i) t)
    (hsym : ∀ v w, ⟪K t v, w⟫_ℝ = ⟪v, K t w⟫_ℝ)
    (heq : ∀ i, e' i + transport i + pressure i = forcing i + ν • lap i)
    (hp : ∀ i, ⟪K t (e i t), pressure i⟫_ℝ = 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => familyEnergy (K s) (fun i => e i s))
      (∑ i, (⟪K' (e i t), e i t⟫_ℝ + 2 * ⟪K t (e i t), forcing i + ν • lap i⟫_ℝ -
        2 * ⟪K t (e i t), transport i⟫_ℝ)) t

name: EulerFiniteMetricEnergy.family_regularized_energy_evolution
statement:
theorem family_regularized_energy_evolution (K : ℝ → H →L[ℝ] H) (e : ι → ℝ → H)
    (t δ c B C ν : ℝ) (K' : H →L[ℝ] H) (e' transport pressure forcing lap : ι → H)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hc : 0 < c) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hν : 0 ≤ ν)
    (hcoercive : ∀ u, c ^ 2 * ‖u‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪K t u, u⟫_ℝ)
    (hK : HasDerivAt K K' t) (he : ∀ i, HasDerivAt (e i) (e' i) t)
    (hsym : ∀ v w, ⟪K t v, w⟫_ℝ = ⟪v, K t w⟫_ℝ)
    (heq : ∀ i, e' i + transport i + pressure i = forcing i + ν • lap i)
    (hp : ∀ i, ⟪K t (e i t), pressure i⟫_ℝ = 0)
    (ht : ∀ i, |⟪K t (e i t), transport i⟫_ℝ| ≤ B * ‖e i t‖ ^ 2)
    (hheat : ∀ i, ⟪K t (e i t), lap i⟫_ℝ ≤ C * ‖e i t‖ ^ 2) :
    deriv (fun s => √(familyEnergy (K s) (fun i => e i s) + δ ^ 2)) t ≤
      ((‖K'‖ + 2 * B + 2 * ν * C) / (2 * c ^ 2)) *
        √(familyEnergy (K t) (fun i => e i t) + δ ^ 2) +
      (‖K t‖ / c) * familyNorm forcing

theorem mixedBoundaryOperator_differenceCommutator (a : Space) (h : ℝ) (χ ψ : Cutoff) :

        (mixedBoundaryOperator χ ψ).comp (spatialDifference a h) =
      (mixedBoundaryOperator (χ.differenceQuotient a h) (ψ.translate (h • a)) +
        mixedBoundaryOperator χ (ψ.differenceQuotient a h)).comp
          (translation (h • a)).toContinuousLinearMap

name: EulerMeanBoundary.mixedBoundaryOperator_differenceCommutator_norm_le
statement:
theorem mixedBoundaryOperator_differenceCommutator_norm_le
    (a : Space) (h : ℝ) (χ ψ : Cutoff) :
    ‖(spatialDifference a h).comp (mixedBoundaryOperator χ ψ) -
        (mixedBoundaryOperator χ ψ).comp (spatialDifference a h)‖ ≤
      cutoffBound (χ.differenceQuotient a h) * cutoffBound (ψ.translate (h • a)) +
        cutoffBound χ * cutoffBound (ψ.differenceQuotient a h)

name: EulerMeanBoundary.mixedBoundaryOperator_differenceCommutator_norm_le_invariant
statement:
theorem mixedBoundaryOperator_differenceCommutator_norm_le_invariant
    (a : Space) (h : ℝ) (χ ψ : Cutoff) :

        (mixedBoundaryOperator χ ψ).comp (spatialDifference a h)‖ ≤

name: EulerMeanBoundary.cutoffBound_differenceQuotient
statement:
theorem cutoffBound_differenceQuotient (χ : Cutoff) (R M₁ M₂ : ℝ)
    (hM₁ : 0 ≤ M₁) (hM₂ : 0 ≤ M₂)
    (hsupport : tsupport χ.field ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : Space) R)
    (hD₁ : ∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ χ.field x‖ ≤ M₁)
    (hD₂ : ∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ χ.field) x‖ ≤ M₂)
    (a : Space) (h : ℝ) (hstep : ‖h • a‖ ≤ 1) :
    cutoffBound (χ.differenceQuotient a h) ≤ cutoffDifferenceConstant R M₁ M₂ * ‖a‖

statement:
theorem differenceQuotient_fderiv (χ : Cutoff) (a : Space) (h : ℝ) (x : Space) :

theorem differenceQuotient_support (χ : Cutoff) (R : ℝ)

name: EulerMeanBoundary.lpNorm_le_bound_volume
statement:
theorem lpNorm_le_bound_volume {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    (f : Space → E) (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f volume) (K : Set Space)
    (hK : volume K ≠ (∞ : ℝ≥0∞)) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hbound : ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ C) (hzero : ∀ x ∉ K, f x = 0) (p : ℝ≥0∞) :
    lpNorm f p volume ≤ C * (volume K).toReal ^ (1 / p.toReal)

name: EulerMeanBoundary.norm_differenceQuotient_le
statement:
theorem norm_differenceQuotient_le {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]

    (hDf : ∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖ ≤ M) (a : Space) (h : ℝ) (x : Space) :
    ‖h⁻¹ • (f (x + h • a) - f x)‖ ≤ M * ‖a‖

name: EulerMeanBoundary.cutoffBound_differenceError
statement:
theorem cutoffBound_differenceError (χ : Cutoff) (R M₂ M₃ : ℝ)
    (hM₂ : 0 ≤ M₂) (hM₃ : 0 ≤ M₃)
    (hs : tsupport χ.field ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : Space) R)
    (hD₂ : ∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ χ.field) x‖ ≤ M₂)
    (hD₃ : ∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ χ.field)) x‖ ≤ M₃)
    (a : Space) (h : ℝ) (hh : h ≠ 0) (hstep : ‖h • a‖ ≤ 1) :
    cutoffBound (χ.differenceError a h) ≤ cutoffDifferenceConstant R M₂ M₃ * |h| * ‖a‖ ^ 2

name: EulerMeanBoundary.cutoffBound_le_of_support
statement:
theorem cutoffBound_le_of_support (χ : Cutoff) (R M₀ M₁ : ℝ)
    (hM₀ : 0 ≤ M₀) (hM₁ : 0 ≤ M₁)
    (hs : tsupport χ.field ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : Space) R)
    (hb : ∀ x, ‖χ.field x‖ ≤ M₀) (hdb : ∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ χ.field x‖ ≤ M₁) :
    cutoffBound χ ≤ 3 * cutoffCurlConstant *
      (M₀ + M₁ * (volume (Metric.closedBall (0 : Space) R)).toReal ^ (1/3 : ℝ))

name: EulerMeanBoundary.norm_differenceQuotient_remainder_le
statement:

name: EulerHilbertCoerciveParameter.contDiff_coerciveInverse_variable
statement:
theorem contDiff_coerciveInverse_variable
    {P : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup P] [NormedSpace ℝ P]
    (A : P → E →L[ℝ] E) (c : P → ℝ) (hc : ∀ x, 0 < c x)
    (hA : ∀ x v, c x * ‖v‖^2 ≤ ⟪A x v, v⟫_ℝ)
    {n : ℕ∞ω} (hreg : ContDiff ℝ n A) :
    ContDiff ℝ n (fun x => coerciveInverse (A x) (c x) (hc x) (hA x))

name: EulerHilbertCoerciveParameter.contDiff_coerciveSolution_variable
statement:
theorem contDiff_coerciveSolution_variable
    {P : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup P] [NormedSpace ℝ P]
    (A : P → E →L[ℝ] E) (c : P → ℝ) (hc : ∀ x, 0 < c x)
    (hA : ∀ x v, c x * ‖v‖^2 ≤ ⟪A x v, v⟫_ℝ)
    (f : P → E) {n : ℕ∞ω} (hreg : ContDiff ℝ n A) (hf : ContDiff ℝ n f) :
    ContDiff ℝ n (fun x => coerciveInverse (A x) (c x) (hc x) (hA x) (f x))

name: EulerHilbertCoerciveParameter.hasDerivAt_coerciveInverse_variable
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_coerciveInverse_variable
    (A : ℝ → E →L[ℝ] E) (c : ℝ → ℝ) (hc : ∀ x, 0 < c x)
    (hA : ∀ x v, c x * ‖v‖^2 ≤ ⟪A x v, v⟫_ℝ)
    (x : ℝ) (A₁ : E →L[ℝ] E) (hder : HasDerivAt A A₁ x) :
    HasDerivAt (fun r => coerciveInverse (A r) (c r) (hc r) (hA r))
      (-(coerciveInverse (A x) (c x) (hc x) (hA x)).comp
        (A₁.comp (coerciveInverse (A x) (c x) (hc x) (hA x)))) x

name: EulerHilbertCoerciveGevrey.coerciveSolution_derivative_recurrence
statement:
theorem coerciveSolution_derivative_recurrence
    (A : P → E →L[ℝ] E) (c : P → ℝ) (hc : ∀ x, 0 < c x)
    (hcoercive : ∀ x v, c x * ‖v‖^2 ≤ ⟪A x v, v⟫_ℝ)
    (f : P → E) (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (x : P) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n
      (fun y => coerciveInverse (A y) (c y) (hc y) (hcoercive y) (f y)) x‖ ≤
    (c x)⁻¹ * (‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f x‖ + ∑ j ∈ range n,
      (n.choose (j+1) : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (j+1) A x‖ *
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n-(j+1))
          (fun y => coerciveInverse (A y) (c y) (hc y) (hcoercive y) (f y)) x‖)

name: EulerHilbertCoerciveGevrey.coerciveSolution_gevrey
statement:
theorem coerciveSolution_gevrey
    (A : P → E →L[ℝ] E) (c : P → ℝ) (hc : ∀ x, 0 < c x)
    (hcoercive : ∀ x v, c x * ‖v‖^2 ≤ ⟪A x v, v⟫_ℝ)
    (f : P → E) (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (M Rc R : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hRc : 0 ≤ Rc) (hR : 2*M*(Rc+1) ≤ R)
    (hinv : ∀ x, (c x)⁻¹ ≤ M)
    (hcoeff : ∀ j x, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (j+1) A x‖ ≤
      Rc^(j+1) * ((j+1).factorial : ℝ)^2)
    (d : ℕ) (hforce : ∀ n x, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f x‖ ≤ majorant R d n)
    (n : ℕ) (x : P) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n
      (fun y => coerciveInverse (A y) (c y) (hc y) (hcoercive y) (f y)) x‖ ≤
        majorant R (d+1) n

name: EulerHilbertCoerciveGevrey.coerciveSolution_gevrey_amplitudes
statement:
theorem coerciveSolution_gevrey_amplitudes
    (A : P → E →L[ℝ] E) (c : P → ℝ) (hc : ∀ x, 0 < c x)
    (hcoercive : ∀ x v, c x * ‖v‖^2 ≤ ⟪A x v, v⟫_ℝ)
    (f : P → E) (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (I C D M Rc R : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hMC : I*C ≤ M) (hMD : I*D ≤ M)
    (hRc : 0 ≤ Rc) (hR : 2*M*(Rc+1) ≤ R)
    (hinv : ∀ x, (c x)⁻¹ ≤ I)
    (hcoeff : ∀ j x, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (j+1) A x‖ ≤
      C * (Rc^(j+1) * ((j+1).factorial : ℝ)^2))
    (d : ℕ) (hforce : ∀ n x, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f x‖ ≤ D * majorant R d n)
    (n : ℕ) (x : P) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n
      (fun y => coerciveInverse (A y) (c y) (hc y) (hcoercive y) (f y)) x‖ ≤
        majorant R (d+1) n

name: EulerHilbertCoerciveGevrey.derivative_recurrence
statement:
theorem derivative_recurrence
    (A : P → E →L[ℝ] E) (u f : P → E)
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (heq : ∀ y, A y (u y) = f y) (x : P)
    (I : E →L[ℝ] E) (hI : ∀ v, I (A x v) = v) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n u x‖ ≤ ‖I‖ *
      (‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f x‖ + ∑ j ∈ range n,
        (n.choose (j+1) : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (j+1) A x‖ *
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n-(j+1)) u x‖)

name: EulerContinuousPathCalculus.apply_bound

theorem apply_bound (A : P → C(K,E →L[ℝ] F)) (f : P → C(K,E))
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (R C D : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hD : 0 ≤ D) (c d : ℕ)
    (hA_bound : ∀ n x, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n A x‖ ≤ C*majorant R c n)

name: EulerBoundedInverseGevrey.solution_gevrey
statement:
theorem solution_gevrey
    (A : P → E →L[ℝ] E) (u f : P → E)
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (heq : ∀ x, A x (u x) = f x)
    (inverse : P → E →L[ℝ] E) (hleft : ∀ x v, inverse x (A x v) = v)
    (I C D M Rc R : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hMC : I*C ≤ M) (hMD : I*D ≤ M)
    (hRc : 0 ≤ Rc) (hR : 2*M*(Rc+1) ≤ R)
    (hinverse : ∀ x, ‖inverse x‖ ≤ I)
    (hcoeff : ∀ j x, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (j+1) A x‖ ≤
      C*(Rc^(j+1)*((j+1).factorial : ℝ)^2))
    (d : ℕ) (hforce : ∀ n x, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f x‖ ≤ D*majorant R d n)
    (n : ℕ) (x : P) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n u x‖ ≤ majorant R (d+1) n

name: EulerCoerciveEndpointBounds.correctionOperator_norm_le
statement:
theorem correctionOperator_norm_le (D : S →L[ℝ] E) (R : S →L[ℝ] S) (A : E →L[ℝ] E)
    (d r a : ℝ) (hd : ‖D‖ ≤ d) (hr : ‖R‖ ≤ r) (ha : ‖A‖ ≤ a) :
    ‖correctionOperator D R A‖ ≤ d ^ 2 * r * a

name: EulerCoerciveEndpointBounds.correctionOperator_sub_norm_le
statement:
theorem correctionOperator_sub_norm_le
    (D D' : S →L[ℝ] E) (R R' : S →L[ℝ] S) (A A' : E →L[ℝ] E)
    (d r a δd δr δa : ℝ)
    (hd : ‖D‖ ≤ d) (hd' : ‖D'‖ ≤ d) (hr : ‖R‖ ≤ r) (hr' : ‖R'‖ ≤ r)
    (ha : ‖A‖ ≤ a) (_ha' : ‖A'‖ ≤ a)
    (hδd : ‖D - D'‖ ≤ δd) (hδr : ‖R - R'‖ ≤ δr) (hδa : ‖A - A'‖ ≤ δa) :
    ‖correctionOperator D R A - correctionOperator D' R' A'‖ ≤
      2 * d * r * a * δd + d ^ 2 * a * δr + d ^ 2 * r * δa

name: EulerCoerciveEndpointBounds.endpointOperator_norm_le
statement:
theorem endpointOperator_norm_le (D : S →L[ℝ] E) (R : S →L[ℝ] S) (A : E →L[ℝ] E)
    (L : V →L[ℝ] E) (d r a l : ℝ)
    (hd : ‖D‖ ≤ d) (hr : ‖R‖ ≤ r) (ha : ‖A‖ ≤ a) (hl : ‖L‖ ≤ l) :
    ‖endpointOperator D R A L‖ ≤ (1 + d ^ 2 * r * a) * l

name: EulerCoerciveEndpointBounds.endpointOperator_sub_norm_le
statement:
theorem endpointOperator_sub_norm_le
    (D D' : S →L[ℝ] E) (R R' : S →L[ℝ] S) (A A' : E →L[ℝ] E)
    (L L' : V →L[ℝ] E) (d r a l δd δr δa δl : ℝ)
    (hd : ‖D‖ ≤ d) (hd' : ‖D'‖ ≤ d) (hr : ‖R‖ ≤ r) (hr' : ‖R'‖ ≤ r)
    (ha : ‖A‖ ≤ a) (ha' : ‖A'‖ ≤ a) (hl : ‖L‖ ≤ l)
    (hδd : ‖D - D'‖ ≤ δd) (hδr : ‖R - R'‖ ≤ δr)
    (hδa : ‖A - A'‖ ≤ δa) (hδl : ‖L - L'‖ ≤ δl) :
    ‖endpointOperator D R A L - endpointOperator D' R' A' L'‖ ≤
      (1 + d ^ 2 * r * a) * δl +
        (2 * d * r * a * δd + d ^ 2 * a * δr + d ^ 2 * r * δa) * l

name: EulerCoerciveEndpointBounds.formOperator_sub_norm_le
statement:
theorem formOperator_sub_norm_le
    (D D' : S →L[ℝ] E) (A A' : E →L[ℝ] E) (d a δd δa : ℝ)
    (hd : ‖D‖ ≤ d) (hd' : ‖D'‖ ≤ d) (ha : ‖A‖ ≤ a) (ha' : ‖A'‖ ≤ a)
    (hδd : ‖D-D'‖ ≤ δd) (hδa : ‖A-A'‖ ≤ δa) :
    ‖formOperator D A - formOperator D' A'‖ ≤ 2 * d * a * δd + d ^ 2 * δa

name: EulerCoerciveEndpointBounds.norm_comp_sub_le

name: EulerMeanHarmonic.partialDerivative_add
EulerMeanHarmonic.partialDerivative_mul
EulerMeanHarmonic.secondPartial_mul
statement:
theorem secondPartial_mul (f g : Space → ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g) (i : Fin 3) (x : Space) :
    partialDerivative (partialDerivative (f * g) i) i x =
      g x * partialDerivative (partialDerivative f i) i x +
        2 * partialDerivative f i x * partialDerivative g i x +
        f x * partialDerivative (partialDerivative g i) i x

    (hU : ∀ i, U i =ᵐ[μ] F i) (hv : v =ᵐ[μ] g)
    (M : X → ℝ) (hM : MemLp M 2 μ)

    (hpoint : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, HasFDerivAt (fun a => F a x) (D x) 0)
    (M : X → ℝ) (hM : MemLp M 2 μ) (hM0 : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ M x)
    (hbound : ∀ᶠ a in 𝓝 (0 : P), ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖F a x-F 0 x‖ ≤ M x*‖a‖) :

name: EulerComparatorCurlTransport.vectorCurl_convection
statement:
theorem vectorCurl_convection (u : Space → Space) (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (x : Space) :
    vectorCurl (fun y => fderiv ℝ u y (u y)) x =
      fderiv ℝ (vectorCurl u) x (u x) - fderiv ℝ u x (vectorCurl u x) +
        divergence u x • vectorCurl u x

name: EulerComparatorCurlTransport.vectorCurl_euler_rhs

    (hdiv : divergence u x = 0) :

      fderiv ℝ u x (vectorCurl u x) - fderiv ℝ (vectorCurl u) x (u x)

    (hQ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Q) (hQ₁ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Q₁)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ v)
    (R C₀ C₁ F V : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) (hC₁ : 0 ≤ C₁)
    (hF : 0 ≤ F) (hV : 0 ≤ V) (d : ℕ)
    (hbQ : ∀ n x, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n Q x‖ ≤ C₀*majorant R 0 n)
    (hbQ₁ : ∀ n x, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n Q₁ x‖ ≤ C₁*majorant R 0 n)
    (hbf : ∀ n x, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f x‖ ≤ F*majorant R d n)
    (hbv : ∀ n x, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n v x‖ ≤ V*majorant R d n)
    (n : ℕ) (x : P) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (forcing Q Q₁ f v) x‖ ≤ (3*C₀*(F+6*C₁*V))*majorant R d n

name: EulerContinuousGramAcceleration.accelerationPath_ae
statement:
theorem accelerationPath_ae (hT : 0 ≤ T) (v a : TimeLp T U) (f : TimeLp T E)
    (vC : C(Icc (0 : ℝ) T, U)) (fC : C(Icc (0 : ℝ) T, E))
    (hv : (v : ℝ → U) =ᵐ[timeMeasure T] extendPath T hT vC)
    (hf : (f : ℝ → E) =ᵐ[timeMeasure T] extendPath T hT fC)
    (heq : ∀ᵐ t ∂timeMeasure T, gram (extendPath T hT Q t) (a t) =
      (extendPath T hT Q t).adjoint (f t-(2 : ℝ) • extendPath T hT Q₁ t (v t))) :
    (a : ℝ → U) =ᵐ[timeMeasure T] extendPath T hT (accelerationPath T Q Q₁ c hc hQ vC fC)

theorem gramPath_bound (Qp : P → C(Icc (0 : ℝ) T,U →L[ℝ] E)) (hQp : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Qp)
    (R C : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hb : ∀ n x, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n Qp x‖ ≤ C*majorant R 0 n) (n : ℕ) (x : P) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => gramPath T (Qp y)) x‖ ≤ (3*C^2)*majorant R 0 n

name: EulerContinuousGramPath.gramPath_contDiff
statement:
theorem gramPath_contDiff (Qp : P → C(Icc (0 : ℝ) T,U →L[ℝ] E)) {n : ℕ∞ω}
    (hQp : ContDiff ℝ n Qp) : ContDiff ℝ n (fun x => gramPath T (Qp x))

name: EulerContinuousGramPath.solve_contDiff
statement:
theorem solve_contDiff (Qp : P → C(Icc (0 : ℝ) T,U →L[ℝ] E))
    (hLower : ∀ x t v, c*‖v‖^2 ≤ ‖Qp x t v‖^2) (f : P → C(Icc (0 : ℝ) T,U))
    {n : ℕ∞ω} (hQp : ContDiff ℝ n Qp) (hf : ContDiff ℝ n f) :
    ContDiff ℝ n (fun x => solve T (Qp x) c hc (hLower x) (f x))

name: EulerContinuousGramPath.solve_equation
statement:
theorem solve_equation (f : C(Icc (0 : ℝ) T,U)) :
    multiplier (gramPath T Q) (solve T Q c hc hQ f) = f

name: EulerContinuousGramPath.solve_left_inverse
statement:
theorem solve_left_inverse (f : C(Icc (0 : ℝ) T,U)) :

name: EulerContinuousGramPath.solve_norm
statement: theorem solve_norm : ‖solve T Q c hc hQ‖ ≤ c⁻¹

name: EulerContinuousGramGevrey.inversePath_gevrey
statement:
theorem inversePath_gevrey (R : ℝ) (hR : 2*gramCost c C 1*(Rc+1) ≤ R) (n : ℕ) (x : P) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => gramInversePath T (Q y) c hc (hLower y)) x‖ ≤
      majorant R 1 n

name: EulerContinuousGramGevrey.leftMultiplicationMap_norm
statement: theorem leftMultiplicationMap_norm (T : ℝ) : ‖leftMultiplicationMap (U := U) T‖ ≤ 1

name: EulerContinuousGramGevrey.solution_gevrey
statement:
theorem solution_gevrey (f : P → C(Icc (0 : ℝ) T,U)) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (D R : ℝ) (hD : 0 ≤ D) (hR : 2*gramCost c C D*(Rc+1) ≤ R)
    (d : ℕ) (hbf : ∀ n x, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f x‖ ≤ D*majorant R d n)
    (n : ℕ) (x : P) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => solve T (Q y) c hc (hLower y) (f y)) x‖ ≤
      majorant R (d+1) n

name: EulerContinuousAccelerationGevrey.acceleration_contDiff
statement:
theorem acceleration_contDiff {n : ℕ∞ω}
    (hQ : ContDiff ℝ n Q) (hQ₁ : ContDiff ℝ n Q₁)
    (hv : ContDiff ℝ n v) (hf : ContDiff ℝ n f) :
    ContDiff ℝ n (fun x => accelerationPath T (Q x) (Q₁ x) c hc (hLower x) (v x) (f x))

name: EulerContinuousAccelerationGevrey.acceleration_eq_solve
statement:
theorem acceleration_eq_solve :
    (fun x => accelerationPath T (Q x) (Q₁ x) c hc (hLower x) (v x) (f x)) =
      fun x => solve T (Q x) c hc (hLower x) (forcing Q Q₁ f v x)

name: EulerContinuousAccelerationGevrey.acceleration_gevrey
statement:
theorem acceleration_gevrey
    (hQ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Q) (hQ₁ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Q₁)
    (hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ v) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (Rc R C₀ C₁ Cf Cv : ℝ) (hRc : 0 ≤ Rc) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hRcR : Rc ≤ R)
    (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) (hC₁ : 0 ≤ C₁) (hCf : 0 ≤ Cf) (hCv : 0 ≤ Cv)
    (hstrong : 2*gramCost c C₀ (3*C₀*(Cf+6*C₁*Cv))*(Rc+1) ≤ R)
    (hQb : ∀ n x, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n Q x‖ ≤ C₀*majorant Rc 0 n)
    (hQ₁b : ∀ n x, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n Q₁ x‖ ≤ C₁*majorant Rc 0 n)
    (d : ℕ)
    (hfb : ∀ n x, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f x‖ ≤ Cf*majorant R d n)
    (hvb : ∀ n x, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n v x‖ ≤ Cv*majorant R d n)
    (n : ℕ) (x : P) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n
      (fun y => accelerationPath T (Q y) (Q₁ y) c hc (hLower y) (v y) (f y)) x‖ ≤
      majorant R (d+1) n

name: EulerContinuousGramSobolev.solution_block_gevrey
statement:
theorem solution_block_gevrey (directions : ι → P)
    (hd : ∀ i, ‖directions i‖ ≤ 1) (q : ℕ) (T : ℝ)
    (Q : P → C(Icc (0 : ℝ) T,U →L[ℝ] E))
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hLower : ∀ x t v, c*‖v‖^2 ≤ ‖Q x t v‖^2)
    (hQ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Q)
    (Rc C : ℝ) (hRc : 0 ≤ Rc) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hbQ : ∀ n x, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n Q x‖ ≤ C*majorant Rc 0 n)
    (f : P → C(Icc (0 : ℝ) T,U)) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (D R : ℝ) (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hR : 2*gramBlockCost ι q c Rc C D*(sobolevCoefficientRadius ι Rc+1) ≤ R)
    (d : ℕ) (hbf : ∀ n x, block directions q f n x ≤ D*majorant R d n)
    (n : ℕ) (x : P) :
    block directions q (fun y => solve T (Q y) c hc (hLower y) (f y)) n x ≤
      majorant R (d+1) n

name: EulerContinuousAccelerationSobolev.acceleration_block_bound
statement:
theorem acceleration_block_bound (directions : ι → P) (hd : ∀ i, ‖directions i‖ ≤ 1) (q : ℕ)
    (T : ℝ) (Q Q₁ : P → C(Icc (0 : ℝ) T,U →L[ℝ] E))
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hLower : ∀ x t w, c*‖w‖^2 ≤ ‖Q x t w‖^2)
    (v : P → C(Icc (0 : ℝ) T,U)) (f : P → C(Icc (0 : ℝ) T,E))
    (hQ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Q) (hQ₁ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Q₁)
    (hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ v) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (Rc R C₀ C₁ Cf Cv : ℝ) (hRc : 0 ≤ Rc) (hRcR : sobolevCoefficientRadius ι Rc ≤ R)
    (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) (hC₁ : 0 ≤ C₁) (hCf : 0 ≤ Cf) (hCv : 0 ≤ Cv)
    (hR : 2*gramBlockCost ι q c Rc C₀ (accelerationBlockAmplitude ι q Rc C₀ C₁ Cf Cv)*
      (sobolevCoefficientRadius ι Rc+1) ≤ R)
    (hbQ : ∀ n x, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n Q x‖ ≤ C₀*majorant Rc 0 n)
    (hbQ₁ : ∀ n x, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n Q₁ x‖ ≤ C₁*majorant Rc 0 n)
    (d : ℕ)
    (hbf : ∀ n x, block directions q f n x ≤ Cf*majorant R d n)
    (hbv : ∀ n x, block directions q v n x ≤ Cv*majorant R d n)
    (n : ℕ) (x : P) :
    block directions q
      (fun y => accelerationPath T (Q y) (Q₁ y) c hc (hLower y) (v y) (f y)) n x ≤
      majorant R (d+1) n

name: EulerContinuousAccelerationSobolev.forcing_block_bound
statement:
theorem forcing_block_bound (directions : ι → P) (hd : ∀ i, ‖directions i‖ ≤ 1) (q : ℕ)
    (T : ℝ) (Q Q₁ : P → C(Icc (0 : ℝ) T,U →L[ℝ] E))
    (f : P → C(Icc (0 : ℝ) T,E)) (v : P → C(Icc (0 : ℝ) T,U))
    (hQ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Q) (hQ₁ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Q₁)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ v)
    (Rc R C₀ C₁ Cf Cv : ℝ) (hRc : 0 ≤ Rc) (hRcR : sobolevCoefficientRadius ι Rc ≤ R)
    (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) (hC₁ : 0 ≤ C₁) (hCf : 0 ≤ Cf) (hCv : 0 ≤ Cv)
    (hbQ : ∀ n x, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n Q x‖ ≤ C₀*majorant Rc 0 n)
    (hbQ₁ : ∀ n x, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n Q₁ x‖ ≤ C₁*majorant Rc 0 n)
    (d : ℕ)
    (hbf : ∀ n x, block directions q f n x ≤ Cf*majorant R d n)
    (hbv : ∀ n x, block directions q v n x ≤ Cv*majorant R d n)
    (n : ℕ) (x : P) :
    block directions q (forcing Q Q₁ f v) n x ≤
      accelerationBlockAmplitude ι q Rc C₀ C₁ Cf Cv*majorant R d n
