    realAdjoint A = A.adjoint

name: EulerPacketPiola.coveringPotential_angle_derivative
statement:
theorem coveringPotential_angle_derivative (P : ℝ) (m : Space → Space)
    (A : LiftTangent → Space) (z : LiftTangent)
    (hA : Continuous (fun θ => A (z.1, θ)))
    (hq : DifferentiableAt ℝ (coveringPotential P m A) z) :
    fderiv ℝ (coveringPotential P m A) z (0, 1) =
      potentialMultiplier (m z.1) (A z)

name: EulerPacketPiola.coveringPotential_pair_piola
statement:
theorem coveringPotential_pair_piola (P κ : ℝ) (m₀ : Space) (Ξ : Space → Space)
    (A : LiftTangent → Space) (hΞ : ContDiff ℝ 2 Ξ)
    (F : Space → Space ≃L[ℝ] Space) (z : LiftTangent)
    (hF : fderiv ℝ Ξ z.1 = (F z.1).toContinuousLinearMap)
    (hdet : (operatorMatrix (F z.1).toContinuousLinearMap).det = 1)
    (hm : (F z.1).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint m₀ ≠ 0)
    (htan : ⟪(F z.1).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint m₀, A z⟫_ℝ = 0)
    (hA : Continuous (fun θ => A (z.1, θ)))
    (hq : DifferentiableAt ℝ
      (coveringPotential P (fun y => (F y).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint m₀) A) z) :
    (F z.1).symm (A z + κ • coveringSlowCurl (F z.1).symm.toContinuousLinearMap
      (coveringPotential P (fun y => (F y).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint m₀) A) z) =
      coveringCurl κ m₀ (coveringPullbackCovector Ξ
        (coveringPotential P (fun y => (F y).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint m₀) A)) z

name: EulerPacketPiola.curlMatrix_rankOne
statement:
theorem curlMatrix_rankOne (a b : Space) :
    curlMatrix (rankOne ℝ a b) = cross b a

name: EulerPacketPiola.curl_lifted_split
statement:
theorem curl_lifted_split (κ : ℝ) (m : Space) (L : LiftTangent →L[ℝ] Space)
    (G : Space →L[ℝ] Space) :
    curlMatrix (L.comp ((EulerGraphPullback.liftedDirection κ m).comp G)) =
      κ • curlMatrix (L.comp ((ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ Space ℝ).comp G)) +
        cross (G.adjoint m) (L (0, 1))

name: EulerPacketPiola.lifted_pair_piola
statement:
theorem lifted_pair_piola (κ : ℝ) (m₀ : Space) (Ξ : Space → Space)
    (A Q : LiftDomain period → Space) (hΞ : ContDiff ℝ 2 Ξ)
    (F : Space → Space ≃L[ℝ] Space)
    (hF : ∀ y, fderiv ℝ Ξ y = (F y).toContinuousLinearMap)
    (hdet : ∀ y, (operatorMatrix (F y).toContinuousLinearMap).det = 1)
    (hQ : ∀ x, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (localFieldLift period Q x)) (x : LiftDomain period)
    (hm : (F x.1).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint m₀ ≠ 0)
    (htan : ⟪(F x.1).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint m₀, A x⟫_ℝ = 0)
    (hangle : fieldDerivative period (0, 1) Q x =
      potentialMultiplier ((F x.1).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint m₀) (A x)) :
    (F x.1).symm (A x + κ • liftedSlowCurl period F Q x) =
      liftedCurl period κ m₀ (liftedPullbackCovector period Ξ Q) x

name: EulerPacketPiola.piolaPairLp_ae
statement:
theorem piolaPairLp_ae (κ : ℝ) (m₀ : Space) (Ξ : Space → Space)
    (A Q : LiftDomain period → Space) (hΞ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Ξ)
    (hc : HasCompactSupport Q) (hQ : ∀ x, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (localFieldLift period Q x))
    (F : Space → Space ≃L[ℝ] Space)
    (hF : ∀ y, fderiv ℝ Ξ y = (F y).toContinuousLinearMap)
    (hdet : ∀ y, (operatorMatrix (F y).toContinuousLinearMap).det = 1)
    (hm : ∀ x, (F x).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint m₀ ≠ 0)
    (htan : ∀ x, ⟪(F x.1).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint m₀, A x⟫_ℝ = 0)
    (hangle : ∀ x, fieldDerivative period (0, 1) Q x =
      potentialMultiplier ((F x.1).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint m₀) (A x)) (p : ℕ) :
    (piolaPairLp period κ m₀ Ξ Q hΞ hc hQ p : LiftDomain period → Space) =ᵐ[liftMeasure period]
      fun x => (F x.1).symm (κ ^ p • A x + κ ^ (p + 1) • liftedSlowCurl period F Q x)

name: EulerPacketPiola.piolaPairLp_mem
statement:
theorem piolaPairLp_mem (κ : ℝ) (m₀ : Space) (Ξ : Space → Space)
    (Q : LiftDomain period → Space) (hΞ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Ξ)
    (hc : HasCompactSupport Q) (hQ : ∀ x, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (localFieldLift period Q x)) (p : ℕ) :
    piolaPairLp period κ m₀ Ξ Q hΞ hc hQ p ∈ divergenceFreeSpace period κ m₀

name: EulerPacketPiola.transformedLiftedCurl_split
statement:
theorem transformedLiftedCurl_split (κ : ℝ) (m₀ : Space)
    (F : Space → Space ≃L[ℝ] Space) (Q : LiftDomain period → Space)
    (x : LiftDomain period) :
    transformedLiftedCurl period κ m₀ F Q x =
      κ • liftedSlowCurl period F Q x +
        cross ((F x.1).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint m₀)
          (fieldDerivative period (0, 1) Q x)

name: EulerPacketPiola.weighted_lifted_pair_piola
statement:
theorem weighted_lifted_pair_piola (κ : ℝ) (m₀ : Space) (Ξ : Space → Space)
    (A Q : LiftDomain period → Space) (hΞ : ContDiff ℝ 2 Ξ)
    (F : Space → Space ≃L[ℝ] Space)
    (hF : ∀ y, fderiv ℝ Ξ y = (F y).toContinuousLinearMap)
    (hdet : ∀ y, (operatorMatrix (F y).toContinuousLinearMap).det = 1)
    (hQ : ∀ x, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (localFieldLift period Q x)) (x : LiftDomain period)
    (hm : (F x.1).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint m₀ ≠ 0)
    (htan : ⟪(F x.1).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint m₀, A x⟫_ℝ = 0)
    (hangle : fieldDerivative period (0, 1) Q x =
      potentialMultiplier ((F x.1).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint m₀) (A x)) (p : ℕ) :
    (F x.1).symm (κ ^ p • A x + κ ^ (p + 1) • liftedSlowCurl period F Q x) =
      κ ^ p • liftedCurl period κ m₀ (liftedPullbackCovector period Ξ Q) x

name: EulerPacketPiola.coveringPotential_contDiff

name: EulerPacketPiola.coveringSlowCurl_contDiff
statement:

name: EulerPacketPiola.smooth_coveringPotential_pair_piola

theorem smooth_coveringPotential_pair_piola (P κ : ℝ) (hP : 0 ≤ P)

    (hΞ : ContDiff ℝ 2 Ξ) (F : Space → Space ≃L[ℝ] Space)
    (hNormal : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => (F y).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint m₀))
    (hm : ∀ y, (F y).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint m₀ ≠ 0)
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (z : LiftTangent)

theorem pairLp_ae

name: EulerPacketResidual.packet_residual_eq_tail
statement:
theorem packet_residual_eq_tail (N : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (hκ : κ ≠ 0)
    (L : V →ₗ[ℝ] W) (G H : Q →ₗ[ℝ] W) (B C : V →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℝ] W)
    (u : ℕ → V) (p : ℕ → Q) (hu : u 0=0) (hp : H (p 0)=0)
    (hcancel : ∀ n ≤ N, coefficient (N+1) L G H B C u p n=0) :
    residual (N+1) κ L G H B C u p =
      ∑ n ∈ Ico (N+1) (2*N+3), κ^n • coefficient (N+1) L G H B C u p n

name: EulerPacketResidual.residual_eq_evaluate
statement:
theorem residual_eq_evaluate (M : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (hκ : κ ≠ 0)
    (L : V →ₗ[ℝ] W) (G H : Q →ₗ[ℝ] W) (B C : V →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℝ] W)
    (u : ℕ → V) (p : ℕ → Q) (hu : u 0=0) (hp : H (p 0)=0) :
    residual M κ L G H B C u p = evaluate (2*M) κ (coefficient M L G H B C u p)

name: EulerPacketResidual.residual_eq_tail

theorem residual_eq_tail (M K : ℕ) (hK : K ≤ 2*M+1) (κ : ℝ) (hκ : κ ≠ 0)

    (u : ℕ → V) (p : ℕ → Q) (hu : u 0=0) (hp : H (p 0)=0)
    (hcancel : ∀ n < K, coefficient M L G H B C u p n=0) :

      ∑ n ∈ Ico K (2*M+1), κ^n • coefficient M L G H B C u p n

name: EulerPacketPointJets.jet_fieldSum
statement:
theorem jet_fieldSum {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (M : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (u : ℕ → Domain → E) (z : Domain)
    (hu : ∀ n ≤ M, DifferentiableAt ℝ (u n) z) :
    jet (fieldSum M κ u) z = evaluate M κ (fun n => jet (u n) z)

name: EulerPacketPointJets.momentumResidual_formula
statement:
theorem momentumResidual_formula (κ : ℝ) (FInv M : Space →L[ℝ] Space) (m : Space)
    (u : Domain → Space) (p : Domain → ℝ) (z : Domain) :
    momentumResidual κ FInv M m u p z =
      fderiv ℝ u z timeDirection + M (u z) +
      FInv.adjoint ((toDual ℝ Space).symm ((fderiv ℝ p z).comp spatialInjection)) +
      κ⁻¹ • (fderiv ℝ p z angleDirection • m) +
      fderiv ℝ u z (spatialInjection (FInv (u z))) +
      κ⁻¹ • (⟪m, u z⟫_ℝ • fderiv ℝ u z angleDirection)

name: EulerPacketPointJets.momentum_fieldSum_eq
statement:
theorem momentum_fieldSum_eq (N : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (hκ : κ ≠ 0)
    (FInv M : Space →L[ℝ] Space) (m : Space)
    (u : ℕ → Domain → Space) (p : ℕ → Domain → ℝ) (z : Domain)
    (hu : ∀ i ≤ N, DifferentiableAt ℝ (u i) z)
    (hp : ∀ i ≤ N, DifferentiableAt ℝ (p i) z)
    (hu0 : jet (u 0) z=0) (hp0 : fastPressure m (jet (p 0) z)=0) :
    momentumResidual κ FInv M m (fieldSum N κ u) (fieldSum N κ p) z =
      evaluate (2*N) κ (momentumGrade N FInv M m u p z)

name: EulerPacketPointJets.momentum_fieldSum_tail
statement:
theorem momentum_fieldSum_tail (N : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (hκ : κ ≠ 0)
    (FInv M : Space →L[ℝ] Space) (m : Space)
    (u : ℕ → Domain → Space) (p : ℕ → Domain → ℝ) (z : Domain)
    (hu : ∀ i ≤ N+1, DifferentiableAt ℝ (u i) z)
    (hp : ∀ i ≤ N+1, DifferentiableAt ℝ (p i) z)
    (hu0 : jet (u 0) z=0) (hp0 : fastPressure m (jet (p 0) z)=0)
    (hcancel : ∀ n ≤ N, momentumGrade (N+1) FInv M m u p z n=0) :
    momentumResidual κ FInv M m (fieldSum (N+1) κ u) (fieldSum (N+1) κ p) z =
      ∑ n ∈ Ico (N+1) (2*N+3), κ^n • momentumGrade (N+1) FInv M m u p z n

name: EulerPacketPointJets.norm_momentum_fieldSum_le
statement:
theorem norm_momentum_fieldSum_le (N : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (hκ : κ ≠ 0)
    (FInv M : Space →L[ℝ] Space) (m : Space)
    (u : ℕ → Domain → Space) (p : ℕ → Domain → ℝ) (z : Domain)
    (hu : ∀ i ≤ N+1, DifferentiableAt ℝ (u i) z)
    (hp : ∀ i ≤ N+1, DifferentiableAt ℝ (p i) z)
    (hu0 : jet (u 0) z=0) (hp0 : fastPressure m (jet (p 0) z)=0)
    (hcancel : ∀ n ≤ N, momentumGrade (N+1) FInv M m u p z n=0) :
    ‖momentumResidual κ FInv M m (fieldSum (N+1) κ u) (fieldSum (N+1) κ p) z‖ ≤
      ∑ n ∈ Ico (N+1) (2*N+3), |κ|^n * ‖momentumGrade (N+1) FInv M m u p z n‖

name: EulerPacketTailBound.finite_tail_norm_le
statement:
theorem finite_tail_norm_le (κ B : ℝ) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hsmall : κ*B ≤ 1/2) (N : ℕ) (c : ℕ → E)
    (hc : ∀ n ∈ Ico (N+1) (2*N+3), ‖c n‖ ≤ B^(n+1)) :

name: EulerPacketTailBound.normalized_tail_norm_le
statement:
theorem normalized_tail_norm_le (k B C : ℝ) (hk : 0 ≤ k) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hsmall : B/k ≤ 1/2) (L : E →L[ℝ] F) (hL : ‖L‖ ≤ C) (N : ℕ) (c : ℕ → E)

    ‖k • L (∑ n ∈ Ico (N+1) (2*N+3), (k⁻¹)^n • c n)‖ ≤
      2*C*k*B*(B/k)^(N+1)

name: EulerPacketMovingFrame.scaledVelocityRhs_first
statement:

name: EulerPacketMovingFrame.scaling_denominator
statement:
theorem scaling_denominator (s₀ ε : ℝ) (R : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    (∑ j : Fin 3, (s₀*rayScale ε j*R j)^2) =
      s₀^2 * rayDenominator ε (R 0) (R 1) (R 2)

name: EulerPacketMovingFrame.scaling_flux
statement:
theorem scaling_flux {a : ℝ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (s₀ ε : ℝ)
    (M : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (R V : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    (∑ i : Fin 3, (s₀*rayScale ε i*R i) *
      (∑ j : Fin 3, M i j*(velocityScale ε j*V j))) =
      s₀*a*velocityNumerator (scaledVelocityEntry a ε M)
        (R 0) (R 1) (R 2) (V 0) (V 1) (V 2)

name: EulerPacketMovingFrame.scaling_pairing
statement:
theorem scaling_pairing (s₀ ε : ℝ) (R V : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    (∑ i : Fin 3, (s₀*rayScale ε i*R i)*(velocityScale ε i*V i)) =
      s₀*ε*(R 0*V 0+R 1*V 1+R 2*V 2)

name: EulerPacketMovingFrame.scaling_velocity_rate
statement:
theorem scaling_velocity_rate {a ε s₀ D : ℝ}
    (ha : a ≠ 0) (hε : ε ≠ 0) (hs₀ : s₀ ≠ 0) (hD : D ≠ 0)
    (M S : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (R V : Fin 3 → ℝ) (J : ℝ) (i : Fin 3) :
    ((-(∑ j : Fin 3, (M i j+S i j)*(velocityScale ε j*V j)) +
      (2*(s₀*a*J)/(s₀^2*D))*(s₀*rayScale ε i*R i))*(ε/a))/velocityScale ε i =
      -(∑ j : Fin 3, scaledVelocityEntry a ε (fun i j => M i j+S i j) i j * V j) +
        2*(rayScale ε i)^2*R i*J/D

name: EulerPacketMovingFrame.thirdVelocity_of_pairing
statement:
theorem thirdVelocity_of_pairing (R V : Fin 3 → ℝ) (hN : R 2 ≠ 0)
    (hRV : R 0*V 0+R 1*V 1+R 2*V 2 = 0) :
    V 2 = velocityThird (R 0) (R 1) (R 2) (V 0) (V 1)

name: EulerPacketMovingFrame.velocityScale_ne_zero

name: EulerPacketMovingFrame.scaling_cross_flux
statement:
theorem scaling_cross_flux {a : ℝ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (s₀ ε : ℝ)
    (M : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (R V : Fin 3 → ℝ) (hV : V 1 ≠ 0) :
    (∑ i : Fin 3,
      (_root_.crossProduct (fun j => s₀*rayScale ε j*R j) (fun j => velocityScale ε j*V j)) i *
        (∑ j : Fin 3, M i j*(velocityScale ε j*V j))) =
      s₀*a*(V 1)^2*frameCrossNumerator ε (R 0) (R 1) (R 2) (V 0/V 1) (V 2/V 1)
        (rowAction (scaledVelocityEntry a ε M) 0 (V 0/V 1) (V 2/V 1))
        (rowAction (scaledVelocityEntry a ε M) 1 (V 0/V 1) (V 2/V 1))
        (rowAction (scaledVelocityEntry a ε M) 2 (V 0/V 1) (V 2/V 1))

name: EulerPacketMovingFrame.scaling_pressure_ratio
statement:
theorem scaling_pressure_ratio {a : ℝ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (s₀ ε : ℝ)
    (M : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (R V : Fin 3 → ℝ) (hV : V 1 ≠ 0) :
    (∑ i : Fin 3, (s₀*rayScale ε i*R i)*(∑ j : Fin 3, M i j*(velocityScale ε j*V j))) =
      s₀*a*(V 1)*velocityNumerator (scaledVelocityEntry a ε M)
        (R 0) (R 1) (R 2) (V 0/V 1) 1 (V 2/V 1)

name: EulerPacketPhysicalTransform.physical_euler_momentum_of_flow
statement:
theorem physical_euler_momentum_of_flow
    (κ k : ℝ) (hκ : k*κ=1) (m : E)
    (F : ℝ × E → E →L[ℝ] E) (z : ℝ × (E × ℝ) → E)
    (u : ℝ × E → E) (p Q : ℝ × E → ℝ) (X Y : ℝ × E → E)
    (t : ℝ) (x : E) (A : E ≃L[ℝ] E)
    (DF : (ℝ × E) →L[ℝ] (E →L[ℝ] E)) (Dz : (ℝ × (E × ℝ)) →L[ℝ] E)
    (Du : (ℝ × E) →L[ℝ] E) (P : E)
    (hleft : ∀ s y, Y (s,X (s,y)) = y)
    (hY : DifferentiableAt ℝ (inverseCoordinates Y) (t,X (t,x)))
    (hX : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 X (t,x))
    (hframe : F =ᶠ[𝓝 (t,x)] fun r => (fderiv ℝ X r).comp (inr ℝ ℝ E))
    (hflow : (fun r => fderiv ℝ X r (1,0)) =ᶠ[𝓝 (t,x)] fun r => u (r.1,X r))
    (hF : HasFDerivAt F DF (t,x)) (hz : HasFDerivAt z Dz (spaceTimeGraph k m (t,x)))
    (hA : F (t,x) = A.toContinuousLinearMap)
    (hu : HasFDerivAt u Du (t,X (t,x)))
    (hp : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => p (t,y)) (X (t,x)))
    (hQ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => Q (t,y)) x)
    (hQgradient : gradient (fun y => Q (t,y)) x = κ • P)
    (hparent : momentumResidual u p (t,X (t,x)) = 0)
    (hlift : Dz (1,(0,0)) +
      (2 : ℝ) • A.symm (DF (1,0) (z (spaceTimeGraph k m (t,x)))) +
      Dz (0,(κ • z (spaceTimeGraph k m (t,x)),⟪m,z (spaceTimeGraph k m (t,x))⟫_ℝ)) +
      κ • A.symm (DF (0,z (spaceTimeGraph k m (t,x))) (z (spaceTimeGraph k m (t,x)))) +
      A.symm (A.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint P) = 0) :
    momentumResidual (fun q => u q+physicalVelocity κ k m F z Y q)
      (fun q => p q+physicalPressure Q Y q) (t,X (t,x)) = 0

theorem slicedMomentum_fieldSum_tail (s : Set ℝ) (N : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (hκ : κ ≠ 0)
    (FInv M : Space →L[ℝ] Space) (m : Space)
    (u : ℕ → Domain → Space) (p : ℕ → Domain → ℝ) (z : Domain)
    (hs : UniqueDiffWithinAt ℝ s z.1)
    (hut : ∀ i ≤ N+1, DifferentiableWithinAt ℝ (fun t => u i (t,z.2)) s z.1)
    (hux : ∀ i ≤ N+1, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => u i (z.1,y)) z.2)
    (hpx : ∀ i ≤ N+1, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => p i (z.1,y)) z.2)
    (hu0 : slicedJet s (u 0) z=0) (hp0 : fastPressure m (pressureJet (p 0) z)=0)
    (hcancel : ∀ n ≤ N, slicedMomentumGrade s (N+1) FInv M m u p z n=0) :
    slicedMomentumResidual s κ FInv M m (fieldSum (N+1) κ u) (fieldSum (N+1) κ p) z=
      ∑ n ∈ Ico (N+1) (2*N+3), κ^n • slicedMomentumGrade s (N+1) FInv M m u p z n

name: EulerPacketResidual.coefficient_assembled
statement:
theorem coefficient_assembled (N p : ℕ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hpN : p ≤ N)
    (L : V →ₗ[ℝ] W) (G H : Q →ₗ[ℝ] W) (B C : V →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℝ] W)
    (a b c : ℕ → V) (q π : ℕ → Q) (hq : ∀ i ≤ N, H (q i)=0) :
    coefficient (N+1) L G H B C (assemble N (fun i => a i+b i) c) (assemble N q π) p =
      (L (a p)+H (π p)) + (L (b p)+G (q p)) + (L (c (p-1))+G (π (p-1))) +
      convolution (N+1) B (assemble N (fun i => a i+b i) c)
        (assemble N (fun i => a i+b i) c) p +
      convolution (N+1) C (assemble N (fun i => a i+b i) c)
        (assemble N (fun i => a i+b i) c) (p+1)

name: EulerPacketResidual.coefficient_assembled_eq_zero
statement:
theorem coefficient_assembled_eq_zero (N p : ℕ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hpN : p ≤ N)
    (L : V →ₗ[ℝ] W) (G H : Q →ₗ[ℝ] W) (B C : V →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℝ] W)
    (a b c : ℕ → V) (q π : ℕ → Q) (hq : ∀ i ≤ N, H (q i)=0) (fmean : W)
    (hmean : L (b p)+G (q p)=fmean)
    (hhigh : L (a p)+H (π p)=
      -(L (c (p-1))+G (π (p-1))+
        convolution (N+1) B (assemble N (fun i => a i+b i) c)
          (assemble N (fun i => a i+b i) c) p+
        convolution (N+1) C (assemble N (fun i => a i+b i) c)
          (assemble N (fun i => a i+b i) c) (p+1))-fmean) :
    coefficient (N+1) L G H B C (assemble N (fun i => a i+b i) c) (assemble N q π) p=0

theorem equation30_slope_ratio_dominates
    {σ lam s t : ℝ} {F F₁ Z Z₁ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hσsmall : σ ≤ 1/4) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam)
    (hF : ∀ x, 0 ≤ x → HasDerivAt F (F₁ x) x)
    (hZ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ x → HasDerivAt Z (Z₁ x) x)
    (hfluxF : ∀ x, 0 ≤ x → HasDerivAt (fun u => (1+(σ^2*u^2)^2)*F₁ u)

    (hfluxZ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ x → HasDerivAt (fun u => (1+(σ^2*u^2)^2)*Z₁ u)
      (2*(1-σ^2*(σ^2*x^2))*Z x) x)
    (hF0 : F 0 = 1) (hF₁0 : F₁ 0 = 0) (hZ0 : Z 0 = 1) (hZ₁0 : Z₁ 0 = lam)

      (if n=N+1 then
        linearPart (O.strain z) (slicedJet O.interval (a N).corrector z)+
        slowPressure (O.inverseFrame z) (pressureJet (a N).highPressure z) else 0) +
      nonlinearGrade (N+1) n (O.inverseFrame z) (O.normal z) (knownJets O (N+1) a z)

    (u c : ℕ → V) (q π : ℕ → Q) :

      (if n=N+1 then L (c N)+G (π N) else 0) +

name: Euler.ComparatorBridge.stage_mapsTo_closedBall_of_partial_sums
statement:
theorem stage_mapsTo_closedBall_of_partial_sums {C : ℝ}
    (hC : ∀ n, ∑ i ∈ range n, δ i ≤ C)
    (R : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (t : Time) (ht : H n t) :

name: Euler.ComparatorBridge.support_subset_of_transport
statement:
theorem support_subset_of_transport {F : Type*} [Zero F]

name: Euler.WeakHilbertODE.continuousOn_of_dense_integral_equation
statement:
theorem continuousOn_of_dense_integral_equation
    {D : Set H} (hD : Dense D) {u b : ℝ → H} {a c : ℝ}
    (hb : IntervalIntegrable b volume a c)
    (hweak : ∀ t ∈ Icc a c, ∀ φ ∈ D,
      inner ℝ φ (u t) - inner ℝ φ (u a) = ∫ s in a..t, inner ℝ φ (b s)) :
    ContinuousOn u (Icc a c)

name: Euler.WeakHilbertODE.continuousOn_of_dense_scalar_derivative
statement:
theorem continuousOn_of_dense_scalar_derivative

    (C : ℝ≥0)
    (hcont : ∀ φ ∈ D, ContinuousOn (fun t => inner ℝ φ (u t)) (Icc a c))
    (hderiv : ∀ φ ∈ D, ∀ t ∈ Ioo a c,
      ∃ d : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s => inner ℝ φ (u s)) d t ∧

    ContinuousOn u (Icc a c)

name: Euler.WeakHilbertODE.eq_of_dense_inner_eq

theorem eq_of_dense_inner_eq {D : Set H} (hD : Dense D) {x y : H}

name: Euler.WeakHilbertODE.hasDerivAt_of_dense_weak_equation

theorem hasDerivAt_of_dense_weak_equation

name: Euler.WeakHilbertODE.hasDerivWithinAt_of_dense_integral_equation
statement:

name: Euler.WeakHilbertODE.hasDerivWithinAt_of_dense_weak_equation

theorem hasDerivWithinAt_of_dense_weak_equation
    {D : Set H} (hD : Dense D) {u b : ℝ → H} {a c t : ℝ}

name: Euler.WeakHilbertODE.lipschitzOnWith_of_dense_scalar_derivative
statement:
theorem lipschitzOnWith_of_dense_scalar_derivative
    {D : Set H} (hD : Dense D) {u : ℝ → H} {a c : ℝ} (hac : a < c)

name: Euler.WeakHilbertODE.lipschitzOnWith_of_dense_weak_equation
statement:
theorem lipschitzOnWith_of_dense_weak_equation
    {D : Set H} (hD : Dense D) {u b : ℝ → H} {a c : ℝ} (hac : a < c)

name: Euler.WeakHilbertODE.norm_le_of_dense_inner_bound

name: Euler.WeakHilbertODE.sub_eq_integral_of_dense_pairing
statement:
theorem sub_eq_integral_of_dense_pairing

name: Euler.WeakHilbertODE.sub_eq_integral_of_dense_weak_equation

name: EulerWeightedForcingAlgebra.familyNorm_add_le
statement: theorem familyNorm_add_le (v w : β → H) : familyNorm (v+w) ≤ familyNorm v + familyNorm w

name: EulerWeightedForcingAlgebra.familyNorm_neg
statement: theorem familyNorm_neg (v : β → H) : familyNorm (-v) = familyNorm v

name: EulerWeightedForcingAlgebra.weightedForcingSum_add_le
statement:
theorem weightedForcingSum_add_le (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (order : α → ℕ) (f g : α → β → H) :
    weightedForcingSum ρ order (f+g) ≤ weightedForcingSum ρ order f + weightedForcingSum ρ order g

name: EulerWeightedForcingAlgebra.weightedForcingSum_neg
statement:
theorem weightedForcingSum_neg (ρ : ℝ) (order : α → ℕ) (f : α → β → H) :
    weightedForcingSum ρ order (-f) = weightedForcingSum ρ order f

name: EulerWeightedForcingAlgebra.weightedForcingSum_sum_le
statement:
theorem weightedForcingSum_sum_le {ι : Type*} (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (order : α → ℕ)
    (S : Finset ι) (f : ι → α → β → H) :
    weightedForcingSum ρ order (∑ i ∈ S, f i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ S, weightedForcingSum ρ order (f i)

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.abs_bilinear_term_le
statement:
theorem abs_bilinear_term_le (a x y wx wy F G : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hF : 0 ≤ F) (_hG : 0 ≤ G) (hwx : 0 ≤ wx) (_hwy : 0 ≤ wy)
    (hx : |x| ≤ F * wx) (hy : |y| ≤ G * wy) :
    |a * x * y| ≤ (F * G) * (a * wx * wy)

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.abs_double_sum_le
statement:
theorem abs_double_sum_le {ι κ : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (t : Finset κ)
    (f M : ι → κ → ℝ) (h : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ k ∈ t, |f i k| ≤ M i k) :
    |∑ i ∈ s, ∑ k ∈ t, f i k| ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ k ∈ t, M i k

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.averageJet_bound
statement:
theorem averageJet_bound {ε F : ℝ} (_hε : 0 < ε) (_hF : 0 ≤ F)
    (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (hf : ∀ n m, |f n m| ≤ F * weight ε n m) (n m : ℕ) :
    |averageJet f n m| ≤ F * weight ε n m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.choose_factorials
statement:
theorem choose_factorials (k l : ℕ) :
    ((k + l).choose k : ℝ) * (k.factorial : ℝ) * (l.factorial : ℝ) =
      ((k + l).factorial : ℝ)

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.choose_product_le
statement:
theorem choose_product_le (i j k l : ℕ) :
    (i + k).choose k * (j + l).choose l ≤ ((i + j) + (k + l)).choose (k + l)

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.coreWeight_factorial
statement:
theorem coreWeight_factorial (ε : ℝ) (n m : ℕ) :
    coreWeight ε n m =
      (1 / 20 : ℝ) ^ n * (ε⁻¹) ^ m * ((n + m).factorial : ℝ) / (n.factorial : ℝ)

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.coreWeight_parameter_shift
statement:
theorem coreWeight_parameter_shift {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (i k : ℕ) :
    coreWeight ε i (k + 1) =
      (20 / ε) * ((i : ℝ) + 1) * coreWeight ε (i + 1) k

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.coreWeight_pos
statement:
theorem coreWeight_pos {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (n m : ℕ) :
    0 < coreWeight ε n m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.coreWeight_product_le
statement:
theorem coreWeight_product_le {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (i j k l : ℕ) :
    ((k + l).choose k : ℝ) * coreWeight ε i k * coreWeight ε j l ≤
      coreWeight ε (i + j) (k + l)

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.coreWeight_radial_identity
statement:
theorem coreWeight_radial_identity {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (n m : ℕ) :
    coreWeight ε n m * ((n : ℝ) + m + 1) =
      20 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * coreWeight ε (n + 1) m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.coreWeight_radial_le
statement:
theorem coreWeight_radial_le {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (n m : ℕ) :
    coreWeight ε n m ≤ 20 * coreWeight ε (n + 1) m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.inverseMixedJet_bound
statement:
theorem inverseMixedJet_bound {ε F G : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hF : 0 ≤ F) (hG : 0 ≤ G)
    {r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (f g : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ n m, |f n m| ≤ F * weight ε n m)
    (hg : ∀ n m, |g n m| ≤ G * weight ε n m) (n m : ℕ) :
    |inverseMixedJet r f g n m| ≤ (5120 / ε) * F * G * weight ε (n + 1) m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.jetProduct_bound
statement:
theorem jetProduct_bound {ε F G : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hF : 0 ≤ F) (hG : 0 ≤ G)
    (f g : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ n m, |f n m| ≤ F * weight ε n m)
    (hg : ∀ n m, |g n m| ≤ G * weight ε n m) (n m : ℕ) :
    |jetProduct f g n m| ≤ 64 * F * G * weight ε n m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.mixedWeightSum_le
statement:
theorem mixedWeightSum_le {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) {r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (n m : ℕ) :
    mixedWeightSum ε r n m ≤ (5120 / ε) * weight ε (n + 1) m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.mixed_factors_le_divisor
statement:
theorem mixed_factors_le_divisor {r n i j : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hij : i + j = n) :
    ((i : ℝ) + 1) * (j : ℝ) ≤ radialDivisor r n

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.mixed_weight_term_le
statement:
theorem mixed_weight_term_le {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) {r n i j : ℕ}
    (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hij : i + j = n) (m k l : ℕ) :
    (((m.choose k : ℝ) * j) / radialDivisor r n) * weight ε i (k + 1) * weight ε j l ≤
      (80 / ε) * ((m.choose k : ℝ) * weight ε (i + 1) k * weight ε j l)

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.parameterPrimitiveJet_bound
statement:
theorem parameterPrimitiveJet_bound {ε F : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hF : 0 ≤ F)
    (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (hf : ∀ n m, |f n m| ≤ F * weight ε n m) (n m : ℕ) :
    |parameterPrimitiveJet f n m| ≤ (80 / ε) * F * weight ε n m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.primitiveJet_bound
statement:
theorem primitiveJet_bound {ε F : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hF : 0 ≤ F)
    (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (hf : ∀ n m, |f n m| ≤ F * weight ε n m) (n m : ℕ) :
    |primitiveJet f n m| ≤ 80 * F * weight ε n m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.productWeightSum_le
statement:
theorem productWeightSum_le {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (n m : ℕ) :
    productWeightSum ε n m ≤ 64 * weight ε n m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.radialDivisor_ge_one
statement: theorem radialDivisor_ge_one {r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (n : ℕ) : 1 ≤ radialDivisor r n

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.radialDivisor_pos
statement: theorem radialDivisor_pos {r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (n : ℕ) : 0 < radialDivisor r n

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.reciprocal_square_telescope
statement:
theorem reciprocal_square_telescope (x : ℝ) (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    1 / x ^ 2 ≤ 2 / x - 2 / (x + 1)

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.regularInverseJet_bound
statement:
theorem regularInverseJet_bound {ε F : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hF : 0 ≤ F)
    {r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ n m, |f n m| ≤ F * weight ε n m) (n m : ℕ) :
    |regularInverseJet r f n m| ≤ 80 * F * weight ε n m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.regularInverseMixedJet_bound
statement:
theorem regularInverseMixedJet_bound {ε F G : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hF : 0 ≤ F) (hG : 0 ≤ G) {r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (f g : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ n m, |f n m| ≤ F * weight ε n m)
    (hg : ∀ n m, |g n m| ≤ G * weight ε n m) (n m : ℕ) :
    |regularInverseMixedJet r f g n m| ≤ (5120 / ε) * F * G * weight ε n m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.shiftedProductWeightSum_le
statement:
theorem shiftedProductWeightSum_le {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (n m : ℕ) :
    shiftedProductWeightSum ε n m ≤ 64 * weight ε (n + 1) m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.squareDecay_convolution_le
statement:
theorem squareDecay_convolution_le (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ ij ∈ antidiagonal n, squareDecay ij.1 * squareDecay ij.2) ≤ 8 * squareDecay n

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.squareDecay_le_four_succ
statement: theorem squareDecay_le_four_succ (n : ℕ) : squareDecay n ≤ 4 * squareDecay (n + 1)

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.squareDecay_pos
statement: theorem squareDecay_pos (n : ℕ) : 0 < squareDecay n

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.squareDecay_product_le
statement:
theorem squareDecay_product_le (i j : ℕ) :
    squareDecay i * squareDecay j ≤
      2 * squareDecay (i + j) * (squareDecay i + squareDecay j)

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.squareDecay_succ_le
statement: theorem squareDecay_succ_le (n : ℕ) : squareDecay (n + 1) ≤ squareDecay n

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.sum_squareDecay_le
statement:
theorem sum_squareDecay_le (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), squareDecay i) ≤ 2 - 2 / ((n : ℝ) + 2)

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.sum_squareDecay_le_two
statement:
theorem sum_squareDecay_le_two (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), squareDecay i) ≤ 2

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.weight_eq_core_decay
statement:
theorem weight_eq_core_decay (ε : ℝ) (n m : ℕ) :
    weight ε n m = coreWeight ε n m * squareDecay n * squareDecay m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.weight_parameter_radial_shift
statement:
theorem weight_parameter_radial_shift {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (i k : ℕ) :
    weight ε i (k + 1) ≤ (80 / ε) * ((i : ℝ) + 1) * weight ε (i + 1) k

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.weight_parameter_radial_shift_ratio
statement:
theorem weight_parameter_radial_shift_ratio {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (i k : ℕ) :
    weight ε i (k + 1) / weight ε (i + 1) k ≤ (80 / ε) * ((i : ℝ) + 1)

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.weight_pos
statement: theorem weight_pos {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (n m : ℕ) : 0 < weight ε n m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.weight_product_term_le
statement:
theorem weight_product_term_le {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (i j k l : ℕ) :
    ((k + l).choose k : ℝ) * weight ε i k * weight ε j l ≤
      coreWeight ε (i + j) (k + l) * (squareDecay i * squareDecay j) *
        (squareDecay k * squareDecay l)

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.weight_radial_shift
statement:
theorem weight_radial_shift {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (n m : ℕ) :
    weight ε n m ≤ 80 * weight ε (n + 1) m

name: NavierStokes.AxisWeightEstimates.weight_radial_shift_ratio
statement:
theorem weight_radial_shift_ratio {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (n m : ℕ) :
    weight ε n m / weight ε (n + 1) m ≤ 80

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.Window.continuous_project
statement: theorem Window.continuous_project (I : Window) : Continuous I.project

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.Window.project_of_mem
statement:
theorem Window.project_of_mem (I : Window) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ I.interval) :
    I.project x = ⟨x, hx⟩

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.abs_iteratedDerivWithin_coefficient_le
statement:
theorem abs_iteratedDerivWithin_coefficient_le (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (A : CoefficientSpace I w) (n m : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ I.interval) :
    |iteratedDerivWithin m (coefficient I w A n) I.interval x| ≤ |w n m| * ‖A‖

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.abs_jet_le
statement:
theorem abs_jet_le (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (A : CoefficientSpace I w)
    (n m : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    |jet I w A.1 n m x| ≤ |w n m| * ‖A‖

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.abs_jet_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_jet_sub_le (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (A B : CoefficientSpace I w)
    (n m : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    |jet I w A.1 n m x - jet I w B.1 n m x| ≤ |w n m| * ‖A - B‖

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.axisSpace_complete
statement: theorem axisSpace_complete (I : Window) (ε : ℝ) : CompleteSpace (AxisSpace I ε)

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.axisSpace_derivative_bound
statement:
theorem axisSpace_derivative_bound (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (A : AxisSpace I ε) (n m : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ I.interval) :
    |iteratedDerivWithin m (coefficient I (AxisWeightEstimates.weight ε) A n) I.interval x| ≤
      AxisWeightEstimates.weight ε n m * ‖A‖

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.axisSpace_norm_le_iff
statement:
theorem axisSpace_norm_le_iff (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (A : AxisSpace I ε) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) :
    ‖A‖ ≤ C ↔ ∀ (n m : ℕ) (x : I.interval),
      |iteratedDerivWithin m (coefficient I (AxisWeightEstimates.weight ε) A n) I.interval x| /
        AxisWeightEstimates.weight ε n m ≤ C

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.axisSpace_smooth
statement:
theorem axisSpace_smooth (I : Window) (ε : ℝ) (A : AxisSpace I ε) (n : ℕ) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (coefficient I (AxisWeightEstimates.weight ε) A n) I.interval

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.coefficient_ext
statement:
theorem coefficient_ext (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ n m, w n m ≠ 0) (A B : CoefficientSpace I w)
    (h : ∀ n x, x ∈ I.interval → coefficient I w A n x = coefficient I w B n x) :
    A = B

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.coefficient_ofJetFamily
statement:
theorem coefficient_ofJetFamily (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (hw : ∀ n m, 0 < w n m)
    (J : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (hcont : ∀ n m, ContinuousOn (J n m) I.interval)
    (hderiv : ∀ n m x, x ∈ I.interval →
      HasDerivWithinAt (J n m) (J n (m + 1) x) I.interval x)
    (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hbound : ∀ n m x, x ∈ I.interval → |J n m x| ≤ C * w n m)
    (n : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ I.interval) :
    coefficient I w (ofJetFamily I w hw J hcont hderiv C hC hbound) n x = J n 0 x

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.coefficient_ofSmoothFamily
statement:
theorem coefficient_ofSmoothFamily (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (hw : ∀ n m, 0 < w n m)
    (F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (hF : ∀ n, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (F n) I.interval)
    (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hbound : ∀ n m x, x ∈ I.interval →
      |iteratedDerivWithin m (F n) I.interval x| ≤ C * w n m)

name: NavierStokes.AxisCoefficientSpace.jet_ofSmoothFamily

theorem jet_ofSmoothFamily (I : Window) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (hw : ∀ n m, 0 < w n m)

name: NavierStokes.AnalyticCoefficientBounds.uniform_normalizedExp_axisData
statement:
theorem uniform_normalizedExp_axisData
    {I : Window} {ε ρ M : ℝ} {F : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hερ : ε < ρ)
    (hF : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ F (closedTube I ρ))
    (hM : ∀ z ∈ closedTube I ρ, (F z).re ≤ M)
    (hreal : ∀ x ∈ I.interval, (F (x : ℂ)).im = 0) :
    ∀ Λ : ℝ, 0 ≤ Λ → ∀ C : ℝ, Real.exp (Λ * M) ≤ C →
      ∃ a : AxisSpace I ε,
        ‖a‖ ≤ radiusLoss (ε / ρ) ∧
        (∀ x ∈ I.interval, coefficient I (AxisWeightEstimates.weight ε) a 0 x =
          Real.exp (Λ * (F (x : ℂ)).re) / C) ∧
        (∀ n : ℕ, n ≠ 0 → ∀ x ∈ I.interval,
          coefficient I (AxisWeightEstimates.weight ε) a n x = 0)

    ∀ Λ : ℝ, 0 ≤ Λ → ∀ C : ℝ, Real.exp (Λ * realPartSup F K) ≤ C →
      ∃ a : AxisSpace I ε,
        ‖a‖ ≤ radiusLoss (ε / ρ) ∧
        (∀ x ∈ I.interval, coefficient I (AxisWeightEstimates.weight ε) a 0 x =
          Real.exp (Λ * (F (x : ℂ)).re) / C) ∧
        (∀ n : ℕ, n ≠ 0 → ∀ x ∈ I.interval,
          coefficient I (AxisWeightEstimates.weight ε) a n x = 0)

name: NavierStokes.MomentRepair.correctionIteration_norm_le
statement:
theorem correctionIteration_norm_le
    (B : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (Q : E → E) (d : E) (β K r : ℝ)
    (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hB : ∀ x, ‖B.symm x‖ ≤ β * ‖x‖)
    (hQ : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ r → ‖Q x‖ ≤ K * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (hsmall : 4 * β * K * r ≤ 1) (hd : 2 * β * ‖d‖ ≤ r)
    (c : E) (hc : ‖c‖ ≤ r) : ‖correctionIteration B Q d c‖ ≤ r

name: NavierStokes.MomentRepair.correctionIteration_sub_le
statement:
theorem correctionIteration_sub_le
    (B : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (Q : E → E) (d : E) (β K r : ℝ)
    (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hB : ∀ x, ‖B.symm x‖ ≤ β * ‖x‖)
    (hQ : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ r → ∀ y, ‖y‖ ≤ r →
      ‖Q x - Q y‖ ≤ K * (‖x‖ + ‖y‖) * ‖x - y‖)
    (hsmall : 4 * β * K * r ≤ 1)
    (x y : E) (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ r) (hy : ‖y‖ ≤ r) :
    ‖correctionIteration B Q d x - correctionIteration B Q d y‖ ≤
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖x - y‖

name: NavierStokes.MomentRepair.exists_unique_small_correction
statement:
theorem exists_unique_small_correction [CompleteSpace E]
    (B : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (Q : E → E) (d : E) (β K r : ℝ)
    (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hB : ∀ x, ‖B.symm x‖ ≤ β * ‖x‖)
    (hQnorm : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ r → ‖Q x‖ ≤ K * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (hQdiff : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ r → ∀ y, ‖y‖ ≤ r →
      ‖Q x - Q y‖ ≤ K * (‖x‖ + ‖y‖) * ‖x - y‖)
    (hsmall : 4 * β * K * r ≤ 1) (hd : 2 * β * ‖d‖ ≤ r) :
    ∃! c : E, ‖c‖ ≤ r ∧ B c + Q c = d

name: NavierStokes.LocalizedMomentRepair.exists_smooth_compact_repair
statement:
theorem exists_smooth_compact_repair (a l u d : Fin n → ℝ) (ha : Injective a)
    (hl : ∀ j, 0 < l j) (hlu : ∀ j, l j < u j)
    (hsep : ∀ i j, i < j → u i ≤ l j) :
    ∃ f : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ f ∧ HasCompactSupport f ∧
      tsupport f ⊆ ⋃ j, Ioo (l j) (u j) ∧ ∀ i, (∫ t, t ^ a i * f t) = d i

name: NavierStokes.LocalizedMomentRepair.iteratedDeriv_finite_sum
statement:
theorem iteratedDeriv_finite_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (f i)) (k : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    iteratedDeriv k (fun x => ∑ i ∈ s, f i x) t = ∑ i ∈ s, iteratedDeriv k (f i) t

statement: theorem repairRegion_isCompact (l u : Fin n → ℝ) : IsCompact (repairRegion l u)

name: NavierStokes.LocalizedMomentRepair.repairRegion_subset_open

theorem repairRegion_subset_open (l u : Fin n → ℝ) (hlu : ∀ j, l j < u j) :

name: NavierStokes.LocalizedMomentRepair.repair_add
statement:
theorem repair_add (a l u d e : Fin n → ℝ) :
    repair a l u (d + e) = repair a l u d + repair a l u e

name: NavierStokes.LocalizedMomentRepair.repair_contDiff
statement: theorem repair_contDiff (a l u d : Fin n → ℝ) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (repair a l u d)

name: NavierStokes.LocalizedMomentRepair.repair_derivative_bound
statement:
theorem repair_derivative_bound (a l u : Fin n → ℝ) (hlu : ∀ j, l j < u j) (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (d : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ),
      |iteratedDeriv k (repair a l u d) t| ≤ C * ‖d‖

name: NavierStokes.LocalizedMomentRepair.repair_eq_sum_coordinate
statement:
theorem repair_eq_sum_coordinate (a l u d : Fin n → ℝ) :
    repair a l u d = fun t => ∑ j, d j * repair a l u (Pi.single j 1) t

name: NavierStokes.LocalizedMomentRepair.repair_exact
statement:
theorem repair_exact (a l u d : Fin n → ℝ) (ha : Injective a)
    (hl : ∀ j, 0 < l j) (hlu : ∀ j, l j < u j)
    (hsep : ∀ i j, i < j → u i ≤ l j) (i : Fin n) :
    (∫ t, t ^ a i * repair a l u d t) = d i

name: NavierStokes.LocalizedMomentRepair.repair_finite_jet_bound
statement:
theorem repair_finite_jet_bound (a l u : Fin n → ℝ) (hlu : ∀ j, l j < u j) (N : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ k ≤ N, ∀ (d e : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ),
      |iteratedDeriv k (repair a l u d) t - iteratedDeriv k (repair a l u e) t| ≤
        C * ‖d - e‖

name: NavierStokes.LocalizedMomentRepair.repair_hasCompactSupport
statement:
theorem repair_hasCompactSupport (a l u d : Fin n → ℝ) (hlu : ∀ j, l j < u j) :
    HasCompactSupport (repair a l u d)

name: NavierStokes.LocalizedMomentRepair.repair_iteratedDeriv_coordinate
statement:
theorem repair_iteratedDeriv_coordinate (a l u d : Fin n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    iteratedDeriv k (repair a l u d) t =
      ∑ j, d j * iteratedDeriv k (repair a l u (Pi.single j 1)) t

name: NavierStokes.LocalizedMomentRepair.repair_smul
statement:
theorem repair_smul (a l u d : Fin n → ℝ) (r : ℝ) :
    repair a l u (r • d) = r • repair a l u d

name: NavierStokes.LocalizedMomentRepair.repair_sub
statement:
theorem repair_sub (a l u d e : Fin n → ℝ) :
    repair a l u (d - e) = repair a l u d - repair a l u e

name: NavierStokes.LocalizedMomentRepair.repair_support_subset
statement:
theorem repair_support_subset (a l u d : Fin n → ℝ) (hlu : ∀ j, l j < u j) :

name: NavierStokes.LocalizedMomentRepair.repair_tsupport_subset
statement:
theorem repair_tsupport_subset (a l u d : Fin n → ℝ) (hlu : ∀ j, l j < u j) :

statement:
theorem repair_tsupport_subset_open (a l u d : Fin n → ℝ) (hlu : ∀ j, l j < u j) :
    tsupport (repair a l u d) ⊆ ⋃ j, Ioo (l j) (u j)

name: NavierStokes.LocalizedMomentRepair.smooth_compact_derivative_bound
statement:
theorem smooth_compact_derivative_bound (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hc : HasCompactSupport f) (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ t, |iteratedDeriv k f t| ≤ C

name: NavierStokes.SmoothMomentRepair.compact_inverse_quadratic_bounds
statement:
theorem compact_inverse_quadratic_bounds [CompleteSpace E]
    {P : Type*} [TopologicalSpace P] (S : Set P) (hS : IsCompact S)
    (B : P → E →L[ℝ] E) (A : P → E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] E)
    (hB : ContinuousOn B S) (hA : ContinuousOn A S)
    (hinv : ∀ p ∈ S, (B p).IsInvertible) :
    ∃ β K : ℝ, 0 < β ∧ 0 < K ∧
      ∀ p ∈ S, ‖(B p).inverse‖ ≤ β ∧ ‖A p‖ ≤ K

name: NavierStokes.SmoothMomentRepair.compact_uniform_small_correction
statement:
theorem compact_uniform_small_correction [CompleteSpace E]
    {P : Type*} [TopologicalSpace P] (S : Set P) (hS : IsCompact S)
    (B : P → E →L[ℝ] E) (A : P → E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] E)
    (hB : ContinuousOn B S) (hA : ContinuousOn A S)
    (hinv : ∀ p ∈ S, (B p).IsInvertible) :
    ∃ β ε : ℝ, 0 < β ∧ 0 < ε ∧ ∀ p ∈ S, ∀ d : E, ‖d‖ ≤ ε →
      ∃! c : E, ‖c‖ ≤ 2 * β * ‖d‖ ∧ B p c + A p c c = d

name: NavierStokes.SmoothMomentRepair.exists_local_analytic_solver
statement:
theorem exists_local_analytic_solver [CompleteSpace E]
    (B : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (A : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] E) :
    ∃ (g : RepairData E → E) (U : Set (RepairData E)),
      IsOpen U ∧ base B A ∈ U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ⊤ g U ∧ g (base B A) = 0 ∧
      ∀ z ∈ U, z.1.1 (g z) + z.1.2 (g z) (g z) = z.2

name: NavierStokes.SmoothMomentRepair.exists_local_bounded_analytic_solver
statement:
theorem exists_local_bounded_analytic_solver [CompleteSpace E]
    (B₀ : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (A₀ : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] E) :
    ∃ (g : RepairData E → E) (U : Set (RepairData E)) (C : ℝ),
      IsOpen U ∧ base B₀ A₀ ∈ U ∧ 0 < C ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ⊤ g U ∧
      g (base B₀ A₀) = 0 ∧ ∀ z ∈ U,
        z.1.1 (g z) + z.1.2 (g z) (g z) = z.2 ∧ ‖g z‖ ≤ C * ‖z.2‖

name: NavierStokes.SmoothMomentRepair.exists_smooth_parameter_branch
statement:
theorem exists_smooth_parameter_branch [CompleteSpace E]
    {P : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup P] [NormedSpace ℝ P]
    (p₀ : P) (B : P → E →L[ℝ] E) (A : P → E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] E) (d : P → E)
    (hB : ContDiff ℝ ∞ B) (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (hd : ContDiff ℝ ∞ d)
    (B₀ : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (hB₀ : B p₀ = B₀.toContinuousLinearMap) (hd₀ : d p₀ = 0) :
    ∃ (c : P → E) (U : Set P) (C : ℝ), IsOpen U ∧ p₀ ∈ U ∧ 0 < C ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c U ∧ c p₀ = 0 ∧
      ∀ p ∈ U, B p (c p) + A p (c p) (c p) = d p ∧ ‖c p‖ ≤ C * ‖d p‖

name: NavierStokes.SmoothMomentRepair.exists_unique_quadratic_correction
statement:
theorem exists_unique_quadratic_correction [CompleteSpace E]
    (B : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (A : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] E) (d : E) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hsmall : 4 * ‖B.symm.toContinuousLinearMap‖ * ‖A‖ * r ≤ 1)
    (hd : 2 * ‖B.symm.toContinuousLinearMap‖ * ‖d‖ ≤ r) :
    ∃! c : E, ‖c‖ ≤ r ∧ B c + A c c = d

name: NavierStokes.SmoothMomentRepair.forward_base
statement:
theorem forward_base (B : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (A : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] E) :
    forward (base B A) = base B A

name: NavierStokes.SmoothMomentRepair.forward_contDiff
statement: theorem forward_contDiff : ContDiff ℝ ⊤ (forward : RepairData E → RepairData E)

name: NavierStokes.SmoothMomentRepair.forward_hasFDerivAt
statement:
theorem forward_hasFDerivAt (B : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (A : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] E) :
    HasFDerivAt forward
      (((ContinuousLinearEquiv.refl ℝ (QuadraticCoefficients E)).prodCongr B).toContinuousLinearMap)
      (base B A)

name: NavierStokes.SmoothMomentRepair.quadratic_norm_le
statement:
theorem quadratic_norm_le (A : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] E) (c : E) :
    ‖A c c‖ ≤ ‖A‖ * ‖c‖ ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.SmoothMomentRepair.quadratic_sub_le
statement:
theorem quadratic_sub_le (A : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] E) (c e : E) :
    ‖A c c - A e e‖ ≤ ‖A‖ * (‖c‖ + ‖e‖) * ‖c - e‖

name: NavierStokes.SmoothMomentRepair.solution_norm_bound
statement:
theorem solution_norm_bound (B₀ : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (B : E →L[ℝ] E)
    (A : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] E) (c d : E) (β δ K r : ℝ)
    (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hinv : ∀ x, ‖B₀.symm x‖ ≤ β * ‖x‖)
    (hB : ‖B - B₀.toContinuousLinearMap‖ ≤ δ) (hA : ‖A‖ ≤ K)
    (hc : ‖c‖ ≤ r) (hsmall : β * (δ + K * r) ≤ 1 / 2)
    (heq : B c + A c c = d) : ‖c‖ ≤ 2 * β * ‖d‖

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.ResetBranch.angular_change
statement:
theorem angular_change (e0 X0 y0 δ : ℝ) (hX : 0 ≤ X0)
    (hδ : δ ∈ Ioo (-B.radius) B.radius) :
    (∫ y, radiusX X0 y *
      (modifiedH lam e0 X0 y0 (B.coefficients δ) y - baseH lam e0 X0 y)) =
      angularScale lam e0 X0 y0 * δ

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.ResetBranch.exact_endpoint_moment
statement:
theorem ResetBranch.exact_endpoint_moment {lam : ℝ} (B : ResetBranch lam)
    (e0 X0 y0 a b Iprior Itarget : ℝ) (he0 : 0 < e0) (hX : 0 < X0)
    (ha : a ≤ y0 - 1) (hb : y0 + 3 ≤ b)
    (hδ : (Itarget - prefixI lam e0 X0 a b Iprior) / angularScale lam e0 X0 y0 ∈
      Ioo (-B.radius) B.radius) :
    Iprior + (∫ y in Icc a b, radiusX X0 y * modifiedH lam e0 X0 y0
      (B.coefficients ((Itarget - prefixI lam e0 X0 a b Iprior) / angularScale lam e0 X0 y0)) y) =
        Itarget

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.ResetBranch.exact_target
statement:
theorem exact_target (e0 X0 y0 Iold Itarget : ℝ) (he0 : 0 < e0) (hX : 0 < X0)
    (hδ : (Itarget - Iold) / angularScale lam e0 X0 y0 ∈ Ioo (-B.radius) B.radius) :
    Iold + (∫ y, radiusX X0 y *
      (modifiedH lam e0 X0 y0
        (B.coefficients ((Itarget - Iold) / angularScale lam e0 X0 y0)) y -
          baseH lam e0 X0 y)) = Itarget

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.ResetBranch.joint_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem ResetBranch.joint_contDiffOn {lam : ℝ} (B : ResetBranch lam)
    (e0 y0 : ℝ) {P : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup P] [NormedSpace ℝ P]
    {S : Set P} {δ : P → ℝ} (hδ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ δ S)
    (hsmall : ∀ p ∈ S, δ p ∈ Ioo (-B.radius) B.radius) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × ℝ => modifiedE lam e0 y0 (B.coefficients (δ z.1)) z.2)
      (S ×ˢ univ)

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.ResetBranch.logSlope_le
statement:
theorem logSlope_le (hlam : 0 < lam) (e0 y0 δ y : ℝ) (he0 : 0 < e0)
    (hδ : δ ∈ Ioo (-B.radius) B.radius) :
    logSlope (modifiedE lam e0 y0 (B.coefficients δ)) y ≤ -lam / 2

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.ResetBranch.positive
statement:
theorem positive (hlam : 0 < lam) (e0 y0 δ y : ℝ) (he0 : 0 < e0)
    (hδ : δ ∈ Ioo (-B.radius) B.radius) :
    0 < modifiedE lam e0 y0 (B.coefficients δ) y

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.ResetBranch.pressure_interval_neutral
statement:
theorem ResetBranch.pressure_interval_neutral {lam : ℝ} (B : ResetBranch lam)
    (e0 y0 a b δ : ℝ) (ha : a ≤ y0 - 1) (hb : y0 + 3 ≤ b)
    (hδ : δ ∈ Ioo (-B.radius) B.radius) :
    (∫ y in Icc a b, (modifiedE lam e0 y0 (B.coefficients δ) y) ^ 2) =
      ∫ y in Icc a b, (baseE lam e0 y) ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.ResetBranch.pressure_neutral
statement:
theorem pressure_neutral (e0 y0 δ : ℝ) (hδ : δ ∈ Ioo (-B.radius) B.radius) :
    (∫ y, (modifiedE lam e0 y0 (B.coefficients δ) y) ^ 2 - (baseE lam e0 y) ^ 2) = 0

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.angularScale_pos
statement:
theorem angularScale_pos (lam e0 X0 y0 : ℝ) (he0 : 0 < e0) (hX : 0 < X0) :
    0 < angularScale lam e0 X0 y0

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.angular_delta_integrable
statement:
theorem angular_delta_integrable (lam e0 X0 y0 : ℝ) (c : Coeff) :
    Integrable (fun y => radiusX X0 y * (modifiedH lam e0 X0 y0 c y - baseH lam e0 X0 y))

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.angular_integral_formula
statement:
theorem angular_integral_formula (lam e0 X0 y0 : ℝ) (c : Coeff) (hX : 0 ≤ X0) :
    (∫ y, radiusX X0 y * (modifiedH lam e0 X0 y0 c y - baseH lam e0 X0 y)) =
      angularScale lam e0 X0 y0 * ∫ y, Real.exp (angularSlope lam * y) * relative c y

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.angular_interval_change
statement:
theorem angular_interval_change (lam e0 X0 y0 a b : ℝ) (c : Coeff)
    (hX : 0 ≤ X0) (ha : a ≤ y0 - 1) (hb : y0 + 3 ≤ b) :
    (∫ y in Icc a b, radiusX X0 y * modifiedH lam e0 X0 y0 c y) -
      (∫ y in Icc a b, radiusX X0 y * baseH lam e0 X0 y) =
      angularScale lam e0 X0 y0 * ∫ y, Real.exp (angularSlope lam * y) * relative c y

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.angular_weight_formula
statement:
theorem angular_weight_formula (lam e0 X0 y : ℝ) (hX : 0 ≤ X0) :
    radiusX X0 y * baseH lam e0 X0 y =
      X0 * Real.sqrt (2 * X0) * e0 * Real.exp (angularSlope lam * y)

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.baseE_contDiff
statement: theorem baseE_contDiff (lam e0 : ℝ) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (baseE lam e0)

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.baseE_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem baseE_hasDerivAt (lam e0 y : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (baseE lam e0) (baseE lam e0 y * (-1 / 2 - lam)) y

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.baseE_pos
statement: theorem baseE_pos (lam e0 y : ℝ) (he0 : 0 < e0) : 0 < baseE lam e0 y

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.baseE_square
statement:
theorem baseE_square (lam e0 y : ℝ) :
    (baseE lam e0 y) ^ 2 = e0 ^ 2 * Real.exp (pressureSlope lam * y)

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.baseH_continuous
statement: theorem baseH_continuous (lam e0 X0 : ℝ) : Continuous (baseH lam e0 X0)

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.bump_contDiff
statement: theorem bump_contDiff (j : Fin 2) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (bump j)

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.bump_hasCompactSupport
statement: theorem bump_hasCompactSupport (j : Fin 2) : HasCompactSupport (bump j)

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.bump_le_one
statement: theorem bump_le_one (j : Fin 2) (y : ℝ) : bump j y ≤ 1

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.bump_moment
statement:
theorem bump_moment (s : ℝ) (j : Fin 2) :
    (∫ y, Real.exp (s * y) * bump j y) =
      Real.exp (s * (2 * (j.val : ℝ))) * moment s

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.bump_nonneg
statement: theorem bump_nonneg (j : Fin 2) (y : ℝ) : 0 ≤ bump j y

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.bump_support
statement:
theorem bump_support (j : Fin 2) :
    support (bump j) ⊆ Icc (2 * (j.val : ℝ) - 3 / 20) (2 * (j.val : ℝ) + 3 / 20)

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.bumps_disjoint
statement: theorem bumps_disjoint (y : ℝ) : bump 0 y * bump 1 y = 0

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.debt_contDiff
statement: theorem debt_contDiff : ContDiff ℝ ∞ debt

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.debt_norm_le
statement: theorem debt_norm_le (δ : ℝ) : ‖debt δ‖ ≤ |δ|

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.exists_normalized_branch
statement:
theorem exists_normalized_branch (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) :
    ∃ (c : ℝ → Coeff) (ε K : ℝ), 0 < ε ∧ 0 < K ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c (Ioo (-ε) ε) ∧ c 0 = 0 ∧
      ∀ δ ∈ Ioo (-ε) ε,
        (∫ y, Real.exp (angularSlope lam * y) * relative (c δ) y) = δ ∧
        (∫ y, Real.exp (pressureSlope lam * y) * ((1 + relative (c δ) y) ^ 2 - 1)) = 0 ∧
        ‖c δ‖ ≤ K * |δ|

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.exists_resetBranch
statement: theorem exists_resetBranch (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) : Nonempty (ResetBranch lam)

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.linearEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem linearEquiv_apply (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) (c : Coeff) :
    linearEquiv lam hlam c = (linearMatrix lam).mulVec c

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.linearMatrix_det
statement:
theorem linearMatrix_det (lam : ℝ) :
    (linearMatrix lam).det = 2 * moment (angularSlope lam) * moment (pressureSlope lam) *
      (Real.exp (2 * pressureSlope lam) - Real.exp (2 * angularSlope lam))

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.linearMatrix_det_ne_zero
statement:
theorem linearMatrix_det_ne_zero (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) :
    (linearMatrix lam).det ≠ 0

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.modifiedE_contDiff
statement:
theorem modifiedE_contDiff (lam e0 y0 : ℝ) (c : Coeff) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (modifiedE lam e0 y0 c)

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.modifiedE_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem modifiedE_hasDerivAt (lam e0 y0 : ℝ) (c : Coeff) (y : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (modifiedE lam e0 y0 c)
      (baseE lam e0 y * (-1 / 2 - lam) * (1 + relative c (y - y0)) +
        baseE lam e0 y * deriv (relative c) (y - y0)) y

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.modifiedE_logSlope
statement:
theorem modifiedE_logSlope (lam e0 y0 : ℝ) (c : Coeff) (y : ℝ) (he0 : e0 ≠ 0)
    (hpos : 1 + relative c (y - y0) ≠ 0) :
    logSlope (modifiedE lam e0 y0 c) y =
      -lam + deriv (relative c) (y - y0) / (1 + relative c (y - y0))

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.modifiedE_sub_hasCompactSupport
statement:
theorem modifiedE_sub_hasCompactSupport (lam e0 y0 : ℝ) (c : Coeff) :
    HasCompactSupport (modifiedE lam e0 y0 c - baseE lam e0)

statement:
theorem moment_map_identity (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) (c : Coeff) :
    linearEquiv lam hlam c + quadraticCLM lam c c =
      ![∫ y, Real.exp (angularSlope lam * y) * relative c y,
        ∫ y, Real.exp (pressureSlope lam * y) * ((1 + relative c y) ^ 2 - 1)]

statement:
theorem positive_and_slope_of_small (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) (c : Coeff) (y : ℝ)
    (h0 : |relative c y| ≤ 1 / 2) (h1 : |deriv (relative c) y| ≤ lam / 4) :
    0 < 1 + relative c y ∧ -lam + deriv (relative c) y / (1 + relative c y) ≤ -lam / 2

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.pressure_change_moment
statement:
theorem pressure_change_moment (lam : ℝ) (c : Coeff) :
    (∫ y, Real.exp (pressureSlope lam * y) * ((1 + relative c y) ^ 2 - 1)) =
      2 * (moment (pressureSlope lam) * c 0 +
        Real.exp (2 * pressureSlope lam) * moment (pressureSlope lam) * c 1) +
      quadraticMoment lam 0 * (c 0) ^ 2 + quadraticMoment lam 1 * (c 1) ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.pressure_integral_formula
statement:
theorem pressure_integral_formula (lam e0 y0 : ℝ) (c : Coeff) :
    (∫ y, (modifiedE lam e0 y0 c y) ^ 2 - (baseE lam e0 y) ^ 2) =
      e0 ^ 2 * Real.exp (pressureSlope lam * y0) *
        ∫ y, Real.exp (pressureSlope lam * y) * ((1 + relative c y) ^ 2 - 1)

name: NavierStokes.AngularMomentReset.pressure_interval_change
statement:
theorem pressure_interval_change (lam e0 y0 a b : ℝ) (c : Coeff)
    (ha : a ≤ y0 - 1) (hb : y0 + 3 ≤ b) :
    (∫ y in Icc a b, (modifiedE lam e0 y0 c y) ^ 2) -
      (∫ y in Icc a b, (baseE lam e0 y) ^ 2) =
      e0 ^ 2 * Real.exp (pressureSlope lam * y0) *
        ∫ y, Real.exp (pressureSlope lam * y) * ((1 + relative c y) ^ 2 - 1)

statement:
theorem iteratedDeriv_average_zero {f : ℝ → E} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (n : ℕ) :
    iteratedDeriv n (average f) 0 = (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) • iteratedDeriv n f 0

name: NavierStokes.EvenSmoothDescent.iteratedDeriv_iteratedDeriv
statement:
theorem iteratedDeriv_iteratedDeriv (f : ℝ → E) (m n : ℕ) :
    iteratedDeriv m (iteratedDeriv n f) = iteratedDeriv (m + n) f

name: NavierStokes.EvenSmoothDescent.iteratedDeriv_radialDerivative_zero
statement:
theorem iteratedDeriv_radialDerivative_zero {f : ℝ → E} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (n : ℕ) :
    iteratedDeriv n (radialDerivative f) 0 =
      (1 / (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1))) • iteratedDeriv (n + 2) f 0

name: NavierStokes.EvenSmoothDescent.iteratedDeriv_scale
statement:
theorem iteratedDeriv_scale {f : ℝ → E} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (n : ℕ) (x t : ℝ) :
    iteratedDeriv n (fun y => f (t * y)) x = t ^ n • iteratedDeriv n f (t * x)

name: NavierStokes.EvenSmoothDescent.localized_eventuallyEq
statement: theorem localized_eventuallyEq (r : ℝ) (f : ℝ → E) : localized r f =ᶠ[𝓝 0] f

name: NavierStokes.EvenSmoothDescent.localized_eventually_zero
statement:
theorem localized_eventually_zero {r x : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hx : r ≤ |x|) (f : ℝ → E) :
    localized r f =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun _ => 0)

name: NavierStokes.EvenSmoothDescent.measurable_scaled_jet
statement:
theorem measurable_scaled_jet {f : ℝ → E} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => iteratedDeriv n (fun y => f (t * y)) x)
      (volume.restrict (Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1))

name: NavierStokes.EvenSmoothDescent.radialDerivative_eq_div
statement:
theorem radialDerivative_eq_div {f : ℝ → E} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (he : Function.Even f) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    radialDerivative f x = (1 / (2 * x)) • deriv f x

name: NavierStokes.EvenSmoothDescent.radialDerivative_identity
statement:
theorem radialDerivative_identity {f : ℝ → E} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (he : Function.Even f) (x : ℝ) :
    (2 * x) • radialDerivative f x = deriv f x

name: NavierStokes.EvenSmoothDescent.radialIterate_at_zero
statement:
theorem radialIterate_at_zero (n : ℕ) {f : ℝ → E} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) :
    radialIterate f n 0 =
      ((n.factorial : ℝ) / ((2 * n).factorial : ℝ)) • iteratedDeriv (2 * n) f 0

name: NavierStokes.EvenSmoothDescent.radialIterate_succ
statement:
theorem radialIterate_succ (f : ℝ → E) (n : ℕ) :
    radialIterate f (n + 1) = radialDerivative (radialIterate f n)

name: NavierStokes.EvenSmoothDescent.radialIterate_succ_right
statement:
theorem radialIterate_succ_right (f : ℝ → E) (n : ℕ) :
    radialIterate f (n + 1) = radialIterate (radialDerivative f) n

name: NavierStokes.EvenSmoothDescent.radialIterate_zero
statement: theorem radialIterate_zero (f : ℝ → E) : radialIterate f 0 = f

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.ball_subset_outer
statement:
theorem ball_subset_outer (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (z : Disk c ρ) :
    ball (z : ℂ) (σ - ρ) ⊆ ball c σ

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.cauchyMap_add
statement:
theorem cauchyMap_add (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (hgap : ρ < σ)
    (f g : C(Disk c σ, E)) : cauchyMap c hgap (f + g) = cauchyMap c hgap f + cauchyMap c hgap g

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.cauchyMap_smul
statement:
theorem cauchyMap_smul (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (hgap : ρ < σ)
    (a : ℂ) (f : C(Disk c σ, E)) : cauchyMap c hgap (a • f) = a • cauchyMap c hgap f

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.circle_kernel_identity
statement:
theorem circle_kernel_identity {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (z : ℂ) (θ : ℝ) (v : E) :
    weight δ θ • v = deriv (circleMap z δ) θ •
      ((circleMap z δ θ - z) ^ (-2 : ℤ) • v)

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.contDiff_derivative_path
statement:
theorem contDiff_derivative_path {X : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X]
    (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (hgap : ρ < σ) {n : WithTop ℕ∞}
    {f : X → C(Disk c σ, E)} (hf : ContDiff ℝ n f) :
    ContDiff ℝ n (fun x => derivativeCLM c hgap (f x))

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.continuous_derivative_path
statement:
theorem continuous_derivative_path {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (hgap : ρ < σ) {f : X → C(Disk c σ, E)} (hf : Continuous f) :
    Continuous (fun x => derivativeCLM c hgap (f x))

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.continuous_integrand
statement:
theorem continuous_integrand (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (hgap : ρ < σ)
    (f : C(Disk c σ, E)) : Continuous (integrand c hgap f)

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.continuous_weight
statement: theorem continuous_weight {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) : Continuous (weight δ)

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.derivativeCLM_apply_integral
statement:
theorem derivativeCLM_apply_integral (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (hgap : ρ < σ)
    (f : C(Disk c σ, E)) (z : Disk c ρ) :
    derivativeCLM c hgap f z = (2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ •
      ∫ θ : ℝ in (0)..(2 * Real.pi),
        weight (σ - ρ) θ • f (sample c hgap θ z)

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.derivativeCLM_apply_of_diffContOnCl
statement:
theorem derivativeCLM_apply_of_diffContOnCl (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (hgap : ρ < σ)
    (F : ℂ → E) (hF : DiffContOnCl ℂ F (ball c σ)) (z : Disk c ρ) :
    derivativeCLM c hgap (ofContinuousOn c σ F hF.continuousOn_ball) z = deriv F z

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.derivativeCLM_apply_of_differentiableOn
statement:
theorem derivativeCLM_apply_of_differentiableOn (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (hgap : ρ < σ)
    (F : ℂ → E) (hF : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (closedBall c σ)) (z : Disk c ρ) :
    derivativeCLM c hgap (ofContinuousOn c σ F hF.continuousOn) z = deriv F z

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.derivativeCLM_apply_of_eq
statement:
theorem derivativeCLM_apply_of_eq (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (hgap : ρ < σ)
    (f : C(Disk c σ, E)) (F : ℂ → E)
    (hF : DiffContOnCl ℂ F (ball c σ))
    (hvalues : ∀ w : Disk c σ, f w = F w) (z : Disk c ρ) :
    derivativeCLM c hgap f z = deriv F z

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.derivativeCLM_restrict_of_eq
statement:
theorem derivativeCLM_restrict_of_eq (c : ℂ) {r ρ σ : ℝ}
    (hgap : r < ρ) (houter : ρ ≤ σ) (f : C(Disk c σ, E)) (F : ℂ → E)
    (hF : DiffContOnCl ℂ F (ball c σ))
    (hvalues : ∀ w : Disk c σ, f w = F w) :
    derivativeCLM c hgap (restrictionCLM c houter f) =
      derivativeCLM c (hgap.trans_le houter) f

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.norm_cauchyMap_le
statement:
theorem norm_cauchyMap_le (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (hgap : ρ < σ)
    (f : C(Disk c σ, E)) : ‖cauchyMap c hgap f‖ ≤ (σ - ρ)⁻¹ * ‖f‖

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.norm_derivativeCLM_le
statement:
theorem norm_derivativeCLM_le (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (hgap : ρ < σ) :
    ‖derivativeCLM (E := E) c hgap‖ ≤ (σ - ρ)⁻¹

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.norm_integrand_le
statement:
theorem norm_integrand_le (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (hgap : ρ < σ)
    (f : C(Disk c σ, E)) (θ : ℝ) :
    ‖integrand c hgap f θ‖ ≤ (σ - ρ)⁻¹ * ‖f‖

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.norm_restrictionCLM_le
statement:
theorem norm_restrictionCLM_le (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (h : ρ ≤ σ) :
    ‖restrictionCLM (E := E) c h‖ ≤ 1

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.norm_restrictionLinear_le
statement:
theorem norm_restrictionLinear_le (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (h : ρ ≤ σ)
    (f : C(Disk c σ, E)) : ‖restrictionLinear c h f‖ ≤ ‖f‖

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.norm_weight
statement: theorem norm_weight {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (θ : ℝ) : ‖weight δ θ‖ = δ⁻¹

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.ofContinuousOn_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofContinuousOn_apply (c : ℂ) (r : ℝ) (F : ℂ → E)
    (hF : ContinuousOn F (closedBall c r)) (z : Disk c r) :
    ofContinuousOn c r F hF z = F z

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.offset_ne_zero
statement: theorem offset_ne_zero {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (θ : ℝ) : circleMap 0 δ θ ≠ 0

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.restrict_derivativeCLM_of_eq
statement:
theorem restrict_derivativeCLM_of_eq (c : ℂ) {r ρ σ : ℝ}
    (hr : r ≤ ρ) (hgap : ρ < σ) (f : C(Disk c σ, E)) (F : ℂ → E)
    (hF : DiffContOnCl ℂ F (ball c σ))
    (hvalues : ∀ w : Disk c σ, f w = F w) :
    restrictionCLM c hr (derivativeCLM c hgap f) =
      derivativeCLM c (hr.trans_lt hgap) f

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.restrictionCLM_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem restrictionCLM_apply (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (h : ρ ≤ σ)
    (f : C(Disk c σ, E)) (z : Disk c ρ) :
    restrictionCLM c h f z = f ⟨z.1, closedBall_subset_closedBall h z.2⟩

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.restrictionCLM_comp
statement:
theorem restrictionCLM_comp (c : ℂ) {r ρ σ : ℝ} (h₁ : r ≤ ρ) (h₂ : ρ ≤ σ) :
    (restrictionCLM (E := E) c h₁).comp (restrictionCLM c h₂) =
      restrictionCLM c (h₁.trans h₂)

name: NavierStokes.CauchyRestriction.translated_mem
statement:
theorem translated_mem (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (hgap : ρ < σ)
    (z : Disk c ρ) (θ : ℝ) : z.1 + circleMap 0 (σ - ρ) θ ∈ closedBall c σ

name: NavierStokes.CompactSmoothFamily.contDiffOn_family_nat
statement:
theorem contDiffOn_family_nat (K : Set Z) [CompactSpace K] (U : Set P) (V : Set Z)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) (hK : K ⊆ V) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ {W : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : P × Z → W),
      ContDiffOn ℝ n F (U ×ˢ V) → ContDiffOn ℝ n (family K F) U

name: NavierStokes.CompactSmoothFamily.contDiffOn_family_of_joint
statement:
theorem contDiffOn_family_of_joint (K : Set Z) [CompactSpace K] (U : Set P) (V : Set Z)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) (hK : K ⊆ V)
    (F : P × Z → E) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (U ×ˢ V)) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (family K F) U

name: NavierStokes.CompactSmoothFamily.contDiffOn_family_of_neighborhood
statement:
theorem contDiffOn_family_of_neighborhood (K : Set Z) [CompactSpace K]
    (U : Set P) (W : Set (P × Z)) (hW : IsOpen W) (hUK : U ×ˢ K ⊆ W)
    (F : P × Z → E) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (family K F) U

name: NavierStokes.CompactSmoothFamily.continuousOn_family
statement:
theorem continuousOn_family {K : Set Z} [CompactSpace K] {U : Set P} {F : P × Z → E}
    (hF : ContinuousOn F (U ×ˢ K)) : ContinuousOn (family K F) U

name: NavierStokes.CompactSmoothFamily.family_apply
statement:
theorem family_apply (K : Set Z) (F : P × Z → E) (p : P)
    (hp : Continuous (fun z : K => F (p, z))) (z : K) :
    family K F p z = F (p, z)

name: NavierStokes.CompactSmoothFamily.family_apply_of_joint
NavierStokes.CompactSmoothFamily.flipCLM_apply
statement:
theorem flipCLM_apply (K : Set Z) [CompactSpace K]
    (g : C(K, P →L[ℝ] E)) (v : P) (z : K) :
    flipCLM (P := P) (E := E) K g v z = g z v

name: NavierStokes.CompactSmoothFamily.hasFDerivAt_family
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_family (K : Set Z) [CompactSpace K] {U : Set P} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (F : P × Z → E) (G : P × Z → P →L[ℝ] E)
    (hF : ContinuousOn F (U ×ˢ K)) (hG : ContinuousOn G (U ×ˢ K))
    (hderiv : ∀ p ∈ U, ∀ z : K, HasFDerivAt (fun q => F (q, z)) (G (p, z)) p)
    {p : P} (hp : p ∈ U) :
    HasFDerivAt (family K F) (flipCLM (P := P) (E := E) K (family K G p)) p

name: NavierStokes.CompactSmoothFamily.iteratedFDeriv_family_apply
statement:
theorem iteratedFDeriv_family_apply (K : Set Z) [CompactSpace K] (U : Set P) (V : Set Z)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) (hK : K ⊆ V)
    (F : P × Z → E) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (U ×ˢ V))
    {p : P} (hp : p ∈ U) (k : ℕ) (v : Fin k → P) (z : K) :
    (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (family K F) p v) z =
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun q => F (q, z)) p v

name: NavierStokes.CompactSmoothFamily.iteratedFDeriv_family_apply_of_neighborhood
statement:
theorem iteratedFDeriv_family_apply_of_neighborhood (K : Set Z) [CompactSpace K]
    (U : Set P) (W : Set (P × Z)) (hW : IsOpen W) (hUK : U ×ˢ K ⊆ W)
    (F : P × Z → E) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W)
    {p : P} (hp : p ∈ U) (k : ℕ) (v : Fin k → P) (z : K) :
    (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (family K F) p v) z =
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun q => F (q, z)) p v

name: NavierStokes.CompactSmoothFamily.norm_flipLinear_le
statement:
theorem norm_flipLinear_le (K : Set Z) [CompactSpace K]
    (g : C(K, P →L[ℝ] E)) (v : P) : ‖flipLinear K g v‖ ≤ ‖g‖ * ‖v‖

NavierStokes.HolomorphicFamily.angleExtend_coe
statement: theorem angleExtend_coe (f : C(Angles, E)) (θ : Angles) : angleExtend f θ = f θ

name: NavierStokes.HolomorphicFamily.cauchyValue_eq
statement:
theorem cauchyValue_eq (c : ℂ) {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ)
    (V : ℝ → C(Disk c σ, E)) (F : ℝ → ℂ → E) {r : ℝ}
    (hF : DifferentiableOn ℂ (F r) (ball c σ))
    (hvalues : ∀ z : Disk c σ, V r z = F r z) {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ ball c σ) :
    cauchyValue c hσ V (r, z) = F r z

name: NavierStokes.HolomorphicFamily.contDiffOn_cauchyValue
statement:
theorem contDiffOn_cauchyValue (c : ℂ) {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ)
    {S : Set ℝ} (V : ℝ → C(Disk c σ, E)) (hV : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ V S) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (cauchyValue c hσ V) (S ×ˢ ball c σ)

name: NavierStokes.HolomorphicFamily.contDiffOn_kernel
statement:
theorem contDiffOn_kernel (c : ℂ) (σ : ℝ) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (kernel c σ) (ball c σ ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ))

name: NavierStokes.HolomorphicFamily.contDiffOn_kernelPath
statement:
theorem contDiffOn_kernelPath (c : ℂ) (σ : ℝ) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (kernelPath c σ) (ball c σ)

name: NavierStokes.HolomorphicFamily.contDiffOn_of_disk_family
statement:
theorem contDiffOn_of_disk_family (c : ℂ) {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ)
    {S : Set ℝ} (V : ℝ → C(Disk c σ, E)) (F : ℝ → ℂ → E)
    (hV : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ V S)
    (hF : ∀ r ∈ S, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F r) (ball c σ))
    (hvalues : ∀ r ∈ S, ∀ z : Disk c σ, V r z = F r z) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => F p.1 p.2) (S ×ˢ ball c σ)

name: NavierStokes.HolomorphicFamily.contDiffOn_of_disk_family_smaller
statement:
theorem contDiffOn_of_disk_family_smaller (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (hgap : ρ < σ)
    {S : Set ℝ} (V : ℝ → C(Disk c σ, E)) (F : ℝ → ℂ → E)
    (hV : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ V S)
    (hF : ∀ r ∈ S, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F r) (ball c σ))
    (hvalues : ∀ r ∈ S, ∀ z : Disk c σ, V r z = F r z) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => F p.1 p.2) (S ×ˢ ball c ρ)

name: NavierStokes.HolomorphicFamily.continuous_angleExtend
statement: theorem continuous_angleExtend (f : C(Angles, E)) : Continuous (angleExtend f)

name: NavierStokes.HolomorphicFamily.diffContOnCl_of_values
statement:
theorem diffContOnCl_of_values (c : ℂ) {σ : ℝ} (v : C(Disk c σ, E)) (F : ℂ → E)
    (hF : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (ball c σ)) (hvalues : ∀ z : Disk c σ, v z = F z) :
    DiffContOnCl ℂ F (ball c σ)

name: NavierStokes.HolomorphicFamily.differentiableAt_of_evaluations
statement:
theorem differentiableAt_of_evaluations {K : Type*} [TopologicalSpace K] [CompactSpace K]
    (G : ℂ → C(K, E)) {z : ℂ} (hG : DifferentiableAt ℝ G z)
    (heval : ∀ x : K, DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w => G w x) z) :
    DifferentiableAt ℂ G z

name: NavierStokes.HolomorphicFamily.differentiableOn_family_of_joint
statement:
theorem differentiableOn_family_of_joint {B : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup B] [NormedSpace ℂ B]
    (K : Set ℝ) [CompactSpace K]
    (U : Set ℂ) (V : Set ℝ) (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) (hKV : K ⊆ V)
    (G : ℂ × ℝ → B) (hG : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G (U ×ˢ V))
    (hhol : ∀ r ∈ K, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => G (z, r)) U) :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (CompactSmoothFamily.family (P := ℂ) (Z := ℝ) (E := B) K G) U

name: NavierStokes.HolomorphicFamily.hasDerivAt_complex
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_complex (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (hgap : ρ < σ)
    (v : C(Disk c σ, E)) (F : ℂ → E)
    (hF : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (ball c σ))
    (hvalues : ∀ z : Disk c σ, v z = F z) (z : Disk c ρ) :
    HasDerivAt F (derivativeCLM c hgap v z) z

name: NavierStokes.HolomorphicFamily.hasDerivAt_parameter
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_parameter (c : ℂ) {σ : ℝ} {S : Set ℝ} (hS : IsOpen S)
    (V : ℝ → C(Disk c σ, E)) (F : ℝ → ℂ → E)
    (hV : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ V S)
    (hvalues : ∀ r ∈ S, ∀ z : Disk c σ, V r z = F r z)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ S) (z : Disk c σ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => F s z) (deriv V r z) r

name: NavierStokes.HolomorphicFamily.hasFDerivAt_joint
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_joint (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (hgap : ρ < σ)
    {S : Set ℝ} (hS : IsOpen S) (V : ℝ → C(Disk c σ, E)) (F : ℝ → ℂ → E)
    (hV : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ V S)
    (hF : ∀ r ∈ S, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F r) (ball c σ))
    (hvalues : ∀ r ∈ S, ∀ z : Disk c σ, V r z = F r z)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ S) (z : Disk c ρ) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => F p.1 p.2)
      (jointDerivative (deriv V r ⟨z, closedBall_subset_closedBall hgap.le z.2⟩)
        (derivativeCLM c hgap (V r) z)) (r, (z : ℂ))

name: NavierStokes.HolomorphicFamily.jointDerivative_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem jointDerivative_apply (a b : E) (v : ℝ × ℂ) :
    jointDerivative a b v = v.1 • a + v.2 • b

name: NavierStokes.HolomorphicFamily.kernelPath_apply
statement:
theorem kernelPath_apply (c : ℂ) (σ : ℝ) {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ ball c σ) (θ : Angles) :
    kernelPath c σ z θ = (circleMap 0 σ θ * I) * (circleMap c σ θ - z)⁻¹

name: NavierStokes.HolomorphicFamily.norm_angleIntegral_le
statement:
theorem norm_angleIntegral_le (f : C(Angles, E)) :
    ‖∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), angleExtend f θ‖ ≤ (2 * Real.pi) * ‖f‖

name: NavierStokes.HolomorphicFamily.norm_complex_partial_le
statement:
theorem norm_complex_partial_le (c : ℂ) {ρ σ : ℝ} (hgap : ρ < σ)
    (v : C(Disk c σ, E)) (z : Disk c ρ) :
    ‖derivativeCLM c hgap v z‖ ≤ (σ - ρ)⁻¹ * ‖v‖

name: NavierStokes.HolomorphicFamily.norm_multiplyPaths_le
statement:
theorem norm_multiplyPaths_le (k : C(Angles, ℂ)) (v : C(Angles, E)) :
    ‖multiplyPaths k v‖ ≤ ‖k‖ * ‖v‖

name: NavierStokes.LoopMoments.avg_add
statement:
theorem avg_add (s : Finset ι) (w f g : ι → ℝ) :
    avg s w (fun i => f i + g i) = avg s w f + avg s w g

name: NavierStokes.LoopMoments.avg_const
statement:
theorem avg_const (s : Finset ι) (w : ι → ℝ) (c : ℝ)
    (hmass : ∑ i ∈ s, w i = 1) :
    avg s w (fun _ => c) = c

name: NavierStokes.LoopMoments.avg_const_mul
statement:

name: NavierStokes.LoopMoments.energy_moment
statement:
theorem energy_moment (s : Finset ι) (w t : ι → ℝ) (a m ρ : ℝ)

    (hmean : avg s w t = m)

statement:
theorem rephased_mass (s : Finset ι) (w t : ι → ℝ) (a m ρ v : ℝ)
    (ha : a ≠ 0) (hv : v ≠ 0) (hmass : ∑ i ∈ s, w i = 1)
    (hmean : avg s w t = m)
    (hvar : avg s w (fun i => (t i - m) ^ 2) = ρ / a)
    (hspeed : v = a * (1 + m ^ 2) + ρ) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, w i * phaseDensity a v (t i) = 1

name: NavierStokes.LoopMoments.rephased_moments
statement:
theorem rephased_moments (s : Finset ι) (w t : ι → ℝ) (a b ρ v : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hmass : ∑ i ∈ s, w i = 1)
    (hmean : avg s w t = -b / a)
    (hvar : avg s w (fun i => (t i - (-b / a)) ^ 2) = ρ / a)
    (hspeed : v = a * (1 + (-b / a) ^ 2) + ρ) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, w i * phaseDensity a v (t i) = 1) ∧
      avg s (fun i => w i * phaseDensity a v (t i)) (fun i => loopA v (t i)) = a ∧
      avg s (fun i => w i * phaseDensity a v (t i)) (fun i => loopC v (t i)) = -b

name: NavierStokes.SmoothLoop.angular_energy_moment
statement:
theorem angular_energy_moment (t : ℝ → ℝ) (a m ρ : ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0)

    (hvar : angularMean (fun θ => (t θ - m) ^ 2) = ρ / a) :
    a * angularMean (fun θ => 1 + t θ ^ 2) = a * (1 + m ^ 2) + ρ

name: NavierStokes.SmoothLoop.angular_rephasing_moments
statement:
theorem angular_rephasing_moments (t : ℝ → ℝ) (a m ρ v : ℝ)
    (ha : a ≠ 0) (hv : v ≠ 0) (ht : Continuous t) (hmean : angularMean t = m)
    (hvar : angularMean (fun θ => (t θ - m) ^ 2) = ρ / a)
    (hspeed : v = a * (1 + m ^ 2) + ρ) :
    angularMean (fun θ => phaseDensity a v (t θ)) = 1 ∧
      angularMean (fun θ => phaseDensity a v (t θ) * loopA v (t θ)) = a ∧
      angularMean (fun θ => phaseDensity a v (t θ) * loopC v (t θ)) = a * m

name: NavierStokes.SmoothLoop.exists_cosine_moments
statement:

    ∃ t : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) t ∧
      Function.Periodic t (2 * Real.pi) ∧ angularMean t = m ∧
      angularMean (fun θ => (t θ - m) ^ 2) = V

name: NavierStokes.SmoothLoop.exists_cosine_moments_with_projection
statement:
theorem exists_cosine_moments_with_projection (p₁ p₂ m V : ℝ) (hV : 0 ≤ V)
    (hmargin : 2 + |p₂ * Real.sqrt (2 * V)| < p₁ + p₂ * m) :
    ∃ t : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) t ∧
      Function.Periodic t (2 * Real.pi) ∧ angularMean t = m ∧
      angularMean (fun θ => (t θ - m) ^ 2) = V ∧
      ∀ θ, 2 < p₁ + p₂ * t θ

name: NavierStokes.SmoothLoop.exists_prescribed_mean_shear_loop
statement:
theorem exists_prescribed_mean_shear_loop (a b ρ : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) :
    ∃ A C : ℝ → ℝ,
      ContDiff ℝ (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) A ∧ ContDiff ℝ (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) C ∧
      Function.Periodic A 1 ∧ Function.Periodic C 1 ∧
      (∫ φ in (0 : ℝ)..1, A φ) = a ∧ (∫ φ in (0 : ℝ)..1, C φ) = -b ∧
      ∀ φ, 0 < A φ ∧
        A φ * (1 + (C φ / A φ) ^ 2) = a * (1 + (-b / a) ^ 2) + ρ

name: NavierStokes.SmoothLoop.exists_rephased_shear_loop
statement:
theorem exists_rephased_shear_loop (t : ℝ → ℝ) (a m ρ v : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hv : 0 < v) (ht : ContDiff ℝ (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) t)
    (hperiodic : Function.Periodic t (2 * Real.pi))
    (hmean : angularMean t = m)
    (hvar : angularMean (fun θ => (t θ - m) ^ 2) = ρ / a)
    (hspeed : v = a * (1 + m ^ 2) + ρ) :
    ∃ A C : ℝ → ℝ,
      ContDiff ℝ (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) A ∧ ContDiff ℝ (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) C ∧
      Function.Periodic A 1 ∧ Function.Periodic C 1 ∧
      (∫ φ in (0 : ℝ)..1, A φ) = a ∧ (∫ φ in (0 : ℝ)..1, C φ) = a * m ∧
      ∀ φ, 0 < A φ ∧ A φ * (1 + (C φ / A φ) ^ 2) = v

statement:
theorem tendstoUniformlyOn_wordLayer {A₀ A₁ : Coeff} {F : Field}

    (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hgap : ρ < σ)
    (hshape : DerivativeShape A₁)

    (hF : RadialBound F T c σ B 0)
    (ha : ∀ v, AnalyticField (word A₀ A₁ v F) T c σ) (i : Fin 6) :
    TendstoUniformlyOn
      (fun N (p : ℝ × ℂ) => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, wordLayer A₀ A₁ F k p.1 p.2 i)
      (fun p => ∑' k, wordLayer A₀ A₁ F k p.1 p.2 i)
      Filter.atTop (Icc 0 T ×ˢ closedBall c ρ)

name: NavierStokes.VolterraAnalyticBounds.wordMajorant_le_exponential
statement:
theorem wordMajorant_le_exponential {a b : ℝ} (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (k : ℕ) :
    wordMajorant a b k ≤
      (a * b) * ((a ^ 2 * b) ^ (k / 2) / ((k / 2).factorial : ℝ))

statement:
theorem word_radialBound {A₀ A₁ : Coeff} {F : Field} {T σ B M δ : ℝ} {c : ℂ}
    (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hA₀ : MatrixBound A₀ T c σ M) (hA₁ : MatrixBound A₁ T c σ M)
    (hF : RadialBound F T c σ B 0)
    (ha : ∀ v, AnalyticField (word A₀ A₁ v F) T c σ)
    (w : List Bool) {ρ : ℝ} (hgap : ρ + (losses w : ℝ) * δ ≤ σ) :
    RadialBound (word A₀ A₁ w F) T c ρ
      (B * M ^ w.length * (δ⁻¹) ^ losses w) w.length

statement:
theorem homogeneous_layer_eq {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)

      (coefficientAction (A₀ z) (V z) + coefficientAction (A₁ z) (deriv V z)))

name: NavierStokes.NilpotentVolterra.integralSolution_spec
statement:
theorem integralSolution_spec {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    {A₀ A₁ : ℂ → CoefficientPath R} {f : ℂ → Path R} {U : Set ℂ}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hA₀ : DifferentiableOn ℂ A₀ U) (hA₁ : DifferentiableOn ℂ A₁ U)
    (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f U) {center : ℂ} {ρ σ : ℝ}
    (hDisk : Metric.closedBall center σ ⊆ U) (hgap : ρ < σ)
    (hshape : VolterraAnalyticBounds.DerivativeShape (rawCoefficient hR A₁)) :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (integralSolution hR A₀ A₁ f) (Metric.ball center ρ) ∧
      ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball center ρ,
        integralSolution hR A₀ A₁ f z = pathInverse hR VolterraAnalyticBounds.exponent
          (f z + (coefficientAction (A₀ z) (integralSolution hR A₀ A₁ f z) +
            coefficientAction (A₁ z) (deriv (integralSolution hR A₀ A₁ f) z)))

name: NavierStokes.NilpotentVolterra.integralSolution_spec_open
statement:
theorem integralSolution_spec_open {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    {A₀ A₁ : ℂ → CoefficientPath R} {f : ℂ → Path R} {U : Set ℂ}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hA₀ : DifferentiableOn ℂ A₀ U) (hA₁ : DifferentiableOn ℂ A₁ U)
    (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f U)
    (hshape : VolterraAnalyticBounds.DerivativeShape (rawCoefficient hR A₁)) :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (integralSolution hR A₀ A₁ f) U ∧
      ∀ z ∈ U, integralSolution hR A₀ A₁ f z =
        pathInverse hR VolterraAnalyticBounds.exponent
          (rhsPath A₀ A₁ f (integralSolution hR A₀ A₁ f) z)

statement:
theorem integral_solution_unique {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)

    (hU : IsOpen U) (hA₀ : DifferentiableOn ℂ A₀ U) (hA₁ : DifferentiableOn ℂ A₁ U)
    (hW₀ : DifferentiableOn ℂ W₀ U) (hW₁ : DifferentiableOn ℂ W₁ U)
    (hshape : VolterraAnalyticBounds.DerivativeShape (rawCoefficient hR A₁))
    (heq₀ : ∀ z ∈ U, W₀ z = pathInverse hR VolterraAnalyticBounds.exponent (rhsPath A₀ A₁ f W₀ z))
    (heq₁ : ∀ z ∈ U, W₁ z = pathInverse hR VolterraAnalyticBounds.exponent (rhsPath A₀ A₁ f W₁ z)) :

name: NavierStokes.NilpotentVolterra.layer_bound
statement:
theorem layer_bound {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    {A₀ A₁ : ℂ → CoefficientPath R} {F : ℂ → Path R} {U : Set ℂ}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hA₀ : DifferentiableOn ℂ A₀ U) (hA₁ : DifferentiableOn ℂ A₁ U)
    (hF : DifferentiableOn ℂ F U) {center : ℂ} {ρ σ B M : ℝ}
    (hDisk : Metric.closedBall center σ ⊆ U) (hgap : ρ < σ)
    (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hshape : VolterraAnalyticBounds.DerivativeShape (rawCoefficient hR A₁))
    (hbA₀ : VolterraAnalyticBounds.MatrixBound (rawCoefficient hR A₀) R center σ M)
    (hbA₁ : VolterraAnalyticBounds.MatrixBound (rawCoefficient hR A₁) R center σ M)
    (hbF : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall center σ, ‖F z‖ ≤ B)
    (k : ℕ) {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ Metric.closedBall center ρ) :
    ‖layer hR VolterraAnalyticBounds.exponent A₀ A₁ F k z‖ ≤
      B * 2 ^ k * VolterraAnalyticBounds.wordMajorant (M * R) (max 1 (σ - ρ)⁻¹) k

theorem layer_holomorphic {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (c : Fin 6 → ℕ)
    {A₀ A₁ : ℂ → CoefficientPath R} {F : ℂ → Path R} {U : Set ℂ}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hA₀ : DifferentiableOn ℂ A₀ U) (hA₁ : DifferentiableOn ℂ A₁ U)
    (hF : DifferentiableOn ℂ F U) (k : ℕ) :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (layer hR c A₀ A₁ F k) U

name: NavierStokes.NilpotentVolterra.layer_succ
statement:
theorem layer_succ {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (c : Fin 6 → ℕ)
    {A₀ A₁ : ℂ → CoefficientPath R} {F : ℂ → Path R} {U : Set ℂ}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hA₀ : DifferentiableOn ℂ A₀ U) (hA₁ : DifferentiableOn ℂ A₁ U)
    (hF : DifferentiableOn ℂ F U) (k : ℕ) {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ U) :
    layer hR c A₀ A₁ F (k + 1) z =
      pathLetter hR c A₀ A₁ false (layer hR c A₀ A₁ F k) z +
        pathLetter hR c A₀ A₁ true (layer hR c A₀ A₁ F k) z

statement:
theorem liftedField_hasDerivAt {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (A₀ A₁ : ℂ → CoefficientPath R)
    (f W : ℂ → Path R) (r : ℝ) (z : ℂ) (i : Fin 6) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => liftedField hR A₀ A₁ f W s z i)
      (extendPath hR (rhsPath A₀ A₁ f W z) r i -
        (VolterraAnalyticBounds.exponent i : ℝ) • weightedMean (VolterraAnalyticBounds.exponent i)
          (fun s => extendPath hR (rhsPath A₀ A₁ f W z) s i) r) r

NavierStokes.NilpotentVolterra.pathInverse_apply
statement:

    (f : Path R) (ξ : Icc (0 : ℝ) R) (i : Fin 6) :

name: NavierStokes.NilpotentVolterra.pathLetter_add
statement:
theorem pathLetter_add {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (c : Fin 6 → ℕ)
    (A₀ A₁ : ℂ → CoefficientPath R) (b : Bool) {F G : ℂ → Path R} {z : ℂ}
