      pathLetter hR c A₀ A₁ b F z + pathLetter hR c A₀ A₁ b G z

name: NavierStokes.NilpotentVolterra.pathLetter_holomorphic
statement:
theorem pathLetter_holomorphic {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (c : Fin 6 → ℕ)
    {A₀ A₁ : ℂ → CoefficientPath R} {F : ℂ → Path R} {U : Set ℂ}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hA₀ : DifferentiableOn ℂ A₀ U) (hA₁ : DifferentiableOn ℂ A₁ U)
    (hF : DifferentiableOn ℂ F U) (b : Bool) :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (pathLetter hR c A₀ A₁ b F) U

name: NavierStokes.NilpotentVolterra.pathLetter_list_sum
statement:
theorem pathLetter_list_sum {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (c : Fin 6 → ℕ)
    (A₀ A₁ : ℂ → CoefficientPath R) (b : Bool) (l : List (ℂ → Path R))
    {U : Set ℂ} (hU : IsOpen U) (h : ∀ F ∈ l, DifferentiableOn ℂ F U)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ U) :
    (l.map (pathLetter hR c A₀ A₁ b)).sum z = pathLetter hR c A₀ A₁ b l.sum z

name: NavierStokes.NilpotentVolterra.pathWord_bound
statement:
theorem pathWord_bound {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    {A₀ A₁ : ℂ → CoefficientPath R} {F : ℂ → Path R} {U : Set ℂ}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hA₀ : DifferentiableOn ℂ A₀ U) (hA₁ : DifferentiableOn ℂ A₁ U)
    (hF : DifferentiableOn ℂ F U) {center : ℂ} {ρ σ B M : ℝ}
    (hDisk : Metric.closedBall center σ ⊆ U) (hgap : ρ < σ)
    (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hshape : VolterraAnalyticBounds.DerivativeShape (rawCoefficient hR A₁))
    (hbA₀ : VolterraAnalyticBounds.MatrixBound (rawCoefficient hR A₀) R center σ M)
    (hbA₁ : VolterraAnalyticBounds.MatrixBound (rawCoefficient hR A₁) R center σ M)
    (hbF : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall center σ, ‖F z‖ ≤ B)
    (w : List Bool) {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ Metric.closedBall center ρ) :
    ‖pathWord hR VolterraAnalyticBounds.exponent A₀ A₁ w F z‖ ≤
      B * VolterraAnalyticBounds.wordMajorant (M * R) (max 1 (σ - ρ)⁻¹) w.length

name: NavierStokes.NilpotentVolterra.pathWord_holomorphic
statement:
theorem pathWord_holomorphic {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (c : Fin 6 → ℕ)
    {A₀ A₁ : ℂ → CoefficientPath R} {F : ℂ → Path R} {U : Set ℂ}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hA₀ : DifferentiableOn ℂ A₀ U) (hA₁ : DifferentiableOn ℂ A₁ U)
    (hF : DifferentiableOn ℂ F U) (w : List Bool) :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (pathWord hR c A₀ A₁ w F) U

name: NavierStokes.NilpotentVolterra.rawCoefficient_bound
statement:
theorem rawCoefficient_bound {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (A : ℂ → CoefficientPath R)
    {center : ℂ} {ρ M : ℝ} (hA : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall center ρ, ‖A z‖ ≤ M) :
    VolterraAnalyticBounds.MatrixBound (rawCoefficient hR A) R center ρ (6 * M)

name: NavierStokes.NilpotentVolterra.rawCoefficient_mulVec
statement:
theorem rawCoefficient_mulVec {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (A : ℂ → CoefficientPath R)
    (r : ℝ) (z : ℂ) (v : Vec) :
    (rawCoefficient hR A r z).mulVec v = A z (projIcc 0 R hR r) v

name: NavierStokes.NilpotentVolterra.rawField_bound
statement:
theorem rawField_bound {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (F : ℂ → Path R)
    {center : ℂ} {ρ B : ℝ} (hF : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall center ρ, ‖F z‖ ≤ B) :
    VolterraAnalyticBounds.RadialBound (rawField hR F) R center ρ B 0

name: NavierStokes.NilpotentVolterra.rawField_deriv
statement:
theorem rawField_deriv {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) {F : ℂ → Path R} {z : ℂ}
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℂ F z) (r : ℝ) :
    VolterraAnalyticBounds.parameterDeriv (rawField hR F) r z =
      rawField hR (deriv F) r z

name: NavierStokes.NilpotentVolterra.rawField_pathLetter
statement:
theorem rawField_pathLetter {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (A₀ A₁ : ℂ → CoefficientPath R) {F : ℂ → Path R} {z : ℂ}
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℂ F z) (b : Bool) {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) R) :
    rawField hR (pathLetter hR VolterraAnalyticBounds.exponent A₀ A₁ b F) r z =
      VolterraAnalyticBounds.letter (rawCoefficient hR A₀) (rawCoefficient hR A₁) b
        (rawField hR F) r z

name: NavierStokes.NilpotentVolterra.rawField_pathWord
statement:
theorem rawField_pathWord {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    {A₀ A₁ : ℂ → CoefficientPath R} {F : ℂ → Path R} {U : Set ℂ}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hA₀ : DifferentiableOn ℂ A₀ U) (hA₁ : DifferentiableOn ℂ A₁ U)
    (hF : DifferentiableOn ℂ F U) (w : List Bool)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) R) {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ U) :
    VolterraAnalyticBounds.word (rawCoefficient hR A₀) (rawCoefficient hR A₁) w
        (rawField hR F) r z =
      rawField hR (pathWord hR VolterraAnalyticBounds.exponent A₀ A₁ w F) r z

name: NavierStokes.NilpotentVolterra.raw_word_analytic
statement:
theorem raw_word_analytic {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    {A₀ A₁ : ℂ → CoefficientPath R} {F : ℂ → Path R} {U : Set ℂ}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hA₀ : DifferentiableOn ℂ A₀ U) (hA₁ : DifferentiableOn ℂ A₁ U)
    (hF : DifferentiableOn ℂ F U) {center : ℂ} {ρ : ℝ}
    (hDisk : Metric.closedBall center ρ ⊆ U) (w : List Bool) :
    VolterraAnalyticBounds.AnalyticField
      (VolterraAnalyticBounds.word (rawCoefficient hR A₀) (rawCoefficient hR A₁) w
        (rawField hR F)) R center ρ

name: NavierStokes.NilpotentVolterra.regularPrimitive_continuous
statement:
theorem regularPrimitive_continuous (c : ℕ) {f : ℝ → E} (hf : Continuous f) :
    Continuous (regularPrimitive c f)

name: NavierStokes.NilpotentVolterra.regularPrimitive_derivative_continuous
statement:
theorem regularPrimitive_derivative_continuous [CompleteSpace E] (c : ℕ)
    {f : ℝ → E} (hf : Continuous f) : Continuous (deriv (regularPrimitive c f))

name: NavierStokes.NilpotentVolterra.regularPrimitive_eq_div
statement:
theorem regularPrimitive_eq_div (c : ℕ) (f : ℝ → E) {ξ : ℝ} (hξ : ξ ≠ 0) :
    regularPrimitive c f ξ = (ξ ^ c)⁻¹ • ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..ξ, s ^ c • f s

name: NavierStokes.NilpotentVolterra.regularPrimitive_equation
statement:
theorem regularPrimitive_equation [CompleteSpace E] (c : ℕ)
    {f : ℝ → E} (hf : Continuous f) {ξ : ℝ} (hξ : ξ ≠ 0) :
    deriv (regularPrimitive c f) ξ + ((c : ℝ) / ξ) • regularPrimitive c f ξ = f ξ

name: NavierStokes.NilpotentVolterra.regularPrimitive_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem regularPrimitive_hasDerivAt [CompleteSpace E] (c : ℕ)
    {f : ℝ → E} (hf : Continuous f) (ξ : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (regularPrimitive c f)
      (f ξ - (c : ℝ) • weightedMean c f ξ) ξ

name: NavierStokes.NilpotentVolterra.regularPrimitive_hasDerivAt_ne_zero
statement:
theorem regularPrimitive_hasDerivAt_ne_zero [CompleteSpace E] (c : ℕ)
    {f : ℝ → E} (hf : Continuous f) {ξ : ℝ} (hξ : ξ ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (regularPrimitive c f)
      (f ξ - (c : ℝ) • weightedMean c f ξ) ξ

name: NavierStokes.NilpotentVolterra.regularPrimitive_hasDerivAt_zero
statement:
theorem regularPrimitive_hasDerivAt_zero (c : ℕ) {f : ℝ → E} (hf : Continuous f) :
    HasDerivAt (regularPrimitive c f) (weightedMean c f 0) 0

name: NavierStokes.NilpotentVolterra.regularPrimitive_integratingFactor
statement:
theorem regularPrimitive_integratingFactor (c : ℕ) (f : ℝ → E) (ξ : ℝ) :
    ξ ^ c • regularPrimitive c f ξ = ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..ξ, s ^ c • f s

name: NavierStokes.NilpotentVolterra.regularPrimitive_norm_le
statement:
theorem regularPrimitive_norm_le (c : ℕ) (f : ℝ → E) (ξ M : ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖f (t * ξ)‖ ≤ M) :
    ‖regularPrimitive c f ξ‖ ≤ |ξ| * M

name: NavierStokes.NilpotentVolterra.regularPrimitive_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem regularPrimitive_zero (c : ℕ) (f : ℝ → E) :
    regularPrimitive c f 0 = 0

name: NavierStokes.NilpotentVolterra.scaled_radius_mem
statement:
theorem scaled_radius_mem {R r t : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) R)
    (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : t * r ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) R

name: NavierStokes.NilpotentVolterra.solutionSeries_deriv_hasSum
statement:
theorem solutionSeries_deriv_hasSum {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ Metric.ball center ρ) :
    HasSum (fun k => deriv (layer hR VolterraAnalyticBounds.exponent A₀ A₁ F k) z)
      (deriv (solutionSeries hR A₀ A₁ F) z)

name: NavierStokes.NilpotentVolterra.solutionSeries_equation
statement:
theorem solutionSeries_equation {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ Metric.ball center ρ) :
    solutionSeries hR A₀ A₁ F z = F z + pathInverse hR VolterraAnalyticBounds.exponent
      (coefficientAction (A₀ z) (solutionSeries hR A₀ A₁ F z) +
        coefficientAction (A₁ z) (deriv (solutionSeries hR A₀ A₁ F) z))

name: NavierStokes.NilpotentVolterra.solutionSeries_hasSum
statement:
theorem solutionSeries_hasSum {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ Metric.closedBall center ρ) :
    HasSum (fun k => layer hR VolterraAnalyticBounds.exponent A₀ A₁ F k z)
      (solutionSeries hR A₀ A₁ F z)

name: NavierStokes.NilpotentVolterra.solutionSeries_holomorphic
statement:
theorem solutionSeries_holomorphic :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (solutionSeries hR A₀ A₁ F) (Metric.ball center ρ)

name: NavierStokes.NilpotentVolterra.weightedMean_continuous
statement:
theorem weightedMean_continuous (c : ℕ) {f : ℝ → E} (hf : Continuous f) :
    Continuous (weightedMean c f)

name: NavierStokes.NilpotentVolterra.weightedMean_norm_le
statement:
theorem weightedMean_norm_le (c : ℕ) (f : ℝ → E) (ξ M : ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖f (t * ξ)‖ ≤ M) :
    ‖weightedMean c f ξ‖ ≤ M

name: NavierStokes.NilpotentVolterra.weightedMean_zero
statement:
theorem weightedMean_zero [CompleteSpace E] (c : ℕ) (f : ℝ → E) :
    weightedMean c f 0 = (1 / ((c : ℝ) + 1)) • f 0

name: NavierStokes.VolterraParity.IntegralEquationOn.reflect
statement:
theorem IntegralEquationOn.reflect {S : Set ℝ} {U : Set ℂ}
    {A₀ A₁ : Coeff} {f W : Field} (h : IntegralEquationOn S U A₀ A₁ f W) :
    IntegralEquationOn {r | -r ∈ S} U (reflectCoeff A₀) (reflectCoeff A₁)
      (reflectedForcing f) (reflectField W)

name: NavierStokes.VolterraParity.equationRHS_congr_at
NavierStokes.VolterraParity.equationRHS_reflect
statement:
theorem equationRHS_reflect (A₀ A₁ : Coeff) (f W : Field) :
    equationRHS (reflectCoeff A₀) (reflectCoeff A₁) (reflectedForcing f) (reflectField W) =
      reflectedForcing (equationRHS A₀ A₁ f W)

name: NavierStokes.VolterraParity.exists_symmetric_integral_solution
statement:
theorem exists_symmetric_integral_solution {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    {A₀ A₁ : ℂ → SymmetricCoefficientPath R} {f : ℂ → SymmetricPath R Vec}
    {U : Set ℂ} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hA₀ : DifferentiableOn ℂ A₀ U) (hA₁ : DifferentiableOn ℂ A₁ U)
    (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f U)
    (hshape : DerivativeShape (symmetricRawCoefficient hR A₁)) :
    ∃ W, IsSymmetricIntegralSolution R U (symmetricRawCoefficient hR A₀)
      (symmetricRawCoefficient hR A₁) (symmetricRawField hR f) W

name: NavierStokes.VolterraParity.first_components_even
statement:
theorem first_components_even {W : Field} {R : ℝ} {U : Set ℂ}
    (hW : ∀ r ∈ Icc (-R) R, ∀ z ∈ U, W (-r) z = parityVec (W r z))
    (i : Fin 6) (hi : i.val < 4) {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ U) :
    ∀ r ∈ Ioo (-R) R, W (-r) z i = W r z i

name: NavierStokes.VolterraParity.glue_integralEquation
statement:
theorem glue_integralEquation {R : ℝ} {U : Set ℂ} {A₀ A₁ : Coeff}
    {f Wp Wm : Field} (h0 : ∀ z, Wp 0 z = Wm 0 z)
    (hp : IntegralEquationOn (Icc 0 R) U A₀ A₁ f Wp)
    (hm : IntegralEquationOn (Icc 0 R) U (reflectCoeff A₀) (reflectCoeff A₁)
      (reflectedForcing f) Wm) :
    IntegralEquationOn (Icc (-R) R) U A₀ A₁ f (glue Wp Wm)

name: NavierStokes.VolterraParity.glue_jointly_continuous
statement:
theorem glue_jointly_continuous {R : ℝ} {U : Set ℂ} {Wp Wm : Field}
    (h0 : ∀ z ∈ U, Wp 0 z = Wm 0 z)
    (hp : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => Wp p.1 p.2) (Icc 0 R ×ˢ U))
    (hm : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => Wm p.1 p.2) (Icc 0 R ×ˢ U)) :
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => glue Wp Wm p.1 p.2) (Icc (-R) R ×ˢ U)

name: NavierStokes.VolterraParity.glue_nonneg
statement:
theorem glue_nonneg (Wp Wm : Field) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (z : ℂ) :
    glue Wp Wm r z = Wp r z

name: NavierStokes.VolterraParity.glue_nonpos
statement:
theorem glue_nonpos {Wp Wm : Field} (h0 : ∀ z, Wp 0 z = Wm 0 z)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : r ≤ 0) (z : ℂ) : glue Wp Wm r z = Wm (-r) z

name: NavierStokes.VolterraParity.glue_parameter_holomorphic
statement:
theorem glue_parameter_holomorphic {R : ℝ} {U : Set ℂ} {Wp Wm : Field}
    (hp : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 R, ∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => Wp r z i) U)
    (hm : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 R, ∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => Wm r z i) U)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Icc (-R) R) (i : Fin 6) :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => glue Wp Wm r z i) U

name: NavierStokes.VolterraParity.glued_solution_unique
statement:
theorem glued_solution_unique {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) {U : Set ℂ} (hU : IsOpen U)
    {A₀ A₁ : Bool → ℂ → NilpotentVolterra.CoefficientPath R}
    {f W₀ W₁ : Bool → ℂ → NilpotentVolterra.Path R}
    (hA₀ : ∀ b, DifferentiableOn ℂ (A₀ b) U)
    (hA₁ : ∀ b, DifferentiableOn ℂ (A₁ b) U)
    (hW₀ : ∀ b, DifferentiableOn ℂ (W₀ b) U)
    (hW₁ : ∀ b, DifferentiableOn ℂ (W₁ b) U)
    (hshape : ∀ b, DerivativeShape (NilpotentVolterra.rawCoefficient hR (A₁ b)))
    (heq₀ : ∀ b z, z ∈ U → W₀ b z = NilpotentVolterra.pathInverse hR exponent
      (NilpotentVolterra.rhsPath (A₀ b) (A₁ b) (f b) (W₀ b) z))
    (heq₁ : ∀ b z, z ∈ U → W₁ b z = NilpotentVolterra.pathInverse hR exponent
      (NilpotentVolterra.rhsPath (A₀ b) (A₁ b) (f b) (W₁ b) z))
    (r : ℝ) {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ U) :
    glue (NilpotentVolterra.liftedField hR (A₀ false) (A₁ false) (f false) (W₀ false))
      (NilpotentVolterra.liftedField hR (A₀ true) (A₁ true) (f true) (W₀ true)) r z =
    glue (NilpotentVolterra.liftedField hR (A₀ false) (A₁ false) (f false) (W₁ false))
      (NilpotentVolterra.liftedField hR (A₀ true) (A₁ true) (f true) (W₁ true)) r z

name: NavierStokes.VolterraParity.hasDerivAt_glue_zero
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_glue_zero {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {f g : ℝ → E} {v : E} (hf : HasDerivAt f v 0) (hg : HasDerivAt g v 0)
    (h0 : f 0 = g 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun r => if 0 ≤ r then f r else g r) v 0

name: NavierStokes.VolterraParity.last_components_odd
statement:
theorem last_components_odd {W : Field} {R : ℝ} {U : Set ℂ}
    (hW : ∀ r ∈ Icc (-R) R, ∀ z ∈ U, W (-r) z = parityVec (W r z))
    (i : Fin 6) (hi : 4 ≤ i.val) {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ U) :
    ∀ r ∈ Ioo (-R) R, W (-r) z i = -W r z i

name: NavierStokes.VolterraParity.lifted_integralEquation
statement:
theorem lifted_integralEquation {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    {A₀ A₁ : ℂ → NilpotentVolterra.CoefficientPath R}
    {f W : ℂ → NilpotentVolterra.Path R} {U : Set ℂ}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hWholo : DifferentiableOn ℂ W U)
    (hW : ∀ z ∈ U, W z = NilpotentVolterra.pathInverse hR exponent
      (NilpotentVolterra.rhsPath A₀ A₁ f W z)) :
    IntegralEquationOn (Icc 0 R) U (NilpotentVolterra.rawCoefficient hR A₀)
      (NilpotentVolterra.rawCoefficient hR A₁) (NilpotentVolterra.rawField hR f)
      (NilpotentVolterra.liftedField hR A₀ A₁ f W)

name: NavierStokes.VolterraParity.negativeHalf_equation
statement:
theorem negativeHalf_equation {R : ℝ} {U : Set ℂ} {A₀ A₁ : Coeff} {f W : Field}
    (h : IntegralEquationOn (Icc 0 R) U (reflectCoeff A₀) (reflectCoeff A₁)
      (reflectedForcing f) W) :
    IntegralEquationOn (Icc (-R) 0) U A₀ A₁ f (reflectField W)

name: NavierStokes.VolterraParity.parameterDeriv_reflect
statement:
@[simp] theorem parameterDeriv_reflect (W : Field) :
    parameterDeriv (reflectField W) = reflectField (parameterDeriv W)

name: NavierStokes.VolterraParity.parityPath_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem parityPath_apply {R : ℝ} (W : NilpotentVolterra.Path R)
    (r : Icc (0 : ℝ) R) : parityPath R W r = parityVec (W r)

name: NavierStokes.VolterraParity.parityPath_deriv
NavierStokes.VolterraParity.parityPath_inverse
statement:
theorem parityPath_inverse {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (W : NilpotentVolterra.Path R) :
    parityPath R (NilpotentVolterra.pathInverse hR exponent W) =
      NilpotentVolterra.pathInverse hR exponent (parityPath R W)

name: NavierStokes.VolterraParity.parityPath_involutive
statement:
@[simp] theorem parityPath_involutive {R : ℝ} (W : NilpotentVolterra.Path R) :
    parityPath R (parityPath R W) = W

name: NavierStokes.VolterraParity.paritySign_mul_self
statement: @[simp] theorem paritySign_mul_self (i : Fin 6) : paritySign i * paritySign i = 1

name: NavierStokes.VolterraParity.parityVec_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem parityVec_apply (v : Vec) (i : Fin 6) :
    parityVec v i = paritySign i * v i

name: NavierStokes.VolterraParity.parityVec_involutive
statement: @[simp] theorem parityVec_involutive (v : Vec) : parityVec (parityVec v) = v

name: NavierStokes.VolterraParity.parity_transforms_equation
statement:
theorem parity_transforms_equation {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    {A₀ A₁ : ℂ → SymmetricCoefficientPath R} {f : ℂ → SymmetricPath R Vec}
    {W : ℂ → NilpotentVolterra.Path R} {U : Set ℂ} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hW : DifferentiableOn ℂ W U)
    (hA₀ : CoefficientParityOn (Icc 0 R) U (symmetricRawCoefficient hR A₀))
    (hA₁ : CoefficientParityOn (Icc 0 R) U (symmetricRawCoefficient hR A₁))
    (hf : ForcingParityOn (Icc 0 R) U (symmetricRawField hR f))
    (heq : ∀ z ∈ U, W z = NilpotentVolterra.pathInverse hR exponent
      (NilpotentVolterra.rhsPath (sideData hR false A₀) (sideData hR false A₁)
        (sideData hR false f) W z)) :
    ∀ z ∈ U, parityPath R (W z) = NilpotentVolterra.pathInverse hR exponent
      (NilpotentVolterra.rhsPath (sideData hR true A₀) (sideData hR true A₁)
        (sideData hR true f) (fun w => parityPath R (W w)) z)

name: NavierStokes.VolterraParity.positive_equation_change_data
statement:
theorem positive_equation_change_data {R : ℝ} {U : Set ℂ}
    {A₀ A₁ B₀ B₁ : Coeff} {f g W : Field}
    (h : IntegralEquationOn (Icc 0 R) U A₀ A₁ f W)
    (h₀ : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 R, ∀ z ∈ U, A₀ r z = B₀ r z)
    (h₁ : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 R, ∀ z ∈ U, A₁ r z = B₁ r z)
    (hf : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 R, ∀ z ∈ U, f r z = g r z) :
    IntegralEquationOn (Icc 0 R) U B₀ B₁ g W

name: NavierStokes.VolterraParity.radialInverse_congr_at
NavierStokes.VolterraParity.radialInverse_equationRHS_reflect
statement:
theorem radialInverse_equationRHS_reflect (A₀ A₁ : Coeff) (f W : Field) :

name: NavierStokes.VolterraParity.radialInverse_reflect

name: NavierStokes.VolterraParity.reflected_forcing_parity
NavierStokes.VolterraParity.reflected_matrix_parity
statement:
theorem reflected_matrix_parity {S : Set ℝ} {U : Set ℂ} {A : Coeff}
    (hA : CoefficientParityOn S U A) {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ S)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ U) (v : Vec) :
    (reflectCoeff A r z).mulVec (parityVec v) = parityVec ((A r z).mulVec v)

name: NavierStokes.VolterraParity.rhsPath_parity
statement:
theorem rhsPath_parity {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    {A₀ A₁ : ℂ → SymmetricCoefficientPath R} {f : ℂ → SymmetricPath R Vec}
    {W : ℂ → NilpotentVolterra.Path R} {U : Set ℂ}
    (hA₀ : CoefficientParityOn (Icc 0 R) U (symmetricRawCoefficient hR A₀))
    (hA₁ : CoefficientParityOn (Icc 0 R) U (symmetricRawCoefficient hR A₁))
    (hf : ForcingParityOn (Icc 0 R) U (symmetricRawField hR f))
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ U) (hW : DifferentiableAt ℂ W z) :
    NilpotentVolterra.rhsPath (sideData hR true A₀) (sideData hR true A₁)
      (sideData hR true f) (fun w => parityPath R (W w)) z =
    parityPath R (NilpotentVolterra.rhsPath (sideData hR false A₀)
      (sideData hR false A₁) (sideData hR false f) W z)

name: NavierStokes.VolterraParity.sideData_coefficient_parity
statement:
theorem sideData_coefficient_parity {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)

    (hA : CoefficientParityOn (Icc 0 R) U (symmetricRawCoefficient hR A))
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ U) (r : Icc (0 : ℝ) R) (v : Vec) :
    sideData hR true A z r (parityVec v) = parityVec (sideData hR false A z r v)

name: NavierStokes.VolterraParity.sideData_false
statement:
@[simp] theorem sideData_false {R : ℝ} {E : Type*}

name: NavierStokes.VolterraParity.sideData_forcing_parity

name: NavierStokes.VolterraParity.sideData_true
statement:

    {U : Set ℂ} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hA₀ : DifferentiableOn ℂ A₀ U) (hA₁ : DifferentiableOn ℂ A₁ U)
    (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f U)
    (hshape : DerivativeShape (symmetricRawCoefficient hR A₁))
    (hpA₀ : CoefficientParityOn (Icc 0 R) U (symmetricRawCoefficient hR A₀))
    (hpA₁ : CoefficientParityOn (Icc 0 R) U (symmetricRawCoefficient hR A₁))
    (hpf : ForcingParityOn (Icc 0 R) U (symmetricRawField hR f))
    {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Icc 0 R) {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ U) :

name: NavierStokes.VolterraParity.sideSolution_spec
statement:
theorem sideSolution_spec {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (b : Bool)
    {A₀ A₁ : ℂ → SymmetricCoefficientPath R} {f : ℂ → SymmetricPath R Vec}
    {U : Set ℂ} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hA₀ : DifferentiableOn ℂ A₀ U) (hA₁ : DifferentiableOn ℂ A₁ U)
    (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f U)
    (hshape : DerivativeShape (symmetricRawCoefficient hR A₁)) :
    NilpotentVolterra.IsRegularSolution R U
      (NilpotentVolterra.rawCoefficient hR (sideData hR b A₀))
      (NilpotentVolterra.rawCoefficient hR (sideData hR b A₁))
      (NilpotentVolterra.rawField hR (sideData hR b f)) (sideSolution hR b A₀ A₁ f) ∧
    IntegralEquationOn (Icc 0 R) U
      (NilpotentVolterra.rawCoefficient hR (sideData hR b A₀))
      (NilpotentVolterra.rawCoefficient hR (sideData hR b A₁))
      (NilpotentVolterra.rawField hR (sideData hR b f)) (sideSolution hR b A₀ A₁ f) ∧
    ∀ z, sideSolution hR b A₀ A₁ f 0 z = 0

name: NavierStokes.VolterraParity.side_curves_parity
statement:
theorem side_curves_parity {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    {A₀ A₁ : ℂ → SymmetricCoefficientPath R} {f : ℂ → SymmetricPath R Vec}
    {U : Set ℂ} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hA₀ : DifferentiableOn ℂ A₀ U) (hA₁ : DifferentiableOn ℂ A₁ U)
    (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f U)
    (hshape : DerivativeShape (symmetricRawCoefficient hR A₁))
    (hpA₀ : CoefficientParityOn (Icc 0 R) U (symmetricRawCoefficient hR A₀))
    (hpA₁ : CoefficientParityOn (Icc 0 R) U (symmetricRawCoefficient hR A₁))
    (hpf : ForcingParityOn (Icc 0 R) U (symmetricRawField hR f)) :
    EqOn
      (NilpotentVolterra.integralSolution hR (sideData hR true A₀)
        (sideData hR true A₁) (sideData hR true f))
      (fun z => parityPath R (NilpotentVolterra.integralSolution hR
        (sideData hR false A₀) (sideData hR false A₁) (sideData hR false f) z)) U

theorem algebraScale_contDiffOn (c : ι → ℕ) {R : ℝ}
    (W f : ∀ j, ℝ → ι → B j) (a₀ a₁ : ∀ j, ℝ → ι → ι → B j)
    (D : ∀ j, B (j + 1) →L[ℝ] B j)
    (hW : ∀ j i, ContinuousOn (fun r => W j r i) (radialDomain R))
    (hf : ∀ j i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun r => f j r i) (radialDomain R))
    (ha₀ : ∀ j i k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun r => a₀ j r i k) (radialDomain R))
    (ha₁ : ∀ j i k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun r => a₁ j r i k) (radialDomain R))
    (heq : ∀ j i, EqOn (fun r => W j r i)
      (regularPrimitive (c i) (fun r => f j r i +
        ∑ k, a₀ j r i k * W j r k + ∑ k, a₁ j r i k * D j (W (j + 1) r k)))
      (radialDomain R)) :
    ∀ j i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun r => W j r i) (radialDomain R)

theorem exists_diagonal_scales (C p : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (g : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < g j) (B : ℕ) :
    ∃ a : ℕ → ℕ,
      B ≤ a 0 ∧
      (∀ j, 0 < a j) ∧
      (∀ j, 2 * a j ≤ a (j + 1)) ∧
      StrictMono a ∧
      (∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ j ≥ N, 1 / (a j : ℝ) < q) ∧
      (∀ j, 1 ≤ j → ∀ m, m ≤ j + 2 → ∀ q : ℝ,
        0 < q → q ≤ 1 / (a j : ℝ) →
          |logPowerWeight (C j m) (p j m) (g j / 2) q| ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j)

statement:

    (r ε : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ a : ℕ, 0 < a ∧
      ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → q ≤ 1 / (a : ℝ) →
        |logPowerWeight (C i) (p i) r q| ≤ ε

name: NavierStokes.DiagonalScale.exists_uniform_tail_order
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_tail_order (g : ℕ → ℝ) (hg : Monotone g)
    (hgtop : Tendsto g atTop atTop) (L N : ℝ) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ J : ℕ, m ≤ J ∧ ∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → q ≤ 1 →
      (∑' n : ℕ, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (J + 1 + n) * q ^ (g (J + 1 + n) / 2 - L)) ≤
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ J * q ^ N

    (hq : 0 < q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1) (J : ℕ) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ =>
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (J + 1 + n) * q ^ (g (J + 1 + n) / 2 - L)) ∧
    (∑' n : ℕ, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (J + 1 + n) * q ^ (g (J + 1 + n) / 2 - L)) ≤
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ J * q ^ (g (J + 1) / 2 - L)

theorem boundary_fderiv_eq {s t : Set SpaceTime} {f g : SpaceTime → V} {T : ℝ}

    (hBs : ∀ x : Space, (T, x) ∈ s) (hBt : ∀ x : Space, (T, x) ∈ t)
    (hvalue : ∀ x : Space, f (T, x) = g (T, x))

theorem exists_smooth_periodic_extension_of_limits {T : ℝ} {f : SpaceTime → V}
    {J : SpaceTime → FormalMultilinearSeries ℝ SpaceTime V}
    {L : Space → FormalMultilinearSeries ℝ SpaceTime V}
    (hzero : ∀ z : SpaceTime, z.1 < T → (J z 0).curry0 = f z)
    (hderiv : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ z : SpaceTime, z.1 < T →
      HasFDerivAt (fun y => J y n) (J z (n + 1)).curryLeft z)
    (hlim : ∀ n : ℕ, TendstoLocallyUniformly (fun t x => J (t, x) n)
      (fun x => L x n) (𝓝[<] T))
    (hperiod : ProblemStatement.UnitSpatialPeriodsOn (Iio T) f) :
    ∃ F : SpaceTime → V, ContDiff ℝ ∞ F ∧
      EqOn F f (SpacetimeEndpoint.openPast T) ∧
      ProblemStatement.UnitSpatialPeriodsOn univ F ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, T + 1 ≤ t → ∀ x : Space, F (t, x) = 0) ∧
      ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ x : Space, iteratedFDeriv ℝ n F (T, x) = L x n

name: NavierStokes.ParametricRadialExtension.extension_axis_jets
statement:
theorem extension_axis_jets {S : Set ℝ} (w : ParameterWindow S) {F : Plane → E}
    (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (univ ×ˢ S))
    (he : ∀ eta ∈ S, ∀ r, F (-r, eta) = F (r, eta))
    (n : ℕ) {eta : ℝ} (heta : |eta| ≤ w.inner) :
    iteratedDeriv n (fun Y => extension w F hF he (Y, eta)) 0 =
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ n * ((n.factorial : ℝ) / ((2 * n).factorial : ℝ))) •
        iteratedDeriv (2 * n) (fun r => F (r, eta)) 0

statement:

    iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (compactIntegral χ M v f) z =

        iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => χ y.1 • totalIntegral M v f y) z

statement:
theorem iteratedFDeriv_compactIntegral_norm_le [CompleteSpace F] {a b M : ℝ} {v : E}
    {f : ℝ × E → F} {χ : ℝ → ℝ} (hχ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hs : RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b f) (n : ℕ) (z : ℝ × E) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (compactIntegral χ M v f) z‖ ≤
      ‖pastIntegral M v (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f) z‖ +
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) *
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun y : ℝ × E => χ y.1) z‖ *
            ‖totalIntegral M v (iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n - i) f) z‖

    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hs : RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b f) (n : ℕ)
    (A B : ℕ → ℝ) (hB : ∀ i ≤ n, 0 ≤ B i)
    (hsource : ∀ j ≤ n, ∀ s ∈ Icc a b, ∀ Y : E, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f (s, Y)‖ ≤ A j)
    (hcutoff : ∀ i ≤ n, ∀ z : ℝ × E, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun y : ℝ × E => χ y.1) z‖ ≤ B i)
    (z : ℝ × E) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (compactIntegral χ M v f) z‖ ≤
      (A n + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * B i * A (n - i)) * (b - a)

name: NavierStokes.TransportPrimitive.transport_compactIntegral
statement:
theorem transport_compactIntegral [CompleteSpace F] {a b M : ℝ} {v : E}
    {f : ℝ × E → F} {χ : ℝ → ℝ} (hχ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hs : RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b f)
    (z : ℝ × E) :
    fixedDeriv (1, M • v) (compactIntegral χ M v f) z =
      f z - deriv χ z.1 • totalIntegral M v f z

statement:
theorem transplant_density_difference (H : α → E → V)
    {base aux replacement : α → E} {K : Set α}
    (hbase : EqOn base aux K) (hedit : ∀ x ∉ K, replacement x = aux x) (x : α) :
    H x (transplant base aux replacement x) - H x (base x) =
      H x (replacement x) - H x (aux x)

statement:
theorem transplanted_density_integral
    {E V : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V]
    (H : (ℝ × ℝ) → E → V) {base aux replacement : ℝ × ℝ → E} {K : Set (ℝ × ℝ)}
    (hbase : EqOn base aux K) (hedit : ∀ x ∉ K, replacement x = aux x) (X eta : ℝ) :
    (∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..X, H (r, eta) (transplant base aux replacement (r, eta)) - H (r, eta) (base (r, eta))) =
      ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..X, H (r, eta) (replacement (r, eta)) - H (r, eta) (aux (r, eta))

      iteratedDeriv 2 (fun r => C * radialProfile a (1 - t) r) r +
        deriv (fun r => C * radialProfile a (1 - t) r) r / r -
        C * radialProfile a (1 - t) r / r ^ 2

theorem spatialFirst_neg {a τ s : ℝ} (ha : 1 < a) (hτ : 0 < τ) (hs : 0 < s) :

statement:
theorem spatialProfile_hasDerivAt_s {a τ s : ℝ} (ha : 1 < a) (hτ : 0 < τ) (hs : 0 < s) :

name: NavierStokes.RadialHeatProfile.spatialProfile_hasDerivAt_time
statement:
theorem spatialProfile_hasDerivAt_time {a τ s : ℝ} (ha : 1 < a) (hτ : 0 < τ) (hs : 0 < s) :
    HasDerivAt (fun τ => spatialProfile a τ s)
      (2 * s ^ (spatialExponent a - 1) * profileJet a 1 (2 * τ / s)) τ

name: NavierStokes.RadialHeatProfile.spatialProfile_joint_contDiffOn
NavierStokes.RadialHeatProfile.spatial_heat_identity
statement:
theorem spatial_heat_identity {a τ s : ℝ} (ha : 1 < a) (hτ : 0 < τ) (hs : 0 < s) :
    -(2 * s ^ (spatialExponent a - 1) * profileJet a 1 (2 * τ / s)) =
      2 * s * spatialSecond a τ s + 2 * spatialFirst a τ s - spatialProfile a τ s / (2 * s)

name: NavierStokes.HeatProfileExtension.derivativeBound_nonneg

name: NavierStokes.HeatProfileExtension.endpointJet_eq_gamma
statement:
theorem endpointJet_eq_gamma {a : ℝ} (ha : 1 < a) (n : ℕ) :

name: NavierStokes.HeatProfileExtension.endpointJet_eq_right_derivative
statement:
theorem endpointJet_eq_right_derivative {a : ℝ} (ha : 1 < a) (n : ℕ) :

name: NavierStokes.HeatProfileExtension.extension_contDiff

theorem extension_derivative_bound {a : ℝ} (ha : 1 < a) (n : ℕ) (z : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.HeatProfileExtension.extension_eq_leftBranch
statement:
theorem extension_eq_leftBranch (a : ℝ) {z : ℝ} (hz : z ≤ 0) :

name: NavierStokes.HeatProfileExtension.extension_eq_profile

theorem extension_eq_profile (a : ℝ) {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 ≤ z) :

theorem extension_pos {a z : ℝ} (ha : 1 < a) (hz : 0 ≤ z) :

statement:
theorem extension_positive_near_zero {a : ℝ} (ha : 1 < a) :

name: NavierStokes.HeatProfileExtension.extension_positive_on_collar
statement:
theorem extension_positive_on_collar {a : ℝ} (ha : 1 < a) :

name: NavierStokes.HeatProfileExtension.extension_preserves_right_jets
statement:
theorem extension_preserves_right_jets {a : ℝ} (ha : 1 < a) (n : ℕ) :

name: NavierStokes.HeatProfileExtension.extension_sub_one_bound
statement:
theorem extension_sub_one_bound {a : ℝ} (ha : 1 < a) (z : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.HeatProfileExtension.extension_zero
statement: theorem extension_zero {a : ℝ} (ha : 1 < a) : extension a 0 = 1

name: NavierStokes.HeatProfileExtension.extension_zero_of_le_neg_one
statement:
theorem extension_zero_of_le_neg_one (a : ℝ) {z : ℝ} (hz : z ≤ -1) :

name: NavierStokes.HeatProfileExtension.iteratedDeriv_extension_eq_profileJet

theorem iteratedDeriv_extension_eq_profileJet {a : ℝ} (ha : 1 < a)

name: NavierStokes.HeatProfileExtension.iteratedDeriv_extension_zero
statement:
theorem iteratedDeriv_extension_zero {a : ℝ} (ha : 1 < a) (n : ℕ) :

name: NavierStokes.HeatProfileExtension.iteratedDeriv_scaledProfile
statement:
theorem iteratedDeriv_scaledProfile {a : ℝ} (ha : 1 < a) (n : ℕ) (X ν : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.HeatProfileExtension.leftBound_nonneg
statement: theorem leftBound_nonneg (a : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ leftBound a n

name: NavierStokes.HeatProfileExtension.leftBranch_contDiff

theorem leftBranch_derivative_bound (a : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (z : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.HeatProfileExtension.leftBranch_jets
statement:
theorem leftBranch_jets (a : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :

name: NavierStokes.HeatProfileExtension.leftBranch_left_jets
statement:
theorem leftBranch_left_jets (a : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :

name: NavierStokes.HeatProfileExtension.leftBranch_zero

theorem physicalProfile_contDiffOn {a : ℝ} (ha : 1 < a) :

name: NavierStokes.HeatProfileExtension.physicalProfile_eq_profile
statement:
theorem physicalProfile_eq_profile (a : ℝ) {X η : ℝ} (hX : 0 < X)
    (hη : η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    physicalProfile a X η = profile a (2 * (1 - η ^ 2) / X)

name: NavierStokes.HeatProfileExtension.profileJet_continuousOn
statement:
theorem profileJet_continuousOn {a : ℝ} (ha : 1 < a) (n : ℕ) :
    ContinuousOn (profileJet a n) (Ici 0)

name: NavierStokes.HeatProfileExtension.scaledProfile_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem scaledProfile_contDiffOn {a : ℝ} (ha : 1 < a) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => scaledProfile a p.1 p.2)

name: NavierStokes.HeatProfileExtension.scaledProfile_derivative_bound
statement:
theorem scaledProfile_derivative_bound {a X : ℝ} (ha : 1 < a) (hX : 0 < X)
    (n : ℕ) (ν : ℝ) :
    |iteratedDeriv n (scaledProfile a X) ν| ≤ (2 / X) ^ n * derivativeBound a n

name: NavierStokes.HeatProfileExtension.scaledProfile_eq_profile
statement:
theorem scaledProfile_eq_profile (a : ℝ) {X ν : ℝ} (hX : 0 < X) (hν : 0 ≤ ν) :

name: NavierStokes.HeatProfileExtension.scaledProfile_sub_one_bound

theorem scaledProfile_sub_one_bound {a : ℝ} (ha : 1 < a) {X : ℝ} (hX : 0 < X)

name: NavierStokes.AppendixHeatResults.derivativeCoeff_eq_rising
statement:
theorem derivativeCoeff_eq_rising (h : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    derivativeCoeff (1 + h) n = (-1 : ℝ) ^ n * rising h n

name: NavierStokes.AppendixHeatResults.derivative_bound_rising
statement:
theorem derivative_bound_rising {h z : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hz : 0 ≤ z) (n : ℕ) :
    |iteratedDerivWithin n (profile (1 + h)) (Ici 0) z| ≤
      rising h n * rising (1 + h) n

name: NavierStokes.AppendixHeatResults.endpoint_derivatives
statement:
theorem endpoint_derivatives {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (n : ℕ) :
    iteratedDerivWithin n (profile (1 + h)) (Ici 0) 0 =
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ n * rising h n * rising (1 + h) n

name: NavierStokes.AppendixHeatResults.first_endpoint_jet
statement:
theorem first_endpoint_jet {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) :
    profileJet (1 + h) 1 0 = -h * (1 + h)

name: NavierStokes.AppendixHeatResults.first_jet_remainder
statement:
theorem first_jet_remainder {h z : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hz : 0 ≤ z) :
    |profileJet (1 + h) 1 z + h * (1 + h)| ≤
      h * (1 + h) ^ 2 * (2 + h) * z

name: NavierStokes.AppendixHeatResults.gamma_add_nat
statement:
theorem gamma_add_nat {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (n : ℕ) :
    Real.Gamma (a + n) = Real.Gamma a * rising a n

name: NavierStokes.AppendixHeatResults.rising_mono
statement:
theorem rising_mono {b c : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c) (n : ℕ) :
    rising b n ≤ rising c n

name: NavierStokes.AppendixHeatResults.rising_nonneg
statement: theorem rising_nonneg {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b) (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ rising b n

name: NavierStokes.AppendixHeatResults.rising_pos
statement: theorem rising_pos {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (n : ℕ) : 0 < rising b n

name: NavierStokes.AppendixHeatResults.rising_succ
statement:
theorem rising_succ (b : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    rising b (n + 1) = rising b n * (b + n)

name: NavierStokes.AppendixHeatResults.rising_succ_left
statement:
theorem rising_succ_left (b : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    rising b (n + 1) = b * rising (1 + b) n

name: NavierStokes.AppendixHeatResults.rising_zero
statement: theorem rising_zero (b : ℝ) : rising b 0 = 1

name: NavierStokes.AppendixHeatResults.second_jet_bound
statement:
theorem second_jet_bound {h z : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hz : 0 ≤ z) :
    |profileJet (1 + h) 2 z| ≤ h * (1 + h) ^ 2 * (2 + h)

name: NavierStokes.AppendixHeatResults.small_argument_remainder
statement:
theorem small_argument_remainder {h z : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hz : 0 ≤ z) :
    |profile (1 + h) z - 1 + h * (1 + h) * z| ≤
      h * (1 + h) ^ 2 * (2 + h) * z ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.AppendixHeatResults.uniform_positive_derivative_bound
statement:
theorem uniform_positive_derivative_bound {h h₀ z : ℝ}
    (hh : 0 < h) (hh₀ : h ≤ h₀) (hz : 0 ≤ z) (n : ℕ) :
    |iteratedDerivWithin (n + 1) (profile (1 + h)) (Ici 0) z| ≤
      (rising (1 + h₀) n * rising (1 + h₀) (n + 1)) * h

name: NavierStokes.AppendixHeatResults.uniform_small_argument
statement:
theorem uniform_small_argument {h h₀ z : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hh₀ : h ≤ h₀)
    (hz : 0 ≤ z) :
    |profile (1 + h) z - 1| + |z * derivWithin (profile (1 + h)) (Ici 0) z| ≤
      (2 * (1 + h₀)) * h * z

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.coefficient_iteratedDeriv
statement:
theorem coefficient_iteratedDeriv (I : Window) (ε : ℝ) (A : AxisSpace I ε)
    (n m : ℕ) {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ Ioo I.left I.right) :
    iteratedDeriv m (coefficient I (weight ε) A n) η = jet I (weight ε) A.1 n m η

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.evaluationCLM_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem evaluationCLM_apply (I : Window) {ε R : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hR20 : R < 20) (k m : ℕ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) (hp : |p.1| ≤ R)

    evaluationCLM I hε hR hR20 k m p hp A = mixedSeries I ε A k m p

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.iteratedDeriv_Y
statement:
theorem iteratedDeriv_Y (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (A : AxisSpace I ε) (k m r : ℕ) {Y η : ℝ}
    (hY : Y ∈ Ioo (-20 : ℝ) 20) (hη : η ∈ Ioo I.left I.right) :
    iteratedDeriv r (fun y => mixedSeries I ε A k m (y, η)) Y =

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.iteratedDeriv_eta
statement:
theorem iteratedDeriv_eta (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.jetBound_nonneg
statement:
theorem jetBound_nonneg {ε R : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (k m : ℕ) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.linearForm_norm
statement: theorem linearForm_norm (u v : ℝ) : ‖linearForm u v‖ ≤ |u| + |v|

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.linearForm_tsum

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.majorant_scale
statement:
theorem majorant_scale (ε C R : ℝ) (k m n : ℕ) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.mixedSeries_add
statement:
theorem mixedSeries_add (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (A B : AxisSpace I ε) (k m : ℕ) {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : |p.1| < 20) :
    mixedSeries I ε (A + B) k m p = mixedSeries I ε A k m p + mixedSeries I ε B k m p

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.mixedSeries_bound
statement:
theorem mixedSeries_bound (I : Window) {ε R : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.mixedSeries_contDiffAt_nat
statement:
theorem mixedSeries_contDiffAt_nat (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)

    ∀ (k m : ℕ) (p : ℝ × ℝ), p ∈ strip I 20 →
      ContDiffAt ℝ r (mixedSeries I ε A k m) p

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.mixedSeries_hasDerivAt_Y
statement:
theorem mixedSeries_hasDerivAt_Y (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)

      (mixedSeries I ε A (k + 1) m (Y, η)) Y

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.mixedSeries_hasDerivAt_eta
statement:
theorem mixedSeries_hasDerivAt_eta (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)

statement:
theorem mixedSeries_hasFDerivAt (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.mixedSeries_hasFDerivAt_strip
statement:
theorem mixedSeries_hasFDerivAt_strip (I : Window) {ε R : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.mixedSeries_smooth
statement:
theorem mixedSeries_smooth (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (A : AxisSpace I ε) (k m : ℕ) {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ strip I 20) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.mixedSeries_smul
statement:
theorem mixedSeries_smul (I : Window) (ε c : ℝ)

    mixedSeries I ε (c • A) k m p = c * mixedSeries I ε A k m p

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.mixedSeries_sub
statement:
theorem mixedSeries_sub (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (A B : AxisSpace I ε) (k m : ℕ) {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : |p.1| < 20) :
    mixedSeries I ε (A - B) k m p = mixedSeries I ε A k m p - mixedSeries I ε B k m p

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.mixedSeries_sub_bound
statement:
theorem mixedSeries_sub_bound (I : Window) {ε R : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hR20 : R < 20) (A B : AxisSpace I ε) (k m : ℕ)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : |p.1| ≤ R) :
    ‖mixedSeries I ε A k m p - mixedSeries I ε B k m p‖ ≤
      jetBound ε R k m * ‖A - B‖

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.mixedSeries_summable
statement:
theorem mixedSeries_summable (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (A : AxisSpace I ε) (k m : ℕ) {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : |p.1| < 20) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.mixedSeries_uniform
statement:
theorem mixedSeries_uniform (I : Window) {ε R : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hR20 : R < 20)
    (A : AxisSpace I ε) (k m : ℕ) :
    TendstoUniformlyOn
      (fun N (p : ℝ × ℝ) => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, term I ε A k m n p)
      (mixedSeries I ε A k m) atTop {p : ℝ × ℝ | |p.1| ≤ R}

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.mixedSeries_zero
statement:
theorem mixedSeries_zero (I : Window) (ε : ℝ) (A : AxisSpace I ε) :
    mixedSeries I ε A 0 0 = profile I ε A

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.mixed_derivative_profile
statement:
theorem mixed_derivative_profile (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (A : AxisSpace I ε) (k m : ℕ) {Y η : ℝ}
    (hY : Y ∈ Ioo (-20 : ℝ) 20) (hη : η ∈ Ioo I.left I.right) :
    iteratedDeriv m (fun x => iteratedDeriv k (fun y => profile I ε A (y, x)) Y) η =
      ∑' n : ℕ, (n.descFactorial k : ℝ) * Y ^ (n - k) *
        jet I (weight ε) A.1 n m η

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.mixed_derivative_profile_coefficients
statement:
theorem mixed_derivative_profile_coefficients (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (A : AxisSpace I ε) (k m : ℕ) {Y η : ℝ}
    (hY : Y ∈ Ioo (-20 : ℝ) 20) (hη : η ∈ Ioo I.left I.right) :
    iteratedDeriv m (fun x => iteratedDeriv k (fun y => profile I ε A (y, x)) Y) η =
      ∑' n : ℕ, (n.descFactorial k : ℝ) * Y ^ (n - k) *
        iteratedDeriv m (coefficient I (weight ε) A n) η

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.polynomialJet_bound

theorem polynomialJet_bound {R Y : ℝ} (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hY : |Y| ≤ R) (n k : ℕ) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisEvaluation.polynomialJet_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem polynomialJet_hasDerivAt (n k : ℕ) (Y : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphic.exists_common_holomorphic_extension
statement:
theorem exists_common_holomorphic_extension (I J : Window) (hleft : I.left < J.left)
    (hright : J.right < I.right) {ε R : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hR20 : R < 20) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∃ B : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ k, 0 ≤ B k) ∧
      ∀ (A : AxisSpace I ε) (Y : ℝ), |Y| ≤ R → ∀ k : ℕ,
        AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (complexProfile I ε A k Y) (parameterTube J δ) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ parameterTube J δ, ‖complexProfile I ε A k Y z‖ ≤ B k * ‖A‖) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ parameterTube J δ,
          iteratedDeriv k (fun y => complexProfile I ε A 0 y z) Y =
            complexProfile I ε A k Y z) ∧
        (∀ (m : ℕ) (x : ℝ), x ∈ J.interval →
          iteratedDeriv m (complexProfile I ε A k Y) (x : ℂ) =
            (mixedSeries I ε A k m (Y, x) : ℂ))

statement:

    (k m : ℕ) {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : |p.1| ≤ R) :
    ‖mixedSeries I ε A k m p‖ ≤

name: NavierStokes.AxisHolomorphicJoint.exists_common_joint_extension
statement:
theorem exists_common_joint_extension (I J : Window) (hleft : I.left < J.left)
    (hright : J.right < I.right) {ε R : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hR20 : R < 20) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∃ S : ℝ, R < S ∧ S < 20 ∧ ∃ B : ℕ → ℝ,
      (∀ k, 0 ≤ B k) ∧ ∀ (A : AxisSpace I ε) (k : ℕ),
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => complexProfile I ε A k p.1 p.2)
          (Ioo (-S) S ×ˢ parameterTube J δ) ∧
        ∀ Y : ℝ, |Y| ≤ R →
          AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (complexProfile I ε A k Y) (parameterTube J δ) ∧
          (∀ z ∈ parameterTube J δ, ‖complexProfile I ε A k Y z‖ ≤ B k * ‖A‖) ∧
          (∀ z ∈ parameterTube J δ,
            iteratedDeriv k (fun y => complexProfile I ε A 0 y z) Y =
              complexProfile I ε A k Y z) ∧
          (∀ (m : ℕ) (x : ℝ), x ∈ J.interval →
            iteratedDeriv m (complexProfile I ε A k Y) (x : ℂ) =
              (mixedSeries I ε A k m (Y, x) : ℂ))

    coefficient I (weight ε) (product I hε A B) n x =

name: NavierStokes.AxisOperators.differentialFamily_bound
statement:
theorem differentialFamily_bound (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (r p : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (d b : ℕ → ℝ) (C : ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ j, 0 ≤ d j) (hb : ∀ i, 0 ≤ b i) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hshift : ∀ i k, weight ε i (p + k) ≤ C * b i * weight ε (i + 1) k)
    (hfactor : ∀ n i j, i + j = n → b i * d j ≤ radialDivisor r n)
    (A B : AxisSpace I ε) (n m : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    |differentialFamily I ε r p d A B n m x| ≤
      ((64 * C) * ‖A‖ * ‖B‖) * weight ε n m

theorem differentialFamily_deriv (I : Window) (ε : ℝ) (r p : ℕ) (d : ℕ → ℝ)
    (A B : AxisSpace I ε) (n m : ℕ) (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ I.interval) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (differentialFamily I ε r p d A B n m)
      (differentialFamily I ε r p d A B n (m + 1) x) I.interval x

name: NavierStokes.AxisOperators.differentialFamily_succ_eq
statement:
theorem differentialFamily_succ_eq (I : Window) (ε : ℝ) (r p : ℕ) (d : ℕ → ℝ)
    (A B : AxisSpace I ε) (n m : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    differentialFamily I ε r p d A B (n + 1) m x =
      ∑ ij ∈ antidiagonal n, (d ij.2 / radialDivisor r n) *
        leibnizSum (fun k => inputJet I ε A ij.1 (p + k) x)
          (fun l => inputJet I ε B ij.2 l x) m

name: NavierStokes.AxisOperators.hasDerivWithinAt_leibnizSum
statement:
theorem hasDerivWithinAt_leibnizSum (I : Window) (f g : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ k x, x ∈ I.interval → HasDerivWithinAt (f k) (f (k + 1) x) I.interval x)
    (hg : ∀ k x, x ∈ I.interval → HasDerivWithinAt (g k) (g (k + 1) x) I.interval x)
    (m : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ I.interval) :
    HasDerivWithinAt
      (fun y => leibnizSum (fun k => f k y) (fun k => g k y) m)
      (leibnizSum (fun k => f k x) (fun k => g k x) (m + 1)) I.interval x

name: NavierStokes.AxisOperators.leibniz_boundary
statement:
theorem leibniz_boundary (f g : ℕ → ℝ) (m : ℕ) :
    (∑ kl ∈ antidiagonal m, (m.choose kl.1 : ℝ) * f kl.1 * g (kl.2 + 1)) =
      f 0 * g (m + 1) +
        ∑ kl ∈ antidiagonal m, (m.choose (kl.1 + 1) : ℝ) * f (kl.1 + 1) * g kl.2

name: NavierStokes.AxisInverseFactors.insert_regularInverse
statement:
theorem insert_regularInverse (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (F B : AxisSpace I ε) :
    insert I hε r hr (regularInverse I hε r hr F) B =
      regularInverse I hε r hr (product I hε F B)

name: NavierStokes.AxisInverseFactors.jet_insert
statement:
theorem jet_insert (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (A B : AxisSpace I ε) (n m : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ I.interval) :
    inputJet I ε (insert I hε r hr A B) n m x = insertFamily I ε r A B n m x

name: NavierStokes.AxisInverseFactors.norm_extra_factors_of_bound
statement:
theorem norm_extra_factors_of_bound (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (A : AxisSpace I ε) (Bs : List (AxisSpace I ε)) {K : ℝ} (hK : ‖A‖ ≤ K) :
    ‖insertFactors I hε r hr A Bs‖ ≤ 64 ^ Bs.length * K * (Bs.map norm).prod

name: NavierStokes.AxisInverseFactors.norm_insertFactors_le
statement:
theorem norm_insertFactors_le (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (A : AxisSpace I ε) (Bs : List (AxisSpace I ε)) :
    ‖insertFactors I hε r hr A Bs‖ ≤ 64 ^ Bs.length * ‖A‖ * (Bs.map norm).prod

name: NavierStokes.AxisInverseFactors.norm_insert_le
statement:
theorem norm_insert_le (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (A B : AxisSpace I ε) : ‖insert I hε r hr A B‖ ≤ 64 * ‖A‖ * ‖B‖

name: NavierStokes.AxisInverseFactors.norm_mixed_extra_factors
statement:
theorem norm_mixed_extra_factors (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (F G : AxisSpace I ε) (Bs : List (AxisSpace I ε)) :
    ‖insertFactors I hε r hr (inverseMixed I hε r hr F G) Bs‖ ≤
      64 ^ Bs.length * (5120 / ε * ‖F‖ * ‖G‖) * (Bs.map norm).prod

name: NavierStokes.AxisInverseFactors.ratio_mem_Icc
statement: theorem ratio_mem_Icc {r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (n i : ℕ) : ratio r n i ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1

name: NavierStokes.AxisInverseFactors.ratio_of_le
statement:
theorem ratio_of_le (r n i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ n) :
    ratio r n i = degreeMultiplier r i / degreeMultiplier r n

name: NavierStokes.AxisInverseFactors.recoveredSource_insert
statement:
theorem recoveredSource_insert (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (A B : AxisSpace I ε) (n : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ I.interval) :
    recoveredSource I ε r (insert I hε r hr A B) n x =
      ∑ ij ∈ antidiagonal n, recoveredSource I ε r A ij.1 x *
        coefficient I (weight ε) B ij.2 x

name: NavierStokes.AxisInverseFactors.recoveredSource_mixed
statement:
theorem recoveredSource_mixed (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (F G : AxisSpace I ε) (n : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ I.interval) :
    recoveredSource I ε r (inverseMixed I hε r hr F G) n x =
      ∑ ij ∈ antidiagonal n, inputJet I ε F ij.1 1 x *
        ((ij.2 : ℝ) * coefficient I (weight ε) G ij.2 x)

name: NavierStokes.HolomorphicFamily.analyticAt_cauchyValue
statement:
theorem analyticAt_cauchyValue (c : ℂ) {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ)

theorem analyticOnNhd_of_disk_family (c : ℂ) {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ)

theorem profile_analyticOnNhd (I : Window) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (A : AxisSpace I ε) :

statement:

statement:
theorem radialExtension_joint_disk (I : Window) {ε R s : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)

name: NavierStokes.AxisProfile.cubicLower_gt_quarter

theorem cubicLower_gt_quarter (t : ℝ) (ht : t ≤ 41 / 20) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisProfile.deriv_leadingAxial
statement:
theorem deriv_leadingAxial (Z L : ℝ) :
    deriv (leadingAxial Z L) = fun _ : ℝ => -Z / (2 * L)

name: NavierStokes.AxisProfile.first_five_weighted_terms_eq_quartic
statement:
theorem first_five_weighted_terms_eq_quartic (χ Y : ℝ) :
    profileCoeff χ 0 + 2 * profileCoeff χ 1 * Y +
      3 * profileCoeff χ 2 * Y ^ 2 + 4 * profileCoeff χ 3 * Y ^ 3 +
      5 * profileCoeff χ 4 * Y ^ 4 = quarticUpper (Y * χ / 2)

name: NavierStokes.AxisProfile.first_four_terms_eq_cubic
statement:
theorem first_four_terms_eq_cubic (χ Y : ℝ) :
    profileCoeff χ 0 + profileCoeff χ 1 * Y +
      profileCoeff χ 2 * Y ^ 2 + profileCoeff χ 3 * Y ^ 3 =
      cubicLower (Y * χ / 2)

name: NavierStokes.AxisProfile.hasDerivAt_leadingAxial
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_leadingAxial (Z L Y : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (leadingAxial Z L) (-Z / (2 * L)) Y

name: NavierStokes.AxisProfile.hasDerivAt_leadingAxial_derivative
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_leadingAxial_derivative (Z L Y : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun _ : ℝ => -Z / (2 * L)) 0 Y

name: NavierStokes.AxisProfile.leadingAxial_scaled_equation
statement:
theorem leadingAxial_scaled_equation (Z L Y : ℝ) (hL : L ≠ 0) :

      -Z / L

name: NavierStokes.AxisProfile.leadingAxial_zero
statement: theorem leadingAxial_zero (Z L : ℝ) : leadingAxial Z L 0 = 0

name: NavierStokes.AxisProfile.profileCoeff_recurrence
statement:
theorem profileCoeff_recurrence (χ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * ((n : ℝ) + 2) * profileCoeff χ (n + 1) =
      -χ * profileCoeff χ n

name: NavierStokes.AxisProfile.profileCoeff_scaled_equation
statement:
theorem profileCoeff_scaled_equation (χ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    2 * radialOperatorCoeff 2 (profileCoeff χ) n = -χ * profileCoeff χ n

name: NavierStokes.AxisProfile.profileCoeff_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem profileCoeff_zero (χ : ℝ) : profileCoeff χ 0 = 1

name: NavierStokes.AxisProfile.quarticUpper_lt_neg_eighteen_hundredths
statement:
theorem quarticUpper_lt_neg_eighteen_hundredths

name: NavierStokes.AxisProfile.radialInverseCoeff_zero

@[simp] theorem radialInverseCoeff_zero (m : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisProfile.radialOperator_inverse
statement:
theorem radialOperator_inverse (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (f : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    radialOperatorCoeff m (radialInverseCoeff m f) n = f n

name: NavierStokes.AxisProfile.weighted_profileCoeff
statement:
theorem weighted_profileCoeff (χ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    ((n : ℝ) + 1) * profileCoeff χ n =
      (-χ / 2) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ) ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.alternating_tail_nonneg
statement:
theorem alternating_tail_nonneg (k j : ℕ) (hj : 1 ≤ j)
    (t : ℝ) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht : t ≤ 4) :
    0 ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, (-1 : ℝ) ^ n * term k (n + j) (-t)

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.bessel_contiguous
statement:
theorem bessel_contiguous (k : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    bessel k t = ((k : ℝ) + 1) * bessel (k + 1) t - t * bessel (k + 2) t

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.bessel_eq_constant_add_tail
statement:
theorem bessel_eq_constant_add_tail (k : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    bessel k t = 1 / (k.factorial : ℝ) + ∑' n : ℕ, term k (n + 1) t

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.bessel_le_odd_partial_sum
statement:
theorem bessel_le_odd_partial_sum (k j : ℕ) (hj : 1 ≤ j) (hodd : Odd j)
    (t : ℝ) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht : t ≤ 4) :
    bessel k t ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range j, term k n t

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.bessel_ode
statement:
theorem bessel_ode (k : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    t * deriv (deriv (bessel k)) t + ((k : ℝ) + 1) * deriv (bessel k) t +
      bessel k t = 0

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.bessel_one_add_mul_deriv
statement:
theorem bessel_one_add_mul_deriv (t : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.bessel_one_gt_quarter
statement:
theorem bessel_one_gt_quarter (t : ℝ) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht : t ≤ 41 / 20) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.bessel_one_le_one
statement:
theorem bessel_one_le_one (t : ℝ) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht : t ≤ 4) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.bessel_one_log_slope_gt
statement:
theorem bessel_one_log_slope_gt (t : ℝ) (ht0 : 99 / 50 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 2) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.bessel_zero
statement: theorem bessel_zero (k : ℕ) : bessel k 0 = 1 / (k.factorial : ℝ)

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.bessel_zero_lt_neg_eighteen_hundredths

theorem bessel_zero_lt_neg_eighteen_hundredths

statement:
theorem cubic_tail_antitone (t : ℝ) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht : t ≤ 41 / 20) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.cubic_tail_nonneg
statement:
theorem cubic_tail_nonneg (t : ℝ) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht : t ≤ 41 / 20) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.deriv_bessel

theorem deriv_bessel (k : ℕ) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.deriv_profile
statement:
theorem deriv_profile (χ : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.factorial_reciprocal
statement:
theorem factorial_reciprocal (k : ℕ) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.hasDerivAt_bessel
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_bessel (k : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.hasDerivAt_profile

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.hasDerivAt_term_succ

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.magnitude_tail_antitone
statement:
theorem magnitude_tail_antitone (k j : ℕ) (hj : 1 ≤ j)

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.profile_gt_quarter
statement:
theorem profile_gt_quarter (χ Y : ℝ) (hχ0 : 0 ≤ χ) (hχ1 : χ ≤ 1)

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.profile_log_slope_at_four

theorem profile_pos (χ Y : ℝ) (hχ0 : 0 ≤ χ) (hχ1 : χ ≤ 1)

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.profile_scaled_ode

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.profile_zero
statement: theorem profile_zero (χ : ℝ) : profile χ 0 = 1

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.second_deriv_bessel
statement:
theorem second_deriv_bessel (k : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.second_deriv_profile

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.summable_norm_term
statement:
theorem summable_norm_term (k : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.summable_term
statement: theorem summable_term (k : ℕ) (t : ℝ) : Summable (fun n : ℕ => term k n t)

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.term_contiguous
statement:
theorem term_contiguous (k n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.term_norm_le

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.term_sign

name: NavierStokes.AxisSeries.term_succ_ratio
statement:

name: NavierStokes.AxisModelBounds.cubicLower_ge_endpoint

name: NavierStokes.AxisModelBounds.profile_bounds

theorem complex_pressure_sign (A c : ℂ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :

name: NavierStokes.TangentProjection.damping_dissipative
statement:
theorem damping_dissipative (δ : ℝ) (t : E) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    ⟪t, -δ • t⟫_ℝ ≤ 0

name: NavierStokes.TangentProjection.differentiated_tangency
statement:
theorem differentiated_tangency {n t : ℝ → E} {n' t' : E} {x : ℝ}
    (hn : HasDerivAt n n' x) (ht : HasDerivAt t t' x)
    (htangent : ∀ y, ⟪n y, t y⟫_ℝ = 0) :
    ⟪n x, t'⟫_ℝ = -⟪n', t x⟫_ℝ

name: NavierStokes.TangentProjection.normal_projectedRhs
statement:
theorem normal_projectedRhs {n : E} (hn : n ≠ 0) (n' t Kt f : E) (δ : ℝ) :
    ⟪n, projectedRhs n n' t Kt f δ⟫_ℝ = -⟪n', t⟫_ℝ - δ * ⟪n, t⟫_ℝ

name: NavierStokes.TangentProjection.normal_projectedRhs_of_tangent
statement:
theorem normal_projectedRhs_of_tangent {n : E} (hn : n ≠ 0)

name: NavierStokes.TangentProjection.pressure_cancellation
statement:
theorem pressure_cancellation (n n' t Kt f : E) (δ : ℝ) :
    projectedRhs n n' t Kt f δ + Kt + δ • t -
      pressureCoefficient n n' t Kt f • n = -f

name: NavierStokes.TangentProjection.projected_balance
statement:
theorem projected_balance (n n' t Kt f : E) (δ : ℝ) :
    projectedRhs n n' t Kt f δ + Kt + δ • t + f =
      pressureCoefficient n n' t Kt f • n

name: NavierStokes.TangentProjection.scalar_defect_zero
statement:
theorem scalar_defect_zero (h δ D : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hD : ∀ x, HasDerivAt D (δ x) x)
    (hh : ∀ x, HasDerivAt h (-δ x * h x) x)
    (x₀ : ℝ) (hzero : h x₀ = 0) : ∀ x, h x = 0

name: NavierStokes.TangentProjection.tangency_defect_derivative
statement:
theorem tangency_defect_derivative {n t : ℝ → E} {n' : E} {x : ℝ}
    {Kt f : E} {δ : ℝ} (hn0 : n x ≠ 0)
    (hn : HasDerivAt n n' x)
    (ht : HasDerivAt t (projectedRhs (n x) n' (t x) Kt f δ) x) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => ⟪n y, t y⟫_ℝ) (-δ * ⟪n x, t x⟫_ℝ) x

name: NavierStokes.TangentProjection.tangency_preserved
statement:
theorem tangency_preserved (n n' t Kt f : ℝ → E) (δ D : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hn0 : ∀ x, n x ≠ 0)
    (hn : ∀ x, HasDerivAt n (n' x) x)
    (ht : ∀ x, HasDerivAt t (projectedRhs (n x) (n' x) (t x) (Kt x) (f x) (δ x)) x)
    (hD : ∀ x, HasDerivAt D (δ x) x)
    (x₀ : ℝ) (hzero : ⟪n x₀, t x₀⟫_ℝ = 0) : ∀ x, ⟪n x, t x⟫_ℝ = 0

name: NavierStokes.TangentProjection.tangentProj_idempotent
statement:
theorem tangentProj_idempotent {n : E} (hn : n ≠ 0) (f : E) :

name: NavierStokes.TangentProjection.tangentProj_normal
statement:
theorem tangentProj_normal {n : E} (hn : n ≠ 0) (f : E) :

name: NavierStokes.TangentProjection.tangentProj_of_tangent
statement:

name: NavierStokes.TangentProjection.viscous_coefficient_nonneg
statement:
theorem viscous_coefficient_nonneg (ε k j : ℝ) (n : E) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) :
    0 ≤ ε * k ^ 2 * j ^ 2 * ⟪n, n⟫_ℝ

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.IntervalSystem.continuous_composeField
statement:
theorem continuous_composeField (f : C(Icc v.left v.right, E)) :
    Continuous (v.composeField f)

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.IntervalSystem.continuous_proj
statement: theorem continuous_proj : Continuous v.proj

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.IntervalSystem.dist_iterate_next_apply_le
statement:
theorem dist_iterate_next_apply_le (f g : C(Icc v.left v.right, E))
    (n : ℕ) (t : Icc v.left v.right) :
    dist (v.next^[n] f t) (v.next^[n] g t) ≤
      (v.lip * |t.1 - v.left|) ^ n / n ! * dist f g

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.IntervalSystem.dist_iterate_next_le
statement:
theorem dist_iterate_next_le (f g : C(Icc v.left v.right, E)) (n : ℕ) :
    dist (v.next^[n] f) (v.next^[n] g) ≤
      (v.lip * (v.right - v.left)) ^ n / n ! * dist f g

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.IntervalSystem.dist_next_apply_le_of_le
statement:
theorem dist_next_apply_le_of_le {f g : C(Icc v.left v.right, E)} {n : ℕ} {d : ℝ}
    (h : ∀ t, dist (f t) (g t) ≤ (v.lip * |t.1 - v.left|) ^ n / n ! * d)
    (t : Icc v.left v.right) :
    dist (v.next f t) (v.next g t) ≤
      (v.lip * |t.1 - v.left|) ^ (n + 1) / (n + 1)! * d

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.IntervalSystem.exists_contracting_iterate
statement:
theorem exists_contracting_iterate :
    ∃ (N : ℕ) (K : ℝ≥0), ContractingWith K v.next^[N]

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.IntervalSystem.exists_fixed
statement: theorem exists_fixed : ∃ f : C(Icc v.left v.right, E), v.next f = f

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.IntervalSystem.exists_solution
statement:
theorem exists_solution :
    ∃ u : ℝ → E, u v.left = v.initial ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Icc v.left v.right, HasDerivAt u (v.field t (u t)) t

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.IntervalSystem.hasDerivAt_integralCurve
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_integralCurve (f : C(Icc v.left v.right, E)) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (v.integralCurve f) (v.composeField f t) t

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.IntervalSystem.integrable_composeField
statement:
theorem integrable_composeField (f : C(Icc v.left v.right, E)) (a b : ℝ) :
    IntervalIntegrable (v.composeField f) volume a b

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.IntervalSystem.next_apply
statement:
theorem next_apply (f : C(Icc v.left v.right, E)) (t : Icc v.left v.right) :
    v.next f t = v.initial + ∫ s in v.left..t, v.composeField f s

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.IntervalSystem.proj_coe
statement: theorem proj_coe (t : Icc v.left v.right) : v.proj t = t

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.IntervalSystem.proj_of_mem
statement:
theorem proj_of_mem {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Icc v.left v.right) :
    (v.proj t : ℝ) = t

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.continuousOn_projectedForcing
statement:
theorem continuousOn_projectedForcing {s : Set ℝ}
    (n f : ℝ → H) (hn : ContinuousOn n s) (hf : ContinuousOn f s)
    (hn0 : ∀ t ∈ s, n t ≠ 0) :
    ContinuousOn (fun t => -TangentProjection.tangentProj (n t) (f t)) s

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.continuousOn_projectedOperator
statement:
theorem continuousOn_projectedOperator {s : Set ℝ}
    (n n' : ℝ → H) (K : ℝ → H →L[ℝ] H) (δ : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hn : ContinuousOn n s) (hn' : ContinuousOn n' s)
    (hK : ContinuousOn K s) (hδ : ContinuousOn δ s)
    (hn0 : ∀ t ∈ s, n t ≠ 0) :
    ContinuousOn (fun t => projectedOperator (n t) (n' t) (K t) (δ t)) s

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.exists_linear_solution
statement:
theorem exists_linear_solution {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (A : ℝ → E →L[ℝ] E) (g : ℝ → E)
    (hA : ContinuousOn A (Icc a b)) (hg : ContinuousOn g (Icc a b)) (x₀ : E) :
    ∃ u : ℝ → E, u a = x₀ ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, HasDerivAt u (A t (u t) + g t) t

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.exists_projected_solution
statement:
theorem exists_projected_solution {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (n n' f : ℝ → H) (K : ℝ → H →L[ℝ] H) (δ : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hn : ContinuousOn n (Icc a b)) (hn' : ContinuousOn n' (Icc a b))
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b)) (hK : ContinuousOn K (Icc a b))
    (hδ : ContinuousOn δ (Icc a b)) (hn0 : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, n t ≠ 0)
    (x₀ : H) :
    ∃ u : ℝ → H, u a = x₀ ∧ ∀ t ∈ Icc a b,
      HasDerivAt u (TangentProjection.projectedRhs (n t) (n' t) (u t)
        (K t (u t)) (f t) (δ t)) t

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.exists_unique_tangent_solution
statement:
theorem exists_unique_tangent_solution {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (n n' f : ℝ → H) (K : ℝ → H →L[ℝ] H) (δ : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hn : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, HasDerivAt n (n' t) t)
    (hn' : ContinuousOn n' (Icc a b)) (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hK : ContinuousOn K (Icc a b)) (hδ : ContinuousOn δ (Icc a b))
    (hn0 : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, n t ≠ 0) (x₀ : H) (hx₀ : ⟪n a, x₀⟫_ℝ = 0) :
    ∃ u : ℝ → H, u a = x₀ ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc a b, HasDerivAt u
        (TangentProjection.projectedRhs (n t) (n' t) (u t) (K t (u t)) (f t) (δ t)) t) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc a b, ⟪n t, u t⟫_ℝ = 0) ∧
      ∀ w : ℝ → H, w a = x₀ →
        (∀ t ∈ Icc a b, HasDerivAt w
          (TangentProjection.projectedRhs (n t) (n' t) (w t) (K t (w t)) (f t) (δ t)) t) →
        EqOn w u (Icc a b)

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.linear_solution_unique
statement:
theorem linear_solution_unique {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (A : ℝ → E →L[ℝ] E) (g : ℝ → E) (hA : ContinuousOn A (Icc a b))
    {u w : ℝ → E}
    (hu : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, HasDerivAt u (A t (u t) + g t) t)
    (hw : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, HasDerivAt w (A t (w t) + g t) t)
    (hinit : u a = w a) : EqOn u w (Icc a b)

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.linear_uniform_lipschitz
statement:
theorem linear_uniform_lipschitz {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (A : ℝ → E →L[ℝ] E) (g : ℝ → E) (hA : ContinuousOn A (Icc a b)) :
    ∃ L : ℝ≥0, ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, LipschitzWith L (fun x => A t x + g t)

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.projectedOperator_apply
statement:
theorem projectedOperator_apply (n n' x f : H) (K : H →L[ℝ] H) (δ : ℝ) :
    projectedOperator n n' K δ x - TangentProjection.tangentProj n f =
      TangentProjection.projectedRhs n n' x (K x) f δ

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.projected_solution_unique
statement:
theorem projected_solution_unique {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (n n' f : ℝ → H) (K : ℝ → H →L[ℝ] H) (δ : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hn : ContinuousOn n (Icc a b)) (hn' : ContinuousOn n' (Icc a b))
    (hK : ContinuousOn K (Icc a b)) (hδ : ContinuousOn δ (Icc a b))
    (hn0 : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, n t ≠ 0) {u w : ℝ → H}
    (hu : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, HasDerivAt u
      (TangentProjection.projectedRhs (n t) (n' t) (u t) (K t (u t)) (f t) (δ t)) t)
    (hw : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, HasDerivAt w
      (TangentProjection.projectedRhs (n t) (n' t) (w t) (K t (w t)) (f t) (δ t)) t)
    (hinit : u a = w a) : EqOn u w (Icc a b)

name: NavierStokes.TangentODE.projected_tangency_preserved
statement:
theorem projected_tangency_preserved {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (n n' f u : ℝ → H) (K : ℝ → H →L[ℝ] H) (δ : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hδ : ContinuousOn δ (Icc a b)) (hn0 : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, n t ≠ 0)
    (hn : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, HasDerivAt n (n' t) t)
    (hu : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, HasDerivAt u
      (TangentProjection.projectedRhs (n t) (n' t) (u t) (K t (u t)) (f t) (δ t)) t)
    (hinit : ⟪n a, u a⟫_ℝ = 0) : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, ⟪n t, u t⟫_ℝ = 0

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.affine_iterate_sub
statement:
theorem affine_iterate_sub (L : X →L[ℝ] X) (g : X) (n : ℕ) (u w : X) :
    (fun x => g + L x)^[n] u - (fun x => g + L x)^[n] w =
      L^[n] u - L^[n] w

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.coefficientAction_apply
statement:
theorem coefficientAction_apply (A : Coefficient a b E) (u : Curve a b E) (t : Icc a b) :
    coefficientAction (E := E) A u t = A t (u t)

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.contDiffOn_solution_family
statement:
theorem contDiffOn_solution_family {s : Set P}
    (A : P → Coefficient a b E) (x₀ : P → E) (f : P → Curve a b E)
    (hA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ A s) (hx₀ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ x₀ s)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f s) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p => solution hab (A p) (x₀ p) (f p)) s

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.contDiff_inverse_family
statement:
theorem contDiff_inverse_family {X Q : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X] [CompleteSpace X]
    [NormedAddCommGroup Q] [NormedSpace ℝ Q]
    (L : Q → X →L[ℝ] X) (hL : ContDiff ℝ ∞ L) (hInv : ∀ q, (L q).IsInvertible) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun q => (L q).inverse)

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.contDiff_resolvent
statement: theorem contDiff_resolvent : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (resolvent (E := E) hab)

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.contDiff_solution_family
statement:
theorem contDiff_solution_family (A : P → Coefficient a b E) (x₀ : P → E)
    (f : P → Curve a b E) (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (hx₀ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ x₀)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p => solution hab (A p) (x₀ p) (f p))

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.continuous_extend
statement: theorem continuous_extend (f : Curve a b E) : Continuous (extend hab f)

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.equationOperator_isInvertible
statement:
theorem equationOperator_isInvertible (A : Coefficient a b E) :
    (equationOperator hab A).IsInvertible

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.extend_coe
statement: theorem extend_coe (f : Curve a b E) (t : Icc a b) : extend hab f t = f t

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.fderiv_resolvent_family
statement:
theorem fderiv_resolvent_family (A : P → Coefficient a b E) (g : P → Curve a b E)
    {p : P} {A' : P →L[ℝ] Coefficient a b E} {g' : P →L[ℝ] Curve a b E}
    (hA : HasFDerivAt A A' p) (hg : HasFDerivAt g g' p) (v : P) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun q => resolvent hab (A q) (g q)) p v =
      resolvent hab (A p) (g' v + volterra (E := E) hab (A' v)
        (resolvent hab (A p) (g p)))

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.id_sub_isInvertible
statement:
theorem id_sub_isInvertible (L : X →L[ℝ] X)
    (hL : ∃ (N : ℕ) (K : ℝ≥0), ContractingWith K L^[N]) :
    (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ X - L).IsInvertible

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.integrator_apply
statement:
theorem integrator_apply (f : Curve a b E) (t : Icc a b) :
    integrator hab f t = ∫ s in a..(t : ℝ), extend hab f s

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.norm_applyCoefficient_le
statement:
theorem norm_applyCoefficient_le (A : Coefficient a b E) (u : Curve a b E) :
    ‖applyCoefficient A u‖ ≤ ‖A‖ * ‖u‖

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.norm_constantCurve_le
statement:
theorem norm_constantCurve_le (x : E) :
    ‖constantCurve (a := a) (b := b) x‖ ≤ ‖x‖

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.norm_integralPath_le
statement:
theorem norm_integralPath_le (f : Curve a b E) :
    ‖integralPath hab f‖ ≤ (b - a) * ‖f‖

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.norm_parameter_derivative_le
statement:
theorem norm_parameter_derivative_le
    (A : P → Coefficient a b E) (x₀ : P → E) (f : P → Curve a b E)
    {p : P} {A' : P →L[ℝ] Coefficient a b E} {x₀' : P →L[ℝ] E}
    {f' : P →L[ℝ] Curve a b E}
    (hA : HasFDerivAt A A' p) (hx₀ : HasFDerivAt x₀ x₀' p)
    (hf : HasFDerivAt f f' p) (v : P) :
    ‖fderiv ℝ (fun q => solution hab (A q) (x₀ q) (f q)) p v‖ ≤
      ‖resolvent hab (A p)‖ * (‖x₀' v‖ + (b - a) *
        (‖A' v‖ * ‖solution hab (A p) (x₀ p) (f p)‖ + ‖f' v‖))

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.norm_solution_le
statement:
theorem norm_solution_le (A : Coefficient a b E) (x₀ : E) (f : Curve a b E) :
    ‖solution hab A x₀ f‖ ≤ ‖resolvent hab A‖ * (‖x₀‖ + (b - a) * ‖f‖)

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.norm_source_le
statement:
theorem norm_source_le (x₀ : E) (f : Curve a b E) :
    ‖source hab x₀ f‖ ≤ ‖x₀‖ + (b - a) * ‖f‖

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.norm_volterra_apply_le
statement:
theorem norm_volterra_apply_le (A : Coefficient a b E) (u : Curve a b E) :
    ‖volterra (E := E) hab A u‖ ≤ (b - a) * ‖A‖ * ‖u‖

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.parameter_derivative_eq_solution
statement:
theorem parameter_derivative_eq_solution
    (A : P → Coefficient a b E) (x₀ : P → E) (f : P → Curve a b E)
    {p : P} {A' : P →L[ℝ] Coefficient a b E} {x₀' : P →L[ℝ] E}
    {f' : P →L[ℝ] Curve a b E}
    (hA : HasFDerivAt A A' p) (hx₀ : HasFDerivAt x₀ x₀' p)
    (hf : HasFDerivAt f f' p) (v : P) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun q => solution hab (A q) (x₀ q) (f q)) p v =
      solution hab (A p) (x₀' v)
        (applyCoefficient (A' v) (solution hab (A p) (x₀ p) (f p)) + f' v)

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.parameter_derivative_hasDerivWithinAt
statement:
theorem parameter_derivative_hasDerivWithinAt
    (A : P → Coefficient a b E) (x₀ : P → E) (f : P → Curve a b E)
    {p : P} {A' : P →L[ℝ] Coefficient a b E} {x₀' : P →L[ℝ] E}
    {f' : P →L[ℝ] Curve a b E}
    (hA : HasFDerivAt A A' p) (hx₀ : HasFDerivAt x₀ x₀' p)
    (hf : HasFDerivAt f f' p) (v : P) (t : Icc a b) :
    HasDerivWithinAt
      (extend hab (fderiv ℝ (fun q => solution hab (A q) (x₀ q) (f q)) p v))
      (A p t ((fderiv ℝ (fun q => solution hab (A q) (x₀ q) (f q)) p v) t) +
        A' v t (solution hab (A p) (x₀ p) (f p) t) + f' v t) (Icc a b) t

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.parameter_derivatives_bounded_on_compact
statement:
theorem parameter_derivatives_bounded_on_compact
    (A : P → Coefficient a b E) (x₀ : P → E) (f : P → Curve a b E)
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (hx₀ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ x₀) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    {s : Set P} (hs : IsCompact s) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ s,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun q => solution hab (A q) (x₀ q) (f q)) p‖ ≤ C

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.resolvent_equation
statement:
theorem resolvent_equation (A : Coefficient a b E) (g : Curve a b E) :
    equationOperator hab A (resolvent hab A g) = g

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.solutionExtension_coe
statement:
theorem solutionExtension_coe (A : Coefficient a b E) (x₀ : E)
    (f : Curve a b E) (t : Icc a b) :
    solutionExtension hab A x₀ f t = solution hab A x₀ f t

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.solutionExtension_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem solutionExtension_hasDerivAt (A : Coefficient a b E) (x₀ : E)
    (f : Curve a b E) (t : Icc a b) :
    HasDerivAt (solutionExtension hab A x₀ f)
      (A t (solutionExtension hab A x₀ f t) + f t) t

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.solution_hasDerivWithinAt
statement:
theorem solution_hasDerivWithinAt (A : Coefficient a b E) (x₀ : E)
    (f : Curve a b E) (t : Icc a b) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (extend hab (solution hab A x₀ f))
      (A t (solution hab A x₀ f t) + f t) (Icc a b) t

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.solution_initial
statement:
theorem solution_initial (A : Coefficient a b E) (x₀ : E) (f : Curve a b E) :
    solution hab A x₀ f ⟨a, le_rfl, hab⟩ = x₀

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.solution_integralEquation
statement:
theorem solution_integralEquation (A : Coefficient a b E) (x₀ : E) (f : Curve a b E) :
    solution hab A x₀ f = constantCurve x₀ +
      integrator hab (applyCoefficient A (solution hab A x₀ f) + f)

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.volterra_apply
statement:
theorem volterra_apply (A : Coefficient a b E) (u : Curve a b E) (t : Icc a b) :
    volterra (E := E) hab A u t =
      ∫ s in a..(t : ℝ), extend hab A s (extend hab u s)

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.volterra_contracting_iterate
statement:
theorem volterra_contracting_iterate (A : Coefficient a b E) :
    ∃ (N : ℕ) (K : ℝ≥0), ContractingWith K (volterra (E := E) hab A)^[N]

name: NavierStokes.ParametricODE.volterra_eq_next
statement:
theorem volterra_eq_next (A : Coefficient a b E) :
    (volterra (E := E) hab A : Curve a b E → Curve a b E) = (homogeneousSystem hab A).next

name: NavierStokes.SmoothPathFamily.contDiffOn_odeFamily_of_joint
statement:
theorem contDiffOn_odeFamily_of_joint (U : Set P) (V : Set ℝ)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) (hI : Icc a b ⊆ V)
    (A : P × ℝ → E →L[ℝ] E) (x₀ : P → E) (f : P × ℝ → E)
    (hA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ A (U ×ˢ V)) (hx₀ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ x₀ U)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (U ×ˢ V)) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (odeFamily hab A x₀ f) U

name: NavierStokes.SmoothPathFamily.contDiffOn_pathFamily_nat
statement:
theorem contDiffOn_pathFamily_nat (U : Set P) (V : Set ℝ)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) (hI : Icc a b ⊆ V) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ {W : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (F : P × ℝ → W),
      ContDiffOn ℝ n F (U ×ˢ V) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ n (pathFamily (a := a) (b := b) F) U

name: NavierStokes.SmoothPathFamily.contDiffOn_pathFamily_of_joint
statement:
theorem contDiffOn_pathFamily_of_joint (U : Set P) (V : Set ℝ)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) (hI : Icc a b ⊆ V)
    (F : P × ℝ → E) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (U ×ˢ V)) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pathFamily (a := a) (b := b) F) U

name: NavierStokes.SmoothPathFamily.continuousOn_pathFamily
NavierStokes.SmoothPathFamily.flipPath_apply
statement:
theorem flipPath_apply (g : C(Icc a b, P →L[ℝ] E)) (v : P) (t : Icc a b) :
    flipPath (P := P) (E := E) g v t = g t v

name: NavierStokes.SmoothPathFamily.hasFDerivAt_pathFamily
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_pathFamily {U : Set P} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (F : P × ℝ → E) (G : P × ℝ → P →L[ℝ] E)
    (hF : ContinuousOn F (U ×ˢ Icc a b))
    (hG : ContinuousOn G (U ×ˢ Icc a b))
    (hderiv : ∀ p ∈ U, ∀ t : Icc a b, HasFDerivAt (fun q => F (q, t)) (G (p, t)) p)
    {p : P} (hp : p ∈ U) :
    HasFDerivAt (pathFamily (a := a) (b := b) F)
      (flipPath (P := P) (E := E) (pathFamily (a := a) (b := b) G p)) p

name: NavierStokes.SmoothPathFamily.iteratedFDeriv_pathFamily_apply
statement:
theorem iteratedFDeriv_pathFamily_apply (U : Set P) (V : Set ℝ)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) (hI : Icc a b ⊆ V)
    (F : P × ℝ → E) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (U ×ˢ V))
    {p : P} (hp : p ∈ U) (k : ℕ) (v : Fin k → P) (t : Icc a b) :
    (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (pathFamily (a := a) (b := b) F) p v) t =

        ∀ x ∈ rectangle (center m D i) (2 * r),
        ∀ y ∈ rectangle (center m D j) (2 * r), ¬ torusEq ((cover ^ n) x) y) ∧
      (∀ n ≤ D, ∀ i : Fin m,
        ∀ x ∈ rectangle (center m D i) (2 * r),
        ∀ y ∈ rectangle (center m D i) (2 * r),
          torusEq ((cover ^ n) x) ((cover ^ n) y) → x = y)

        Disjoint (liftedSupport level (orientedRectangle (center m D i) a b (2 * r)))
          (liftedSupport (level + n) (orientedRectangle (center m D j) a b (2 * r)))) ∧
      (∀ n ≤ D, ∀ i : Fin m,
        ∀ x ∈ orientedRectangle (center m D i) a b (2 * r),
        ∀ y ∈ orientedRectangle (center m D i) a b (2 * r),
          torusEq ((cover ^ n) x) ((cover ^ n) y) → x = y)

    (mask : ℝ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)

    (hcone : |a * t| < b * m) :
    (signedMatrix a b scaleMinus scalePlus).mulVec
        (fun i => (Real.sqrt ε * amplitudes a b scaleMinus scalePlus m t i * mask) ^ 2) =
      (ε * mask ^ 2) • target m t

    (hG : ∀ i j, ContinuousOn (fun x => G x i j) K)
    (hT : ∀ i, ContinuousOn (fun x => T x i) K)
    (hcone : ∀ x ∈ K, SmoothCovariance.StrictCone (G x) (T x)) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ i,
      δ * edge (σ - κ i) x ≤ inverseCoefficients σ κ G T x i ∧
      δ * edge ((σ - κ i) / 2) x ≤ primaryAmplitude σ κ G T x i

    (hcone : ∀ x ∈ s, SmoothCovariance.StrictCone (G x) (T x)) (i : Fin 2) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => SmoothCovariance.weights (G x) (R x) i /
      (2 * SmoothCovariance.amplitudes (G x) (T x) i)) s

name: NavierStokes.FlatCovariance.signed_weighted_derivatives_zero

    (hT : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => T x i))
    (hR : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => R x i))
    (hcone : ∀ x, SmoothCovariance.StrictCone (G x) (T x))
    (hgap : ∀ i, (σ + κ i) / 2 < τ) (i : Fin 2) (loss n : ℕ) :

    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => primaryAmplitude σ (fun j => 2 * lam j) G T x i / x ^ loss) s ∧

    (hcont : ContinuousOn rate D)
    (hdiff : DifferentiableOn ℝ rate (interior D))
    (hderiv : ∀ x ∈ interior D,
      -C / ell ≤ deriv rate x ∧ deriv rate x ≤ -c / ell)
    (hm : midpoint ∈ D) (ht : time ∈ D) (hzero : rate midpoint = 0)

name: NavierStokes.GaussianEnvelope.gaussian_envelope_bounds
statement:
theorem gaussian_envelope_bounds {D : Set ℝ} {rate : ℝ → ℝ}
    {midpoint time c C ell : ℝ} (hD : Convex ℝ D)
    (hcont : ContinuousOn rate D)
    (hdiff : DifferentiableOn ℝ rate (interior D))
    (hderiv : ∀ x ∈ interior D,
      -C / ell ≤ deriv rate x ∧ deriv rate x ≤ -c / ell)
    (hm : midpoint ∈ D) (ht : time ∈ D) (hzero : rate midpoint = 0) :
    Real.exp (-C * (time - midpoint) ^ 2 / (2 * ell)) ≤ envelope rate midpoint time ∧
      envelope rate midpoint time ≤ Real.exp (-c * (time - midpoint) ^ 2 / (2 * ell))

name: NavierStokes.GaussianEnvelope.integral_quadratic_bounds

    (hcont : ContinuousOn rate D)
    (hdiff : DifferentiableOn ℝ rate (interior D))
    (hderiv : ∀ x ∈ interior D, lower ≤ deriv rate x ∧ deriv rate x ≤ upper)
    (hm : midpoint ∈ D) (ht : time ∈ D) (hzero : rate midpoint = 0) :
    lower * (time - midpoint) ^ 2 / 2 ≤ (∫ x in midpoint..time, rate x) ∧
      (∫ x in midpoint..time, rate x) ≤ upper * (time - midpoint) ^ 2 / 2

name: NavierStokes.GaussianEnvelope.reference_gaussian_bounds

    Real.exp (-(u * referenceMaxSlope lam u) * (time - ell / 2) ^ 2 / (2 * ell)) ≤
        envelope (referenceRate lam u ell) (ell / 2) time ∧
      envelope (referenceRate lam u ell) (ell / 2) time ≤
        Real.exp (-(u * referenceMinSlope lam u) * (time - ell / 2) ^ 2 / (2 * ell))

          envelope (referenceRate lam u ell) (ell / 2) time ∧
        envelope (referenceRate lam u ell) (ell / 2) time ≤
          Real.exp (-c * (time - ell / 2) ^ 2 / ell)

statement:
theorem compact_actual_positive_inverse
    {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K)
    {c₀ u : X → ℝ} {T : X → Vec2}
    (hmodel : ∀ i j, ContinuousOn (fun p => signedModel (c₀ p) (u p) i j) K)
    (hT : ∀ i, ContinuousOn (fun p => T p i) K)
    (hcone : ∀ p ∈ K, SmoothCovariance.StrictCone (signedModel (c₀ p) (u p)) (T p))
    {a A b B E C U : ℝ} (hE : 0 ≤ E) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hU : 0 ≤ U)
    (hc₀ : ∀ p ∈ K, |c₀ p| ≤ C) (hu : ∀ p ∈ K, |u p| ≤ U) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R ∧ ∀ p ∈ K, ∀ r : ℝ, R ≤ r →
      ∀ pulses : SignedPulsePair r a A b B (c₀ p) (u p) E,
      ∀ ci : Vec2, (∀ j, 0 < ci j) →
        (actualMatrix pulses ci).det ≠ 0 ∧
        (∀ i, 0 < SmoothCovariance.weights (actualMatrix pulses ci) (T p) i) ∧
        (∀ i, 0 < SmoothCovariance.amplitudes (actualMatrix pulses ci) (T p) i)

name: NavierStokes.PulseCovariance.compact_actual_positive_inverse_of_scalar_cone
statement:
theorem compact_actual_positive_inverse_of_scalar_cone
    {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K)
    {c₀ u m t : X → ℝ} (hc₀ : ContinuousOn c₀ K) (hu : ContinuousOn u K)
    (hm : ContinuousOn m K) (ht : ContinuousOn t K)
    (hc₀neg : ∀ p ∈ K, c₀ p < 0) (hupos : ∀ p ∈ K, 0 < u p)
    (hcone : ∀ p ∈ K, |Covariance.normalMagnitude (c₀ p) (u p) * t p| < u p * m p)
    {a A b B E : ℝ} (hE : 0 ≤ E) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R ∧ ∀ p ∈ K, ∀ r : ℝ, R ≤ r →
      ∀ pulses : SignedPulsePair r a A b B (c₀ p) (u p) E,
      ∀ ci : Vec2, (∀ j, 0 < ci j) →
        (actualMatrix pulses ci).det ≠ 0 ∧
        (∀ i, 0 < SmoothCovariance.weights (actualMatrix pulses ci) (Covariance.target (m p) (t p)) i) ∧
        (∀ i, 0 < SmoothCovariance.amplitudes (actualMatrix pulses ci) (Covariance.target (m p) (t p)) i)
