    ∃ u : Torus → ℂ, Continuous u ∧ (∫ z, u z ∂torusMeasure) = 0 ∧
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : Plane => u ((x.1 : UnitAddCircle), (x.2 : UnitAddCircle))) ∧
      ∀ x : Plane,
        fderiv ℝ (fun y : Plane => u ((y.1 : UnitAddCircle), (y.2 : UnitAddCircle)))
          x (vector d) = series a x

name: NavierStokes.SmoothFourierData.coefficient_decay_first
statement:
theorem coefficient_decay_first {f : Plane → ℂ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hp : UnitPeriodic f) {k : Frequency} (hk : k.1 ≠ 0) (p : ℕ) {C : ℝ}
    (hb : ∀ x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖xJet p f (x, y)‖ ≤ C) :
    ‖coefficient f k‖ ≤ ‖(omega * (k.1 : ℂ))⁻¹‖ ^ p * C

      ‖xJet p (swapFunction f) (x, y)‖ ≤ C) :

name: NavierStokes.SmoothFourierData.coefficient_polynomial_bound
statement:
theorem coefficient_polynomial_bound {f : Plane → ℂ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hp : UnitPeriodic f) (p : ℕ) {C : ℝ}
    (hzero : ∀ x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖f (x, y)‖ ≤ C)
    (hfirst : ∀ x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖xJet p f (x, y)‖ ≤ C)
    (hsecond : ∀ x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ‖xJet p (swapFunction f) (x, y)‖ ≤ C) (k : Frequency) :
    weight k ^ p * ‖coefficient f k‖ ≤ 3 ^ p * C

name: NavierStokes.SmoothFourierData.coefficient_seminorm_bound
statement:
theorem coefficient_seminorm_bound {f : Plane → ℂ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hp : UnitPeriodic f) (p : ℕ) {C : ℝ}
    (hzero : ∀ x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖f (x, y)‖ ≤ C)
    (hfirst : ∀ x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ‖xJet (p + 4) f (x, y)‖ ≤ C)
    (hsecond : ∀ x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ‖xJet (p + 4) (swapFunction f) (x, y)‖ ≤ C) :
    coeffSeminorm p (coefficient f) ≤
      (3 ^ (p + 4) * C) * ∑' k : Frequency, (weight k ^ 4)⁻¹

name: NavierStokes.TorusAverages.primary_covariance_average
statement:
theorem primary_covariance_average (vr vt center : Plane)
    (hdet : vr.1 * vt.2 - vr.2 * vt.1 ≠ 0) (ci r0 : ℝ) (hci : 0 < ci)
    {χ ψ x : ℝ → ℝ} {t : ℝ → PulseCovariance.Vec2}
    (hχ : Continuous χ) (hψ : Continuous ψ) (hx : Continuous x) (ht : Continuous t)
    (hcχ : HasCompactSupport χ) (hcψ : HasCompactSupport ψ) (i : Fin 2) (n : ℕ)
    (phase : Plane → ℝ) (j : ℤ) (hj : j ≠ 0) :
    let a := fun z => periodize
      (nativeField (slotChart vr vt hdet) center
        (transverseStretch ci r0 (pulseProfile χ ψ x t i)))
      (covering^[n] z)
    squareAverage (fun z => SmoothLoop.angularMean
      (fun θ => a z * Real.cos ((j : ℝ) * θ + phase z) ^ 2)) =
      (|vr.1 * vt.2 - vr.2 * vt.1| / 2) * (∫ ξ : ℝ, χ ξ ^ 2) *
        PulseCovariance.actualColumn ci ψ x t i

    {r a A b B : ℝ} {χ ψ x : ℝ → ℝ} {t : ℝ → PulseCovariance.Vec2}
    (hp : PulseCovariance.PulseBounds r a A b B ψ x)
    (hχ : Continuous χ) (ht : Continuous t) (hcχ : HasCompactSupport χ)
    (i : Fin 2) (n : ℕ) (phase : Plane → ℝ) (j : ℤ) (hj : j ≠ 0) :
    let amp := fun z => periodize
      (nativeField (slotChart vr vt hdet) center
        (transverseStretch ci r0 (pulseProfile χ ψ x t i)))
      (covering^[n] z)
    squareAverage (fun z => SmoothLoop.angularMean
      (fun θ => amp z * Real.cos ((j : ℝ) * θ + phase z) ^ 2)) =
      (|vr.1 * vt.2 - vr.2 * vt.1| / 2) * (∫ ξ : ℝ, χ ξ ^ 2) *
        (ci * ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..r ^ 2, ψ v ^ 2 * x v * t v i)

theorem exists_solution_with_envelope_bound [CompleteSpace H]
    {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (A : ℝ → H →L[ℝ] H) (f : ℝ → H)
    (rate P : ℝ → ℝ) {μ : ℝ} (hμ : 0 ≤ μ)
    (hPpos : ∀ t, 0 < P t) (hP : ∀ t, HasDerivAt P (rate t * P t) t)
    (hcA : ContinuousOn A (Icc a b)) (hcf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hA : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b, ∀ x : H,
      ⟪x, A t x⟫_ℝ ≤ (rate t + μ) * ‖x‖ ^ 2) (x₀ : H) :
    ∃ u : ℝ → H, u a = x₀ ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc a b, HasDerivAt u (A t (u t) + f t) t) ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, ‖u t‖ ≤ Real.exp (μ * (t - a)) * P t *
        (‖x₀‖ / P a + ∫ s in a..t, ‖f s‖ / P s)

name: NavierStokes.ViscousPropagator.high_harmonic_propagator_estimate
statement:
theorem high_harmonic_propagator_estimate
    {a b midpoint S dampingError matrixError : ℝ}
    (hS : 0 < S) (hdampingError : 0 ≤ dampingError) (hmatrixError : 0 ≤ matrixError)
    (lam fundamentalDamping referenceDamping rate : ℝ → ℝ)
    (E : ℝ → Plane →L[ℝ] Plane) {u f : ℝ → Plane} {j : ℤ} (hj : j ≠ 0)
    (hrate : Continuous rate)
    (hreference : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b, rate t = lam t - referenceDamping t)
    (hlam : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b, 0 ≤ lam t)
    (hD : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b, 0 ≤ fundamentalDamping t)
    (hdamping : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b,
      referenceDamping t - dampingError / S ≤ fundamentalDamping t)
    (hE : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b, ‖E t‖ ≤ matrixError / S)
    (hu : ContinuousOn u (Icc a b)) (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hode : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b, HasDerivWithinAt u
      (coefficient (lam t) ((j : ℝ) ^ 2 * fundamentalDamping t) (E t) (u t) + f t)
      (Ici t) t) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc a b,
      ‖u t‖ ≤ Real.exp (((dampingError + matrixError) / S) * (t - a)) *
        GaussianEnvelope.envelope rate midpoint t *
        (‖u a‖ / GaussianEnvelope.envelope rate midpoint a +
          ∫ s in a..t, ‖f s‖ / GaussianEnvelope.envelope rate midpoint s)

theorem homogeneous_viscous_propagator_estimate
    {a b midpoint S dampingError matrixError : ℝ}
    (hS : 0 < S) (hdampingError : 0 ≤ dampingError) (hmatrixError : 0 ≤ matrixError)
    (lam damping referenceDamping rate : ℝ → ℝ)
    (E : ℝ → Plane →L[ℝ] Plane) {u : ℝ → Plane}
    (hrate : Continuous rate)
    (hreference : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b, rate t = lam t - referenceDamping t)
    (hlam : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b, 0 ≤ lam t)
    (hdamping : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b, referenceDamping t - dampingError / S ≤ damping t)
    (hE : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b, ‖E t‖ ≤ matrixError / S)
    (hu : ContinuousOn u (Icc a b))
    (hode : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b, HasDerivWithinAt u
      (coefficient (lam t) (damping t) (E t) (u t)) (Ici t) t) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc a b,
      ‖u t‖ ≤ Real.exp (((dampingError + matrixError) / S) * |t - a|) *
        (GaussianEnvelope.envelope rate midpoint t /
          GaussianEnvelope.envelope rate midpoint a) * ‖u a‖

    (hA : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b, ∀ x : H,
      ⟪x, A t x⟫_ℝ ≤ (rate t + μ) * ‖x‖ ^ 2) :

statement:
theorem reference_pulse_propagator_estimate
    {a b S dampingError matrixError lam₀ u₀ ell : ℝ}
    (hS : 0 < S) (hdampingError : 0 ≤ dampingError) (hmatrixError : 0 ≤ matrixError)
    (hlam₀ : 0 ≤ lam₀) (damping : ℝ → ℝ)
    (E : ℝ → Plane →L[ℝ] Plane) {u f : ℝ → Plane}
    (hdamping : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b,
      referenceViscosity lam₀ u₀ ell t - dampingError / S ≤ damping t)
    (hE : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b, ‖E t‖ ≤ matrixError / S)
    (hu : ContinuousOn u (Icc a b)) (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hode : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b, HasDerivWithinAt u
      (coefficient (referenceEigenvalue lam₀ u₀ ell t) (damping t) (E t) (u t) + f t)
      (Ici t) t) :
    let P := GaussianEnvelope.envelope (GaussianEnvelope.referenceRate lam₀ u₀ ell) (ell / 2)
    ∀ t ∈ Icc a b,
      ‖u t‖ ≤ Real.exp (((dampingError + matrixError) / S) * (t - a)) * P t *
        (‖u a‖ / P a + ∫ s in a..t, ‖f s‖ / P s)

statement:
theorem viscous_propagator_estimate
    {a b midpoint S dampingError matrixError : ℝ}
    (hS : 0 < S) (hdampingError : 0 ≤ dampingError) (hmatrixError : 0 ≤ matrixError)
    (lam damping referenceDamping rate : ℝ → ℝ)
    (E : ℝ → Plane →L[ℝ] Plane) {u f : ℝ → Plane}
    (hrate : Continuous rate)
    (hreference : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b, rate t = lam t - referenceDamping t)
    (hlam : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b, 0 ≤ lam t)
    (hdamping : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b, referenceDamping t - dampingError / S ≤ damping t)
    (hE : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b, ‖E t‖ ≤ matrixError / S)
    (hu : ContinuousOn u (Icc a b)) (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hode : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b, HasDerivWithinAt u
      (coefficient (lam t) (damping t) (E t) (u t) + f t) (Ici t) t) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc a b,
      ‖u t‖ ≤ Real.exp (((dampingError + matrixError) / S) * (t - a)) *
        GaussianEnvelope.envelope rate midpoint t *
        (‖u a‖ / GaussianEnvelope.envelope rate midpoint a +
          ∫ s in a..t, ‖f s‖ / GaussianEnvelope.envelope rate midpoint s)

name: NavierStokes.ViscousPropagator.weighted_norm_le_initial_add_integral
statement:
theorem weighted_norm_le_initial_add_integral
    {a b : ℝ} {u f : ℝ → H} (A : ℝ → H →L[ℝ] H)
    (growth W : ℝ → ℝ) (hWpos : ∀ t, 0 < W t)
    (hW : ∀ t, HasDerivAt W (growth t * W t) t)
    (hu : ContinuousOn u (Icc a b)) (hf : Continuous f)
    (hode : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b,
      HasDerivWithinAt u (A t (u t) + f t) (Ici t) t)
    (hA : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b, ∀ x : H,
      ⟪x, A t x⟫_ℝ ≤ growth t * ‖x‖ ^ 2) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc a b,
      ‖u t‖ / W t ≤ ‖u a‖ / W a + ∫ s in a..t, ‖f s‖ / W s

name: NavierStokes.ViscousPropagator.zero_initial_source_bound
statement:
theorem zero_initial_source_bound
    {a b K : ℝ} {u f : ℝ → H} (A : ℝ → H →L[ℝ] H)
    (rate P : ℝ → ℝ) {μ : ℝ} (hμ : 0 ≤ μ)
    (hPpos : ∀ t, 0 < P t) (hP : ∀ t, HasDerivAt P (rate t * P t) t)
    (hu : ContinuousOn u (Icc a b)) (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hode : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b,
      HasDerivWithinAt u (A t (u t) + f t) (Ici t) t)
    (hA : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b, ∀ x : H,
      ⟪x, A t x⟫_ℝ ≤ (rate t + μ) * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (hinit : u a = 0) (hsource : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, ‖f t‖ ≤ K * P t) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc a b,
      ‖u t‖ ≤ Real.exp (μ * (t - a)) * P t * (K * (t - a))

name: NavierStokes.WeightedODEJets.amplitude_le_polynomial
statement:
theorem amplitude_le_polynomial {S K w L : ℝ} (hS : 1 ≤ S) (hK : 1 ≤ K)
    (hw : 0 ≤ w) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hLS : L ≤ K * S) (m N n : ℕ) :
    K * (w * K * S ^ m + L * (w * K * S ^ m)) *
        (1 + K * L * ((2 : ℝ) ^ N * (K * S ^ m))) ^ n ≤
      w * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (N + 1) * K ^ 3) ^ (n + 1) * S ^ ((m + 1) * (n + 1))

theorem jet_pathFamily_apply (U : Set Q) (V : Set ℝ)

statement:
theorem jet_product {U : Set P} (hU : IsOpen U)

    (hA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ A U) (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u U) (l : List P) :

name: NavierStokes.WeightedODEJets.jet_solution_eq_solution
statement:
theorem jet_solution_eq_solution (hab : a ≤ b) {U : Set P} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (A : P → Coefficient a b E) (x₀ : P → E) (f : P → Curve a b E)
    (hA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ A U) (hx₀ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ x₀ U)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U) (l : List P) {p : P} (hp : p ∈ U) :
    jet (fun q => solution hab (A q) (x₀ q) (f q)) l p =
      solution hab (A p) (jet x₀ l p)
        (jetSource A f (fun q => solution hab (A q) (x₀ q) (f q)) l p)

name: NavierStokes.WeightedODEJets.jet_solution_hasDerivWithinAt
statement:
theorem jet_solution_hasDerivWithinAt (hab : a ≤ b) {U : Set P} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (A : P → Coefficient a b E) (x₀ : P → E) (f : P → Curve a b E)
    (hA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ A U) (hx₀ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ x₀ U)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U) (l : List P) {p : P} (hp : p ∈ U) (t : Icc a b) :
    let u := fun q => solution hab (A q) (x₀ q) (f q)
    HasDerivWithinAt (extend hab (jet u l p))
      (A p t (jet u l p t) + jetSource A f u l p t) (Icc a b) t

name: NavierStokes.WeightedODEJets.norm_crossJet_le
statement:
theorem norm_crossJet_le
    (A : P → Coefficient a b E) (u : P → Curve a b E) (l : List P)

    (hA : ∀ k : List P, k.length ≤ l.length → UnitWord k → ‖jet A k p t‖ ≤ M)
    (hu : ∀ k : List P, k.length < l.length → UnitWord k → ‖jet u k p t‖ ≤ B)

    ‖crossJet A u l p t‖ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ l.length * M * B

name: NavierStokes.WeightedODEJets.norm_iteratedFDeriv_odeFamily_le_polynomial
statement:
theorem norm_iteratedFDeriv_odeFamily_le_polynomial (hab : a ≤ b)
    (U : Set Q) (V : Set ℝ) (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) (hI : Icc a b ⊆ V)
    (A : Q × ℝ → H →L[ℝ] H) (x₀ : Q → H) (f : Q × ℝ → H)
    (hA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ A (U ×ˢ V)) (hx₀ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ x₀ U)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (U ×ˢ V)) {p : Q} (hp : p ∈ U)
    (rate W : ℝ → ℝ) {μ S K w : ℝ} (hμ : 0 ≤ μ)
    (hW : ∀ t, 0 < W t) (hdW : ∀ t, HasDerivAt W (rate t * W t) t)
    (henergy : ∀ t : Icc a b, ∀ x : H, ⟪x, A (p, t) x⟫_ℝ ≤ (rate t + μ) * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (hC : Real.exp (μ * (b - a)) ≤ K) (hS : 1 ≤ S) (hK : 1 ≤ K) (hw : 0 ≤ w)
    (hslot : b - a ≤ K * S) (m N : ℕ)
    (hAj : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ N → ∀ t : Icc a b,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun q => A (q, t)) p‖ ≤ K * S ^ m)
    (hxj : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ N → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j x₀ p‖ ≤ w * K * S ^ m * W a)
    (hfj : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ N → ∀ t : Icc a b,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun q => f (q, t)) p‖ ≤ w * K * S ^ m * W t)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ N) (t : Icc a b) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun q => odeFamily hab A x₀ f q t) p‖ ≤
      w * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (N + 1) * K ^ 3) ^ (n + 1) * S ^ ((m + 1) * (n + 1)) * W t

name: NavierStokes.WeightedODEJets.norm_jet_solution_le
statement:
theorem norm_jet_solution_le (hab : a ≤ b) {U : Set P} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (A : P → Coefficient a b H) (x₀ : P → H) (f : P → Curve a b H)
    (hA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ A U) (hx₀ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ x₀ U)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U) {p : P} (hp : p ∈ U)
    (rate W : ℝ → ℝ) {μ C M X F₀ : ℝ} (hμ : 0 ≤ μ)
    (hW : ∀ t, 0 < W t) (hdW : ∀ t, HasDerivAt W (rate t * W t) t)
    (henergy : ∀ t : Icc a b, ∀ x : H, ⟪x, A p t x⟫_ℝ ≤ (rate t + μ) * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (hC : Real.exp (μ * (b - a)) ≤ C) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hX : 0 ≤ X) (hF : 0 ≤ F₀)
    (N : ℕ)
    (hAj : ∀ l : List P, l.length ≤ N → UnitWord l → ∀ t : Icc a b, ‖jet A l p t‖ ≤ M)
    (hxj : ∀ l : List P, l.length ≤ N → UnitWord l → ‖jet x₀ l p‖ ≤ X * W a)
    (hfj : ∀ l : List P, l.length ≤ N → UnitWord l → ∀ t : Icc a b,
      ‖jet f l p t‖ ≤ F₀ * W t)
    (l : List P) (hlN : l.length ≤ N) (hl : UnitWord l) (t : Icc a b) :
    ‖jet (fun q => solution hab (A q) (x₀ q) (f q)) l p t‖ ≤
      C * (X + (b - a) * F₀) * (1 + C * (b - a) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ N * M)) ^ l.length * W t

name: NavierStokes.WeightedODEJets.norm_jet_solution_le_polynomial
statement:
theorem norm_jet_solution_le_polynomial (hab : a ≤ b) {U : Set P} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (A : P → Coefficient a b H) (x₀ : P → H) (f : P → Curve a b H)
    (hA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ A U) (hx₀ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ x₀ U)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U) {p : P} (hp : p ∈ U)
    (rate W : ℝ → ℝ) {μ S K w : ℝ} (hμ : 0 ≤ μ)
    (hW : ∀ t, 0 < W t) (hdW : ∀ t, HasDerivAt W (rate t * W t) t)
    (henergy : ∀ t : Icc a b, ∀ x : H, ⟪x, A p t x⟫_ℝ ≤ (rate t + μ) * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (hC : Real.exp (μ * (b - a)) ≤ K) (hS : 1 ≤ S) (hK : 1 ≤ K) (hw : 0 ≤ w)
    (hslot : b - a ≤ K * S) (m N : ℕ)
    (hAj : ∀ l : List P, l.length ≤ N → UnitWord l → ∀ t : Icc a b,
      ‖jet A l p t‖ ≤ K * S ^ m)
    (hxj : ∀ l : List P, l.length ≤ N → UnitWord l → ‖jet x₀ l p‖ ≤ w * K * S ^ m * W a)
    (hfj : ∀ l : List P, l.length ≤ N → UnitWord l → ∀ t : Icc a b,
      ‖jet f l p t‖ ≤ w * K * S ^ m * W t)
    (l : List P) (hlN : l.length ≤ N) (hl : UnitWord l) (t : Icc a b) :
    ‖jet (fun q => solution hab (A q) (x₀ q) (f q)) l p t‖ ≤
      w * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (N + 1) * K ^ 3) ^ (l.length + 1) *
        S ^ ((m + 1) * (l.length + 1)) * W t

name: NavierStokes.WeightedODEJets.norm_productJet_le
statement:
theorem norm_productJet_le
    (A : P → Coefficient a b E) (u : P → Curve a b E) (l : List P)
    (p : P) (t : Icc a b) {M B : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M) (_hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hA : ∀ k : List P, k.length ≤ l.length → UnitWord k → ‖jet A k p t‖ ≤ M)

name: NavierStokes.WeightedODEJets.norm_solution_le_envelope
statement:
theorem norm_solution_le_envelope (hab : a ≤ b)
    (A : Coefficient a b H) (x₀ : H) (f : Curve a b H)
    (rate W : ℝ → ℝ) {μ C X F₀ : ℝ} (hμ : 0 ≤ μ)
    (hW : ∀ t, 0 < W t) (hdW : ∀ t, HasDerivAt W (rate t * W t) t)
    (henergy : ∀ t : Icc a b, ∀ x : H, ⟪x, A t x⟫_ℝ ≤ (rate t + μ) * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (hC : Real.exp (μ * (b - a)) ≤ C) (hX : 0 ≤ X) (hF : 0 ≤ F₀)

name: NavierStokes.CommonCoverSolve.LinearData.anchoredSolve_jets_le_polynomial
statement:
theorem LinearData.anchoredSolve_jets_le_polynomial
    {P V E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup P] [NormedSpace ℝ P]
    [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    {a b : ℝ} (d : LinearData P V E) (g : Geometry) (hab : a ≤ b)
    {U : Set P} (hU : IsOpen U) (k : Frequency)
    (hA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ d.coefficient (U ×ˢ univ))
    (hB : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ d.forcingMap (U ×ˢ univ))
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ d.source (U ×ˢ univ))
    {p : P × Plane} (hp : p.1 ∈ U)
    (rate W : ℝ → ℝ) {μ S K w : ℝ} (hμ : 0 ≤ μ)
    (hW : ∀ t, 0 < W t) (hdW : ∀ t, HasDerivAt W (rate t * W t) t)
    (henergy : ∀ t : Icc a b, ∀ x : E,
      ⟪x, d.coefficientAlong g k (p, t) x⟫_ℝ ≤ (rate t + μ) * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (hC : Real.exp (μ * (b - a)) ≤ K) (hS : 1 ≤ S) (hK : 1 ≤ K) (hw : 0 ≤ w)
    (hslot : b - a ≤ K * S) (m N : ℕ)
    (hAj : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ N → ∀ t : Icc a b,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun q => d.coefficientAlong g k (q, t)) p‖ ≤ K * S ^ m)
    (hfj : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ N → ∀ t : Icc a b,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun q => d.forcingAlong g k (q, t)) p‖ ≤ w * K * S ^ m * W t)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ N) (t : Icc a b) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun q => d.anchoredSolve g hab k q t) p‖ ≤
      w * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (N + 1) * K ^ 3) ^ (n + 1) * S ^ ((m + 1) * (n + 1)) * W t

name: NavierStokes.CommonCoverSolve.TangentData.anchoredSolve_projected_equation
statement:
theorem anchoredSolve_projected_equation {U : Set P} (k : Frequency)
    (hA : ContinuousOn t.linearData.coefficient (U ×ˢ univ))
    (hB : ContinuousOn t.linearData.forcingMap (U ×ˢ univ))
    (hf : ContinuousOn t.source (U ×ˢ univ)) {p : P} (hp : p ∈ U)
    (Y : Plane) (s : Icc a b) :
    let z := (p, ((g.coordinates k Y).1, (s : ℝ)))
    HasDerivAt (t.linearData.anchoredSolve g hab k (p, Y))
      (TangentProjection.projectedRhs (t.normal z) (t.normalDot z)
        (t.linearData.anchoredSolve g hab k (p, Y) s)
        (t.action z (t.linearData.anchoredSolve g hab k (p, Y) s))
        (t.source (p, g.path k Y s)) (t.damping z)) s

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.axial_chain_coefficient
statement:
theorem axial_chain_coefficient {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (b h η X F FX Fη : ℝ) :
    b * q ^ (b - 1) * qAxial q h η * F +
        q ^ b * (FX * xAxial q h η X + Fη * etaAxial q h η) =
      q ^ (b - D h) * axialCoeff b h η X F FX Fη

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.axial_rates
statement:
theorem axial_rates (q h η : ℝ) :

      inverseEta q h η 0 1 = etaAxial q h η

statement:
theorem forward_coordinate_identity {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (h η : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.incompressibility_coefficient
statement:
theorem incompressibility_coefficient
    (h η X U UX Uη Ubar UbarX Ubarη UbarηX : ℝ)
    (hU : Ubar + X * UbarX = U) (hUη : Ubarη + X * UbarηX = Uη) :
    (2 * η * U - 2 * D h * η * Ubar - d η * Ubarη +
        X * (2 * η * UX - 2 * D h * η * UbarX - d η * UbarηX)) / L h η =
      -axialCoeff (-A h) h η X U UX Uη

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.incompressibility_numerator
statement:
theorem incompressibility_numerator
    (h η X U UX Uη Ubar UbarX Ubarη UbarηX : ℝ)
    (hU : Ubar + X * UbarX = U) (hUη : Ubarη + X * UbarηX = Uη) :
    2 * η * U - 2 * D h * η * Ubar - d η * Ubarη +
        X * (2 * η * UX - 2 * D h * η * UbarX - d η * UbarηX) =
      2 * A h * η * U - d η * Uη + 2 * η * X * UX

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.inverseEta_recover
statement:
theorem inverseEta_recover {q h η : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hL : L h η ≠ 0)
    (q' η' : ℝ) :
    inverseEta q h η (d η * q' - 2 * q * η * η')
      (D h * η * (q ^ D h / q) * q' + q ^ D h * η') = η'

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.inverseQ_recover
statement:
theorem inverseQ_recover {q h η : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hL : L h η ≠ 0)
    (q' η' : ℝ) :
    inverseQ q h η (d η * q' - 2 * q * η * η')
      (D h * η * (q ^ D h / q) * q' + q ^ D h * η') = q'

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.inverse_satisfies_tau
statement:
theorem inverse_satisfies_tau {q h η : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hL : L h η ≠ 0) (τ' z' : ℝ) :
    d η * inverseQ q h η τ' z' -
        2 * q * η * inverseEta q h η τ' z' = τ'

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.inverse_satisfies_z
statement:
theorem inverse_satisfies_z {q h η : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hL : L h η ≠ 0) (τ' z' : ℝ) :
    D h * η * (q ^ D h / q) * inverseQ q h η τ' z' +
        q ^ D h * inverseEta q h η τ' z' = z'

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.jacobian_det
statement:
theorem jacobian_det {q : ℝ} (hq : q ≠ 0) (h η : ℝ) :
    d η * q ^ D h - (-2 * q * η) * (D h * η * (q ^ D h / q)) =
      q ^ D h * L h η

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.jacobian_det_pos
statement:
theorem jacobian_det_pos {q h η : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hh₀ : 0 ≤ h) (hh : h < 1 / 2) (hη : η ^ 2 ≤ 1) :
    0 < d η * q ^ D h - (-2 * q * η) * (D h * η * (q ^ D h / q))

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.qAxial_rpow
statement:
theorem qAxial_rpow {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (h η : ℝ) :
    qAxial q h η = 2 * η * q ^ (1 - D h) / L h η

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.rates_unique
statement:
theorem rates_unique {q h η q' η' τ' z' : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hL : L h η ≠ 0) (hτ : d η * q' - 2 * q * η * η' = τ')
    (hz : D h * η * (q ^ D h / q) * q' + q ^ D h * η' = z') :
    q' = inverseQ q h η τ' z' ∧ η' = inverseEta q h η τ' z'

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.time_chain_coefficient
statement:
theorem time_chain_coefficient {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (b h η X F FX Fη : ℝ) :
    b * q ^ (b - 1) * qTime h η * F +
        q ^ b * (FX * xTime q h η X + Fη * etaTime q h η) =
      q ^ (b - 1) * timeCoeff b h η X F FX Fη

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.time_rates
statement:
theorem time_rates (q h η : ℝ) :
    inverseQ q h η (-1) 0 = qTime h η ∧
      inverseEta q h η (-1) 0 = etaTime q h η

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.xAxial_from_qAxial
statement:
theorem xAxial_from_qAxial {q : ℝ} (hq : q ≠ 0) (h η X : ℝ) :
    xAxial q h η X = -(X / q) * qAxial q h η

name: NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.xTime_from_qTime
statement:
theorem xTime_from_qTime (q h η X : ℝ) :
    xTime q h η X = -(X / q) * qTime h η

statement:

statement:
theorem radialOp_expanded (d : ℝ) (vr : Plane) (F : Lift → ℝ) (p : Lift) :

      radialSpeed d p.1.1 *
        (vr.1 * fderiv ℝ F p ((0, 0), (1, 0)) +

        vt.2 * fderiv ℝ F p ((0, 0), (0, 1)))

name: NavierStokes.JetBounds.AllJetBound.mul_rpow
statement:
theorem AllJetBound.mul_rpow {f g : D → ℝ} {s : Set D}
    {A B : ℕ → ℝ} {ε α β : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hs : IsOpen s)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f s) (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g s)
    (hA : AllJetBound f s (fun n => A n * ε ^ α))
    (hB : AllJetBound g s (fun n => B n * ε ^ β)) :
    AllJetBound (fun x => f x * g x) s
      (fun n => leibnizProfile A B n * ε ^ (α + β))

name: NavierStokes.JetBounds.FiniteJetBound.add
statement:
theorem FiniteJetBound.add {m : ℕ} {f g : D → E} {s : Set D} {A B : ℝ}
    (hs : IsOpen s) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ m f s) (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ m g s)
    (hA : FiniteJetBound m f s A) (hB : FiniteJetBound m g s B) :
    FiniteJetBound m (fun x => f x + g x) s (A + B)

name: NavierStokes.JetBounds.FiniteJetBound.bilinear
statement:
theorem FiniteJetBound.bilinear {m : ℕ} (B : E →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] G)
    {f : D → E} {g : D → F} {s : Set D} {A C : ℝ}
    (hs : IsOpen s) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ m f s) (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ m g s)
    (hA : FiniteJetBound m f s A) (hC : FiniteJetBound m g s C) :
    FiniteJetBound m (fun x => B (f x) (g x)) s (‖B‖ * (2 : ℝ) ^ m * A * C)

name: NavierStokes.JetBounds.FiniteJetBound.bilinear_perturbation
statement:
theorem FiniteJetBound.bilinear_perturbation {m : ℕ} (L : E →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] G)
    {f u : D → E} {g v : D → F} {s : Set D} {A U B V : ℝ}
    (hs : IsOpen s) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ m f s) (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ m u s)
    (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ m g s) (hv : ContDiffOn ℝ m v s)
    (hA : FiniteJetBound m f s A) (hU : FiniteJetBound m u s U)
    (hB : FiniteJetBound m g s B) (hV : FiniteJetBound m v s V) :
    FiniteJetBound m
      (fun x => L (f x + u x) (g x + v x) - L (f x) (g x)) s
      (‖L‖ * (2 : ℝ) ^ m * (A * V + U * B + U * V))

name: NavierStokes.JetBounds.FiniteJetBound.clm_apply
statement:
theorem FiniteJetBound.clm_apply {m : ℕ} {f : D → E →L[ℝ] F} {g : D → E}
    {s : Set D} {A B : ℝ} (hs : IsOpen s)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ m f s) (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ m g s)
    (hA : FiniteJetBound m f s A) (hB : FiniteJetBound m g s B) :
    FiniteJetBound m (fun x => (f x) (g x)) s ((2 : ℝ) ^ m * A * B)

NavierStokes.JetBounds.FiniteJetBound.mono
statement:
theorem FiniteJetBound.mono {m : ℕ} {f : D → E} {s : Set D} {A B : ℝ}

name: NavierStokes.JetBounds.FiniteJetBound.mul
statement:
theorem FiniteJetBound.mul {m : ℕ} {f g : D → ℝ} {s : Set D} {A B : ℝ}
    (hs : IsOpen s) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ m f s) (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ m g s)

name: NavierStokes.JetBounds.FiniteJetBound.mul_rpow
statement:
theorem FiniteJetBound.mul_rpow {m : ℕ} {f g : D → ℝ} {s : Set D}
    {A B ε α β : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hs : IsOpen s)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ m f s) (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ m g s)
    (hA : FiniteJetBound m f s (A * ε ^ α))
    (hB : FiniteJetBound m g s (B * ε ^ β)) :
    FiniteJetBound m (fun x => f x * g x) s
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ m * A * B * ε ^ (α + β))

name: NavierStokes.JetBounds.FiniteJetBound.nonneg
statement:
theorem FiniteJetBound.nonneg {m : ℕ} {f : D → E} {s : Set D} {C : ℝ}

name: NavierStokes.JetBounds.FiniteJetBound.norm_le

name: NavierStokes.JetBounds.FiniteJetBound.secondFDeriv
NavierStokes.JetBounds.FiniteJetBound.transport
statement:
theorem FiniteJetBound.transport {m : ℕ} {f : D → D} {g : D → E}
    {s : Set D} {A B : ℝ} (hs : IsOpen s)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ m f s) (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ (m + 1) g s)
    (hA : FiniteJetBound m f s A) (hB : FiniteJetBound (m + 1) g s B) :
    FiniteJetBound m (fun x => _root_.fderiv ℝ g x (f x)) s ((2 : ℝ) ^ m * B * A)

name: NavierStokes.JetBounds.leibnizProfile_scale
statement:
theorem leibnizProfile_scale (A B : ℕ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    leibnizProfile (fun i => A i * a) (fun i => B i * b) n =
      leibnizProfile A B n * (a * b)

name: NavierStokes.JetBounds.norm_iteratedFDeriv_bilinear_le_on
statement:
theorem norm_iteratedFDeriv_bilinear_le_on (B : E →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] G)
    {f : D → E} {g : D → F} {s : Set D} {N : WithTop ℕ∞}
    (hs : IsOpen s) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ N f s) (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ N g s)
    {x : D} (hx : x ∈ s) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≤ N) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => B (f y) (g y)) x‖ ≤
      ‖B‖ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) *
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f x‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n - i) g x‖

name: NavierStokes.JetBounds.norm_iteratedFDeriv_mul_le_on
statement:
theorem norm_iteratedFDeriv_mul_le_on {f g : D → ℝ} {s : Set D}
    {N : WithTop ℕ∞} (hs : IsOpen s) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ N f s)
    (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ N g s) {x : D} (hx : x ∈ s) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≤ N) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => f y * g y) x‖ ≤
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) *
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f x‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n - i) g x‖

name: NavierStokes.PhaseCalculus.backwardMaterialOp_phase
statement:
theorem backwardMaterialOp_phase (ε p pz x0 : ℝ) (b F G : Slow → ℝ) (q : Slot)
    (hε : ε ≠ 0) (hR : 0 < q.1.1)
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F q.1) (hG : DifferentiableAt ℝ G q.1) :
    backwardMaterialOp ε b F G (phase ε p pz x0 F G) q =
      b q.1 * x0 - q.2.2 *
        (b q.1 * (p * slowR F q.1 + pz * slowR G q.1) -
          ε * (p * slowT F q.1 + pz * slowT G q.1) +
          ε * G q.1 * (p * slowZ F q.1 + pz * slowZ G q.1))

name: NavierStokes.PhaseCalculus.contDiffAt_phaseNormal
statement:
theorem contDiffAt_phaseNormal (ε p pz x0 : ℝ) (F G : Slow → ℝ) (q : Slot)
    (hR : q.1.1 ≠ 0) (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (phaseNormal ε p pz x0 F G) q

name: NavierStokes.PhaseCalculus.contDiff_harmonic
statement:
theorem contDiff_harmonic {n : WithTop ℕ∞} (k : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (ε p pz x0 : ℝ)
    (F G : Slow → ℝ) (hF : ContDiff ℝ n F) (hG : ContDiff ℝ n G) :
    ContDiff ℝ n (harmonic k j ε p pz x0 F G)

name: NavierStokes.PhaseCalculus.contDiff_phase
statement:
theorem contDiff_phase {n : WithTop ℕ∞} (ε p pz x0 : ℝ) (F G : Slow → ℝ)
    (hF : ContDiff ℝ n F) (hG : ContDiff ℝ n G) :
    ContDiff ℝ n (phase ε p pz x0 F G)

name: NavierStokes.PhaseCalculus.fderiv_phase_apply
statement:
theorem fderiv_phase_apply (ε p pz x0 : ℝ) (F G : Slow → ℝ) (q w : Slot)
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F q.1) (hG : DifferentiableAt ℝ G q.1) :
    fderiv ℝ (phase ε p pz x0 F G) q w =
      p * w.2.1 + (pz / ε) * w.1.2.1 + x0 * w.1.1 -
        (w.2.2 * (p * F q.1 + pz * G q.1) +
          q.2.2 * (p * fderiv ℝ F q.1 w.1 + pz * fderiv ℝ G q.1 w.1))

name: NavierStokes.PhaseCalculus.harmonic_angularShift_two_pi
statement:
theorem harmonic_angularShift_two_pi (k : ℝ) (j m : ℤ) (ε p pz x0 : ℝ)
    (F G : Slow → ℝ) (q : Slot) (hkp : k * p = (m : ℝ)) :
    harmonic k j ε p pz x0 F G (angularShift (2 * Real.pi) q) =
      harmonic k j ε p pz x0 F G q

name: NavierStokes.PhaseCalculus.harmonic_theta_periodic
statement:
theorem harmonic_theta_periodic (k : ℝ) (j m : ℤ) (ε p pz x0 : ℝ)
    (F G : Slow → ℝ) (s : Slow) (v : ℝ) (hkp : k * p = (m : ℝ)) :
    Function.Periodic (fun θ => harmonic k j ε p pz x0 F G (s, (θ, v))) (2 * Real.pi)

name: NavierStokes.PhaseCalculus.hasDerivAt_phaseNormal_slot
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_phaseNormal_slot (ε p pz x0 θ v : ℝ) (F G : Slow → ℝ) (s : Slow)
    (hε : ε ≠ 0) (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F s) (hG : DifferentiableAt ℝ G s) :
    HasDerivAt (fun w => phaseNormal ε p pz x0 F G (s, (θ, w)))
      (normalSlotDerivative ε p pz F G s) v

name: NavierStokes.PhaseCalculus.phaseNormal_formula
statement:
theorem phaseNormal_formula (ε p pz x0 : ℝ) (F G : Slow → ℝ) (q : Slot)
    (hε : ε ≠ 0) (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F q.1) (hG : DifferentiableAt ℝ G q.1) :
    phaseNormal ε p pz x0 F G q =
      !₂[x0 - q.2.2 * (p * slowR F q.1 + pz * slowR G q.1),
        p / q.1.1,
        pz - ε * q.2.2 * (p * slowZ F q.1 + pz * slowZ G q.1)]

name: NavierStokes.PhaseCalculus.phaseNormal_ne_zero_of_close
statement:
theorem phaseNormal_ne_zero_of_close (ε p pz x0 B s Kθ Kz : ℝ)
    (F G : Slow → ℝ) (q : Slot) (hB : 0 < B) (hK : Kθ ^ 2 + Kz ^ 2 = 1)
    (hclose : ‖phaseNormal ε p pz x0 F G q - referenceNormal B s Kθ Kz‖ ≤ B / 2) :
    phaseNormal ε p pz x0 F G q ≠ 0

name: NavierStokes.PhaseCalculus.phaseNormal_norm_lower
statement:
theorem phaseNormal_norm_lower (ε p pz x0 B s Kθ Kz δ : ℝ)
    (F G : Slow → ℝ) (q : Slot) (hK : Kθ ^ 2 + Kz ^ 2 = 1)
    (hclose : ‖phaseNormal ε p pz x0 F G q - referenceNormal B s Kθ Kz‖ ≤ δ) :
    B - δ ≤ ‖phaseNormal ε p pz x0 F G q‖

name: NavierStokes.PhaseCalculus.phase_angularShift
statement:
theorem phase_angularShift (ε p pz x0 h : ℝ) (F G : Slow → ℝ) (q : Slot) :
    phase ε p pz x0 F G (angularShift h q) = phase ε p pz x0 F G q + p * h

name: NavierStokes.PhaseCalculus.phase_dR
statement:
theorem phase_dR (ε p pz x0 : ℝ) (F G : Slow → ℝ) (q : Slot)
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F q.1) (hG : DifferentiableAt ℝ G q.1) :
    fderiv ℝ (phase ε p pz x0 F G) q eR =
      x0 - q.2.2 * (p * slowR F q.1 + pz * slowR G q.1)

name: NavierStokes.PhaseCalculus.phase_dT
statement:
theorem phase_dT (ε p pz x0 : ℝ) (F G : Slow → ℝ) (q : Slot)
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F q.1) (hG : DifferentiableAt ℝ G q.1) :
    fderiv ℝ (phase ε p pz x0 F G) q eT =
      -q.2.2 * (p * slowT F q.1 + pz * slowT G q.1)

name: NavierStokes.PhaseCalculus.phase_dTheta
statement:
theorem phase_dTheta (ε p pz x0 : ℝ) (F G : Slow → ℝ) (q : Slot)
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F q.1) (hG : DifferentiableAt ℝ G q.1) :
    fderiv ℝ (phase ε p pz x0 F G) q eTheta = p

name: NavierStokes.PhaseCalculus.phase_dV
statement:
theorem phase_dV (ε p pz x0 : ℝ) (F G : Slow → ℝ) (q : Slot)
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F q.1) (hG : DifferentiableAt ℝ G q.1) :
    fderiv ℝ (phase ε p pz x0 F G) q eV = -(p * F q.1 + pz * G q.1)

name: NavierStokes.PhaseCalculus.phase_dZ
statement:
theorem phase_dZ (ε p pz x0 : ℝ) (F G : Slow → ℝ) (q : Slot)
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F q.1) (hG : DifferentiableAt ℝ G q.1) :
    fderiv ℝ (phase ε p pz x0 F G) q eZ =
      pz / ε - q.2.2 * (p * slowZ F q.1 + pz * slowZ G q.1)

name: NavierStokes.PhaseCalculus.referenceNormal_norm_ge
statement:
theorem referenceNormal_norm_ge (B s Kθ Kz : ℝ)
    (hK : Kθ ^ 2 + Kz ^ 2 = 1) :
    B ≤ ‖referenceNormal B s Kθ Kz‖

name: NavierStokes.PhaseCalculus.signedMaterialOp_phase
statement:
theorem signedMaterialOp_phase (σ ε p pz x0 : ℝ) (b F G : Slow → ℝ) (q : Slot)
    (hε : ε ≠ 0) (hR : 0 < q.1.1)
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F q.1) (hG : DifferentiableAt ℝ G q.1) :
    signedMaterialOp σ ε b F G (phase ε p pz x0 F G) q =
      b q.1 * x0 - q.2.2 *
        (b q.1 * (p * slowR F q.1 + pz * slowR G q.1) +
          σ * ε * (p * slowT F q.1 + pz * slowT G q.1) +
          ε * G q.1 * (p * slowZ F q.1 + pz * slowZ G q.1))

name: NavierStokes.PhaseCalculus.vec3_norm_sq
statement:
theorem vec3_norm_sq (w : Vec3) :
    ‖w‖ ^ 2 = (w 0) ^ 2 + (w 1) ^ 2 + (w 2) ^ 2

NavierStokes.FlatKernelBounds.PolynomialBound.mul

statement:
theorem iteratedDeriv_kernel {b : ℝ → ℝ} (hb : ContDiff ℝ ∞ b)

      ∀ y : ℝ, |y| ≤ R → |iteratedDeriv k b y| ≤ C) :

      |iteratedDeriv n (fun y => kernel c j b y t) x| ≤

theorem kernel_iteratedDeriv_contDiff_x {b : ℝ → ℝ} (hb : ContDiff ℝ ∞ b)

name: NavierStokes.FlatKernelBounds.kernel_iteratedDeriv_continuousOn_t
statement:
theorem kernel_iteratedDeriv_continuousOn_t {b : ℝ → ℝ} (hb : ContDiff ℝ ∞ b)
    (c : ℝ) (j n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    ContinuousOn (fun t => iteratedDeriv n (fun y => kernel c j b y t) x) (Ici 0)

name: NavierStokes.FlatKernelBounds.one_le_denominator
statement: theorem one_le_denominator {x t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) : 1 ≤ denominator x t

name: NavierStokes.FlatKernelBounds.unweighted_iteratedDeriv_bound
statement:
theorem unweighted_iteratedDeriv_bound {b : ℝ → ℝ} (hb : ContDiff ℝ ∞ b)
    (j n : ℕ) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∃ N : ℕ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ x t : ℝ, |x| ≤ R → 0 ≤ t →
      |iteratedDeriv n (fun y => (denominator y t ^ j / denominator y t ^ 3) *
        b (coordinate y t)) x| ≤ C * (1 + t) ^ N

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitive.edge_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem edge_hasDerivAt {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (edge c) (2 * c * edge c x / x ^ 3) x

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitive.integral_derivativePolynomial

theorem integral_derivativePolynomial {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (p : ℝ[X]) (x : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitive.integrand_contDiff

theorem integrand_contDiff {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (j : ℕ)

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitive.integrand_continuous
statement:
theorem integrand_continuous {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (j : ℕ)
    {b : ℝ → ℝ} (hb : Continuous b) : Continuous (integrand c j b)

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitive.iteratedDeriv_zero_on_nonpos
statement:
theorem iteratedDeriv_zero_on_nonpos {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hzero : ∀ x : ℝ, x ≤ 0 → f x = 0) (m : ℕ) :
    ∀ x : ℝ, x ≤ 0 → iteratedDeriv m f x = 0

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitive.normalizedPrimitive_continuousWithinAt_zero
statement:
theorem normalizedPrimitive_continuousWithinAt_zero {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (j : ℕ)

    ContinuousWithinAt (normalizedPrimitive c j b) (Ici 0) 0

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitive.normalizedPrimitive_factorization
statement:
theorem normalizedPrimitive_factorization (c : ℝ) (j : ℕ) (b : ℝ → ℝ)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    primitive c j b x = scale c j x * normalizedPrimitive c j b x

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitive.primitive_contDiff
statement:
theorem primitive_contDiff {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (j : ℕ)

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitive.primitive_deriv
statement:
theorem primitive_deriv {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (j : ℕ)
    {b : ℝ → ℝ} (hb : Continuous b) :
    deriv (primitive c j b) = integrand c j b

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitive.primitive_div_pow_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem primitive_div_pow_tendsto_zero {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (j : ℕ)
    {b : ℝ → ℝ} (hb : Continuous b) (loss : ℕ) :

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitive.primitive_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem primitive_hasDerivAt {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (j : ℕ)
    {b : ℝ → ℝ} (hb : Continuous b) (x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (primitive c j b) (integrand c j b x) x

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitive.primitive_iteratedDeriv_zero
statement:
theorem primitive_iteratedDeriv_zero {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (j : ℕ)
    {b : ℝ → ℝ} (hb : ContDiff ℝ ∞ b) (m : ℕ) :
    iteratedDeriv m (primitive c j b) 0 = 0

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitive.primitive_normalized_eventually_pos
statement:
theorem primitive_normalized_eventually_pos {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (j : ℕ)
    {b : ℝ → ℝ} (hb : Continuous b) (hb0 : 0 < b 0) :
    ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝[>] 0, 0 < primitive c j b x / scale c j x

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitive.primitive_normalized_tendsto
statement:
theorem primitive_normalized_tendsto {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (j : ℕ)
    {b : ℝ → ℝ} (hb : Continuous b) :
    Tendsto (fun x => primitive c j b x / scale c j x) (𝓝[>] 0)
      (𝓝 (b 0 / (2 * c)))

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitive.primitive_of_nonpos
statement:
theorem primitive_of_nonpos (c : ℝ) (j : ℕ) (b : ℝ → ℝ)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≤ 0) : primitive c j b x = 0

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitive.primitive_recurrence
statement:
theorem primitive_recurrence {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (j : ℕ)
    {b : ℝ → ℝ} (hb : ContDiff ℝ ∞ b) (x : ℝ) :
    (2 * c) * primitive c j b x =
      scale c j x * b x - primitive c j (sourceCoefficient 0 j b) x

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitive.primitive_sourceCoefficient
statement:
theorem primitive_sourceCoefficient {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (j : ℕ)
    {a : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ a) (x : ℝ) :
    primitive c j (sourceCoefficient c j a) x = scale c j x * a x

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitive.primitive_three_one
statement:
theorem primitive_three_one {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (x : ℝ) :
    primitive c 3 (fun _ => 1) x = edge c x / (2 * c)

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitive.primitive_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem primitive_zero (c : ℝ) (j : ℕ) (b : ℝ → ℝ) :
    primitive c j b 0 = 0

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitive.scale_contDiff
statement:
theorem scale_contDiff {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (j : ℕ) {n : ℕ∞} :
    ContDiff ℝ n (scale c j)

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitive.scale_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem scale_hasDerivAt {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (j : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (scale c j)
      ((edge c x / x ^ j) * (2 * c + (3 - (j : ℝ)) * x ^ 2)) x

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitive.scale_pos
statement: theorem scale_pos (c : ℝ) (j : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) : 0 < scale c j x

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitive.scale_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem scale_zero (c : ℝ) (j : ℕ) : scale c j 0 = 0

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitive.sourceCoefficient_contDiff
statement:
theorem sourceCoefficient_contDiff (c : ℝ) (j : ℕ) {a : ℝ → ℝ}

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitiveFactor.const_polynomial_exp_integrable

theorem const_polynomial_exp_integrable {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (C : ℝ) (N : ℕ) :

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitiveFactor.coordinate_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem coordinate_hasDerivAt (x : ℝ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitiveFactor.coordinate_image
statement: theorem coordinate_image {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) : coordinate x '' Ioi 0 = Ioo 0 x

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitiveFactor.coordinate_injOn
statement: theorem coordinate_injOn {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) : InjOn (coordinate x) (Ioi 0)

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitiveFactor.coordinate_mem_Ioo
statement:
theorem coordinate_mem_Ioo {x t : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (ht : 0 < t) :
    coordinate x t ∈ Ioo 0 x

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitiveFactor.coordinate_pos
statement: theorem coordinate_pos {x t : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (ht : 0 ≤ t) : 0 < coordinate x t

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitiveFactor.denominator_inner_pos
statement: theorem denominator_inner_pos (x : ℝ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) : 0 < 1 + x ^ 2 * t

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitiveFactor.denominator_pos
statement: theorem denominator_pos (x : ℝ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) : 0 < denominator x t

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitiveFactor.denominator_ratio_eq_rpow
statement:
theorem denominator_ratio_eq_rpow (j : ℕ) (x : ℝ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    denominator x t ^ j / denominator x t ^ 3 =
      (1 + x ^ 2 * t) ^ (((j : ℝ) - 3) / 2)

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitiveFactor.denominator_sq
statement:
theorem denominator_sq (x : ℝ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    denominator x t ^ 2 = 1 + x ^ 2 * t

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitiveFactor.edge_coordinate
statement:
theorem edge_coordinate (c : ℝ) {x t : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    edge c (coordinate x t) = edge c x * Real.exp (-c * t)

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitiveFactor.exists_smooth_factor
statement:
theorem exists_smooth_factor {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (j : ℕ) {b : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hb : ContDiff ℝ ∞ b) :
    ∃ F : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ F ∧ F 0 = b 0 / (2 * c) ∧
      ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → primitive c j b x = scale c j x * F x

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitiveFactor.exists_smooth_factor_original
statement:
theorem exists_smooth_factor_original {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (j : ℕ) {b : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hb : ContDiff ℝ ∞ b) :
    ∃ F : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ F ∧ F 0 = b 0 / (2 * c) ∧
      ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x →
        (∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..x, (Real.exp (-c / u ^ 2) / u ^ j) * b u) =
          Real.exp (-c / x ^ 2) * x ^ (3 - (j : ℝ)) * F x

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitiveFactor.factor_at_zero
statement:
theorem factor_at_zero {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (j : ℕ) (b : ℝ → ℝ) :
    factor c j b 0 = b 0 / (2 * c)

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitiveFactor.factor_contDiff
statement:
theorem factor_contDiff {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (j : ℕ) {b : ℝ → ℝ}

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitiveFactor.factor_eq_normalized_primitive
statement:
theorem factor_eq_normalized_primitive (c : ℝ) (j : ℕ) (b : ℝ → ℝ)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    factor c j b x = primitive c j b x / scale c j x

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitiveFactor.factor_iteratedDeriv
statement:
theorem factor_iteratedDeriv {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (j : ℕ) {b : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hb : ContDiff ℝ ∞ b) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    iteratedDeriv n (factor c j b) x =
      ∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), iteratedDeriv n (fun y => kernel c j b y t) x

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitiveFactor.factor_sqrt_contDiffAt_zero
NavierStokes.FlatPrimitiveFactor.integral_exp_eq_primitive
statement:
theorem integral_exp_eq_primitive (c : ℝ) (j : ℕ) (b : ℝ → ℝ)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    (∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..x, (Real.exp (-c / u ^ 2) / u ^ j) * b u) =

statement:
theorem kernel_ae_contDiff (c : ℝ) (j : ℕ) {b : ℝ → ℝ} (hb : ContDiff ℝ ∞ b) :

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitiveFactor.kernel_at_zero
statement:
theorem kernel_at_zero (c : ℝ) (j : ℕ) (b : ℝ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    kernel c j b 0 t = (b 0 / 2) * Real.exp (-c * t)

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitiveFactor.kernel_iteratedDeriv_measurable
statement:
theorem kernel_iteratedDeriv_measurable (c : ℝ) (j : ℕ) {b : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hb : ContDiff ℝ ∞ b) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => iteratedDeriv n (fun y => kernel c j b y t) x)
      (volume.restrict (Ioi 0))

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitiveFactor.kernel_locallyDominated
statement:
theorem kernel_locallyDominated {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (j : ℕ) {b : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hb : ContDiff ℝ ∞ b) :
    NavierStokes.SmoothParameterIntegral.LocallyDominatedDeriv
      (kernel c j b) (volume.restrict (Ioi 0))

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitiveFactor.polynomial_exp_integrable
statement:
theorem polynomial_exp_integrable {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (N : ℕ) :
    IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => (1 + t) ^ N * Real.exp (-c * t)) (Ioi 0)

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitiveFactor.primitive_eq_scale_mul_factor
statement:
theorem primitive_eq_scale_mul_factor (c : ℝ) (j : ℕ) (b : ℝ → ℝ)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    primitive c j b x = scale c j x * factor c j b x

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitiveFactor.scale_eq_rpow
statement:
theorem scale_eq_rpow (c : ℝ) (j : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    scale c j x = Real.exp (-c / x ^ 2) * x ^ (3 - (j : ℝ))

name: NavierStokes.FlatPrimitiveFactor.transformed_integrand
statement:
theorem transformed_integrand (c : ℝ) (j : ℕ) (b : ℝ → ℝ)
    {x t : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    |-(x ^ 3 / (2 * denominator x t ^ 3))| *
        integrand c j b (coordinate x t) =
      scale c j x * kernel c j b x t

theorem amplitude_contDiff (j : ℕ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :

      |iteratedDeriv n (fun y => amplitude j y t) x| ≤ C * (1 + t) ^ N

statement:
theorem amplitude_joint_derivative_bound (j n : ℕ) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) :

statement:
theorem coordinate_contDiff {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :

name: NavierStokes.ParametricKernelBounds.coordinate_derivative_bound
statement:
theorem coordinate_derivative_bound (n : ℕ) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) :

      |iteratedDeriv n (fun y => coordinate y t) x| ≤ C * (1 + t) ^ N

name: NavierStokes.ParametricKernelBounds.coordinate_eq_expr
statement:
theorem coordinate_eq_expr (x t : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.ParametricKernelBounds.finite_polynomial_majorant
statement:
theorem finite_polynomial_majorant {X : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup X]
    (f : ℕ → X → ℝ → ℝ) (R : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    (∀ k ≤ n, ∃ C : ℝ, ∃ N : ℕ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ y t,
      ‖y‖ ≤ R → 0 ≤ t → f k y t ≤ C * (1 + t) ^ N) →
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∃ N : ℕ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ k ≤ n, ∀ y t,
      ‖y‖ ≤ R → 0 ≤ t → f k y t ≤ C * (1 + t) ^ N

name: NavierStokes.ParametricKernelBounds.kernel_eq_raw
statement:
theorem kernel_eq_raw (c : ℝ) (j : ℕ) (b : E × ℝ → ℝ) (y : E × ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    kernel c j b y t = ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-c * t)) * rawKernel j b y t

name: NavierStokes.ParametricKernelBounds.kernel_iteratedFDeriv_bound_of_jetBounds
statement:
theorem kernel_iteratedFDeriv_bound_of_jetBounds {b : E × ℝ → ℝ}
    (hb : ContDiff ℝ ∞ b) (c : ℝ) (j n : ℕ) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B)

    ∃ C : ℝ, ∃ N : ℕ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ y : E × ℝ, ∀ t : ℝ,
      ‖y‖ ≤ R → 0 ≤ t →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun z => kernel c j b z t) y‖ ≤
        C * (1 + t) ^ N * Real.exp (-c * t)

statement:
theorem norm_iteratedFDeriv_linear_le (L : X →L[ℝ] F) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (x : X) :

name: NavierStokes.ParametricKernelBounds.norm_iteratedFDeriv_mul_le_of_bounds
statement:
theorem norm_iteratedFDeriv_mul_le_of_bounds {f g : X → ℝ}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g) (n : ℕ) (x : X)
    {C D : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (_hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hfb : ∀ i ≤ n, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f x‖ ≤ C)
    (hgb : ∀ i ≤ n, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i g x‖ ≤ D) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => f y * g y) x‖ ≤
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ)) * C * D

statement:
theorem norm_iteratedFDeriv_pair_le {f : X → F} {g : X → G}

    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => (f y, g y)) x‖ ≤
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f x‖ + ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g x‖

theorem norm_iteratedFDeriv_scalar_snd_le {f : ℝ → ℝ}

NavierStokes.ParametricKernelBounds.rawKernel_iteratedFDeriv_bound

theorem rawKernel_iteratedFDeriv_bound {b : E × ℝ → ℝ} (hb : ContDiff ℝ ∞ b)

statement:
theorem transform_derivative_bound (n : ℕ) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) :

name: NavierStokes.ParametricFlatFactor.bounded_coefficient_jets
statement:

name: NavierStokes.ParametricFlatFactor.contDiffAt_partial_iteratedFDeriv
statement:
theorem contDiffAt_partial_iteratedFDeriv (F : P → Y → Z) (n : ℕ) (p : P) (y : Y)
    (hF : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (Function.uncurry F) (p, y)) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z : P × Y => iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (F z.1) z.2) (p, y)

name: NavierStokes.ParametricFlatFactor.exists_joint_smooth_factor
statement:
theorem exists_joint_smooth_factor {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (j : ℕ)
    {b : E × ℝ → ℝ} (hb : ContDiff ℝ ∞ b) :
    ∃ F : E × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ F ∧
      (∀ p : E, F (p, 0) = b (p, 0) / (2 * c)) ∧
      ∀ (p : E) (x : ℝ), 0 < x →
        (∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..x, (Real.exp (-c / u ^ 2) / u ^ j) * b (p, u)) =
          Real.exp (-c / x ^ 2) * x ^ (3 - (j : ℝ)) * F (p, x)

name: NavierStokes.ParametricFlatFactor.factor_at_zero
statement:
theorem factor_at_zero {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (j : ℕ) (b : E × ℝ → ℝ) (p : E) :
    factor c j b (p, 0) = b (p, 0) / (2 * c)

theorem factor_contDiff {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (j : ℕ)

name: NavierStokes.ParametricFlatFactor.factor_eq_scalar
statement:
theorem factor_eq_scalar (c : ℝ) (j : ℕ) (b : E × ℝ → ℝ) (p : E) (x : ℝ) :
    factor c j b (p, x) = FlatPrimitiveFactor.factor c j (fun u => b (p, u)) x

name: NavierStokes.ParametricFlatFactor.factor_iteratedFDeriv
statement:
theorem factor_iteratedFDeriv {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (j : ℕ)
    {b : E × ℝ → ℝ} (hb : ContDiff ℝ ∞ b) (n : ℕ) (y : E × ℝ) :
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (factor c j b) y =
      ∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun z => kernel c j b z t) y

name: NavierStokes.ParametricFlatFactor.integral_original_factorization
statement:
theorem integral_original_factorization (c : ℝ) (j : ℕ) (b : E × ℝ → ℝ)

name: NavierStokes.ConeAlgebra.boundary_polynomial
statement:
theorem boundary_polynomial (P J v : ℝ) :
    2 * (P - v) ^ 2 - (v - 2) * J ^ 2 =
      2 * v ^ 2 - (4 * P + J ^ 2) * v + 2 * P ^ 2 + 2 * J ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.ConeAlgebra.coneBound_gt_two
statement: theorem coneBound_gt_two {P J : ℝ} (hP : 2 < P) : 2 < coneBound P J

name: NavierStokes.ConeAlgebra.coneBound_le_parameter
statement: theorem coneBound_le_parameter {P J : ℝ} (hP : 2 < P) : coneBound P J ≤ P

name: NavierStokes.ConeAlgebra.equation_eleven_sufficient
statement:
theorem equation_eleven_sufficient {a b w : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hfirst : 0 < a - b * w)
    (hsecond : 2 * b * w + b ^ 2 / a + (a - 2) * w ^ 2 < 2) :
    ∃ p₀ : ℝ, ∀ p : ℝ, p₀ < p →
      2 < p * (1 - b * w / a) ∧ a * (1 + (b / a) ^ 2) <
        coneBound (p * (1 - b * w / a)) (p * (w + b / a))

name: NavierStokes.ConeAlgebra.finite_amplitude_cone
statement:
theorem finite_amplitude_cone {c j v p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p)
    (hP : 2 < p * c) (hvP : v < p * c)
    (hscale : 4 * c * v < p * (2 * c ^ 2 - (v - 2) * j ^ 2)) :
    v < coneBound (p * c) (p * j)

name: NavierStokes.ConeAlgebra.normalized_factorization
statement:
theorem normalized_factorization (a b w : ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    (a * (1 + (b / a) ^ 2) - 2) * (w + b / a) ^ 2 -
        2 * (1 - b * w / a) ^ 2 =
      (1 + (b / a) ^ 2) * ((a - 2) * w ^ 2 + 2 * b * w + b ^ 2 / a - 2)

name: NavierStokes.ConeAlgebra.normalized_test_negative
statement:
theorem normalized_test_negative {a b w : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hcriterion : 2 * b * w + b ^ 2 / a + (a - 2) * w ^ 2 < 2) :
    (a * (1 + (b / a) ^ 2) - 2) * (w + b / a) ^ 2 -
      2 * (1 - b * w / a) ^ 2 < 0

name: NavierStokes.ConeAlgebra.relaxed_cone_of_le_two
statement:
theorem relaxed_cone_of_le_two {P J v : ℝ} (hP : 2 < P) (hv : v ≤ 2) :
    v < coneBound P J

name: NavierStokes.ConeAlgebra.rootTerm_ge_quarter
statement:
theorem rootTerm_ge_quarter {P J : ℝ} (hP : 2 < P) :
    J ^ 2 / 4 ≤ rootTerm P J

name: NavierStokes.ConeAlgebra.rootTerm_nonneg
statement: theorem rootTerm_nonneg (P J : ℝ) : 0 ≤ rootTerm P J

name: NavierStokes.ConeAlgebra.rootTerm_sq
statement:
theorem rootTerm_sq {P J : ℝ} (hP : 2 < P) :
    rootTerm P J ^ 2 = J ^ 2 * ((P - 2) / 2 + J ^ 2 / 16)

name: NavierStokes.ConeAlgebra.square_difference
statement:
theorem square_difference (P J v : ℝ) :
    (P + J ^ 2 / 4 - v) ^ 2 - J ^ 2 * ((P - 2) / 2 + J ^ 2 / 16) =
      (P - v) ^ 2 - (v - 2) * J ^ 2 / 2

name: NavierStokes.ConeAlgebra.sufficiently_large_amplitude_cone
statement:
theorem sufficiently_large_amplitude_cone {c j v : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c)
    (hmargin : (v - 2) * j ^ 2 < 2 * c ^ 2) :
    ∃ p₀ : ℝ, ∀ p : ℝ, p₀ < p →
      2 < p * c ∧ v < coneBound (p * c) (p * j)

name: NavierStokes.ConeAlgebra.true_cone_iff
statement:
theorem true_cone_iff {P J v : ℝ} (hv : 2 < v) :
    (2 < P ∧ v < coneBound P J) ↔
      (v < P ∧ (v - 2) * J ^ 2 < 2 * (P - v) ^ 2)

name: NavierStokes.UniformCone.compact_equation_eleven
statement:
theorem compact_equation_eleven {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K)
    {a b w : X → ℝ} (ha : ContinuousOn a K) (hb : ContinuousOn b K)
    (hw : ContinuousOn w K) (hapos : ∀ x ∈ K, 0 < a x)
    (hfirst : ∀ x ∈ K, 0 < a x - b x * w x)
    (hsecond : ∀ x ∈ K,
      2 * b x * w x + b x ^ 2 / a x + (a x - 2) * w x ^ 2 < 2) :
    ∃ ε p₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ 0 ≤ p₀ ∧
      (∀ x ∈ K, ε ≤ 1 - b x * w x / a x ∧
        ε ≤ 2 * (1 - b x * w x / a x) ^ 2 -
          (a x * (1 + (b x / a x) ^ 2) - 2) * (w x + b x / a x) ^ 2) ∧
      ∀ p : ℝ, p₀ < p → ∀ x ∈ K,
        2 < p * (1 - b x * w x / a x) ∧
        a x * (1 + (b x / a x) ^ 2) <
          coneBound (p * (1 - b x * w x / a x)) (p * (w x + b x / a x))

name: NavierStokes.UniformCone.compact_equation_eleven_gap
statement:
theorem compact_equation_eleven_gap {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K)
    {a b w : X → ℝ} (ha : ContinuousOn a K) (hb : ContinuousOn b K)
    (hw : ContinuousOn w K) (hapos : ∀ x ∈ K, 0 < a x)
    (hfirst : ∀ x ∈ K, 0 < a x - b x * w x)
    (hsecond : ∀ x ∈ K,
      2 * b x * w x + b x ^ 2 / a x + (a x - 2) * w x ^ 2 < 2) :
    ∃ η p₀ : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ 0 ≤ p₀ ∧ ∀ p : ℝ, p₀ < p → ∀ x ∈ K,
      2 + η < p * (1 - b x * w x / a x) ∧
        a x * (1 + (b x / a x) ^ 2) + η <
          coneBound (p * (1 - b x * w x / a x)) (p * (w x + b x / a x))

name: NavierStokes.UniformCone.compact_family_quadratic_stable
statement:
theorem compact_family_quadratic_stable {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K)
    {P J v : X → ℝ} (hP : ContinuousOn P K) (hJ : ContinuousOn J K)
    (hv : ContinuousOn v K)
    (hcone : ∀ x ∈ K, 2 < v x ∧ 2 < P x ∧ v x < coneBound (P x) (J x)) :
    ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ P' J' v' : ℝ,
      |P' - P x| ≤ ρ → |J' - J x| ≤ ρ → |v' - v x| ≤ ρ →
        2 < v' ∧ v' < P' ∧ (v' - 2) * J' ^ 2 < 2 * (P' - v') ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.UniformCone.compact_family_trueCone_stable
statement:
theorem compact_family_trueCone_stable {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K)
    {P J v : X → ℝ} (hP : ContinuousOn P K) (hJ : ContinuousOn J K)
    (hv : ContinuousOn v K)
    (hcone : ∀ x ∈ K, 2 < v x ∧ 2 < P x ∧ v x < coneBound (P x) (J x)) :
    ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ P' J' v' : ℝ,
      dist (P', J', v') (P x, J x, v x) ≤ ρ →
        2 < v' ∧ 2 < P' ∧ v' < coneBound P' J'

name: NavierStokes.UniformCone.compact_normalized_cone
statement:
theorem compact_normalized_cone {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K)
    {c j v : X → ℝ} (hc : ContinuousOn c K) (hj : ContinuousOn j K)
    (hv : ContinuousOn v K) (hcpos : ∀ x ∈ K, 0 < c x)
    (hmargin : ∀ x ∈ K, (v x - 2) * j x ^ 2 < 2 * c x ^ 2) :
    ∃ ε p₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ 0 ≤ p₀ ∧
      (∀ x ∈ K, ε ≤ c x ∧ ε ≤ 2 * c x ^ 2 - (v x - 2) * j x ^ 2) ∧
      ∀ p : ℝ, p₀ < p → ∀ x ∈ K,
        2 < p * c x ∧ v x < coneBound (p * c x) (p * j x)

name: NavierStokes.UniformCone.compact_normalized_cone_gap
statement:
theorem compact_normalized_cone_gap {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K)
    {c j v : X → ℝ} (hc : ContinuousOn c K) (hj : ContinuousOn j K)
    (hv : ContinuousOn v K) (hcpos : ∀ x ∈ K, 0 < c x)
    (hmargin : ∀ x ∈ K, (v x - 2) * j x ^ 2 < 2 * c x ^ 2) :
    ∃ η p₀ : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ 0 ≤ p₀ ∧ ∀ p : ℝ, p₀ < p → ∀ x ∈ K,
      2 + η < p * c x ∧ v x + η < coneBound (p * c x) (p * j x)

name: NavierStokes.UniformCone.compact_source_margins
statement:
theorem compact_source_margins {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K)
    {a b w : X → ℝ} (ha : ContinuousOn a K) (hb : ContinuousOn b K)
    (hw : ContinuousOn w K) (hapos : ∀ x ∈ K, 0 < a x)
    (hfirst : ∀ x ∈ K, 0 < a x - b x * w x)
    (hsecond : ∀ x ∈ K,
      2 * b x * w x + b x ^ 2 / a x + (a x - 2) * w x ^ 2 < 2) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ x ∈ K,
      ε ≤ a x ∧ ε ≤ a x - b x * w x ∧
        ε ≤ 2 - (2 * b x * w x + b x ^ 2 / a x + (a x - 2) * w x ^ 2)

name: NavierStokes.UniformCone.compact_trueCone_margins
statement:
theorem compact_trueCone_margins {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K)
    {P J v : X → ℝ} (hP : ContinuousOn P K) (hJ : ContinuousOn J K)
    (hv : ContinuousOn v K)
    (hcone : ∀ x ∈ K, 2 < v x ∧ 2 < P x ∧ v x < coneBound (P x) (J x)) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ x ∈ K,
      ε ≤ v x - 2 ∧ ε ≤ P x - 2 ∧ ε ≤ coneBound (P x) (J x) - v x

name: NavierStokes.UniformCone.compact_trueCone_stable
statement:
theorem compact_trueCone_stable {S : Set ConeDatum} (hS : IsCompact S)
    (hcone : S ⊆ trueCone) :

    graphDerivative M a e v f n x =
      fderiv ℝ (f n) x (e + M n • (a x • v))

name: NavierStokes.WeightedClasses.majorant_mul
statement:
theorem majorant_mul (s : StripData D) (w v : ℕ → D → ℝ)
    (α β A B : ℝ) (p q n : ℕ) (x : D) :
    majorant s w α A p n x * majorant s v β B q n x =
      majorant s (fun n x => w n x * v n x) (α + β) (A * B) (p + q) n x

name: NavierStokes.WeightedRadialPrimitive.canonical_transport_compact_uniform
statement:
theorem canonical_transport_compact_uniform
    {a b cL cR : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b)
    (hcL : 0 < cL) (hcR : 0 < cR) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ (M : ℝ) (v : E) (f : ℝ × E → V), Continuous f →
      RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b f → ∀ A : ℝ, 0 ≤ A →
      (∀ X ∈ Ioo a b, ∀ Y : E, ‖f (X, Y)‖ ≤ A * logWeight cL cR a b m X) →
      ∀ z : ℝ × E, z.1 ∈ Ioo a b →
        ‖TransportPrimitive.compactIntegral (TransportPrimitive.interiorCutoff a b) M v f z‖ ≤
          K * A * logWeight cL cR a b m z.1

      (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ m → ∀ X ∈ Ioo a b, ∀ Y : E,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f (X, Y)‖ ≤ A * logWeight cL cR a b p X) →
      ∀ z : ℝ × E, z.1 ∈ Ioo a b → ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ m →

statement:
theorem logStrip_majorant_eq
    {a b cL cR : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hcL : 0 < cL) (hcR : 0 < cR)
    (ε S : ℕ → ℝ) (hε : ∀ n, 0 < ε n) (hεone : ∀ n, ε n ≤ 1) (hS : ∀ n, 1 ≤ S n)
    (α C : ℝ) (p n : ℕ) (z : ℝ × E) (hz : z.1 ∈ Ioo a b) :
    WeightedClasses.majorant (logStripData a b cL cR ha hcL hcR ε S hε hεone hS)
      (fun _ y => (logStripData a b cL cR ha hcL hcR ε S hε hεone hS).zeta y) α C p n z =
      (C * (ε n) ^ α * (S n) ^ p) * logWeight cL cR a b p z.1

name: NavierStokes.WeightedRadialPrimitive.logWeight_formula
statement:

    (cL cR : ℝ) (m : ℕ) :
    logWeight cL cR a b m X =
      Real.exp (-cL / (Real.log (X / a)) ^ 2 - cR / (Real.log (b / X)) ^ 2) /
        (min 1 (min (Real.log (X / a)) (Real.log (b / X)))) ^ m

name: NavierStokes.WeightedRadialPrimitive.transport_compact_primitive_uniform
statement:
theorem transport_compact_primitive_uniform
    {a b c d cL cR : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hac : a < c) (hcd : c < d) (hdb : d < b)
    (hcL : 0 < cL) (hcR : 0 < cR) (m : ℕ) (χ : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hχ : ∀ X, |χ X| ≤ 1)
    (hleft : ∀ X, X ≤ c → χ X = 0) (hright : ∀ X, d ≤ X → χ X = 1) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ (M : ℝ) (v : E) (f : ℝ × E → V), Continuous f →
      RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b f → ∀ A : ℝ, 0 ≤ A →
      (∀ X ∈ Ioo a b, ∀ Y : E, ‖f (X, Y)‖ ≤ A * logWeight cL cR a b m X) →
      ∀ z : ℝ × E, z.1 ∈ Ioo a b →
        ‖TransportPrimitive.compactIntegral χ M v f z‖ ≤
          K * A * logWeight cL cR a b m z.1

      ∀ z : ℝ × E, z.1 ∈ Ioo a b → logLength a b / 2 ≤ logPosition a z.1 →
        ‖TransportPrimitive.futureIntegral M v f z‖ ≤ K * A * logWeight cL cR a b m z.1

    (hclass : WeightedClasses.MeanClass
      (logStripData a b cL cR ha hcL hcR ε S hε hεone hS) α g) :

name: NavierStokes.RadialPullback.normalizeSource_finiteJets_uniform
statement:
theorem normalizeSource_finiteJets_uniform {a b d : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hd : 0 < d) (cL cR : ℝ) (p m : ℕ) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ (g : ℝ × E → V), ContDiff ℝ ∞ g → ∀ A : ℝ, 0 ≤ A →
      (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ m → ∀ R ∈ Ioo a b, ∀ Y : E,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j g (R, Y)‖ ≤ A * logWeight cL cR a b p R) →
      ∀ z : ℝ × E, z.1 ∈ Ioo (a ^ d) (b ^ d) → ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ m →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (normalizeSource d a g) z‖ ≤
          K * A * logWeight (d ^ 2 * cL) (d ^ 2 * cR) (a ^ d) (b ^ d) p z.1

    (∫ U in (a ^ d)..(R ^ d), normalizeSource d a g (U, Y + (M * (U - U₀)) • v)) =
      ∫ s in a..R, g (s, Y + (M * (s ^ d - U₀)) • v)

name: NavierStokes.RadialPullback.physicalCompact_contDiff
NavierStokes.RadialPullback.physicalCompact_eq_radialIntegral
statement:
theorem physicalCompact_eq_radialIntegral {a b d : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hd : 0 < d) {g : ℝ × E → V}
    (hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g) (hs : RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b g)
    (M : ℝ) (v : E) (z : ℝ × E) (hz : a ≤ z.1) :
    physicalCompact d a b M v g z =
      (∫ s in a..z.1, g (s, z.2 + (M * (s ^ d - z.1 ^ d)) • v)) -
      TransportPrimitive.interiorCutoff (a ^ d) (b ^ d) (z.1 ^ d) •
        (∫ s in a..b, g (s, z.2 + (M * (s ^ d - z.1 ^ d)) • v))

    (ε S : ℕ → ℝ) (hε : ∀ n, 0 < ε n) (hεone : ∀ n, ε n ≤ 1) (hS : ∀ n, 1 ≤ S n)
    (α : ℝ) (M : ℕ → ℝ) (v : ℕ → E) (g : ℕ → ℝ × E → V)

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalGraphBounds.carrier_class_physical_bound
statement:
theorem carrier_class_physical_bound {h a b : ℝ} (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1 / 2)
    (ha : 0 < a) (m : ℕ) (g d e A B H : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 1 ≤ B)
    (he : 0 ≤ e) (hH : 0 ≤ H) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, 4 ≤ n → ∀ p : SpaceTime,
      scaledRadial n p ∈ annulus a b → |p.1| ≤ 1 →
      ∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → q / 2 ≤ ChartScales.Q n → ChartScales.Q n ≤ 2 * q →
      ∀ (amp : LiftPoint → ℂ) (Φ : LiftPoint → ℝ) (j : ℤ),
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ amp → ContDiff ℝ ∞ Φ → |(j : ℝ)| ≤ H →
      (∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i amp (physicalLift h n p)‖ ≤
        A * ChartScales.Q n ^ g * ChartScales.S n ^ d) →
      (∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i Φ (physicalLift h n p)‖ ≤
        B * ChartScales.S n ^ e * ChartScales.Q n ^ (-1 : ℝ)) →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m
        ((fun y => amp y * character ((ChartScales.carrier h n : ℝ) * (j : ℝ)) (Φ y)) ∘
          physicalLift h n) p‖ ≤ C * q ^ (g - waveLoss h m)

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalGraphBounds.carrier_graph_jet_bound

    (ha : 0 < a) (m : ℕ) : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
    ∀ n : ℕ, 4 ≤ n → ∀ p : SpaceTime,
      scaledRadial n p ∈ annulus a b → |p.1| ≤ 1 →
      ∀ (A : LiftPoint → ℂ) (Φ : LiftPoint → ℝ),
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ A → ContDiff ℝ ∞ Φ → ∀ (P B H : ℝ) (j : ℤ),
      0 ≤ P → 1 ≤ B → |(j : ℝ)| ≤ H →
      (∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i A (physicalLift h n p)‖ ≤ P) →
      (∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i Φ (physicalLift h n p)‖ ≤ B) →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m
        ((fun y => A y * character ((ChartScales.carrier h n : ℝ) * (j : ℝ)) (Φ y)) ∘
          physicalLift h n) p‖ ≤
        C * P * B ^ m * (1 + 2 * H) ^ m *
          ChartScales.Q n ^ (-(graphLoss m + h * (m : ℝ) / 2))

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalGraphBounds.liftedPhase_jet_bound
statement:
theorem liftedPhase_jet_bound {κ : Plane → Plane} (hκ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ κ)
    (h : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (center : Plane) (r0 p pz x0 : ℝ) {F G : Slow → ℝ}
    (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (y : LiftPoint) (m : ℕ)
    {K M B : ℝ} (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hκb : ∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i κ (liftXY y)‖ ≤ K)
    (hpoint : ‖slotMap κ (ChartScales.timeCoefficient h n) center r0 y‖ ≤ M)
    (hFb : ∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F
      (slotMap κ (ChartScales.timeCoefficient h n) center r0 y).1‖ ≤ B)
    (hGb : ∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i G
      (slotMap κ (ChartScales.timeCoefficient h n) center r0 y).1‖ ≤ B) :
    ∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (liftedPhase κ h n center r0 p pz x0 F G) y‖ ≤
      (m.factorial : ℝ) *
        ((|p| + |pz / ChartScales.epsilon h n| + |x0|) * M +
          (2 : ℝ) ^ m * M * ((|p| + |pz|) * B)) *
        (K + 1 + |(ChartScales.timeCoefficient h n)⁻¹| * ‖etaCoordinate‖) ^ m

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalGraphBounds.liftedPhase_physical_formula
statement:
theorem liftedPhase_physical_formula {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (chart : PolarCharts.Index) (h : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (center : Plane)
    (r0 p pz x0 : ℝ) (F G : Slow → ℝ) (w : SpaceTime)
    (hw : scaledRadial n w ∈ PolarCharts.sector a b chart) :
    let R := PolarCharts.radius (scaledRadial n w)
    let θ := Real.arctan ((PolarCharts.rotate chart (scaledRadial n w)).2 /
      (PolarCharts.rotate chart (scaledRadial n w)).1) + PolarCharts.offset chart
    let Z := ChartScales.Q n ^ (-CoordinateAlgebra.D h) * w.2 2
    let T := (1 - w.1) / ChartScales.Q n
    liftedPhase (PolarCharts.chart a chart) h n center r0 p pz x0 F G (physicalLift h n w) =
      p * θ + (pz / ChartScales.epsilon h n) * Z + x0 * R -
        slotTime h n center r0 w * (p * F (R, (Z, T)) + pz * G (R, (Z, T)))

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalGraphBounds.liftedPhase_power_bound
statement:
theorem liftedPhase_power_bound {h K Z r0 P B d : ℝ}
    (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1) (hK : 1 ≤ K)
    (hZ : 0 ≤ Z) (hr0 : 0 ≤ r0) (hP : 1 ≤ P) (hB : 1 ≤ B) (hd : 0 ≤ d) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧ ∀ κ : Plane → Plane, ContDiff ℝ ∞ κ →
      ∀ n : ℕ, 4 ≤ n → ∀ (center : Plane) (p pz x0 : ℝ),
      |p| ≤ P → |pz| ≤ P → |x0| ≤ P → ∀ (F G : Slow → ℝ),
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ F → ContDiff ℝ ∞ G → ∀ y : LiftPoint,
      (∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i κ (liftXY y)‖ ≤ K) →
      ‖liftZT y‖ ≤ Z → |etaCoordinate (y.2 - center)| ≤ r0 →
      (∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F
        (slotMap κ (ChartScales.timeCoefficient h n) center r0 y).1‖ ≤ B * ChartScales.S n ^ d) →
      (∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i G
        (slotMap κ (ChartScales.timeCoefficient h n) center r0 y).1‖ ≤ B * ChartScales.S n ^ d) →
      ∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (liftedPhase κ h n center r0 p pz x0 F G) y‖ ≤
        C * ChartScales.S n ^ (d + (m : ℝ) + 1) * ChartScales.Q n ^ (-1 : ℝ)

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalGraphBounds.native_carrier_physical_bound
statement:
theorem native_carrier_physical_bound {h a b Z r0 P B dBase : ℝ}
    (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1 / 2) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hZ : 0 ≤ Z) (hr0 : 0 ≤ r0) (hP : 1 ≤ P) (hB : 1 ≤ B) (hdBase : 0 ≤ dBase)
    (m : ℕ) (g dAmp A H : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hH : 0 ≤ H) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, 4 ≤ n → ∀ w : SpaceTime,
      scaledRadial n w ∈ annulus a b → |w.1| ≤ 1 →
      ‖liftZT (physicalLift h n w)‖ ≤ Z →
      ∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → q / 2 ≤ ChartScales.Q n → ChartScales.Q n ≤ 2 * q →
      ∀ (chart : PolarCharts.Index) (center : Plane) (p pz x0 : ℝ),
      |p| ≤ P → |pz| ≤ P → |x0| ≤ P →
      |etaCoordinate (nativeGraph h n w - center)| ≤ r0 →
      ∀ (amp : LiftPoint → ℂ) (F G : Slow → ℝ) (j : ℤ),
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ amp → ContDiff ℝ ∞ F → ContDiff ℝ ∞ G → |(j : ℝ)| ≤ H →
      (∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i amp (physicalLift h n w)‖ ≤
        A * ChartScales.Q n ^ g * ChartScales.S n ^ dAmp) →
      (∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F
        (slotMap (PolarCharts.chart a chart) (ChartScales.timeCoefficient h n) center r0
          (physicalLift h n w)).1‖ ≤ B * ChartScales.S n ^ dBase) →
      (∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i G
        (slotMap (PolarCharts.chart a chart) (ChartScales.timeCoefficient h n) center r0
          (physicalLift h n w)).1‖ ≤ B * ChartScales.S n ^ dBase) →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m
        ((fun y => amp y * character ((ChartScales.carrier h n : ℝ) * (j : ℝ))
          (liftedPhase (PolarCharts.chart a chart) h n center r0 p pz x0 F G y)) ∘
          physicalLift h n) w‖ ≤ C * q ^ (g - waveLoss h m)

statement:
theorem pointwise_product_jet_bound {E A : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [NormedRing A] [NormedAlgebra ℝ A] {f g : E → A} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g) (x : E) {m k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ m) {P Q : ℝ}
    (hP : 0 ≤ P) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q)
    (hfb : ∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f x‖ ≤ P)
    (hgb : ∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i g x‖ ≤ Q) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun y => f y * g y) x‖ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m * P * Q

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalGraphBounds.positive_jet_affine_bound
statement:
theorem positive_jet_affine_bound {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalGraphBounds.radialProjection_apply

@[simp] theorem radialProjection_apply (p : SpaceTime) :

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalGraphBounds.radiusPower_eq
statement:
theorem radiusPower_eq (d : ℝ) (y : Plane) :

statement:
theorem radiusPower_smul (d : ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (y : Plane) :

theorem rounded_carrier_jet_bound {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 ≤ h) (n m : ℕ)

    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (character ((ChartScales.carrier h n : ℝ) * (j : ℝ))) t‖ ≤
      (2 * H) ^ m * ChartScales.Q n ^ (-(h * (m : ℝ) / 2))

statement:
theorem scaledRadial_ne_zero {n : ℕ} {p : SpaceTime} (hp : scaledRadial n p ≠ 0) :

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalGraphBounds.slotMap_formula
statement:
theorem slotMap_formula (κ : Plane → Plane) (ci : ℝ) (center : Plane) (r0 : ℝ) (y : LiftPoint) :
    slotMap κ ci center r0 y =
      (((κ (liftXY y)).1, (y.1.2.2.2, y.1.1)),
        ((κ (liftXY y)).2, (etaCoordinate (y.2 - center) + r0) / ci))

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalGraphBounds.slotMap_norm_bound
statement:
theorem slotMap_norm_bound (κ : Plane → Plane) (ci : ℝ) (center : Plane) (r0 : ℝ)
    (y : LiftPoint) {K Z V : ℝ} (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hZ : 0 ≤ Z) (hV : 0 ≤ V)
    (hk : ‖κ (liftXY y)‖ ≤ K) (hz : ‖liftZT y‖ ≤ Z)
    (hv : |(etaCoordinate (y.2 - center) + r0) / ci| ≤ V) :
    ‖slotMap κ ci center r0 y‖ ≤ K + Z + V

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalGraphBounds.slotMap_physical
statement:
theorem slotMap_physical (κ : Plane → Plane) (h : ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    (center : Plane) (r0 : ℝ) (p : SpaceTime) :
    slotMap κ (ChartScales.timeCoefficient h n) center r0 (physicalLift h n p) =
      (((κ (scaledRadial n p)).1,
        (ChartScales.Q n ^ (-CoordinateAlgebra.D h) * p.2 2, (1 - p.1) / ChartScales.Q n)),
       ((κ (scaledRadial n p)).2, slotTime h n center r0 p))

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalGraphBounds.slotMap_positive_jet_bound
statement:
theorem slotMap_positive_jet_bound {κ : Plane → Plane} (hκ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ κ)
    (ci : ℝ) (center : Plane) (r0 : ℝ) (y : LiftPoint) (m : ℕ) {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hκb : ∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i κ (liftXY y)‖ ≤ K) :
    ∀ i, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ m → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (slotMap κ ci center r0) y‖ ≤
      K + 1 + |ci⁻¹| * ‖etaCoordinate‖

statement:
theorem slotMap_smooth {κ : Plane → Plane} (hκ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ κ)

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalGraphBounds.slotTime_affine
statement:
theorem slotTime_affine (h : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (center : Plane) (r0 : ℝ) (p : SpaceTime) :
    slotTime h n center r0 p =
      ChartScales.Q n ^ (-1 - h) * p.1 +
        (r0 - etaCoordinate center) / ChartScales.timeCoefficient h n

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalGraphBounds.slotTime_derivative
statement:
theorem slotTime_derivative (h : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (center : Plane) (r0 : ℝ)
    (p v : SpaceTime) :
    fderiv ℝ (slotTime h n center r0) p v = ChartScales.Q n ^ (-1 - h) * v.1

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalGraphBounds.slotTime_spatial_derivative
statement:
theorem slotTime_spatial_derivative (h : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (center : Plane) (r0 : ℝ)

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalGraphBounds.slow_power_absorption
statement:
theorem slow_power_absorption (a : ℝ) : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ n : ℕ,

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalGraphBounds.stripped_class_physical_bound
statement:
theorem stripped_class_physical_bound {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {h a b : ℝ} (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1 / 2) (ha : 0 < a)
    (m : ℕ) (g d A : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
    ∀ n : ℕ, 4 ≤ n → ∀ p : SpaceTime,
      scaledRadial n p ∈ annulus a b → |p.1| ≤ 1 →
      ∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → q / 2 ≤ ChartScales.Q n → ChartScales.Q n ≤ 2 * q →
      ∀ F : LiftPoint → E, ContDiff ℝ ∞ F →
      (∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F (physicalLift h n p)‖ ≤
        A * ChartScales.Q n ^ g * ChartScales.S n ^ d) →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (F ∘ physicalLift h n) p‖ ≤
        C * q ^ (g - (graphLoss m + 1))

statement:
theorem coordinateEta_abs_lt_one {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1)

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateEta_hasDerivAt_tau
statement:
theorem coordinateEta_hasDerivAt_tau {a τ z : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => coordinateEta a (t, z))
      (-((1 - a) / 2) * coordinateEta a (τ, z) /
        (coordinateQ a (τ, z) * scalarSlope a z (coordinateQ a (τ, z)))) τ

statement:
theorem coordinateEta_hasDerivAt_time {a t z : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) (ht : t < 1) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => coordinateEta a (1 - s, z))
      (((1 - a) / 2) * coordinateEta a (1 - t, z) /
        (coordinateQ a (1 - t, z) *
          (1 - a * coordinateEta a (1 - t, z) ^ 2))) t

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateEta_hasDerivAt_z
statement:
theorem coordinateEta_hasDerivAt_z {a τ z : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun x => coordinateEta a (τ, x))
      ((1 - coordinateEta a (τ, z) ^ 2) /
        (coordinateQ a (τ, z) ^ ((1 - a) / 2) *
          scalarSlope a z (coordinateQ a (τ, z)))) z

statement:
theorem coordinateEta_hasDerivAt_z_L {a τ z : ℝ}

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateEta_sq
statement:
theorem coordinateEta_sq {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1)

statement:
theorem coordinateEta_sq_lt_one {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1)

statement:
theorem coordinateQ_above_threshold {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1)

name: NavierStokes.SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateQ_fderiv_apply
statement:
theorem coordinateQ_fderiv_apply {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : 0 < p.1) (v : ℝ × ℝ) :
    fderiv ℝ (coordinateQ a) p v =
      (v.1 + 2 * p.2 * coordinateQ a p ^ a * v.2) /

statement:
theorem coordinateQ_hasDerivAt_tau {a τ z : ℝ}

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalWaveSum.common_carrier_physical_bound
statement:
theorem common_carrier_physical_bound {h a b Z r0 P B eBase : ℝ}
    (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1 / 2) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hZ : 0 ≤ Z) (hr0 : 0 ≤ r0) (hP : 1 ≤ P) (hB : 1 ≤ B) (heBase : 0 ≤ eBase)
    (Δ m : ℕ) (g eAmp A H : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hH : 0 ≤ H) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, 4 ≤ n → ∀ d : ℕ, d ≤ Δ →
      ∀ w : SpaceTime, PhysicalGraphBounds.scaledRadial n w ∈ PhysicalGraphBounds.annulus a b →
      |w.1| ≤ 1 → ‖PhysicalGraphBounds.liftZT (PhysicalGraphBounds.physicalLift h n w)‖ ≤ Z →
      ∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → q / 2 ≤ ChartScales.Q n → ChartScales.Q n ≤ 2 * q →
      ∀ (c : CarrierData) (amp : LiftPoint → ℂ) (j : ℤ),
      |c.angular| ≤ P → |c.axial| ≤ P → |c.radial| ≤ P →
      |PhysicalGraphBounds.etaCoordinate (PhysicalGraphBounds.nativeGraph h n w - c.center)| ≤ r0 →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ amp → ContDiff ℝ ∞ c.F → ContDiff ℝ ∞ c.G → |(j : ℝ)| ≤ H →
      (∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i amp (commonLift h n d w)‖ ≤
        A * ChartScales.Q n ^ g * ChartScales.S n ^ eAmp) →
      (∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i c.F
        (PhysicalGraphBounds.slotMap (PolarCharts.chart a c.chart)
          (ChartScales.timeCoefficient h n) c.center r0 (PhysicalGraphBounds.physicalLift h n w)).1‖ ≤
            B * ChartScales.S n ^ eBase) →
      (∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i c.G
        (PhysicalGraphBounds.slotMap (PolarCharts.chart a c.chart)
          (ChartScales.timeCoefficient h n) c.center r0 (PhysicalGraphBounds.physicalLift h n w)).1‖ ≤
            B * ChartScales.S n ^ eBase) →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (commonWave a h n d r0 c amp j) w‖ ≤
        C * q ^ (g - PhysicalGraphBounds.waveLoss h m)

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalWaveSum.common_stripped_physical_bound
statement:
theorem common_stripped_physical_bound {E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {h a b : ℝ} (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1 / 2) (ha : 0 < a)
    (Δ m : ℕ) (g e A : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, 4 ≤ n → ∀ d : ℕ, d ≤ Δ →
      ∀ w : SpaceTime, PhysicalGraphBounds.scaledRadial n w ∈ PhysicalGraphBounds.annulus a b → |w.1| ≤ 1 →
      ∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → q / 2 ≤ ChartScales.Q n → ChartScales.Q n ≤ 2 * q →
      ∀ f : LiftPoint → E, ContDiff ℝ ∞ f →
      (∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f (commonLift h n d w)‖ ≤
        A * ChartScales.Q n ^ g * ChartScales.S n ^ e) →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (f ∘ commonLift h n d) w‖ ≤
        C * q ^ (g - (PhysicalGraphBounds.graphLoss m + 1))

theorem physical_sum_jet_bound {h a b Z r0 P B eBase : ℝ}
    (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hZ : 0 ≤ Z) (hr0 : 0 ≤ r0) (hP : 1 ≤ P) (hB : 1 ≤ B) (heBase : 0 ≤ eBase)
    (H Δ m : ℕ) (g eAmp A : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ f : WaveFamily H,
      RegularFamily f a b h r0 Z Δ → StrippedClass f a b h r0 P A B g eAmp eBase m →
      ∀ w : SpaceTime, w ∈ preterminal → |w.1| ≤ 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (f.sum a h r0) w‖ ≤
        C * physicalQ h w ^ (g - PhysicalGraphBounds.waveLoss h m)

      (∀ i, RegularFamily (f i) a b h r0 Z Δ) →
      (∀ i, StrippedClass (f i) a b h r0 P A B g eAmp eBase m) →
      ∀ w : SpaceTime, w ∈ preterminal → |w.1| ≤ 1 →

      (∀ j, 1 ≤ j → ∀ m, m ≤ j + 2 → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ 1 / (a j : ℝ) →
        |DiagonalScale.logPowerWeight (C j m) (p j m) (g j / 2) r| ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j) ∧

      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (velocitySum (fun j => (a j : ℝ)) q A) U ∧
