name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.individual_correction_jet_bound
statement:
theorem individual_correction_jet_bound (c : Parameters) (hsmall : c.lam ≤ 1 / 120)
    (amp : ℝ → ℝ) {eta : ℝ} (heta : |eta| ≤ 1) (j : Fin 2) (k : ℕ) (y : ℝ) :
    |iteratedDeriv k (fun t =>
      LocalizedMomentRepair.coefficients c.exponents c.lower c.upper (debt c amp eta) j *
        LocalizedMomentRepair.bump (c.lower j) (c.upper j) (Real.exp t)) y| ≤
      correctionJetBound c.P c.m k * Real.exp (-(1 / (4 * c.lam))) * (1 + |amp eta|)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.individual_correction_jet_eta_bound
statement:
theorem individual_correction_jet_eta_bound (c : Parameters) (hsmall : c.lam ≤ 1 / 120)
    {amp : ℝ → ℝ} {eta amp' : ℝ} (ha : HasDerivAt amp amp' eta) (heta : |eta| ≤ 1)
    (j : Fin 2) (k : ℕ) (y : ℝ) :
    |deriv (fun s => iteratedDeriv k (fun t =>
      LocalizedMomentRepair.coefficients c.exponents c.lower c.upper (debt c amp s) j *
        LocalizedMomentRepair.bump (c.lower j) (c.upper j) (Real.exp t)) y) eta| ≤
      (2 * correctionJetBound c.P c.m k) * Real.exp (-(1 / (4 * c.lam))) * (1 + |amp'|)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.individual_correction_jet_formula
statement:
theorem individual_correction_jet_formula (c : Parameters) (amp : ℝ → ℝ)
    (eta : ℝ) (j : Fin 2) (k : ℕ) (y : ℝ) :
    iteratedDeriv k (fun t =>
      LocalizedMomentRepair.coefficients c.exponents c.lower c.upper (debt c amp eta) j *
        LocalizedMomentRepair.bump (c.lower j) (c.upper j) (Real.exp t)) y =
      affineCoefficients c (parameterPolynomial eta) (amp eta) j *
        iteratedDeriv k logTemplate (y - center c j)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.paper_correction_bounds
statement:
theorem paper_correction_bounds (P m : ℝ) (hP : 0 < P) (hm : 0 < m) (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) (hsmall : lam ≤ 1 / 120),
      let c := paperParameters P m lam hP hm hlam (by linarith)
      ∀ (amp : ℝ → ℝ) (eta y : ℝ), |eta| ≤ 1 →
        |correctionJet c amp k eta y| ≤ C * Real.exp (-(1 / (4 * lam))) * (1 + |amp eta|) ∧
        ∀ amp' : ℝ, HasDerivAt amp amp' eta →
          |deriv (fun t => correctionJet c amp k t y) eta| ≤
            C * Real.exp (-(1 / (4 * lam))) * (1 + |amp'|)

name: NavierStokes.OutgoingPulseBounds.paper_prefix_bounds
statement:
theorem paper_prefix_bounds (P m : ℝ) (hP : 0 < P) (hm : 0 < m) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) (hsmall : lam ≤ 1 / 120),
      let c := paperParameters P m lam hP hm hlam (by linarith)
      pulseAmplitude c ≤ C * lam ^ 30 ∧
        ∀ (amp : ℝ → ℝ) (eta : ℝ), |eta| ≤ 1 →
          |massMoment c amp eta c.pulseStart /
            (Real.exp c.pulseStart * angular c.P c.dropLength c.lam (c.pulseStart, eta))| ≤ C * lam ^ 29 ∧
          |deriv (fun t => massMoment c amp t c.pulseStart /
            (Real.exp c.pulseStart * angular c.P c.dropLength c.lam (c.pulseStart, t))) eta| ≤ C * lam ^ 29

    0 < decayHold d ∧
    holdLag d (decayHold d) = tailLag d 0 ∧

      finalAngular d (y, eta) = angular d.core.P d.core.dropLength d.core.lam (y, eta)) ∧

    energyDensity d eta y ≤ 4 * energyDensity d eta d.releaseStart *
      (Real.exp 2 * Real.exp (-2 * (y - d.releaseStart)) +
        d.h ^ 8 * Real.exp 8 * Real.exp (-(2 * d.h) * (y - d.releaseStart)))

name: NavierStokes.TailEnergyBounds.energyDensity_release_eq
statement:
theorem energyDensity_release_eq (d : TailData) (eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ}
    (hy : d.releaseStart ≤ y) :
    energyDensity d eta y = energyDensity d eta d.releaseStart *
      Real.exp (2 * releasePrimitive d (y - d.releaseStart)) *
      (tailShape d (y - tailStart d) / (1 - d.rho)) ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.TailEnergyBounds.etaCoefficient_abs_le

theorem finalAngular_before_release (d : TailData) (eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ}

name: NavierStokes.TailEnergyBounds.finalAngular_hasDerivAt_eta
statement:
theorem finalAngular_hasDerivAt_eta (d : TailData) (eta y : ℝ) :

      (-(2 * (1 - sigma ((y - d.core.endpoint) / flattenLength)) * eta / (1 + eta ^ 2)) *
        finalAngular d (y, eta)) eta

theorem flattenFactor_le_one (d : TailData) (eta y : ℝ) (heta : eta ^ 2 ≤ 1) :

name: NavierStokes.TailEnergyBounds.h_secondRampStart_le

statement:

name: NavierStokes.TailEnergyBounds.integral_shift_exp
statement:
theorem integral_shift_exp {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (R : ℝ) :

theorem normalizedPostPulseEnergy_hasDerivAt (d : TailData) (eta : ℝ) :

statement:

statement:
theorem normalized_postPulseEnergy_le (d : TailData) (eta : ℝ) (heta : eta ^ 2 ≤ 1) :

statement:
theorem postPulseEnergy_le (d : TailData) (eta : ℝ) (heta : eta ^ 2 ≤ 1) :

statement:
theorem postPulseEnergy_le_length (d : TailData) (eta : ℝ) (heta : eta ^ 2 ≤ 1) :

name: NavierStokes.TailEnergyBounds.postPulseEnergy_nonneg
statement: theorem postPulseEnergy_nonneg (d : TailData) (eta : ℝ) : 0 ≤ postPulseEnergy d eta

statement:
theorem postPulseEnergy_split (d : TailData) (eta : ℝ) {a : ℝ}

statement:

theorem amplitude_derivative_bound_of_error (d : OutgoingTail.TailData) (eta e : ℝ)

    (hT : |deriv (normalizedTail d) eta| ≤ e) : |deriv (amplitude d) eta| ≤ 128 * e

name: NavierStokes.PulseAmplitude.amplitude_derivative_identity
statement:
theorem amplitude_derivative_identity (d : OutgoingTail.TailData) (eta : ℝ)
    (hc : constantTerm d eta < -(1 / 5)) :
    (2 * quadraticCoefficient d.core * amplitude d eta + linearTerm d.core eta) *
        deriv (amplitude d) eta +
      deriv (linearTerm d.core) eta * amplitude d eta + deriv (constantTerm d) eta = 0

statement:
theorem amplitude_energy_equation (d : OutgoingTail.TailData) (eta : ℝ)

statement: theorem amplitude_pos (d : OutgoingTail.TailData) (eta : ℝ) : 0 < amplitude d eta

name: NavierStokes.PulseAmplitude.amplitude_spec
statement:
theorem amplitude_spec (d : OutgoingTail.TailData)
    (hsmall : d.core.lam ≤ 1 / 120) (hwait : d.core.wait = 60 * Real.log (1 / d.core.lam))
    (hscale : errorScale d.core ≤ 1 / 1000) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (amplitude d) ∧ ∀ eta : ℝ, eta ^ 2 ≤ 1 →
      9 / 10 < amplitude d eta ∧ amplitude d eta < 6 / 5 ∧
      (∫ y, Real.exp y * (axial d.core (amplitude d) (y, eta) ^ 2 -
        OutgoingTail.finalAngular d (y, eta) ^ 2 / 2)) = 0 ∧
      |deriv (amplitude d) eta| ≤ 128 * errorScale d.core ∧
      (∀ A ∈ Icc (9 / 10 : ℝ) (6 / 5), totalEnergy d A eta = 0 → A = amplitude d eta)

name: NavierStokes.PulseAmplitude.amplitude_spec_of_error_bound
statement:
theorem amplitude_spec_of_error_bound (d : OutgoingTail.TailData) (eta e : ℝ)

    9 / 10 < amplitude d eta ∧ amplitude d eta < 6 / 5 ∧
      totalEnergy d (amplitude d eta) eta = 0

      quadraticCoefficient c - pulseConstant ≤ correctionEnergyConstant c.P c.m * c.lam ∧
      |linearCoefficient c| ≤ correctionEnergyConstant c.P c.m * c.lam ∧
      0 ≤ constantCorrection c ∧
      constantCorrection c ≤ correctionEnergyConstant c.P c.m * c.lam

theorem correction_eq_affine (c : Parameters) (amp : ℝ → ℝ) (eta y : ℝ) :

statement:
theorem energyIntegrand_integral_ideal (d : OutgoingTail.TailData) (A eta : ℝ) :

theorem energyIntegrand_integral_prefix (d : OutgoingTail.TailData) (A eta : ℝ) :

statement:
theorem energyIntegrand_integral_pulse (d : OutgoingTail.TailData) (A eta : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.PulseAmplitude.energyIntegrand_late
NavierStokes.PulseAmplitude.energyIntegrand_prefix
statement:
theorem energyIntegrand_prefix (d : OutgoingTail.TailData) (A eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ}
    (hy : y ≤ d.core.pulseStart) :
    energyIntegrand d A eta y =
      eta ^ 2 * (Real.exp y * dropCoefficient d.core.m y ^ 2) -
        shape eta ^ 2 * (coreEnergyWeight d.core y / 2)

name: NavierStokes.PulseAmplitude.energyIntegrand_pulse
statement:
theorem energyIntegrand_pulse (d : OutgoingTail.TailData) (A eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ}

    energyIntegrand d A eta y = normalization d.core * shape eta ^ 2 *
      (pulseWeight d.core (y - d.core.pulseStart) *
        (pulseRatio d.core (fun _ => A) (y - d.core.pulseStart, eta) ^ 2 - 1 / 2))

theorem exists_rate_threshold (C : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.PulseAmplitude.exists_uniform_amplitude_threshold
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_amplitude_threshold (P m : ℝ) (hP : 0 < P) :
    ∃ lam₀ C : ℝ, 0 < lam₀ ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∀ d : OutgoingTail.TailData,
      d.core.P = P → d.core.m = m → d.core.wait = 60 * Real.log (1 / d.core.lam) →
      d.core.lam < lam₀ →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (amplitude d) ∧ ∀ eta : ℝ, eta ^ 2 ≤ 1 →
        9 / 10 < amplitude d eta ∧ amplitude d eta < 6 / 5 ∧
        (∫ y, Real.exp y * (axial d.core (amplitude d) (y, eta) ^ 2 -
          OutgoingTail.finalAngular d (y, eta) ^ 2 / 2)) = 0 ∧
        |deriv (amplitude d) eta| ≤ C * d.core.lam * (1 + Real.log (1 / d.core.lam)) ∧
        (∀ A ∈ Icc (9 / 10 : ℝ) (6 / 5), totalEnergy d A eta = 0 → A = amplitude d eta)

      |linearTerm d.core eta| ≤ 1 / 100 ∧
      -(13 / 50) ≤ constantTerm d eta ∧ constantTerm d eta ≤ -(23 / 100)

statement:
theorem realized_energy_eq (d : OutgoingTail.TailData) (eta : ℝ) :
    (∫ y, Real.exp y * (axial d.core (amplitude d) (y, eta) ^ 2 -
      OutgoingTail.finalAngular d (y, eta) ^ 2 / 2)) = totalEnergy d (amplitude d eta) eta

name: NavierStokes.PulseAmplitude.repairBasis_bound
statement:
theorem repairBasis_bound (c : Parameters) (hsmall : c.lam ≤ 1 / 120) (y : ℝ) :
    |prefixRepair c y| ≤ OutgoingPulseBounds.correctionJetBound c.P c.m 0 *
        Real.exp (-(1 / (4 * c.lam))) ∧
      |amplitudeRepair c y| ≤ OutgoingPulseBounds.correctionJetBound c.P c.m 0 *
        Real.exp (-(1 / (4 * c.lam)))

name: NavierStokes.PulseAmplitude.scaledPulseEnergy_eq
statement:
theorem scaledPulseEnergy_eq (c : Parameters) (A eta : ℝ) :
    scaledPulseEnergy c A eta = quadraticCoefficient c * A ^ 2 +
      linearCoefficient c * etaPolynomial eta * A +
      constantCorrection c * etaPolynomial eta ^ 2 - RadialSchedule.pulseEnergyDebt

name: NavierStokes.PulseAmplitude.totalEnergy_eq
statement:
theorem totalEnergy_eq (d : OutgoingTail.TailData) (A eta : ℝ) :
    totalEnergy d A eta = prefixEnergy d.core eta +
      normalization d.core * shape eta ^ 2 / d.core.lam * scaledPulseEnergy d.core A eta -
        tailEnergy d eta / 2

name: NavierStokes.PulseAmplitude.totalEnergy_eq_of_integrable
statement:
theorem totalEnergy_eq_of_integrable (d : OutgoingTail.TailData) (A eta : ℝ)
    (htail : IntegrableOn (fun y => Real.exp y * OutgoingTail.finalAngular d (y, eta) ^ 2)
      (Ioi d.core.endpoint)) :
    totalEnergy d A eta = prefixEnergy d.core eta +
      normalization d.core * shape eta ^ 2 / d.core.lam * scaledPulseEnergy d.core A eta -
        tailEnergy d eta / 2

name: NavierStokes.PulseAmplitude.totalEnergy_normalized
statement:
theorem totalEnergy_normalized (d : OutgoingTail.TailData) (A eta : ℝ) :
    d.core.lam * totalEnergy d A eta / (normalization d.core * shape eta ^ 2) =
      energyPolynomial d A eta

name: NavierStokes.PulseAmplitude.weighted_product_bound
statement:
theorem weighted_product_bound (c : Parameters) (f g : ℝ → ℝ)

    |c.lam * (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..c.pulseLength, pulseWeight c y * f y * g y)| ≤ 13 * M ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.PulseAmplitude.weighted_square_bound
statement:
theorem weighted_square_bound (c : Parameters) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : Continuous f)

    0 ≤ c.lam * (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..c.pulseLength, pulseWeight c y * f y ^ 2) ∧
      c.lam * (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..c.pulseLength, pulseWeight c y * f y ^ 2) ≤ 13 * M ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.UniformAngularReset.ResetWitness.angular_change
statement:
theorem angular_change (eta : ℝ) :
    (∫ y, Real.exp (3 * y / 2) *
      (correctedAngular d w.coefficients (y, eta) - finalAngular d (y, eta))) =
      (baseWeight d (correctionCenter d) / 2) * normalizedDebt d eta

name: NavierStokes.UniformAngularReset.ResetWitness.correctedHistory_eq_integral
statement:
theorem correctedHistory_eq_integral (eta : ℝ) :
    correctedHistory d w.coefficients eta =
      ∫ t in Iic d.releaseStart, Real.exp (3 * t / 2) * correctedAngular d w.coefficients (t, eta)

name: NavierStokes.UniformAngularReset.ResetWitness.exact_endpoint
statement:
theorem exact_endpoint (eta : ℝ) : correctedHistory d w.coefficients eta =
    baseWeight d d.releaseStart / (2 * (1 - d.core.lam))

name: NavierStokes.UniformAngularReset.ResetWitness.logSlope_le
statement:
theorem logSlope_le (eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ} (hy : y ∈ Ioo (d.releaseStart - 4) d.releaseStart) :

name: NavierStokes.UniformAngularReset.ResetWitness.physical_endpoint
statement:
theorem physical_endpoint (eta : ℝ) :
    Real.sqrt 2 * correctedHistory d w.coefficients eta =
      (Real.exp d.releaseStart * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.exp d.releaseStart) *
        correctedAngular d w.coefficients (d.releaseStart, eta)) / (1 - d.core.lam)

name: NavierStokes.UniformAngularReset.ResetWitness.physical_integral_endpoint
statement:
theorem physical_integral_endpoint (eta : ℝ) :
    (∫ t in Iic d.releaseStart, Real.exp t * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.exp t) *
      correctedAngular d w.coefficients (t, eta)) =
      (Real.exp d.releaseStart * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.exp d.releaseStart) *
        correctedAngular d w.coefficients (d.releaseStart, eta)) / (1 - d.core.lam)

statement:

theorem pressure_neutral (eta : ℝ) :

statement:
theorem actual_debt_first_jet_bound (d : TailData) (hlam : d.core.lam ≤ 1 / 15) (eta : ℝ) :
    |normalizedDebt d eta| ≤ (3 * Real.exp 3) * d.core.lam ^ (28 : ℕ) ∧
    |deriv (normalizedDebt d) eta| ≤ (3 * Real.exp 3) * d.core.lam ^ (28 : ℕ)

name: NavierStokes.UniformAngularReset.actual_debt_tends_to_zero
statement:
theorem actual_debt_tends_to_zero (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ lam0 : ℝ, 0 < lam0 ∧ ∀ d : TailData, d.core.lam < lam0 → ∀ eta : ℝ,
      |normalizedDebt d eta| < ε ∧ |deriv (normalizedDebt d) eta| < ε

name: NavierStokes.UniformAngularReset.actual_moment_map
statement:
theorem actual_moment_map (lam : ℝ) (c : Coeff) :
    linearCLM lam c + quadraticCLM lam c c =
      ![∫ y, Real.exp (angularSlope lam * y) * relative c y,
        ∫ y, Real.exp (pressureSlope lam * y) * ((1 + relative c y) ^ 2 - 1)]

name: NavierStokes.UniformAngularReset.complete_angular_reset
statement:
theorem complete_angular_reset :
    ∃ lam0 : ℝ, 0 < lam0 ∧ ∀ d : TailData, d.core.lam < lam0 →
      ∃ c : ℝ → Coeff,
        ContDiff ℝ ∞ (correctedAngular d c) ∧
        (∀ p, 0 < correctedAngular d c p) ∧
        (∀ eta y, y ∉ Ioo (d.releaseStart - 4) d.releaseStart →
          correctedAngular d c (y, eta) = finalAngular d (y, eta)) ∧
        (∀ eta, (∫ y, (correctedAngular d c (y, eta)) ^ 2 - (finalAngular d (y, eta)) ^ 2) = 0 ∧
          Real.sqrt 2 * correctedHistory d c eta =
            (Real.exp d.releaseStart * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.exp d.releaseStart) *
              correctedAngular d c (d.releaseStart, eta)) / (1 - d.core.lam)) ∧
        (∀ eta y, y ∈ Ioo (d.releaseStart - 4) d.releaseStart →
          logSlope (fun t => correctedAngular d c (t, eta)) y ≤ -d.core.lam / 2)

NavierStokes.UniformAngularReset.corrected_difference_reference
statement:
theorem corrected_difference_reference (d : TailData) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta y : ℝ) :
    correctedAngular d c (y, eta) - finalAngular d (y, eta) =
      modifiedE d.core.lam (referenceAmplitude d) (correctionCenter d) (c eta) y -
        baseE d.core.lam (referenceAmplitude d) y

name: NavierStokes.UniformAngularReset.corrected_matches_reference
statement:
theorem corrected_matches_reference (d : TailData) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta : ℝ) {y : ℝ}
    (hy : y ∈ Ioo (d.releaseStart - 4) d.releaseStart) :
    correctedAngular d c (y, eta) =

statement:
theorem exists_smooth_solver_on_ball [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    (B : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (A : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] E)
    (β K r : ℝ) (hβ : 0 < β) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hinv : ∀ x, ‖B.symm x‖ ≤ β * ‖x‖) (hA : ‖A‖ ≤ K)
    (hsmall : 4 * β * K * r ≤ 1) :
    ∃ g : E → E, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (Metric.ball 0 (r / (4 * β))) ∧
      (∀ d ∈ Metric.ball 0 (r / (4 * β)), quadraticMap B A (g d) = d ∧ ‖g d‖ ≤ 2 * β * ‖d‖) ∧
      ∀ d ∈ Metric.ball 0 (r / (4 * β)), ∀ e ∈ Metric.ball 0 (r / (4 * β)),
        ‖g d - g e‖ ≤ 2 * β * ‖d - e‖

name: NavierStokes.UniformAngularReset.uniform_reset_branch

      ∃ c : ℝ → Coeff, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c (Ioo (-ε) ε) ∧ c 0 = 0 ∧
        ∀ δ ∈ Ioo (-ε) ε,
          (∫ y, Real.exp (angularSlope lam * y) * relative (c δ) y) = δ ∧
          (∫ y, Real.exp (pressureSlope lam * y) * ((1 + relative (c δ) y) ^ 2 - 1)) = 0 ∧
          ‖c δ‖ ≤ L * |δ| ∧ ‖deriv c δ‖ ≤ L ∧ ∀ y,
            |relative (c δ) y| ≤ L * |δ| ∧ |deriv (relative (c δ)) y| ≤ L * |δ|

name: NavierStokes.CorrectedPulseAmplitude.amplitude_clamped_equation
statement:
theorem amplitude_clamped_equation (d : TailData) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta : ℝ) :
    PulseAmplitude.quadraticCoefficient d.core * amplitude d c eta ^ 2 +
      PulseAmplitude.linearTerm d.core eta * amplitude d c eta +
      PulseAmplitude.negativeClamp (constantTerm d c eta) = 0

name: NavierStokes.CorrectedPulseAmplitude.amplitude_contDiff
statement:
theorem amplitude_contDiff (d : TailData) {c : ℝ → Coeff} (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) :

name: NavierStokes.CorrectedPulseAmplitude.amplitude_derivative_bound
statement:
theorem amplitude_derivative_bound (d : TailData) {c : ℝ → Coeff}
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (eta e : ℝ) (heta : eta ^ 2 ≤ 1)
    (h : PulseAmplitude.EnergyErrorBounds d eta e) (hshift : |energyShift d c eta| ≤ e)
    (he : e ≤ 1 / 1000) (hT : |deriv (PulseAmplitude.normalizedTail d) eta| ≤ e)
    (hs : |deriv (energyShift d c) eta| ≤ e) : |deriv (amplitude d c) eta| ≤ 128 * e

name: NavierStokes.CorrectedPulseAmplitude.amplitude_derivative_identity
statement:
theorem amplitude_derivative_identity (d : TailData) {c : ℝ → Coeff}
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (eta : ℝ) (hneg : constantTerm d c eta < -(1 / 5)) :
    (2 * PulseAmplitude.quadraticCoefficient d.core * amplitude d c eta +
        PulseAmplitude.linearTerm d.core eta) * deriv (amplitude d c) eta +
      deriv (PulseAmplitude.linearTerm d.core) eta * amplitude d c eta +
        deriv (constantTerm d c) eta = 0

name: NavierStokes.CorrectedPulseAmplitude.amplitude_energy_equation
statement:
theorem amplitude_energy_equation (d : TailData) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta : ℝ)
    (hc : constantTerm d c eta ≤ -(1 / 5)) : energyPolynomial d c (amplitude d c eta) eta = 0

name: NavierStokes.CorrectedPulseAmplitude.amplitude_pos
statement: theorem amplitude_pos (d : TailData) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta : ℝ) : 0 < amplitude d c eta

name: NavierStokes.CorrectedPulseAmplitude.amplitude_spec
statement:
theorem amplitude_spec {d : TailData} {K : ℝ} (w : ResetWitness d K) (hK : 0 < K)
    (hsmall : d.core.lam ≤ 1 / 120) (hwait : d.core.wait = 60 * Real.log (1 / d.core.lam))
    (hscale : combinedScale d K ≤ 1 / 1000) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (amplitude d w.coefficients) ∧ ∀ eta : ℝ, eta ^ 2 ≤ 1 →
      9 / 10 < amplitude d w.coefficients eta ∧ amplitude d w.coefficients eta < 6 / 5 ∧
      totalEnergy d w.coefficients (amplitude d w.coefficients eta) eta = 0 ∧
      |deriv (amplitude d w.coefficients) eta| ≤ 128 * combinedScale d K ∧
      (∀ A ∈ Icc (9 / 10 : ℝ) (6 / 5), totalEnergy d w.coefficients A eta = 0 →
        A = amplitude d w.coefficients eta)

name: NavierStokes.CorrectedPulseAmplitude.amplitude_spec_of_bounds
statement:
theorem amplitude_spec_of_bounds (d : TailData) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta e : ℝ)

    (hshift : |energyShift d c eta| ≤ e) (he : e ≤ 1 / 1000) :
    9 / 10 < amplitude d c eta ∧ amplitude d c eta < 6 / 5 ∧ totalEnergy d c (amplitude d c eta) eta = 0

statement:
theorem amplitude_totalEnergy_zero (d : TailData) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta : ℝ)

statement:
theorem amplitude_unique (d : TailData) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta e : ℝ)

name: NavierStokes.CorrectedPulseAmplitude.exists_corrected_amplitude
statement:
theorem exists_corrected_amplitude (P m : ℝ) (hP : 0 < P) :
    ∃ lam₀ K C : ℝ, 0 < lam₀ ∧ 0 < K ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∀ d : TailData,
      d.core.P = P → d.core.m = m → d.core.wait = 60 * Real.log (1 / d.core.lam) →
      d.core.lam < lam₀ → ∃ w : ResetWitness d K,
        ContDiff ℝ ∞ (amplitude d w.coefficients) ∧ ∀ eta : ℝ, eta ^ 2 ≤ 1 →
          9 / 10 < amplitude d w.coefficients eta ∧ amplitude d w.coefficients eta < 6 / 5 ∧
          totalEnergy d w.coefficients (amplitude d w.coefficients eta) eta = 0 ∧
          |deriv (amplitude d w.coefficients) eta| ≤ C * d.core.lam * (1 + Real.log (1 / d.core.lam)) ∧
          (∀ XR : ℝ, 0 < XR →
            IntegrableOn (radialEnergyIntegrand d w.coefficients (amplitude d w.coefficients) eta XR) (Ioi 0) ∧
            (∫ X in Ioi 0, radialEnergyIntegrand d w.coefficients (amplitude d w.coefficients) eta XR X) = 0) ∧
          (∀ A ∈ Icc (9 / 10 : ℝ) (6 / 5), totalEnergy d w.coefficients A eta = 0 →
            A = amplitude d w.coefficients eta)

name: NavierStokes.CorrectedPulseAmplitude.numerical_coefficient_bounds
statement:
theorem numerical_coefficient_bounds (d : TailData) (c : ℝ → Coeff) (eta e : ℝ)
    (heta : eta ^ 2 ≤ 1) (h : PulseAmplitude.EnergyErrorBounds d eta e)
    (hshift : |energyShift d c eta| ≤ e) (he : e ≤ 1 / 1000) :
    1 / 5 ≤ PulseAmplitude.quadraticCoefficient d.core ∧
      PulseAmplitude.quadraticCoefficient d.core ≤ 13 / 50 ∧
      |PulseAmplitude.linearTerm d.core eta| ≤ 1 / 100 ∧
      -(13 / 50) ≤ constantTerm d c eta ∧ constantTerm d c eta ≤ -(23 / 100)

name: NavierStokes.CorrectedPulseAmplitude.totalEnergy_eq

      energyPolynomial d c A eta

name: NavierStokes.DiagonalJetBounds.eventually_zero_tail_of_locallyFinite
NavierStokes.DiagonalJetBounds.exists_potential_tail_order
statement:
theorem exists_potential_tail_order {a : ℕ → ℝ} (ha : Tendsto a atTop atTop)
    {q : E → ℝ} {A : ℕ → E → V} {g L : ℕ → ℝ} {U : Set E}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ q U)
    (hA : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (A j) U) (hg : Monotone g)
    (hgtop : Tendsto g atTop atTop) (hb : CutStageBounds a q A g L U)
    (M Jmin : ℕ) (N : ℝ) :
    ∃ J : ℕ, Jmin ≤ J ∧ M ≤ J ∧ ∀ m ≤ M, ∀ x ∈ U,
      0 < q x → q x ≤ 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m
        (fun y => SolenoidalDiagonal.potentialSum a q A y -
          SolenoidalDiagonal.partialPotential a q A (J + 1) y) x‖ ≤
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ J * (q x) ^ N

name: NavierStokes.DiagonalJetBounds.exists_prefix_gain
statement:
theorem exists_prefix_gain (g L : ℕ → ℝ) (hgtop : Tendsto g atTop atTop)
    (M Jmin : ℕ) (N : ℝ) :
    ∃ J : ℕ, Jmin ≤ J ∧ M ≤ J ∧ ∀ m ≤ M, N ≤ g (J + 1) - L m

name: NavierStokes.DiagonalJetBounds.exists_uncut_tail_order
statement:
theorem exists_uncut_tail_order {a : ℕ → ℝ} (ha : Tendsto a atTop atTop)
    {q : E → ℝ} {A : ℕ → E → V} {g L : ℕ → ℝ} {U : Set E}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ q U)
    (hA : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (A j) U) (hg : Monotone g)
    (hgtop : Tendsto g atTop atTop) (hb : CutStageBounds a q A g L U)
    (M Jmin : ℕ) (N : ℝ) :
    ∃ J : ℕ, Jmin ≤ J ∧ M ≤ J ∧ ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧
      ∀ m ≤ M, ∀ x ∈ U, 0 < q x → q x < δ →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m
          (fun y => SolenoidalDiagonal.potentialSum a q A y -
            uncutPrefix A (J + 1) y) x‖ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ J * (q x) ^ N

name: NavierStokes.DiagonalJetBounds.exists_uncut_tail_order_eventually
statement:
theorem exists_uncut_tail_order_eventually {a : ℕ → ℝ} (ha : Tendsto a atTop atTop)
    {q : E → ℝ} {A : ℕ → E → V} {g L : ℕ → ℝ} {U : Set E}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ q U)
    (hA : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (A j) U) (hg : Monotone g)
    (hgtop : Tendsto g atTop atTop) (hb : CutStageBounds a q A g L U)
    {l : Filter E} (hlU : ∀ᶠ x in l, x ∈ U) (hlq : ∀ᶠ x in l, 0 < q x)
    (hqzero : Tendsto q l (𝓝 0)) (M Jmin : ℕ) (N : ℝ) :
    ∃ J : ℕ, Jmin ≤ J ∧ M ≤ J ∧ ∀ᶠ x in l, ∀ m ≤ M,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m
        (fun y => SolenoidalDiagonal.potentialSum a q A y -
          uncutPrefix A (J + 1) y) x‖ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ J * (q x) ^ N

name: NavierStokes.DiagonalJetBounds.norm_tsum_sub_prefix_jet_le
statement:
theorem norm_tsum_sub_prefix_jet_le {F : ℕ → E → V} {x : E}
    (hloc : ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, ∀ j : ℕ, K ≤ j → F j y = 0)
    (hF : ∀ j, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (F j) x)
    (g : ℕ → ℝ) (hg : Monotone g) (L q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1)
    (J m : ℕ)
    (hbound : ∀ j, J < j →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (F j) x‖ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j * q ^ (g j - L)) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m
      (fun y => (∑' j : ℕ, F j y) - ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), F j y) x‖ ≤
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ J * q ^ (g (J + 1) - L)

name: NavierStokes.DiagonalJetBounds.norm_tsum_sub_prefix_jet_le_of_locallyFinite
statement:
theorem norm_tsum_sub_prefix_jet_le_of_locallyFinite {F : ℕ → E → V} {x : E}
    (hloc : LocallyFinite (fun j => support (F j)))
    (hF : ∀ j, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (F j) x)
    (g : ℕ → ℝ) (hg : Monotone g) (L q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1)
    (J m : ℕ)
    (hbound : ∀ j, J < j →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (F j) x‖ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j * q ^ (g j - L)) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m
      (fun y => (∑' j : ℕ, F j y) - ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), F j y) x‖ ≤
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ J * q ^ (g (J + 1) - L)

name: NavierStokes.DiagonalJetBounds.partialPotential_eventuallyEq_uncut
statement:
theorem partialPotential_eventuallyEq_uncut (a : ℕ → ℝ) (q : E → ℝ)
    (A : ℕ → E → V) (N : ℕ) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x : E, ContinuousAt q x → |q x| < δ →
      SolenoidalDiagonal.partialPotential a q A N =ᶠ[𝓝 x] uncutPrefix A N

name: NavierStokes.DiagonalJetBounds.potential_tail_jet_bound
statement:
theorem potential_tail_jet_bound {a : ℕ → ℝ} (ha : Tendsto a atTop atTop)
    {q : E → ℝ} {A : ℕ → E → V} {g L : ℕ → ℝ} {U : Set E}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ q U)
    (hA : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (A j) U) (hg : Monotone g)
    (hb : CutStageBounds a q A g L U) {x : E} (hx : x ∈ U)
    (hqx : 0 < q x) (hqx1 : q x ≤ 1) (J m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ J + 3) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m
      (fun y => SolenoidalDiagonal.potentialSum a q A y -
        SolenoidalDiagonal.partialPotential a q A (J + 1) y) x‖ ≤
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ J * (q x) ^ (g (J + 1) - L m)

name: NavierStokes.DiagonalJetBounds.scalar_tail_bound
statement:
theorem scalar_tail_bound (g : ℕ → ℝ) (hg : Monotone g) (L q : ℝ)
    (hq : 0 < q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1) (J : ℕ) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ =>
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (J + 1 + n) * q ^ (g (J + 1 + n) - L)) ∧
    (∑' n : ℕ, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (J + 1 + n) * q ^ (g (J + 1 + n) - L)) ≤
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ J * q ^ (g (J + 1) - L)

name: NavierStokes.DiagonalJetBounds.tsum_jet_identity
statement:
theorem tsum_jet_identity {F : ℕ → E → V} {x : E}
    (hloc : ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, ∀ j : ℕ, K ≤ j → F j y = 0)
    (hF : ∀ j, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (F j) x) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y => ∑' j : ℕ, F j y) x ∧
      ∀ m : ℕ, Summable (fun j => iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (F j) x) ∧
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun y => ∑' j : ℕ, F j y) x =
          ∑' j : ℕ, iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (F j) x

name: NavierStokes.DiagonalJetBounds.tsum_sub_prefix_jet
statement:
theorem tsum_sub_prefix_jet {F : ℕ → E → V} {x : E}
    (hloc : ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, ∀ j : ℕ, K ≤ j → F j y = 0)
    (hF : ∀ j, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (F j) x) (J m : ℕ) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (F (J + 1 + n)) x) ∧
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ m
        (fun y => (∑' j : ℕ, F j y) - ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), F j y) x =
          ∑' n : ℕ, iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (F (J + 1 + n)) x

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalCoordinateBounds.dilation_apply

name: NavierStokes.PhysicalCoordinateBounds.eta_derivative_bound
statement:
theorem eta_derivative_bound {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1)

    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ p ∈ positiveTime, qCoord a p ≤ qbig → xCoord a p ∈ Icc lo hi →

NavierStokes.CutStageEstimates.cut_product_bound
statement:
theorem cut_product_bound {U S : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U) (hSU : S ⊆ U)
    {q : E → ℝ} (hq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ q U) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ S, 0 < q x)
    {A : E → V} (hA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ A U)
    (Q C p L : ℕ → ℝ) (g : ℝ)
    (hcut : ∀ k a, 0 ≤ a → ∀ x ∈ S, q x ≤ 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun y => SmoothCutoffs.scaledCutoff a (q y)) x‖ ≤
        Q k * q x ^ (-(k : ℝ)))
    (hraw : ∀ k x, x ∈ S → q x ≤ 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k A x‖ ≤
        C k * (1 + |Real.log (q x)|) ^ (p k) * q x ^ (g - L k))
    (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ ∀ a : ℝ, 0 ≤ a → ∀ x ∈ S, q x ≤ 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun y => SmoothCutoffs.scaledCutoff a (q y) • A y) x‖ ≤
        K * (1 + |Real.log (q x)|) ^ (finiteBound p m) * q x ^ (g - cutLoss L m)

name: NavierStokes.CutStageEstimates.cut_product_bound_of_threshold
statement:
theorem cut_product_bound_of_threshold {U S : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U) (hSU : S ⊆ U)
    {q : E → ℝ} (hq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ q U) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ S, 0 < q x)
    {A : E → V} (hA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ A U) (m : ℕ)
    {K P g L a ε : ℝ} (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hcut : ∀ c, 0 ≤ c → ∀ x ∈ S, q x ≤ 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun y => SmoothCutoffs.scaledCutoff c (q y) • A y) x‖ ≤
        K * (1 + |Real.log (q x)|) ^ P * q x ^ (g - L))
    (hsmall : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ 1 / a →
      |DiagonalScale.logPowerWeight K P (g / 2) r| ≤ ε) :
    ∀ x ∈ S,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun y => SmoothCutoffs.scaledCutoff a (q y) • A y) x‖ ≤
        ε * q x ^ (g / 2 - L)

statement:
theorem exists_cut_stage_constants {U S : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U) (hSU : S ⊆ U)
    {q : E → ℝ} (hq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ q U) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ S, 0 < q x)
    (B : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ k x, x ∈ S → q x ≤ 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k q x‖ ≤ B k * q x ^ (1 - (k : ℝ)))
    {A : ℕ → E → V} (hA : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (A j) U)
    (g L : ℕ → ℝ) (C p : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (hraw : RawStageBounds q A g L C p S) :
    ∃ K : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ, (∀ j m, 0 < K j m) ∧
      ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → ∀ m a, 0 ≤ a → ∀ x ∈ S, q x ≤ 1 →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun y => SmoothCutoffs.scaledCutoff a (q y) • A j y) x‖ ≤
          K j m * (1 + |Real.log (q x)|) ^ (cutLog p j m) * q x ^ (g j - cutLoss L m)

name: NavierStokes.CutStageEstimates.exists_diagonal_cut_bounds
statement:
theorem exists_diagonal_cut_bounds {U S : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U) (hSU : S ⊆ U)
    {q : E → ℝ} (hq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ q U) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ S, 0 < q x)
    (Bq : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hBq : ∀ k x, x ∈ S → q x ≤ 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k q x‖ ≤ Bq k * q x ^ (1 - (k : ℝ)))
    {A : ℕ → E → V} (hA : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (A j) U)
    (g L : ℕ → ℝ) (C p : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (hraw : RawStageBounds q A g L C p S) (hg : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < g j) (lower : ℕ) :
    ∃ a : ℕ → ℕ, lower ≤ a 0 ∧ (∀ j, 0 < a j) ∧
      (∀ j, 2 * a j ≤ a (j + 1)) ∧ StrictMono a ∧
      Tendsto (fun j => (a j : ℝ)) atTop atTop ∧
      DiagonalJetBounds.CutStageBounds (fun j => (a j : ℝ)) q A
        (fun j => g j / 2) (cutLoss L) S

name: NavierStokes.CutStageEstimates.exists_finite_diagonal_cut_bounds
statement:
theorem exists_finite_diagonal_cut_bounds {U S : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U) (hSU : S ⊆ U)
    {q : E → ℝ} (hq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ q U) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ S, 0 < q x)
    (Bq : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hBq : ∀ k x, x ∈ S → q x ≤ 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k q x‖ ≤ Bq k * q x ^ (1 - (k : ℝ)))
    {A : ∀ i, ℕ → E → W i} (hA : ∀ i j, 1 ≤ j → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (A i j) U)
    (g L : ℕ → ℝ) (C p : ι → ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (hraw : ∀ i, RawStageBounds q (A i) g L (C i) (p i) S)
    (hg : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < g j) (lower : ℕ) :
    ∃ a : ℕ → ℕ, lower ≤ a 0 ∧ (∀ j, 0 < a j) ∧
      (∀ j, 2 * a j ≤ a (j + 1)) ∧ StrictMono a ∧
      Tendsto (fun j => (a j : ℝ)) atTop atTop ∧
      ∀ i, DiagonalJetBounds.CutStageBounds (fun j => (a j : ℝ)) q (A i)
        (fun j => g j / 2) (cutLoss L) S

    (hraw : RawStageBounds (PhysicalWaveSum.physicalQ h) A g L C p S)

    ∃ a : ℕ → ℕ, lower ≤ a 0 ∧ (∀ j, 0 < a j) ∧
      (∀ j, 2 * a j ≤ a (j + 1)) ∧ StrictMono a ∧
      Tendsto (fun j => (a j : ℝ)) atTop atTop ∧
      DiagonalJetBounds.CutStageBounds (fun j => (a j : ℝ))

statement:
theorem exists_physical_local_diagonal_cut_bounds {h qbig : ℝ}
    (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2) (hqbig : 0 < qbig)
    {S : Set SpaceTime} (hS : S ⊆ PhysicalWaveSum.preterminal)
    {A : ∀ i, ℕ → SpaceTime → W i}
    (hA : ∀ i j, 1 ≤ j → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (A i j) (physicalSublevel h qbig))

    (hraw : ∀ i, RawStageBounds (PhysicalWaveSum.physicalQ h) (A i) g L (C i) (p i)
      (S ∩ physicalSublevel h qbig))
    (hg : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < g j) (lower : ℕ) :
    ∃ a : ℕ → ℕ, lower ≤ a 0 ∧ (∀ j, 0 < a j) ∧
      (∀ j, 2 * a j ≤ a (j + 1)) ∧ StrictMono a ∧
      Tendsto (fun j => (a j : ℝ)) atTop atTop ∧
      (∀ j, 1 / (a j : ℝ) < qbig) ∧
      ∀ i, DiagonalJetBounds.CutStageBounds (fun j => (a j : ℝ))
          (PhysicalWaveSum.physicalQ h) (positiveStages (A i))
          (fun j => g j / 2) (cutLoss L) S ∧
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
          (SolenoidalDiagonal.potentialSum (fun j => (a j : ℝ))
            (PhysicalWaveSum.physicalQ h) (positiveStages (A i))) PhysicalWaveSum.preterminal

      Tendsto (fun j => (a j : ℝ)) atTop atTop ∧

          (PhysicalWaveSum.physicalQ h) (positiveStages (A i))
          (fun j => g j / 2) (cutLoss L) S ∧
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞

name: NavierStokes.LocalAxisymmetricResidual.advection_velocity
statement:
theorem advection_velocity {B F U : Profile} {t : ℝ} {x : Space}
    (hB : DifferentiableAt ℝ B (profilePoint t x))
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F (profilePoint t x))
    (hU : DifferentiableAt ℝ U (profilePoint t x)) :
    advection (velocity B F U) t x =
      pack (x 0 * advectionRadial B F U (profilePoint t x) +
        x 1 * advectionAngular B F U (profilePoint t x))
      (x 1 * advectionRadial B F U (profilePoint t x) -
        x 0 * advectionAngular B F U (profilePoint t x))
      (advectionAxial B U (profilePoint t x))

statement:
theorem divergence_velocity {B F U : Profile} {t : ℝ} {x : Space}
    (hB : DifferentiableAt ℝ B (profilePoint t x))
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F (profilePoint t x))
    (hU : DifferentiableAt ℝ U (profilePoint t x)) :
    spatialDivergence (velocity B F U) t x =
      partialZ U (profilePoint t x) - 2 * B (profilePoint t x) -
        2 * radialEnergy x * partialS B (profilePoint t x)

    fderiv ℝ (lift G t) x v =

theorem navierStokesResidual_eq_zero {B F U P : Profile} {t : ℝ} {x : Space}
    (hB : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 B (profilePoint t x))

    (hU : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 U (profilePoint t x))
    (hP : DifferentiableAt ℝ P (profilePoint t x))
    (hr : residualRadial B F U P (profilePoint t x) = 0)
    (ha : residualAngular B F U (profilePoint t x) = 0)
    (hz : residualAxial B U P (profilePoint t x) = 0) :
    navierStokesResidual (velocity B F U) (pressure P) t x = 0

name: NavierStokes.LocalAxisymmetricResidual.navierStokesResidual_velocity
statement:
theorem navierStokesResidual_velocity {B F U P : Profile} {t : ℝ} {x : Space}
    (hB : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 B (profilePoint t x))
    (hF : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 F (profilePoint t x))
    (hU : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 U (profilePoint t x))
    (hP : DifferentiableAt ℝ P (profilePoint t x)) :
    navierStokesResidual (velocity B F U) (pressure P) t x =
      pack (x 0 * residualRadial B F U P (profilePoint t x) +
        x 1 * residualAngular B F U (profilePoint t x))
      (x 1 * residualRadial B F U P (profilePoint t x) -
        x 0 * residualAngular B F U (profilePoint t x))
      (residualAxial B U P (profilePoint t x))

theorem second_direction_coord_mul {g : Space → ℝ} {x : Space}
    (hg : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 g x) (i j : Fin 3) :
    direction (fun y => direction (fun z => z i * g z) j y) j x =

name: NavierStokes.LocalAxisymmetricResidual.spatialLaplacian_velocity
statement:
theorem spatialLaplacian_velocity {B F U : Profile} {t : ℝ} {x : Space}
    (hB : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 B (profilePoint t x))
    (hF : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 F (profilePoint t x))
    (hU : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 U (profilePoint t x)) :
    spatialLaplacian (velocity B F U) t x =
      pack (-x 0 * laplaceWeighted B (profilePoint t x) -
        x 1 * laplaceWeighted F (profilePoint t x))
      (-x 1 * laplaceWeighted B (profilePoint t x) +
        x 0 * laplaceWeighted F (profilePoint t x))
      (laplaceScalar U (profilePoint t x))

name: NavierStokes.LocalAxisymmetricResidual.temporalDerivative_velocity
statement:
theorem temporalDerivative_velocity {B F U : Profile} {t : ℝ} {x : Space}
    (hB : DifferentiableAt ℝ B (profilePoint t x))
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F (profilePoint t x))
    (hU : DifferentiableAt ℝ U (profilePoint t x)) :
    temporalDerivative (velocity B F U) t x =
      pack (-x 0 * partialT B (profilePoint t x) - x 1 * partialT F (profilePoint t x))
        (-x 1 * partialT B (profilePoint t x) + x 0 * partialT F (profilePoint t x))
        (partialT U (profilePoint t x))

name: NavierStokes.LocalAxisymmetricResidual.vectorLaplacian_pack

    vectorLaplacian (fun y => pack (a y) (b y) (c y)) x =
      pack (scalarLaplacian a x) (scalarLaplacian b x) (scalarLaplacian c x)

theorem cartesianAdvection_components {f : Space → Space} {q : Space}
    (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f (chart q)) (hr : q 0 ≠ 0) :

name: NavierStokes.CylindricalResidual.cartesianDerivative_components
statement:
theorem cartesianDerivative_components {f : Space → Space} {q : Space}
    (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f (chart q)) (hr : q 0 ≠ 0) (b : Space) :
    frame (-(q 1)) (fderiv ℝ f (chart q) (frame (q 1) b)) =
      b 0 • dCoord 0 (components f) q +
        (b 1 / q 0) • (dCoord 1 (components f) q + connection (components f q)) +
        b 2 • dCoord 2 (components f) q

statement:
theorem dCoord_pullback {f : Space → E} {q : Space}
    (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f (chart q)) (i : Fin 3) :

      fderiv ℝ f (chart q) (dCoord i chart q)

statement:
theorem divergence_cylindrical {u : VelocityField} {t : ℝ} {q : Space}
    (hu : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x => u (t, x)) (chart q)) (hr : 0 < q 0) :
    spatialDivergence u t (chart q) =
      vectorDivergence (fun y => velocityComponents u (t, y)) q

name: NavierStokes.CylindricalResidual.encode_components
statement:
theorem encode_components (f : Space → Space) :
    encode (components f) = fun q => f (chart q)

name: NavierStokes.CylindricalResidual.fderiv_encode
statement:
theorem fderiv_encode {w : Space → Space} {q : Space}
    (hw : DifferentiableAt ℝ w q) (v : Space) :
    fderiv ℝ (encode w) q v =
      frame (q 1) (fderiv ℝ w q v + v 1 • connection (w q))

name: NavierStokes.CylindricalResidual.fderiv_pack
statement:
theorem fderiv_pack (f : Space → E) (q : Space) (a b c : ℝ) :
    fderiv ℝ f q (pack a b c) =
      a • dCoord 0 f q + b • dCoord 1 f q + c • dCoord 2 f q

NavierStokes.CylindricalResidual.frame_apply
statement:
theorem frame_apply (θ : ℝ) (v : Space) :
    frame θ v = pack (Real.cos θ * v 0 - Real.sin θ * v 1)
      (Real.sin θ * v 0 + Real.cos θ * v 1) (v 2)

name: NavierStokes.CylindricalResidual.frame_connection
statement:
theorem frame_connection (θ : ℝ) :
    (frame θ).comp connection = -Real.sin θ • horizontal + Real.cos θ • connection

name: NavierStokes.CylindricalResidual.frame_inverse
statement: theorem frame_inverse (θ : ℝ) (v : Space) : frame (-θ) (frame θ v) = v

name: NavierStokes.CylindricalResidual.frame_inverse'
statement: theorem frame_inverse' (θ : ℝ) (v : Space) : frame θ (frame (-θ) v) = v

name: NavierStokes.CylindricalResidual.hasFDerivAt_frameField
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_frameField (q : Space) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun y : Space => frame (y 1))
      ((projection 1).smulRight ((frame (q 1)).comp connection)) q

name: NavierStokes.CylindricalResidual.navierStokesResidual_cylindrical
statement:
theorem navierStokesResidual_cylindrical
    {u : VelocityField} {p : PressureField} {t : ℝ} {q : Space}
    (hu : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 u (t, chart q))
    (hp : DifferentiableAt ℝ p (t, chart q)) (hr : 0 < q 0) :
    navierStokesResidual u p t (chart q) =
      frame (q 1) (cylindricalResidual (velocityComponents u) (pressurePullback p) t q)

name: NavierStokes.CylindricalResidual.navierStokesResidual_cylindrical_of_slices
statement:
theorem navierStokesResidual_cylindrical_of_slices

    (hp : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x => p (t, x)) (chart q))
    (hr : 0 < q 0) :
    navierStokesResidual u p t (chart q) =
      frame (q 1) (cylindricalResidual (velocityComponents u) (pressurePullback p) t q)

name: NavierStokes.CylindricalResidual.navierStokesResidual_of_representation
statement:
theorem navierStokesResidual_of_representation
    {u w : VelocityField} {p P : PressureField} {t : ℝ} {q : Space}
    (hu : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 u (t, chart q))
    (hp : DifferentiableAt ℝ p (t, chart q)) (hr : 0 < q 0)
    (hw : (fun tq : SpaceTime => u (tq.1, chart tq.2)) =ᶠ[𝓝 (t, q)]
      (fun tq => frame (tq.2 1) (w tq)))
    (hP : pressurePullback p =ᶠ[𝓝 (t, q)] P) :
    navierStokesResidual u p t (chart q) = frame (q 1) (cylindricalResidual w P t q)

name: NavierStokes.CylindricalResidual.navierStokesResidual_zero_iff
statement:
theorem navierStokesResidual_zero_iff
    {u : VelocityField} {p : PressureField} {t : ℝ} {q : Space}

statement:
theorem second_chain {f : Space → E} {g : Space → Space} {q : Space}
    (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f (g q)) (hg : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 g q) (i : Fin 3) :
    dCoord i (dCoord i (f ∘ g)) q =
      hessian f (g q) (dCoord i g q) (dCoord i g q) +
        fderiv ℝ f (g q) (dCoord i (dCoord i g) q)

name: NavierStokes.CylindricalResidual.trace_rotation
statement:
theorem trace_rotation (A : Space →L[ℝ] Space) (θ : ℝ) :
    (∑ i : Fin 3, (A (coordinateVector i)) i) =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, (frame (-θ) (A (frame θ (coordinateVector i)))) i

name: NavierStokes.CylindricalResidual.vectorAdvection_angular
statement:
theorem vectorAdvection_angular (w : Space → Space) (q : Space) :
    vectorAdvection w q 1 =
      w q 0 * dCoord 0 w q 1 + w q 1 / q 0 * dCoord 1 w q 1 +
        w q 2 * dCoord 2 w q 1 + w q 0 * w q 1 / q 0

name: NavierStokes.CylindricalResidual.vectorAdvection_axial
statement:
theorem vectorAdvection_axial (w : Space → Space) (q : Space) :
    vectorAdvection w q 2 =
      w q 0 * dCoord 0 w q 2 + w q 1 / q 0 * dCoord 1 w q 2 +
        w q 2 * dCoord 2 w q 2

name: NavierStokes.CylindricalResidual.vectorAdvection_radial
statement:
theorem vectorAdvection_radial (w : Space → Space) (q : Space) :
    vectorAdvection w q 0 =
      w q 0 * dCoord 0 w q 0 + w q 1 / q 0 * dCoord 1 w q 0 +
        w q 2 * dCoord 2 w q 0 - (w q 1) ^ 2 / q 0

name: NavierStokes.CylindricalResidual.vectorLaplacian_angular
statement:
theorem vectorLaplacian_angular (w : Space → Space) (q : Space) :
    vectorLaplacian w q 1 = scalarLaplacian w q 1 -
      w q 1 / (q 0) ^ 2 + 2 * dCoord 1 w q 0 / (q 0) ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.CylindricalResidual.vectorLaplacian_axial
statement:
theorem vectorLaplacian_axial (w : Space → Space) (q : Space) :
    vectorLaplacian w q 2 = scalarLaplacian w q 2

name: NavierStokes.CylindricalResidual.vectorLaplacian_radial
statement:
theorem vectorLaplacian_radial (w : Space → Space) (q : Space) :
    vectorLaplacian w q 0 = scalarLaplacian w q 0 -
      w q 0 / (q 0) ^ 2 - 2 * dCoord 1 w q 1 / (q 0) ^ 2

NavierStokes.DiagonalJetBoundsNoOptions.exists_potential_tail_order
statement:
theorem exists_potential_tail_order {a : ℕ → ℝ} (ha : Tendsto a atTop atTop)
    {q : E → ℝ} {A : ℕ → E → V} {g L : ℕ → ℝ} {U : Set E}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ q U)
    (hA : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (A j) U) (hg : Monotone g)
    (hgtop : Tendsto g atTop atTop) (hb : CutStageBounds a q A g L U)
    (M Jmin : ℕ) (N : ℝ) :
    ∃ J : ℕ, Jmin ≤ J ∧ M ≤ J ∧ ∀ m ≤ M, ∀ x ∈ U,
      0 < q x → q x ≤ 1 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m
        (fun y => SolenoidalDiagonal.potentialSum a q A y -
          SolenoidalDiagonal.partialPotential a q A (J + 1) y) x‖ ≤
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ J * (q x) ^ N

name: NavierStokes.DiagonalJetBoundsNoOptions.exists_uncut_tail_order
statement:
theorem exists_uncut_tail_order {a : ℕ → ℝ} (ha : Tendsto a atTop atTop)
    {q : E → ℝ} {A : ℕ → E → V} {g L : ℕ → ℝ} {U : Set E}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ q U)
    (hA : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (A j) U) (hg : Monotone g)
    (hgtop : Tendsto g atTop atTop) (hb : CutStageBounds a q A g L U)
    (M Jmin : ℕ) (N : ℝ) :
    ∃ J : ℕ, Jmin ≤ J ∧ M ≤ J ∧ ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧
      ∀ m ≤ M, ∀ x ∈ U, 0 < q x → q x < δ →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m
          (fun y => SolenoidalDiagonal.potentialSum a q A y -
            uncutPrefix A (J + 1) y) x‖ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ J * (q x) ^ N

statement:
theorem exists_uncut_tail_order_eventually {a : ℕ → ℝ} (ha : Tendsto a atTop atTop)

    (hqzero : Tendsto q l (𝓝 0)) (M Jmin : ℕ) (N : ℝ) :
    ∃ J : ℕ, Jmin ≤ J ∧ M ≤ J ∧ ∀ᶠ x in l, ∀ m ≤ M,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m

name: NavierStokes.DiagonalJetBoundsNoOptions.norm_tsum_sub_prefix_jet_le
statement:
theorem norm_tsum_sub_prefix_jet_le {F : ℕ → E → V} {x : E}
    (hloc : ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, ∀ j : ℕ, K ≤ j → F j y = 0)
    (hF : ∀ j, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (F j) x)
    (g : ℕ → ℝ) (hg : Monotone g) (L q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1)
    (J m : ℕ)
    (hbound : ∀ j, J < j →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (F j) x‖ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j * q ^ (g j - L)) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m
      (fun y => (∑' j : ℕ, F j y) - ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), F j y) x‖ ≤
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ J * q ^ (g (J + 1) - L)

statement:

    (hF : ∀ j, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (F j) x)

name: NavierStokes.DiagonalJetBoundsNoOptions.potential_tail_jet_bound
statement:
theorem potential_tail_jet_bound {a : ℕ → ℝ} (ha : Tendsto a atTop atTop)
    {q : E → ℝ} {A : ℕ → E → V} {g L : ℕ → ℝ} {U : Set E}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ q U)
    (hA : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (A j) U) (hg : Monotone g)
    (hb : CutStageBounds a q A g L U) {x : E} (hx : x ∈ U)
    (hqx : 0 < q x) (hqx1 : q x ≤ 1) (J m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ J + 3) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m
      (fun y => SolenoidalDiagonal.potentialSum a q A y -
        SolenoidalDiagonal.partialPotential a q A (J + 1) y) x‖ ≤

name: NavierStokes.DiagonalJetBoundsNoOptions.scalar_tail_bound
statement:
theorem scalar_tail_bound (g : ℕ → ℝ) (hg : Monotone g) (L q : ℝ)
    (hq : 0 < q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1) (J : ℕ) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ =>
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (J + 1 + n) * q ^ (g (J + 1 + n) - L)) ∧
    (∑' n : ℕ, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (J + 1 + n) * q ^ (g (J + 1 + n) - L)) ≤

name: NavierStokes.DiagonalJetBoundsNoOptions.tsum_jet_identity
statement:
theorem tsum_jet_identity {F : ℕ → E → V} {x : E}
    (hloc : ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, ∀ j : ℕ, K ≤ j → F j y = 0)
    (hF : ∀ j, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (F j) x) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y => ∑' j : ℕ, F j y) x ∧
      ∀ m : ℕ, Summable (fun j => iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (F j) x) ∧
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun y => ∑' j : ℕ, F j y) x =
          ∑' j : ℕ, iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (F j) x

name: NavierStokes.DiagonalJetBoundsNoOptions.tsum_sub_prefix_jet
statement:
theorem tsum_sub_prefix_jet {F : ℕ → E → V} {x : E}
    (hloc : ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, ∀ j : ℕ, K ≤ j → F j y = 0)
    (hF : ∀ j, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (F j) x) (J m : ℕ) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (F (J + 1 + n)) x) ∧
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ m
        (fun y => (∑' j : ℕ, F j y) - ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), F j y) x =
          ∑' n : ℕ, iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (F (J + 1 + n)) x

theorem allJetsFlat_diagonal_residual {a : ℕ → ℝ} (ha : Tendsto a atTop atTop)
    {q : SpaceTime → ℝ} {A : ℕ → VelocityField} {P : ℕ → PressureField}
    {g LA LP Lbg Lres : ℕ → ℝ} {U : Set SpaceTime} {l : Filter SpaceTime}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hqpos : ∀ z ∈ U, 0 < q z) (hq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ q U)
    (hA : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (A j) U) (hP : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (P j) U)
    (hgmono : Monotone g) (hgtop : Tendsto g atTop atTop)
    (hbA : DiagonalJetBounds.CutStageBounds a q A g LA U)
    (hbP : DiagonalJetBounds.CutStageBounds a q P g LP U)
    (hlU : ∀ᶠ z in l, z ∈ U) (hqzero : Tendsto q l (𝓝 0))
    (hbg : ∀ J m, JetRate l q
      (SpatialCurl.spatialCurl (DiagonalJetBounds.uncutPrefix A (J + 1))) m (-Lbg m))
    (hres : ∀ J m, JetRate l q
      (fun z => navierStokesResidual
        (SpatialCurl.spatialCurl (DiagonalJetBounds.uncutPrefix A (J + 1)))
        (DiagonalJetBounds.uncutPrefix P (J + 1)) z.1 z.2) m (g J - Lres m)) :
    AllJetsFlat l q (fun z => navierStokesResidual
      (SolenoidalDiagonal.velocitySum a q A)
      (SolenoidalDiagonal.potentialSum a q P) z.1 z.2)

statement:
theorem allJetsFlat_residual_of_stages {U : Set SpaceTime} {l : Filter SpaceTime}
    {q : SpaceTime → ℝ} {u : VelocityField} {p : PressureField}
    {uStage : ℕ → VelocityField} {pStage : ℕ → PressureField}
    {g Lbg Ltail Lres : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hlU : ∀ᶠ z in l, z ∈ U)
    (hq : ∀ᶠ z in l, 0 < q z ∧ q z ≤ 1)
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u U) (hp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ p U)
    (hus : ∀ J, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (uStage J) U)
    (hps : ∀ J, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pStage J) U)
    (hg : Tendsto g atTop atTop)
    (hbg : ∀ J m, JetRate l q (uStage J) m (-Lbg m))
    (htu : ∀ J m, m ≤ J →
      JetRate l q (fun z => u z - uStage J z) m (g J - Ltail m))
    (htp : ∀ J m, m ≤ J →
      JetRate l q (fun z => p z - pStage J z) m (g J - Ltail m))
    (hres : ∀ J m, JetRate l q
      (fun z => navierStokesResidual (uStage J) (pStage J) z.1 z.2) m (g J - Lres m)) :
    AllJetsFlat l q (fun z => navierStokesResidual u p z.1 z.2)

theorem perturbation_majorant_le {q A W P b n t d p k : ℝ}
    (hq : 0 < q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hW : 0 ≤ W) (hP : 0 ≤ P)
    (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hn : 0 ≤ n)
    (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hd : 0 ≤ d) (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hk : 0 ≤ k) :
    t * (W * q ^ (n + b)) + d * (W * q ^ (n + b)) + p * (P * q ^ (n + b)) +
      k * (A * q ^ (-b)) * (W * q ^ (n + b)) +
      k * (W * q ^ (n + b)) * (A * q ^ (-b)) +
      k * (W * q ^ (n + b)) * (W * q ^ (n + b)) ≤
      (t * W + d * W + p * P + k * A * W + k * W * A + k * W * W) * q ^ n

name: NavierStokes.DiagonalResidual.power_product_le

    (A * q ^ r) * (B * q ^ s) ≤ (A * B) * q ^ n

name: NavierStokes.DiagonalResidual.residualDifference_jetRate
statement:
theorem residualDifference_jetRate {U : Set SpaceTime} {l : Filter SpaceTime}
    {q : SpaceTime → ℝ} {u w : VelocityField} {p r : PressureField}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hlU : ∀ᶠ z in l, z ∈ U)
    (hq : ∀ᶠ z in l, 0 < q z ∧ q z ≤ 1)
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u U) (hw : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w U)
    (hp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ p U) (hr : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ r U)
    (m : ℕ) {b n : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hn : 0 ≤ n)
    (hbg : FiniteJetRate l q u (m + 1) (-b))
    (hwu : FiniteJetRate l q w (m + 2) (n + b))
    (hpr : FiniteJetRate l q r (m + 1) (n + b)) :
    JetRate l q (residualDifference u w p r) m n

name: NavierStokes.DiagonalResidual.residual_jetRate_of_stages
statement:
theorem residual_jetRate_of_stages {U : Set SpaceTime} {l : Filter SpaceTime}
    {q : SpaceTime → ℝ} {u : VelocityField} {p : PressureField}
    {uStage : ℕ → VelocityField} {pStage : ℕ → PressureField}
    {g Lbg Ltail Lres : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hlU : ∀ᶠ z in l, z ∈ U)
    (hq : ∀ᶠ z in l, 0 < q z ∧ q z ≤ 1)
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u U) (hp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ p U)
    (hus : ∀ J, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (uStage J) U)
    (hps : ∀ J, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pStage J) U)
    (hg : Tendsto g atTop atTop)
    (hbg : ∀ J m, JetRate l q (uStage J) m (-Lbg m))
    (htu : ∀ J m, m ≤ J →
      JetRate l q (fun z => u z - uStage J z) m (g J - Ltail m))
    (htp : ∀ J m, m ≤ J →
      JetRate l q (fun z => p z - pStage J z) m (g J - Ltail m))
    (hres : ∀ J m, JetRate l q
      (fun z => navierStokesResidual (uStage J) (pStage J) z.1 z.2) m (g J - Lres m))
    (m : ℕ) (n : ℝ) (hn : 0 ≤ n) :
    JetRate l q (fun z => navierStokesResidual u p z.1 z.2) m n

name: NavierStokes.DiagonalResidual.spatialCurl_sub_on
statement:

    EqOn (SpatialCurl.spatialCurl (fun z => A z - B z))
      (fun z => SpatialCurl.spatialCurl A z - SpatialCurl.spatialCurl B z) U

        waveExponent (stageParameter n) + particularGain (stageParameter n) κ ∧
    waveExponent (stageParameter (n + 1)) <
        waveExponent (stageParameter n) + signedGain (stageParameter n) κ ∧
    waveExponent (stageParameter (n + 1)) < meanUpdateExponent (stageParameter n) κ ∧
    meanExponent (stageParameter (n + 1)) <
        meanExponent (stageParameter n) + min (17 / 100) (1 - 4 * κ) ∧
    meanExponent (stageParameter (n + 1)) <
        meanExponent (stageParameter n) + 9 / 10 - 4 * κ

statement:
theorem outgoingEdit_eventual_heat (d : TailData) (ν eta : ℝ) {K X : ℝ}
    (hK : 0 < K) (hX : 0 < X) (htail : 3 ≤ Real.log (X / K) + 1 / 5) :

      outgoingAmplitude d * (X / K) ^ (-exponent d.h) *
        tailShape d (Real.log (X / K) + 1 / 5) *
          RadialHeatProfile.profile (1 + d.h) (2 * ν / X)

theorem outgoing_pressure_eta_contDiff (d : TailData) (ν : ℝ) {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun eta => pressureDebt (outgoingProfile d K eta) d.h ν K)

name: NavierStokes.HeatTailEdit.outgoing_pressure_eta_jet_zero
statement:
theorem outgoing_pressure_eta_jet_zero (d : TailData) (ν : ℝ) {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K)
    (n : ℕ) (eta : ℝ) :
    iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (fun eta => pressureDebt (outgoingProfile d K eta) d.h ν K) eta = 0

name: NavierStokes.HeatTailEdit.outgoing_pressure_jet_bound
statement:
theorem outgoing_pressure_jet_bound (d : TailData) {ν K : ℝ} (hν : 0 < ν) (hK : 0 < K)
    (n : ℕ) (eta : ℝ) :
    |iteratedDeriv n (fun eta => pressureDebt (outgoingProfile d K eta) d.h ν K) eta| ≤
      2 * heatConstant d.h ν * outgoingAmplitude d ^ 2 / (K * (2 * exponent d.h + 1))

name: NavierStokes.HeatTailEdit.outgoing_squareChange_eq
statement:
theorem outgoing_squareChange_eq (d : TailData) (ν eta : ℝ) {K X : ℝ}
    (hK : 0 < K) (hX : K ≤ X) :
    squareChange (outgoingProfile d K eta) d.h ν K X =
      squareChange (powerTail d.h (outgoingAmplitude d) K (outgoingShape d)) d.h ν K X

name: NavierStokes.HeatTailEdit.powerTail_angular
statement:
theorem powerTail_angular {h ν K e M : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hν : 0 < ν)
    (hK : 0 < K) (he : 0 ≤ e) {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hbound : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → |f t| ≤ M) :
    IntegrableOn (fun X => Real.sqrt (2 * X) * change (powerTail h e K f) h ν K X) (Ioi K) ∧
      |angularDebt (powerTail h e K f) h ν K| ≤
        Real.sqrt 2 * heatConstant h ν * e * M * Real.sqrt K / h

name: NavierStokes.HeatTailEdit.powerTail_bound
statement:
theorem powerTail_bound {K e M X : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (he : 0 ≤ e) (hX : K ≤ X)
    (h : ℝ) {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → |f t| ≤ M) :
    |powerTail h e K f X| ≤ e * M * (X / K) ^ (-exponent h)

name: NavierStokes.HeatTailEdit.powerTail_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem powerTail_contDiffOn {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (h e : ℝ) {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (powerTail h e K f) (Ioi 0)

name: NavierStokes.HeatTailEdit.powerTail_energy
statement:
theorem powerTail_energy {h ν K e M : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hν : 0 < ν)
    (hK : 0 < K) (he : 0 ≤ e) (hM : 0 ≤ M) {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hbound : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → |f t| ≤ M) :
    IntegrableOn (squareChange (powerTail h e K f) h ν K) (Ioi K) ∧
      |energyDebt (powerTail h e K f) h ν K| ≤
        2 * heatConstant h ν * e ^ 2 * M ^ 2 / (2 * exponent h)

name: NavierStokes.HeatTailEdit.powerTail_pressure
statement:
theorem powerTail_pressure {h ν K e M : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hν : 0 < ν)
    (hK : 0 < K) (he : 0 ≤ e) (hM : 0 ≤ M) {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hbound : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → |f t| ≤ M) :
    IntegrableOn (fun X => squareChange (powerTail h e K f) h ν K X / X) (Ioi K) ∧
      |pressureDebt (powerTail h e K f) h ν K| ≤
        2 * heatConstant h ν * e ^ 2 * M ^ 2 / (K * (2 * exponent h + 1))

name: NavierStokes.HeatTailEdit.powerTail_square_bound
statement:
theorem powerTail_square_bound {K e M X : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (he : 0 ≤ e)
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hX : K ≤ X) (h : ℝ) {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → |f t| ≤ M) :
    powerTail h e K f X ^ 2 ≤ e ^ 2 * M ^ 2 * (X / K) ^ (-2 * exponent h)

name: NavierStokes.HeatTailEdit.powerTail_weighted_change
statement:
theorem powerTail_weighted_change {h ν K e M q : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hν : 0 < ν)
    (hK : 0 < K) (he : 0 ≤ e) {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hbound : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → |f t| ≤ M) (hq : q < exponent h) :
    IntegrableOn (fun X => X ^ q * change (powerTail h e K f) h ν K X) (Ioi K) ∧
      |∫ X in Ioi K, X ^ q * change (powerTail h e K f) h ν K X| ≤
        heatConstant h ν * e * M * K ^ q / (exponent h - q)

name: NavierStokes.HeatTailEdit.powerTail_weighted_squareChange
statement:
theorem powerTail_weighted_squareChange {h ν K e M q : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hν : 0 < ν)
    (hK : 0 < K) (he : 0 ≤ e) (hM : 0 ≤ M) {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hbound : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → |f t| ≤ M) (hq : q < 2 * exponent h) :
    IntegrableOn (fun X => X ^ q * squareChange (powerTail h e K f) h ν K X) (Ioi K) ∧
      |∫ X in Ioi K, X ^ q * squareChange (powerTail h e K f) h ν K X| ≤
        2 * heatConstant h ν * e ^ 2 * M ^ 2 * K ^ q / (2 * exponent h - q)

name: NavierStokes.HeatTailEdit.pressureDebt_eq
statement:
theorem pressureDebt_eq (E : ℝ → ℝ) (h ν K : ℝ) :
    pressureDebt E h ν K = ∫ X in Ioi K, X ^ (-1 : ℝ) * squareChange E h ν K X

name: NavierStokes.HeatTailEdit.squareChange_bound
statement:
theorem squareChange_bound {E : ℝ → ℝ} {h ν K X : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hν : 0 ≤ ν)
    (hX : 0 < X) : |squareChange E h ν K X| ≤
      2 * heatConstant h ν * E X ^ 2 / X

name: NavierStokes.HeatTailEdit.switch_one

name: NavierStokes.HeatTailEdit.switch_zero

name: NavierStokes.HeatTailEdit.weightedKernel_eq
statement:
theorem weightedKernel_eq {K X : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (hX : 0 < X) (p q : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.HeatTailEdit.weightedKernel_integrable
statement:
theorem weightedKernel_integrable {K p q : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (hpq : p + q < 0) :

name: NavierStokes.HeatTailEdit.weighted_integral_bound
statement:
theorem weighted_integral_bound {K p q B : ℝ} {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hK : 0 < K)
    (hpq : p + q < 0) (hg : ContinuousOn g (Ioi K))
    (hb : ∀ X ∈ Ioi K, |g X| ≤ B * (X / K) ^ p / X) :
    IntegrableOn (fun X => X ^ q * g X) (Ioi K) ∧
      |∫ X in Ioi K, X ^ q * g X| ≤ B * K ^ q / (-p - q)

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.correctionJet_continuousOn_X
statement:
theorem correctionJet_continuousOn_X {h K ν : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h)

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.correctionJet_eq_iteratedDerivWithin
statement:
theorem correctionJet_eq_iteratedDerivWithin {h K X ν : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hX : 0 < X) (hν : 0 ≤ ν) (n : ℕ) :
    iteratedDerivWithin n (fun u => multiplier h u K X - 1) (Ici 0) ν =
      correctionJet h K n ν X

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.correctionJet_hasDerivWithinAt
statement:
theorem correctionJet_hasDerivWithinAt {h K ν X : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hX : 0 < X) (hν : 0 ≤ ν) (n : ℕ) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (fun u => correctionJet h K n u X)
      (correctionJet h K (n + 1) ν X) (Ici 0) ν

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.correctionJet_zero
statement:
theorem correctionJet_zero (h K ν X : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.diffusion_of_physical_coordinates

theorem diffusion_of_physical_coordinates {q τ z : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hrel : q = τ + z ^ 2) :

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.etaDebt_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem etaDebt_contDiffOn (d : TailData) {K : ℝ} (hK : 1 ≤ K) (square : Bool)
    {q : ℝ} (hq : tailDecay d square + q < 0) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (etaDebt d K square q) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.etaDebt_hasDerivWithinAt
statement:
theorem etaDebt_hasDerivWithinAt (d : TailData) {K : ℝ} (hK : 1 ≤ K) (square : Bool)
    {q : ℝ} (hq : tailDecay d square + q < 0) {eta : ℝ} (hη : eta ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (etaDebt d K square q)
      (nuDebtJet d K square q 1 (diffusion eta) * (-2 * eta)) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) eta

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.etaDebt_jet_bound
statement:
theorem etaDebt_jet_bound (d : TailData) {K : ℝ} (hK : 1 ≤ K) (square : Bool)

    (hη : eta ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    |iteratedDerivWithin n (etaDebt d K square q) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) eta| ≤
      etaConstant d square q n * K ^ q

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.exists_physical_debt_C1_bounds
statement:
theorem exists_physical_debt_C1_bounds (d : TailData) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ K : ℝ, 1 ≤ K → ∀ eta ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
      |physicalPressure d K eta| ≤ C / K ∧
      |derivWithin (physicalPressure d K) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) eta| ≤ C / K ∧
      |physicalEnergy d K eta| ≤ C ∧
      |derivWithin (physicalEnergy d K) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) eta| ≤ C ∧
      |physicalAngular d K eta| ≤ C * Real.sqrt K ∧
      |derivWithin (physicalAngular d K) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) eta| ≤ C * Real.sqrt K

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.exists_physical_debt_jet_bounds
statement:
theorem exists_physical_debt_jet_bounds (d : TailData) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ K : ℝ, 1 ≤ K → ∀ eta ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
      |iteratedDerivWithin n (physicalPressure d K) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) eta| ≤ C / K ∧
      |iteratedDerivWithin n (physicalEnergy d K) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) eta| ≤ C ∧
      |iteratedDerivWithin n (physicalAngular d K) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) eta| ≤ C * Real.sqrt K

theorem jetProduct_bound {a b A B : ℕ → ℝ} {X : ℝ} (hX : 1 ≤ X)
    (hA : ∀ i, 0 ≤ A i) (hB : ∀ i, 0 ≤ B i)
    (ha : ∀ i, |a i| ≤ A i / X) (hb : ∀ i, |b i| ≤ B i / X) (n : ℕ) :

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.jetProduct_continuousOn
NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.jetProduct_hasDerivWithinAt
statement:
theorem jetProduct_hasDerivWithinAt {a b : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ} {s : Set ℝ} {ν : ℝ}
    (ha : ∀ i, HasDerivWithinAt (a i) (a (i + 1) ν) s ν)
    (hb : ∀ i, HasDerivWithinAt (b i) (b (i + 1) ν) s ν) (n : ℕ) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (fun u => jetProduct (fun i => a i u) (fun i => b i u) n)
      (jetProduct (fun i => a i ν) (fun i => b i ν) (n + 1)) s ν

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.multiplier_nu_jet_bound

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.outgoing_debts_integrable
statement:
theorem outgoing_debts_integrable (d : TailData) {K ν : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (hν : 0 ≤ ν)
    (eta : ℝ) :
    IntegrableOn (fun X => squareChange (outgoingProfile d K eta) d.h ν K X / X) (Ioi K) ∧
    IntegrableOn (squareChange (outgoingProfile d K eta) d.h ν K) (Ioi K) ∧
    IntegrableOn (fun X => Real.sqrt (2 * X) * change (outgoingProfile d K eta) d.h ν K X)

name: NavierStokes.ParametricHeatTail.physicalAngular_hasDerivWithinAt
statement:
theorem physicalAngular_hasDerivWithinAt (d : TailData) {K : ℝ} (hK : 1 ≤ K)

    q ^ (-exponent d.h) * physicalEdit d K eta (s / q) =

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.exists_heat_compensation
statement:
theorem exists_heat_compensation (P : Patch) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam)
    (T : OutgoingTail.TailData) (ν q : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (hq : 0 < q)
    {U S : Set ℝ} (hU : IsOpen U) (hS : IsCompact S) (hSU : S ⊆ U)
    (a : ℝ → ℝ) (ha : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a U) (hpos : ∀ η ∈ U, 0 < a η) :
    ∃ K₀ C : ℝ, 0 < K₀ ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∀ K : ℝ, K₀ ≤ K →
      ∃ (c : ℝ → Coeff) (V : Set ℝ),
        IsOpen V ∧ S ⊆ V ∧ V ⊆ U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c V ∧
        ∀ η ∈ S,
          physicalMoments P lam (q * K) (a η) (c η) + heatDebt T ν K η = 0 ∧
          ‖c η‖ ≤ C / K ∧ ‖deriv c η‖ ≤ C / K ∧
          FirstJetBound P a c η (C / K) ∧
          ∀ X : ℝ, 0 < X → 0 < physicalProfile P lam (q * K) (a η) (c η) X

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.exists_normalized_compensation
statement:
theorem exists_normalized_compensation (P : Patch) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam) :
    ∃ (g : Coeff → Coeff) (ε C : ℝ), 0 < ε ∧ 0 < C ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (Metric.ball 0 ε) ∧ g 0 = 0 ∧
      ∀ d ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Coeff) ε,
        momentMap P lam (g d) = d ∧ ‖g d‖ ≤ C * ‖d‖ ∧ ‖fderiv ℝ g d‖ ≤ C ∧
        ∀ x : ℝ,
          (|correction P (g d) x| ≤ C * ‖d‖ ∧
            |deriv (correction P (g d)) x| ≤ C * ‖d‖) ∧
          (0 < x → 0 < baseProfile lam x + correction P (g d) x)

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.exists_uniform_parameter_compensation
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_parameter_compensation (P : Patch) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam)
    {U S : Set ℝ} (hU : IsOpen U) (hS : IsCompact S) (hSU : S ⊆ U)
    (a : ℝ → ℝ) (ha : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a U) (hpos : ∀ η ∈ U, 0 < a η) :
    ∃ ε C : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∀ v : Coeff, ‖v‖ < ε →
      ∃ (c : ℝ → Coeff) (V : Set ℝ),
        IsOpen V ∧ S ⊆ V ∧ V ⊆ U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c V ∧
        ∀ η ∈ S, momentMap P lam (c η) = amplitudeDebt (a η) v ∧
          ‖c η‖ ≤ C * ‖v‖ ∧ ‖deriv c η‖ ≤ C * ‖v‖ ∧
          FirstJetBound P a c η (C * ‖v‖) ∧
          ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < a η * (baseProfile lam x + correction P (c η) x)

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.momentMap_identity
statement:
theorem momentMap_identity (P : Patch) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam) (c : Coeff) :
    linearEquiv P lam hlam c + quadraticCLM P c c = momentMap P lam c

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.normalizedDebt_eq
statement:
theorem normalizedDebt_eq (R a : ℝ) (d : Coeff) :
    normalizedDebt R a d = amplitudeDebt a (scaledDebt R d)

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.patch_heat_disjoint
statement:
theorem patch_heat_disjoint (P : Patch) (lam q K a h ν : ℝ)
    (hq : 0 < q) (hK : 0 < K) (hpatch : q * P.right ≤ 1)
    (c : Coeff) (E : ℝ → ℝ) {X : ℝ} (hX : 0 < X) :
    (physicalProfile P lam (q * K) a c X - cleanProfile lam (q * K) a X) *
      HeatTailEdit.change E h ν K X = 0

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.physicalDifference_hasCompactSupport
statement:
theorem physicalDifference_hasCompactSupport (P : Patch) (lam R a : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R)

    HasCompactSupport (fun X => physicalProfile P lam R a c X - cleanProfile lam R a X)

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.physicalMoments_cancel
statement:
theorem physicalMoments_cancel (P : Patch) (lam R a : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (ha : 0 < a)
    (c d : Coeff) (heq : momentMap P lam c = normalizedDebt R a d) :
    physicalMoments P lam R a c + d = 0

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.physicalMoments_eq
statement:
theorem physicalMoments_eq (P : Patch) (lam R a : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (c : Coeff) :
    physicalMoments P lam R a c =
      ![2 * a ^ 2 * momentMap P lam c 0,
        2 * R * a ^ 2 * momentMap P lam c 1,
        R * Real.sqrt (2 * R) * a * momentMap P lam c 2]

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.physicalMoments_integrable
statement:
theorem physicalMoments_integrable (P : Patch) (lam R a : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (c : Coeff) :
    Integrable (fun X => ((physicalProfile P lam R a c X) ^ 2 -
      (cleanProfile lam R a X) ^ 2) / X) ∧
    Integrable (fun X => (physicalProfile P lam R a c X) ^ 2 -
      (cleanProfile lam R a X) ^ 2) ∧
    Integrable (fun X => Real.sqrt (2 * X) *
      (physicalProfile P lam R a c X - cleanProfile lam R a X))

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.physicalMoments_positive_radius
statement:
theorem physicalMoments_positive_radius (P : Patch) (lam R a : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (c : Coeff) :
    physicalMoments P lam R a c =
      ![∫ X in Ioi 0, ((physicalProfile P lam R a c X) ^ 2 - (cleanProfile lam R a X) ^ 2) / X,
        ∫ X in Ioi 0, (physicalProfile P lam R a c X) ^ 2 - (cleanProfile lam R a X) ^ 2,
        ∫ X in Ioi 0, Real.sqrt (2 * X) *
          (physicalProfile P lam R a c X - cleanProfile lam R a X)]

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.physicalProfile_eq_clean_of_nonpos
statement:
theorem physicalProfile_eq_clean_of_nonpos (P : Patch) (lam R a : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R)
    (c : Coeff) {X : ℝ} (hX : X ≤ 0) :
    physicalProfile P lam R a c X = cleanProfile lam R a X

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.physicalProfile_eq_clean_outside
statement:
theorem physicalProfile_eq_clean_outside (P : Patch) (lam R a : ℝ) (c : Coeff) (X : ℝ)
    (hX : X / R ∉ Ioo P.left P.right) :
    physicalProfile P lam R a c X = cleanProfile lam R a X

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.physicalProfile_family_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem physicalProfile_family_contDiffOn (P : Patch) (lam R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R)
    {U : Set ℝ} {a : ℝ → ℝ} {c : ℝ → Coeff}
    (ha : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a U) (hc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c U) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.powers_injective
statement: theorem powers_injective (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam) : Injective (powers lam)

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.pressure_density_rescale
statement:
theorem pressure_density_rescale (P : Patch) (lam R a : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R)
    (c : Coeff) (x : ℝ) :
    ((physicalProfile P lam R a c (R * x)) ^ 2 - (cleanProfile lam R a (R * x)) ^ 2) /
        (R * x) = (2 * a ^ 2 / R) * weightedChange P lam c (-1) x

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.quadraticCLM_apply
statement:
theorem quadraticCLM_apply (P : Patch) (c d : Coeff) :
    quadraticCLM P c d =
      ![(1 / 2) * ∑ j, squareMoment P (-1) j * c j * d j,
        (1 / 2) * ∑ j, squareMoment P 0 j * c j * d j, 0]

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.scaled_heatDebt_bound
statement:
theorem scaled_heatDebt_bound (T : OutgoingTail.TailData) (ν q : ℝ)
    (hν : 0 < ν) (hq : 0 < q) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ K : ℝ, 0 < K →
      ‖scaledDebt (q * K) (heatDebt T ν K 0)‖ ≤ C / K

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.square_change_add_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem square_change_add_of_disjoint (b p t : ℝ) (hpt : p * t = 0) :
    (b + p + t) ^ 2 - b ^ 2 = ((b + p) ^ 2 - b ^ 2) + ((b + t) ^ 2 - b ^ 2)

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.weightedChange_identity
statement:
theorem weightedChange_identity (P : Patch) (lam : ℝ) (c : Coeff) (w x : ℝ) :
    weightedChange P lam c w x =
      x ^ (w + slope lam) * correction P c x + x ^ w * (correction P c x) ^ 2 / 2

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.weightedChange_integrable
statement:
theorem weightedChange_integrable (P : Patch) (lam : ℝ) (c : Coeff) (w : ℝ) :

name: NavierStokes.TerminalCompensation.weightedChange_integral
statement:
theorem weightedChange_integral (P : Patch) (lam : ℝ) (c : Coeff) (w : ℝ) :
    (∫ x, weightedChange P lam c w x) =
      (∑ j, c j * bumpMoment P (w + slope lam) j) +
        (∑ j, (c j) ^ 2 * squareMoment P w j) / 2

theorem weighted_bump_integrable (P : Patch) (s : ℝ) (j : Fin 3) :

NavierStokes.ParametricTerminalCompensation.amplitudeDebt_variable_bounds
statement:
theorem amplitudeDebt_variable_bounds {S : Set ℝ} (huniq : UniqueDiffOn ℝ S)
    {a : ℝ → ℝ} {v : ℝ → Coeff} (ha : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a S)
    (hpos : ∀ η ∈ S, 0 < a η) (hv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v S)
    {D : ℝ} (hD : ∀ η ∈ S, ‖amplitudeFactors (a η)‖ ≤ D ∧
      ‖derivWithin (fun θ => amplitudeFactors (a θ)) S η‖ ≤ D)
    {η : ℝ} (hη : η ∈ S) :
    ‖amplitudeDebt (a η) (v η)‖ ≤ D * ‖v η‖ ∧
      ‖derivWithin (fun θ => amplitudeDebt (a θ) (v θ)) S η‖ ≤
        D * (‖v η‖ + ‖derivWithin v S η‖)

name: NavierStokes.ParametricTerminalCompensation.amplitudeDebt_variable_contDiffOn
NavierStokes.ParametricTerminalCompensation.amplitudeDebt_variable_derivWithin
statement:
theorem amplitudeDebt_variable_derivWithin {S : Set ℝ} {a : ℝ → ℝ} {v : ℝ → Coeff}
    {η : ℝ} (huniq : UniqueDiffWithinAt ℝ S η)
    (ha : DifferentiableWithinAt ℝ (fun θ => amplitudeFactors (a θ)) S η)
    (hv : DifferentiableWithinAt ℝ v S η) :
    derivWithin (fun θ => amplitudeDebt (a θ) (v θ)) S η =
      -(derivWithin (fun θ => amplitudeFactors (a θ)) S η * v η +
        amplitudeFactors (a η) * derivWithin v S η)

name: NavierStokes.ParametricTerminalCompensation.angular_scaling_bound
statement:
theorem angular_scaling_bound {K B u : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hu : |u| ≤ B * Real.sqrt K) : |u / (K * Real.sqrt (2 * K))| ≤ B / K

name: NavierStokes.ParametricTerminalCompensation.compact_amplitude_within_bounds
statement:
theorem compact_amplitude_within_bounds {S : Set ℝ} (hS : IsCompact S)
    (huniq : UniqueDiffOn ℝ S) {a : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a S)
    (hpos : ∀ η ∈ S, 0 < a η) :
    ∃ D : ℝ, 0 < D ∧ ∀ η ∈ S,
      ‖amplitudeFactors (a η)‖ ≤ D ∧
      ‖derivWithin (fun θ => amplitudeFactors (a θ)) S η‖ ≤ D ∧
      |a η| ≤ D ∧ |derivWithin a S η| ≤ D

name: NavierStokes.ParametricTerminalCompensation.composed_solver_derivWithin_bound
statement:
theorem composed_solver_derivWithin_bound {g : Coeff → Coeff} {ε C : ℝ}
    (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (Metric.ball 0 ε))
    (hbound : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Coeff) ε, ‖fderiv ℝ g v‖ ≤ C)
    {S : Set ℝ} {d : ℝ → Coeff} {η : ℝ} (huniq : UniqueDiffWithinAt ℝ S η)
    (hd : DifferentiableWithinAt ℝ d S η) (hmem : d η ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Coeff) ε) :
    ‖derivWithin (g ∘ d) S η‖ ≤ C * ‖derivWithin d S η‖

NavierStokes.ParametricTerminalCompensation.exists_compensation_for_scaled_family
statement:
theorem exists_compensation_for_scaled_family (P : Patch) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam)
    (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) {S : Set ℝ} (hS : IsCompact S) (huniq : UniqueDiffOn ℝ S)
    (a : ℝ → ℝ) (ha : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a S) (hpos : ∀ η ∈ S, 0 < a η)
    (d : ℝ → ℝ → Coeff) (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 < B)
    (hreg : ∀ K : ℝ, 1 ≤ K → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => scaledDebt (q * K) (d K η)) S)
    (hbound : ∀ K : ℝ, 1 ≤ K → ∀ η ∈ S,
      ‖scaledDebt (q * K) (d K η)‖ ≤ B / K ∧
      ‖derivWithin (fun θ => scaledDebt (q * K) (d K θ)) S η‖ ≤ B / K) :
    ∃ K₀ C : ℝ, 0 < K₀ ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∀ K : ℝ, K₀ ≤ K →
      ∃ c : ℝ → Coeff, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c S ∧ ∀ η ∈ S,
        physicalMoments P lam (q * K) (a η) (c η) + d K η = 0 ∧
        ‖c η‖ ≤ C / K ∧ ‖derivWithin c S η‖ ≤ C / K ∧
        FirstJetWithinBound P a c S η (C / K) ∧
        ∀ X : ℝ, 0 < X → 0 < physicalProfile P lam (q * K) (a η) (c η) X

name: NavierStokes.ParametricTerminalCompensation.exists_compensation_for_switch_family
statement:
theorem exists_compensation_for_switch_family (P : Patch) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam)
    (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) {S : Set ℝ} (hS : IsCompact S) (huniq : UniqueDiffOn ℝ S)
    (a : ℝ → ℝ) (ha : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a S) (hpos : ∀ η ∈ S, 0 < a η)
    (d : ℝ → ℝ → Coeff) (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 < B)
    (hreg : ∀ K : ℝ, 1 ≤ K → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => scaledDebt K (d K η)) S)
    (hbound : ∀ K : ℝ, 1 ≤ K → ∀ η ∈ S,
      ‖scaledDebt K (d K η)‖ ≤ B / K ∧
      ‖derivWithin (fun θ => scaledDebt K (d K θ)) S η‖ ≤ B / K) :
    ∃ K₀ C : ℝ, 0 < K₀ ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∀ K : ℝ, K₀ ≤ K →
      ∃ c : ℝ → Coeff, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c S ∧ ∀ η ∈ S,
        physicalMoments P lam (q * K) (a η) (c η) + d K η = 0 ∧
        ‖c η‖ ≤ C / K ∧ ‖derivWithin c S η‖ ≤ C / K ∧
        FirstJetWithinBound P a c S η (C / K) ∧
        ∀ X : ℝ, 0 < X → 0 < physicalProfile P lam (q * K) (a η) (c η) X

name: NavierStokes.ParametricTerminalCompensation.exists_physical_heat_compensation
statement:
theorem exists_physical_heat_compensation (P : Patch) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam)
    (T : OutgoingTail.TailData) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (a : ℝ → ℝ) (ha : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1))
    (hpos : ∀ η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, 0 < a η) :
    ∃ K₀ C : ℝ, 0 < K₀ ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∀ K : ℝ, K₀ ≤ K →
      ∃ c : ℝ → Coeff, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) ∧
        ∀ η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
          physicalMoments P lam (q * K) (a η) (c η) + physicalDebt T K η = 0 ∧
          ‖c η‖ ≤ C / K ∧ ‖derivWithin c (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) η‖ ≤ C / K ∧
          FirstJetWithinBound P a c (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) η (C / K) ∧
          ∀ X : ℝ, 0 < X → 0 < physicalProfile P lam (q * K) (a η) (c η) X

name: NavierStokes.ParametricTerminalCompensation.exists_variable_compensation
statement:
theorem exists_variable_compensation (P : Patch) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam)
    {S : Set ℝ} (hS : IsCompact S) (huniq : UniqueDiffOn ℝ S)
    (a : ℝ → ℝ) (ha : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a S) (hpos : ∀ η ∈ S, 0 < a η) :
    ∃ ε C : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∀ v : ℝ → Coeff,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v S → (∀ η ∈ S, ‖v η‖ < ε) →
      ∃ c : ℝ → Coeff, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c S ∧ ∀ η ∈ S,
        momentMap P lam (c η) = amplitudeDebt (a η) (v η) ∧
        ‖c η‖ ≤ C * ‖v η‖ ∧
        ‖derivWithin c S η‖ ≤ C * (‖v η‖ + ‖derivWithin v S η‖) ∧
        FirstJetWithinBound P a c S η (C * (‖v η‖ + ‖derivWithin v S η‖)) ∧
        ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < a η * (baseProfile lam x + correction P (c η) x)

name: NavierStokes.ParametricTerminalCompensation.interior_first_jet
statement:
theorem interior_first_jet {P : Patch} {S : Set ℝ} {a : ℝ → ℝ} {c : ℝ → Coeff}
    {η L : ℝ} (hS : S ∈ 𝓝 η) (hc : ‖derivWithin c S η‖ ≤ L)
    (hE : FirstJetWithinBound P a c S η L) :
    ‖deriv c η‖ ≤ L ∧ FirstJetBound P a c η L

name: NavierStokes.ParametricTerminalCompensation.physicalDebt_eq_actual
statement:
theorem physicalDebt_eq_actual (T : OutgoingTail.TailData) (K η : ℝ) :
    physicalDebt T K η =
      ![HeatTailEdit.pressureDebt (HeatTailEdit.outgoingProfile T K η) T.h (1 - η ^ 2) K,
        HeatTailEdit.energyDebt (HeatTailEdit.outgoingProfile T K η) T.h (1 - η ^ 2) K,
        HeatTailEdit.angularDebt (HeatTailEdit.outgoingProfile T K η) T.h (1 - η ^ 2) K]

name: NavierStokes.ParametricTerminalCompensation.physical_scaled_debt_C1_bounds
statement:
theorem physical_scaled_debt_C1_bounds (T : OutgoingTail.TailData) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∀ K : ℝ, 1 ≤ K → ∀ η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
      ‖scaledDebt K (physicalDebt T K η)‖ ≤ B / K ∧
      ‖derivWithin (fun θ => scaledDebt K (physicalDebt T K θ)) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) η‖ ≤ B / K

name: NavierStokes.ParametricTerminalCompensation.physical_scaled_debt_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem physical_scaled_debt_contDiffOn (T : OutgoingTail.TailData) {K : ℝ} (hK : 1 ≤ K) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => scaledDebt K (physicalDebt T K η)) (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)

name: NavierStokes.ParametricTerminalCompensation.radiusRatio_derivWithin
statement:
theorem radiusRatio_derivWithin (q : ℝ) {S : Set ℝ} {v : ℝ → Coeff} {η : ℝ}
    (huniq : UniqueDiffWithinAt ℝ S η) (hv : DifferentiableWithinAt ℝ v S η) :
    derivWithin (fun θ => radiusRatioCLM q (v θ)) S η =
      radiusRatioCLM q (derivWithin v S η)

name: NavierStokes.ParametricTerminalCompensation.scaledDebt_radiusRatio
statement:
theorem scaledDebt_radiusRatio (q K : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) (d : Coeff) :

name: NavierStokes.ParametricTerminalCompensation.scaled_family_ratio_bounds
statement:
theorem scaled_family_ratio_bounds (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q)
    {S : Set ℝ} (huniq : UniqueDiffOn ℝ S) (d : ℝ → ℝ → Coeff)
    (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 < B)
    (hreg : ∀ K : ℝ, 1 ≤ K → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => scaledDebt K (d K η)) S)
    (hbound : ∀ K : ℝ, 1 ≤ K → ∀ η ∈ S,
      ‖scaledDebt K (d K η)‖ ≤ B / K ∧
      ‖derivWithin (fun θ => scaledDebt K (d K θ)) S η‖ ≤ B / K) :
    ∃ Bq : ℝ, 0 < Bq ∧ ∀ K : ℝ, 1 ≤ K →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun η => scaledDebt (q * K) (d K η)) S ∧
      ∀ η ∈ S, ‖scaledDebt (q * K) (d K η)‖ ≤ Bq / K ∧
        ‖derivWithin (fun θ => scaledDebt (q * K) (d K θ)) S η‖ ≤ Bq / K

NavierStokes.ParametricTerminalCompensation.scaled_triple_derivWithin
statement:
theorem scaled_triple_derivWithin {S : Set ℝ} (K : ℝ) {p e i : ℝ → ℝ} {η : ℝ}
    (huniq : UniqueDiffWithinAt ℝ S η)
    (hp : DifferentiableWithinAt ℝ p S η) (he : DifferentiableWithinAt ℝ e S η)
    (hi : DifferentiableWithinAt ℝ i S η) :
    derivWithin (fun θ => scaledDebt K ![p θ, e θ, i θ]) S η =
      scaledDebt K ![derivWithin p S η, derivWithin e S η, derivWithin i S η]

name: NavierStokes.ParametricTerminalCompensation.scaled_triple_first_jet_bound
statement:
theorem scaled_triple_first_jet_bound {S : Set ℝ} {K B : ℝ} {p e i : ℝ → ℝ} {η : ℝ}
    (hK : 0 < K) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (huniq : UniqueDiffWithinAt ℝ S η)
    (hp : DifferentiableWithinAt ℝ p S η) (he : DifferentiableWithinAt ℝ e S η)
    (hi : DifferentiableWithinAt ℝ i S η)
    (hpb : |p η| ≤ B / K ∧ |derivWithin p S η| ≤ B / K)
    (heb : |e η| ≤ B ∧ |derivWithin e S η| ≤ B)
    (hib : |i η| ≤ B * Real.sqrt K ∧ |derivWithin i S η| ≤ B * Real.sqrt K) :
    ‖scaledDebt K ![p η, e η, i η]‖ ≤ B / K ∧
      ‖derivWithin (fun θ => scaledDebt K ![p θ, e θ, i θ]) S η‖ ≤ B / K

name: NavierStokes.ParametricTerminalCompensation.scaled_triple_norm_bound
statement:
theorem scaled_triple_norm_bound {K B p e i : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (hB : 0 ≤ B)

name: NavierStokes.ExtendedHeatDebts.actualIntegrand_joint_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem actualIntegrand_joint_contDiffOn (d : TailData) {K : ℝ} (hK : 1 ≤ K)
    (square : Bool) (q : ℝ) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
      weightedJet (tailWeight d K square) square d.h K q 0 (diffusion p.1) p.2)
      ((univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ Ioi K)

name: NavierStokes.ExtendedHeatDebts.angular_integrand_eq
statement:
theorem angular_integrand_eq (d : TailData) {K X : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (hX : K < X) (η : ℝ) :
    Real.sqrt (2 * X) * change (outgoingProfile d K η) d.h (diffusion η) K X =
      Real.sqrt 2 * weightedJet (tailWeight d K false) false d.h K (1 / 2) 0 (diffusion η) X

name: NavierStokes.ExtendedHeatDebts.correctionBound_succ
statement:
theorem correctionBound_succ (h L : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
