statement: theorem commutatorConstant_nonneg : 0 ≤ commutatorConstant

name: NavierStokesR3.PressureFlux.cutoff_commutator_bound
statement:
theorem cutoff_commutator_bound {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) {w : Space → Space}
    (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w) (hw2 : MemLp w 2 volume) {g : Space → ℝ}
    (hg : Integrable g volume) (i j : Fin 3) :
    ‖commutatorPair i j (ComparisonCutoffs.multiplier R) g
      (rTest R hR w hw) (fluxTest R hR w hw)‖ ≤
      commutatorConstant * comparisonLpNorm 1 g * comparisonLpNorm 2 w ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) *
        R ^ (-(7 / 4 : ℝ)) *
          comparisonLpNorm 6 (fun x => ComparisonCutoffs.cutoff R x ^ 4 • w x) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ)

name: NavierStokesR3.PressureFlux.cutoff_pressurePair_bound
statement:
theorem cutoff_pressurePair_bound {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) {u v : VelocityField} {t : ℝ}
    (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => u (t, x))) (hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => v (t, x)))
    (hw2 : MemLp (fun x => (u - v) (t, x)) 2 volume)
    (hu3 : MemLp (fun x => u (t, x)) 3 volume) (i j : Fin 3)
    (hg : Integrable (tensorDiff u v t i j) volume) :
    ‖pressurePair i j (tensorDiff u v t i j)
      (fluxTest R hR (fun x => (u - v) (t, x)) (hu.sub hv))‖ ≤
      localPairConstant *
        (comparisonLpNorm 2 (fun x => (u - v) (t, x)) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) *
            cutoffL6 (ComparisonCutoffs.cutoff R) (u - v) t ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) +
          2 * comparisonLpNorm 2 (fun x => (u - v) (t, x)) * comparisonLpNorm 3 (fun x => u (t, x))) *
        (dissipationRoot (ComparisonCutoffs.cutoff R) (u - v) t / R +
          comparisonLpNorm 2 (fun x => (u - v) (t, x)) / R ^ 2) +
      commutatorConstant * comparisonLpNorm 1 (tensorDiff u v t i j) *
        comparisonLpNorm 2 (fun x => (u - v) (t, x)) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * R ^ (-(7 / 4 : ℝ)) *
          cutoffL6 (ComparisonCutoffs.cutoff R) (u - v) t ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ)

name: NavierStokesR3.PressureFlux.exists_uniform_actual_pressure_flux_bound
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_actual_pressure_flux_bound {T : ℝ} {u v : VelocityField}
    {p q : PressureField} (H : PressureRecovery.Hypotheses T u v p q)
    (M₀ U₀ G₀ : ℝ) (hM₀ : 0 ≤ M₀) (hU₀ : 0 ≤ U₀) (hG₀ : 0 ≤ G₀)
    (hM : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, MemLp (fun x => (u - v) (t, x)) 2 volume ∧
      comparisonLpNorm 2 (fun x => (u - v) (t, x)) ≤ M₀)
    (hU : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, MemLp (fun x => u (t, x)) 3 volume ∧
      comparisonLpNorm 3 (fun x => u (t, x)) ≤ U₀)
    (hG : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      Integrable (tensorDiff u v t i j) volume ∧ comparisonLpNorm 1 (tensorDiff u v t i j) ≤ G₀) :
    ∃ CP : ℝ, 0 ≤ CP ∧ ∀ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R → ∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 T,
      |∫ x, (p - q) (t, x) * fderiv ℝ (ComparisonCutoffs.weight R) x ((u - v) (t, x))| ≤ CP *
        ((cutoffL6 (ComparisonCutoffs.cutoff R) (u - v) t ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) + 1) *
          (dissipationRoot (ComparisonCutoffs.cutoff R) (u - v) t / R + 1 / R ^ 2) +
          R ^ (-(7 / 4 : ℝ)) * cutoffL6 (ComparisonCutoffs.cutoff R) (u - v) t ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ))

name: NavierStokesR3.PressureFlux.exists_uniform_canonicalCutoffFlux_bound
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_canonicalCutoffFlux_bound (M₀ U₀ G₀ : ℝ)
    (hM₀ : 0 ≤ M₀) (hU₀ : 0 ≤ U₀) (hG₀ : 0 ≤ G₀) :
    ∃ CP : ℝ, 0 ≤ CP ∧ ∀ (R : ℝ) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (u v : VelocityField) (t : ℝ)
      (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => u (t, x))) (hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => v (t, x))),
      MemLp (fun x => (u - v) (t, x)) 2 volume →
      MemLp (fun x => u (t, x)) 3 volume →
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, Integrable (tensorDiff u v t i j) volume) →
      comparisonLpNorm 2 (fun x => (u - v) (t, x)) ≤ M₀ →
      comparisonLpNorm 3 (fun x => u (t, x)) ≤ U₀ →
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, comparisonLpNorm 1 (tensorDiff u v t i j) ≤ G₀) →
      ‖canonicalCutoffFlux R (zero_lt_one.trans_le hR) u v t hu hv‖ ≤ CP *
        ((cutoffL6 (ComparisonCutoffs.cutoff R) (u - v) t ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) + 1) *
          (dissipationRoot (ComparisonCutoffs.cutoff R) (u - v) t / R + 1 / R ^ 2) +
          R ^ (-(7 / 4 : ℝ)) * cutoffL6 (ComparisonCutoffs.cutoff R) (u - v) t ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ))

statement:
theorem localized_pair_bound {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) {u v : VelocityField} {t : ℝ}
    (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => u (t, x))) (hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => v (t, x)))
    (hw2 : MemLp (fun x => (u - v) (t, x)) 2 volume)
    (hu3 : MemLp (fun x => u (t, x)) 3 volume) (i j : Fin 3) :
    Integrable (fun x => (ComparisonCutoffs.multiplier R x * tensorDiff u v t i j x : ℝ) *
      rieszTest i j (rTest R hR (fun x => (u - v) (t, x)) (hu.sub hv)) x) volume ∧
    ‖∫ x, (ComparisonCutoffs.multiplier R x * tensorDiff u v t i j x : ℝ) *
      rieszTest i j (rTest R hR (fun x => (u - v) (t, x)) (hu.sub hv)) x‖ ≤
      localPairConstant *
        (comparisonLpNorm 2 (fun x => (u - v) (t, x)) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) *
            cutoffL6 (ComparisonCutoffs.cutoff R) (u - v) t ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) +
          2 * comparisonLpNorm 2 (fun x => (u - v) (t, x)) * comparisonLpNorm 3 (fun x => u (t, x))) *
        (dissipationRoot (ComparisonCutoffs.cutoff R) (u - v) t / R +
          comparisonLpNorm 2 (fun x => (u - v) (t, x)) / R ^ 2)

statement:
theorem uniform_expression_bound {C₁ C₂ M₀ U₀ G₀ M U G A B R : ℝ}
    (hC₁ : 0 ≤ C₁) (hC₂ : 0 ≤ C₂) (hM₀ : 0 ≤ M₀) (hU₀ : 0 ≤ U₀) (hG₀ : 0 ≤ G₀)
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hU : 0 ≤ U) (_hG : 0 ≤ G) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hMM : M ≤ M₀) (hUU : U ≤ U₀) (hGG : G ≤ G₀) (hR : 0 < R) :
    C₁ * (M ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) * B ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) + 2 * M * U) *
        (A / R + M / R ^ 2) +
      C₂ * G * M ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * R ^ (-(7 / 4 : ℝ)) * B ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ) ≤
    uniformCoefficient C₁ C₂ M₀ U₀ G₀ *
      ((B ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) + 1) * (A / R + 1 / R ^ 2) +
        R ^ (-(7 / 4 : ℝ)) * B ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ))

name: NavierStokesR3.ComparisonYoung.exists_cutoff_absorption
statement:
theorem exists_cutoff_absorption {C δ : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∃ D ≥ 0, ∀ A ≥ 0, ∀ R ≥ 1,
      C * ((A + R⁻¹) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) + 1) *
          (R⁻¹ * A + R ^ (-2 : ℝ)) +
        C * R ^ (-7 / 4 : ℝ) * (A + R⁻¹) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ) +
        C * R⁻¹ * (A + R⁻¹) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) ≤
          δ * A ^ 2 + D / R

name: NavierStokesR3.ComparisonYoung.exists_rpow_absorption
NavierStokesR3.ComparisonYoung.exists_scaled_shifted_rpow_absorption
statement:
theorem exists_scaled_shifted_rpow_absorption {C δ p : ℝ}
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp2 : p < 2) :
    ∃ D ≥ 0, ∀ A ≥ 0, ∀ R ≥ 1,
      C / R * (A + 1) ^ p ≤ δ * A ^ 2 + D / R

name: NavierStokesR3.ComparisonYoung.exists_shifted_rpow_absorption
NavierStokesR3.ComparisonRateBound.exists_uniform_flux_absorption
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_flux_absorption {C1 C2 S M δ : ℝ}
    (hC1 : 0 ≤ C1) (hC2 : 0 ≤ C2) (hS : 0 ≤ S) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∃ D ≥ 0, ∀ R ≥ 1, ∀ A ≥ 0, ∀ B ≥ 0, B ≤ S * (A + M / R) →
      C1 / R * B ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) +
        C2 * ((B ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) + 1) * (A / R + 1 / R ^ 2) +
          R ^ (-7 / 4 : ℝ) * B ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ)) ≤ δ * A ^ 2 + D / R

name: NavierStokesR3.LocalizedDifferenceEnergy.integral_weighted_laplacian
statement:
theorem integral_weighted_laplacian {χ : Space → ℝ} {w : Space → Space}

name: NavierStokesR3.LocalizedDifferenceEnergy.difference_energy_balance
statement:
theorem difference_energy_balance {χ : Space → ℝ} {u v : VelocityField}
    {p q : PressureField} {t : ℝ}
    (hχ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ) (hcχ : HasCompactSupport χ)
    (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : Space => u (t, x)))
    (hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : Space => v (t, x)))
    (hp : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : Space => p (t, x)))
    (hq : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : Space => q (t, x)))
    (htu : ∀ x : Space, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun r => u (r, x)) t)
    (htv : ∀ x : Space, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun r => v (r, x)) t)
    (hdivu : ∀ x : Space, spatialDivergence u t x = 0)
    (hdivv : ∀ x : Space, spatialDivergence v t x = 0)
    (hNS : ∀ x : Space, ProblemStatement.navierStokesResidual 1 u p t x =
      ProblemStatement.navierStokesResidual 1 v q t x) :
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) * weightedEnergyRate χ (u - v) t + weightedDissipation χ (u - v) t =
      -(∫ x : Space, χ x * ⟪(u - v) (t, x), spatialDerivative u t x ((u - v) (t, x))⟫_ℝ) +
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (∫ x : Space, ‖(u - v) (t, x)‖ ^ 2 *
        ∑ i : Fin 3, spatialPartial i (spatialPartial i χ) x) +
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (∫ x : Space, ‖(u - v) (t, x)‖ ^ 2 *
        fderiv ℝ χ x (v (t, x))) +
      ∫ x : Space, (p - q) (t, x) * fderiv ℝ χ x ((u - v) (t, x))

name: NavierStokesR3.LocalizedDifferenceEnergy.hasDerivAt_difference_energy_balance
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_difference_energy_balance {a b t : ℝ} {χ : Space → ℝ}
    {u v : VelocityField} {p q : PressureField}
    (hχ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ) (hcχ : HasCompactSupport χ)
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u (Comparison.slab a b))
    (hv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v (Comparison.slab a b))
    (hp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ p (Comparison.slab a b))
    (hq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ q (Comparison.slab a b)) (ht : t ∈ Ioo a b)
    (hdivu : ∀ x : Space, spatialDivergence u t x = 0)
    (hdivv : ∀ x : Space, spatialDivergence v t x = 0)
    (hNS : ∀ x : Space, ProblemStatement.navierStokesResidual 1 u p t x =
      ProblemStatement.navierStokesResidual 1 v q t x) :
    HasDerivAt (weightedEnergy χ (u - v))
      (-2 * weightedDissipation χ (u - v) t -
        2 * (∫ x : Space, χ x *
          ⟪(u - v) (t, x), spatialDerivative u t x ((u - v) (t, x))⟫_ℝ) +
        (∫ x : Space, ‖(u - v) (t, x)‖ ^ 2 *
          ∑ i : Fin 3, spatialPartial i (spatialPartial i χ) x) +
        (∫ x : Space, ‖(u - v) (t, x)‖ ^ 2 * fderiv ℝ χ x (v (t, x))) +
        2 * ∫ x : Space, (p - q) (t, x) * fderiv ℝ χ x ((u - v) (t, x))) t

name: NavierStokesR3.LocalizedFluxEstimates.norm_fderiv_cutoff_eight_apply_le
statement:
theorem norm_fderiv_cutoff_eight_apply_le {φ : Space → ℝ} {x : Space}
    (hφ : DifferentiableAt ℝ φ x) (hφ0 : 0 ≤ φ x) (hφ1 : φ x ≤ 1)
    {L : ℝ} (hL0 : 0 ≤ L) (hL : ‖fderiv ℝ φ x‖ ≤ L) (z : Space) :
    ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => φ y ^ 8) x z‖ ≤ (8 * L) * φ x ^ 6 * ‖z‖

name: NavierStokesR3.LocalizedFluxEstimates.transport_flux_bound
statement:
theorem transport_flux_bound {φ : Space → ℝ} {u v : VelocityField} {t : ℝ}
    (hφ : ContDiff ℝ 1 φ) (hs : HasCompactSupport φ)
    (hu : Continuous (fun x => u (t, x))) (hv : Continuous (fun x => v (t, x)))
    (hw2 : MemLp (fun x => (u - v) (t, x)) 2 volume)
    (hφ0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x) (hφ1 : ∀ x, φ x ≤ 1)
    {L : ℝ} (hL0 : 0 ≤ L) (hL : ∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ φ x‖ ≤ L)
    (hvanish : ∀ x, fderiv ℝ (fun y => φ y ^ 8) x (u (t, x)) = 0) :
    Integrable (fun x => ‖(u - v) (t, x)‖ ^ 2 *
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => φ y ^ 8) x (v (t, x))) volume ∧
    |∫ x, ‖(u - v) (t, x)‖ ^ 2 * fderiv ℝ (fun y => φ y ^ 8) x (v (t, x))| ≤
      (8 * L) * comparisonLpNorm 2 (fun x => (u - v) (t, x)) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) *
        cutoffL6 φ (u - v) t ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)

    (hcont : ∀ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R → ContinuousOn (E R) (Icc 0 T))
    (hinitial : ∀ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R → E R 0 = 0)
    (hderiv : ∀ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R → ∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 T, HasDerivAt (E R) (E' R t) t)
    (hbound : ∀ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R → ∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 T, E' R t ≤ K * E R t + C / R) :
    ∃ D : ℝ, 0 ≤ D ∧ ∀ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R → ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, E R t ≤ D / R

theorem exp_neg_mul_le_of_deriv_le {T K ε : ℝ} {E E' : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hcont : ContinuousOn E (Icc 0 T)) (hinitial : E 0 ≤ 0)
    (hderiv : ∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 T, HasDerivAt E (E' t) t)
    (hbound : ∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 T, E' t ≤ K * E t + ε) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, Real.exp (-K * t) * E t ≤ ε * t

statement:
theorem eq_of_pressure_flux_bound {T M G CP R₀ : ℝ}
    {u v : VelocityField} {p q : PressureField}
    (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hM0 : 0 ≤ M) (hG0 : 0 ≤ G) (hCP0 : 0 ≤ CP)
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u (Comparison.slab 0 T))
    (hv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v (Comparison.slab 0 T))
    (hp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ p (Comparison.slab 0 T))
    (hq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ q (Comparison.slab 0 T))
    (hwu : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, MemLp (fun x => (u - v) (t, x)) 2 volume)
    (hM : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, comparisonLpNorm 2 (fun x => (u - v) (t, x)) ≤ M)
    (hG : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ x, ‖spatialDerivative u t x‖ ≤ G)
    (hdu : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ x, spatialDivergence u t x = 0)
    (hdv : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ x, spatialDivergence v t x = 0)
    (hNS : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ x,
      navierStokesResidual 1 u p t x = navierStokesResidual 1 v q t x)
    (hzero : ∀ x, u (0, x) = v (0, x))
    (hvanish : ∀ R ≥ R₀, ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ x,
      fderiv ℝ (weight R) x (u (t, x)) = 0)
    (hpressure : ∀ R ≥ 1, ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T,
      |∫ x : Space, (p - q) (t, x) * fderiv ℝ (weight R) x ((u - v) (t, x))| ≤
        CP * pressureEnvelope R (dissipationRoot (cutoff R) (u - v) t)
          (cutoffL6 (cutoff R) (u - v) t)) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ x, u (t, x) = v (t, x)

theorem spatialPartial_three_sub_smooth {f g : Space → E}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g) (i j k : Fin 3) :
    spatialPartial i (spatialPartial j (spatialPartial k (f - g))) =
      spatialPartial i (spatialPartial j (spatialPartial k f)) -
        spatialPartial i (spatialPartial j (spatialPartial k g))

    (hdu : ContinuousOn du (Icc a b ×ˢ univ))

      HasDerivAt (fun s => u (s, x)) (du (r, x)) r)
    (ht : t ∈ Ioo a b)
    {F : ℝ → Lp Space 2 (volume : Measure Space)}
    (hF : ∀ r ∈ Icc a b, F r =ᵐ[volume] fun x => u (r, x))

    HasDerivAt F D t

theorem H1Approximation.derivative_distribution {f : Space → ℂ}
    {df : Fin 3 → Space → ℂ} (h : H1Approximation f df) (i : Fin 3) :
    ∂_{coordinateVector i} (distribution (h.memLp.toLp f)) =
      distribution ((h.derivative_memLp i).toLp (df i))

name: NavierStokesR3.H3PressureDistribution.compact_integration_by_parts

theorem compact_integration_by_parts {f g : Space → ℂ}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f) (hg : ContDiff ℝ 1 g)

    (∫ x, f x * spatialPartial i g x) = -(∫ x, spatialPartial i f x * g x)

name: NavierStokesR3.H3PressureDistribution.derivative_toLp_apply
statement:
theorem derivative_toLp_apply {f : Space → ℂ} (hf : MemLp f 2 volume)
    (i : Fin 3) (ψ : ComplexTest) :
    (∂_{coordinateVector i} (distribution (hf.toLp f))) ψ =
      -(∫ x, spatialPartial i (ψ : Space → ℂ) x * f x)

name: NavierStokesR3.H3PressureDistribution.derivative_toLp_of_compact
statement:
theorem derivative_toLp_of_compact {f : Space → ℂ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hcf : HasCompactSupport f) (i : Fin 3) :
    ∂_{coordinateVector i} (distribution ((smooth_compact_memLp hf hcf).toLp f)) =
      distribution ((smooth_compact_memLp (spatial_partial_contDiff hf i)
        (hcf.fderiv_apply ℝ (coordinateVector i))).toLp (spatialPartial i f))

      ∫ x, spatialPartial j ψ x * spatialPartial i p x

    (hdiv : ∀ᵐ x : Space ∂volume, ∑ i : Fin 3, dw i x i = 0) :

      ((hw.map (complexComponent i)).memLp.toLp (complexComponent i ∘ w)))) = 0

name: NavierStokesR3.H3PressureOrthogonality.integral_representatives
statement:
theorem integral_representatives (f g : Fin 3 → Space → ℂ)
    (hf : ∀ i, MemLp (f i) 2 volume) (hg : ∀ i, MemLp (g i) 2 volume) :
    (∑ i : Fin 3, inner ℂ ((hf i).toLp (f i)) ((hg i).toLp (g i))) =
      ∫ x : Space, ∑ i : Fin 3, star (f i x) * g i x

name: NavierStokesR3.H3PressureOrthogonality.pressure_pairing_zero
statement:

name: NavierStokesR3.H3PressureOrthogonality.spatialPartial_ofReal

name: NavierStokesR3.H3Comparison.bilinear_norm_le
statement:
theorem bilinear_norm_le (B : E →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] G) (x : E) (y : F) :
    ‖B x y‖ ≤ ‖B‖ * ‖x‖ * ‖y‖

name: NavierStokesR3.H3Comparison.memLp_bilinear_bounded
statement:
theorem memLp_bilinear_bounded (B : E →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] G)
    {f : Space → E} {g : Space → F} (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f volume)
    (hg : MemLp g 2 volume) {C : ℝ} (hC : ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ C) :
    MemLp (fun x => B (f x) (g x)) 2 volume

name: NavierStokesR3.H3Comparison.norm_toLp_bilinear_le
statement:
theorem norm_toLp_bilinear_le (B : E →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] G)
    {f : Space → E} {g : Space → F} (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f volume)
    (hg : MemLp g 2 volume) {C : ℝ} (hC : ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ C) :
    ‖(memLp_bilinear_bounded B hf hg hC).toLp (fun x => B (f x) (g x))‖ ≤
      (‖B‖ * C) * ‖hg.toLp g‖

name: NavierStokesR3.H3Comparison.tendsto_toLp_bilinear
statement:
theorem tendsto_toLp_bilinear (B : E →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] G)
    {f : ℕ → Space → E} {g : ℕ → Space → F} {f₀ : Space → E} {g₀ : Space → F}
    (hf : ∀ n, AEStronglyMeasurable (f n) volume) (hf₀ : AEStronglyMeasurable f₀ volume)
    (hg : ∀ n, MemLp (g n) 2 volume) (hg₀ : MemLp g₀ 2 volume)
    {a : ℕ → ℝ} (ha : Tendsto a atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hfa : ∀ n x, ‖f n x - f₀ x‖ ≤ a n) {C : ℝ} (hC : ∀ x, ‖f₀ x‖ ≤ C)
    (hglim : Tendsto (fun n => (hg n).toLp (g n)) atTop (𝓝 (hg₀.toLp g₀))) :
    ∃ hp : ∀ n, MemLp (fun x => B (f n x) (g n x)) 2 volume,
      Tendsto (fun n => (hp n).toLp (fun x => B (f n x) (g n x))) atTop
        (𝓝 ((memLp_bilinear_bounded B hf₀ hg₀ hC).toLp (fun x => B (f₀ x) (g₀ x))))

name: NavierStokesR3.H3Comparison.H3Approximation.transport_zero
NavierStokesR3.H3Comparison.integrable_transport
statement:
theorem integrable_transport {w v : Space → Space} {dw : Fin 3 → Space → Space}
    (hw : MemLp w 2 volume) (hv : AEStronglyMeasurable v volume)
    (hdw : ∀ i, MemLp (dw i) 2 volume) {C : ℝ} (hC : ∀ x, ‖v x‖ ≤ C)
    (i : Fin 3) : Integrable (fun x => v x i * ⟪w x, dw i x⟫_ℝ)

name: NavierStokesR3.H3Comparison.weak_transport_zero
statement:
theorem weak_transport_zero {w v : Space → Space} {dw dv : Fin 3 → Space → Space}
    (hw : H1Approximation w dw) (hv : H1Approximation v dv)
    {aw av : ℕ → ℝ} (haw : Tendsto aw atTop (𝓝 0)) (hav : Tendsto av atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hew : ∀ n x, ‖hw.approx n x - w x‖ ≤ aw n)
    (hev : ∀ n x, ‖hv.approx n x - v x‖ ≤ av n)
    {Cw Cv : ℝ} (hcw : ∀ x, ‖w x‖ ≤ Cw) (hcv : ∀ x, ‖v x‖ ≤ Cv)
    (hdiv : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, (∑ i : Fin 3, dv i x i) = 0) :
    (∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 3, v x i * ⟪w x, dw i x⟫_ℝ) = 0

name: NavierStokesR3.H3Comparison.difference_rate_le
statement:
theorem difference_rate_le {w v dt g : Space → Space}
    {dw dv : Fin 3 → Space → Space}
    {ddw ddv : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Space → Space}
    {dddw dddv : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Space → Space}
    (hw : H3Approximation w dw ddw dddw) (hv : H3Approximation v dv ddv dddv)
    (hcw : Continuous w) (hcv : Continuous v)
    (hg : MemLp g 2 volume) {ν G : ℝ} (hν : 0 ≤ ν)
    (A : Space → Space →L[ℝ] Space) (hA : AEStronglyMeasurable A volume)
    (hG : ∀ x, ‖A x‖ ≤ G)
    (hdiv : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, (∑ i : Fin 3, dv i x i) = 0)
    (hpressure : (∫ x, ⟪w x, g x⟫_ℝ) = 0)
    (hNS : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, dt x = ν • (∑ i : Fin 3, ddw i i x) - A x (w x) -
      (∑ i : Fin 3, (v x i) • dw i x) - g x) :
    2 * (∫ x, ⟪w x, dt x⟫_ℝ) ≤ 2 * G * (∫ x, ‖w x‖ ^ 2)

name: NavierStokesR3.H3Comparison.eq_of_toLp_eq
statement:

    (hcu : Continuous u) (hcv : Continuous v) (he : hu.toLp u = hv.toLp v) : u = v

name: NavierStokesR3.H3Comparison.hasDerivAt_integral_norm_sq
NavierStokesR3.H3Comparison.hilbert_curve_zero

name: NavierStokesR3.H3Comparison.strong_unique_of_pressure_pairing
statement:
theorem strong_unique_of_pressure_pairing {ν T : ℝ} (hν : 0 ≤ ν)
    {f u v : VelocityField} {p q : PressureField}
    (hu : StrongSolutionOnIcc ν f 0 T u p) (hv : StrongSolutionOnIcc ν f 0 T v q)
    (A : ℝ → Space → Space →L[ℝ] Space) {G : ℝ} (hG : 0 ≤ G)
    (hAm : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, AEStronglyMeasurable (A t) volume)
    (hAb : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ x, ‖A t x‖ ≤ G)
    (hAe : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, ∀ z : Space,
      A t x z = ∑ i : Fin 3, z i • hu.curve.first i (t, x))
    (hpg : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T,
      MemLp (fun x => pressureGradient p t x - pressureGradient q t x) 2 volume)
    (hpressure : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T,
      (∫ x, ⟪u (t, x) - v (t, x), pressureGradient p t x - pressureGradient q t x⟫_ℝ) = 0)
    (hinitial : ∀ x, u (0, x) = v (0, x)) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ x, u (t, x) = v (t, x)

name: NavierStokesR3.SharpEnergyBound.energy_le_integral_sq
statement:
theorem energy_le_integral_sq {T : ℝ} {E E' q : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hcont : ContinuousOn E (Icc 0 T))
    (hnonneg : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, 0 ≤ E t) (hinitial : E 0 = 0)
    (hq : ContinuousOn q (Icc 0 T)) (hqnonneg : ∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 T, 0 ≤ q t)
    (hderiv : ∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 T, HasDerivAt E (E' t) t)
    (hbound : ∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 T, E' t ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt (E t) * q t) :
    E T ≤ (∫ t in 0..T, q t) ^ 2

name: NavierStokesR3.SharpEnergyBound.sqrt_energy_le_integral
statement:
theorem sqrt_energy_le_integral {T : ℝ} {E E' q : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hcont : ContinuousOn E (Icc 0 T))
    (hnonneg : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, 0 ≤ E t) (hinitial : E 0 = 0)
    (hq : ContinuousOn q (Icc 0 T)) (hqnonneg : ∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 T, 0 ≤ q t)
    (hderiv : ∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 T, HasDerivAt E (E' t) t)
    (hbound : ∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 T, E' t ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt (E t) * q t) :
    Real.sqrt (E T) ≤ ∫ t in 0..T, q t

name: NavierStokesR3.CompactEnergy.work_le_sqrt_l2Sq
statement:
theorem work_le_sqrt_l2Sq {u f : VelocityField} {t : ℝ}

    (hf : Continuous (fun x : Space => f (t, x)))
    (hcu : HasCompactSupport (fun x : Space => u (t, x)))
    (hf_sq : Integrable (fun x : Space => ‖f (t, x)‖ ^ 2)) :
    (∫ x : Space, ⟪u (t, x), f (t, x)⟫_ℝ) ≤
      Real.sqrt (l2Sq u t) * Real.sqrt (l2Sq f t)

name: NavierStokesR3.CompactEnergy.candidate_energy_dissipation_le
statement:
theorem candidate_energy_dissipation_le {ν : ℝ} (hν : 0 < ν)
    {u f : VelocityField} {p : PressureField} {K : Set Space}
    (hc : ProblemStatement.CandidateProperties ν u p f K)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : T ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    l2Sq u T + 2 * ν * (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..T, dissipation u t) ≤
      (cumulativeForceNorm f T) ^ 2

name: NavierStokesR3.CompactEnergy.candidate_energy_estimates
statement:
theorem candidate_energy_estimates {ν : ℝ} (hν : 0 < ν)
    {u f : VelocityField} {p : PressureField} {K : Set Space}
    (hc : ProblemStatement.CandidateProperties ν u p f K) :
    IntervalIntegrable (l2Norm f) volume 0 1 ∧
    IntegrableOn (dissipation u) (Ico (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
    (∀ T ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) 1,
      l2Sq u T + 2 * ν * (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..T, dissipation u t) ≤
        (cumulativeForceNorm f T) ^ 2) ∧
    2 * ν * (∫ t in Ico (0 : ℝ) 1, dissipation u t) ≤
      (cumulativeForceNorm f 1) ^ 2

name: NavierStokesR3.CompactEnergy.candidate_integrable_dissipation
statement:

name: NavierStokesR3.CompactEnergy.candidate_l2Norm_le_cumulativeForceNorm

name: NavierStokesR3.CompactEnergy.candidate_uniform_kineticEnergy_le
statement:

name: NavierStokesR3.CompactEnergy.force_work_le
statement:
theorem force_work_le {u f : VelocityField} {t : ℝ}

name: NavierStokesR3.CompactEnergy.integrated_energy_balance
statement:
theorem integrated_energy_balance {ν T : ℝ} {u f : VelocityField}
    {p : PressureField} {K : Set Space} (hT : 0 < T)
    (hK : IsCompact K) (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u (slab 0 T))
    (hp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ p (slab 0 T)) (hf : Continuous f)
    (hsupp : ∀ r ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, tsupport (fun x => u (r, x)) ⊆ K)
    (hinitial : ∀ x : Space, u (0, x) = 0)
    (hdiv : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ x, spatialDivergence u t x = 0)
    (hNS : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ x,
      ProblemStatement.navierStokesResidual ν u p t x = f (t, x)) :
    l2Sq u T + 2 * ν * (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..T, dissipation u t) =

theorem pull_advection (a l : ℝ) (u : VelocityField) (t : ℝ) (x : Space) :

name: NavierStokesR3.ParabolicScaling.pull_spatialDerivative

name: NavierStokesR3.ParabolicScaling.pull_temporalDerivative

NavierStokes.RadialFluxResidual.divergence_coefficient
statement:
theorem divergence_coefficient {V : Profile} (U : Profile) {p : ProfilePoint}
    (hV : DifferentiableAt ℝ V p) (hs : p.2.1 ≠ 0) :
    partialZ U p - 2 * radialB V p - 2 * p.2.1 * partialS (radialB V) p =
      partialS V p + partialZ U p

name: NavierStokes.RadialFluxResidual.divergence_radialB
statement:
theorem divergence_radialB {V F U : Profile} {t : ℝ} {x : Space}
    (hV : DifferentiableAt ℝ V (profilePoint t x))
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F (profilePoint t x))
    (hU : DifferentiableAt ℝ U (profilePoint t x)) (hs : 0 < radialEnergy x) :
    spatialDivergence (AxisymmetricResidual.velocity (radialB V) F U) t x =
      partialS V (profilePoint t x) + partialZ U (profilePoint t x)

name: NavierStokes.RadialFluxResidual.divergence_velocity_at
statement:
theorem divergence_velocity_at {B F U : Profile} {t : ℝ} {x : Space}
    (hB : DifferentiableAt ℝ B (profilePoint t x))
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F (profilePoint t x))
    (hU : DifferentiableAt ℝ U (profilePoint t x)) :
    spatialDivergence (AxisymmetricResidual.velocity B F U) t x =
      partialZ U (profilePoint t x) - 2 * B (profilePoint t x) -
        2 * radialEnergy x * partialS B (profilePoint t x)

name: NavierStokes.RadialFluxResidual.fderiv_radialB_apply
statement:
theorem fderiv_radialB_apply {V : Profile} {p : ProfilePoint}
    (hV : DifferentiableAt ℝ V p) (hs : p.2.1 ≠ 0) (v : ProfilePoint) :
    fderiv ℝ (radialB V) p v =
      -fderiv ℝ V p v / (2 * p.2.1) + V p * v.2.1 / (2 * p.2.1 ^ 2)

name: NavierStokes.RadialFluxResidual.laplaceWeighted_radialB
statement:
theorem laplaceWeighted_radialB {V : Profile} {p : ProfilePoint}
    (hV : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 V p) (hs : p.2.1 ≠ 0) :
    laplaceWeighted (radialB V) p =
      -partialS (partialS V) p - partialZ (partialZ V) p / (2 * p.2.1)

name: NavierStokes.RadialFluxResidual.partialS_partialS_radialB
statement:
theorem partialS_partialS_radialB {V : Profile} {p : ProfilePoint}
    (hV : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 V p) (hs : p.2.1 ≠ 0) :
    partialS (partialS (radialB V)) p =
      -partialS (partialS V) p / (2 * p.2.1) +
        partialS V p / p.2.1 ^ 2 - V p / p.2.1 ^ 3

name: NavierStokes.RadialFluxResidual.partialS_radialB
statement:
theorem partialS_radialB {V : Profile} {p : ProfilePoint}
    (hV : DifferentiableAt ℝ V p) (hs : p.2.1 ≠ 0) :
    partialS (radialB V) p =
      radialB (partialS V) p + 2 * radialB (radialB V) p

name: NavierStokes.RadialFluxResidual.partialS_radialB_explicit
statement:
theorem partialS_radialB_explicit {V : Profile} {p : ProfilePoint}
    (hV : DifferentiableAt ℝ V p) (hs : p.2.1 ≠ 0) :
    partialS (radialB V) p =
      -partialS V p / (2 * p.2.1) + V p / (2 * p.2.1 ^ 2)

statement:
theorem physical_radial_flux_residual {V F U P : Profile} {t : ℝ} {x : Space}
    (hV : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 V (profilePoint t x))
    (hF : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 F (profilePoint t x))
    (hU : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 U (profilePoint t x))
    (hP : DifferentiableAt ℝ P (profilePoint t x)) (hs : 0 < radialEnergy x) :
    x 0 * navierStokesResidual (AxisymmetricResidual.velocity (radialB V) F U)
        (pressure P) t x 0 +
      x 1 * navierStokesResidual (AxisymmetricResidual.velocity (radialB V) F U)
        (pressure P) t x 1 = fluxResidual V F U P (profilePoint t x)

name: NavierStokes.RadialFluxResidual.radial_flux_velocity
statement:
theorem radial_flux_velocity (V F U : Profile) (t : ℝ) (x : Space)
    (hs : 0 < radialEnergy x) :
    x 0 * AxisymmetricResidual.velocity (radialB V) F U (t, x) 0 +
      x 1 * AxisymmetricResidual.velocity (radialB V) F U (t, x) 1 =
        V (profilePoint t x)

statement:
theorem admissible_iff {a b p₁ p₂ : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hv : 2 < shearMagnitude a b) :
    AdmissibleCone a b p₁ p₂ ↔
      shearMagnitude a b < parallelStress a b p₁ p₂ ∧
        (shearMagnitude a b - 2) * transverseStress a b p₁ p₂ ^ 2 <
          2 * (parallelStress a b p₁ p₂ - shearMagnitude a b) ^ 2

    (hsecond : ∀ z ∈ K,
      2 * z.2.1 * z.2.2 + z.2.1 ^ 2 / z.1 + (z.1 - 2) * z.2.2 ^ 2 < 2) :
    ∃ P : ℝ, 0 < P ∧ ∀ z ∈ K, ∀ p₁ : ℝ, P ≤ p₁ →
      RelaxedCone z.1 z.2.1 p₁ (z.2.2 * p₁)

    ∃ P : ℝ, 0 < P ∧ ∀ z ∈ K, ∀ p₁ : ℝ, P ≤ p₁ →
      RelaxedCone z.1 z.2.1 p₁ (z.2.2 * p₁) ∧

          AdmissibleCone z.1 z.2.1 p₁ (z.2.2 * p₁))

NavierStokes.SeedHandbackJets.profile_comparison
statement:
theorem profile_comparison (k : ℕ) (h X₀ X₁ μ B B₀ : ℝ)
    (hh : 0 < h) (hh' : h < 1/2) (hX₀ : 0 < X₀) (hXX : X₀ ≤ X₁)
    (hμ : 0 < μ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hB₀ : 0 ≤ B₀) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ P Q : Profile,
      P.SmoothOnBand X₀ X₁ → Q.SmoothOnBand X₀ X₁ →
      P.JetBound (k+1) X₀ X₁ B → Q.JetBound (k+1) X₀ X₁ B →
      (∀ X ∈ Icc X₀ X₁, ∀ η ∈ J, μ ≤ P.E (X,η)) →
      (∀ X ∈ Icc X₀ X₁, ∀ η ∈ J, μ ≤ Q.E (X,η)) →
      ∀ P₀ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P₀ J → Bound (k+1) P₀ B₀ →
      ∀ εf εm : ℝ, 0 ≤ εf → 0 ≤ εm →
      (∀ X ∈ Icc X₀ X₁,
        Bound (k+1) (fun η => Q.E (X,η)-P.E (X,η)) εf ∧
        Bound (k+1) (fun η => Q.U (X,η)-P.U (X,η)) εf) →
      (∀ X ∈ Icc X₀ X₁, ∀ i,
        Bound (k+1) (fun η => Q.history i X η-P.history i X η) εm) →
      ∀ X ∈ Icc X₀ X₁, ∀ i,
        Bound k (fun η => Q.outputs h P₀ X i η-P.outputs h P₀ X i η) (C*(εf+εm))

name: NavierStokes.SeedHandbackJets.profile_comparison_norm
statement:
theorem profile_comparison_norm (k : ℕ) (h X₀ X₁ μ B B₀ : ℝ)
    (hh : 0 < h) (hh' : h < 1/2) (hX₀ : 0 < X₀) (hXX : X₀ ≤ X₁)
    (hμ : 0 < μ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hB₀ : 0 ≤ B₀) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ P Q : Profile,
      P.SmoothOnBand X₀ X₁ → Q.SmoothOnBand X₀ X₁ →
      P.JetBound (k+1) X₀ X₁ B → Q.JetBound (k+1) X₀ X₁ B →
      (∀ X ∈ Icc X₀ X₁, ∀ η ∈ J, μ ≤ P.E (X,η)) →
      (∀ X ∈ Icc X₀ X₁, ∀ η ∈ J, μ ≤ Q.E (X,η)) →
      ∀ P₀ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P₀ J → Bound (k+1) P₀ B₀ →
      parameterNorm k X₀ X₁ (outputDifference h P₀ P Q) ≤ C *
        (parameterNorm (k+1) X₀ X₁ (fieldDifference P Q)+
          parameterNorm (k+1) X₀ X₁ (historyDifference P Q))

name: NavierStokes.SeedHandbackJets.stocks_comparison
statement:
theorem stocks_comparison (k : ℕ) (h X₀ X₁ μ B B₀ : ℝ)
    (hh : 0 < h) (hh' : h < 1/2) (hX₀ : 0 < X₀) (hXX : X₀ ≤ X₁)
    (hμ : 0 < μ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hB₀ : 0 ≤ B₀) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ X ∈ Icc X₀ X₁, ∀ P₀ : ℝ → ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P₀ J → Bound (k+1) P₀ B₀ →
      ∀ f g : Curves, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 ≤ ε →
      (∀ i, PairBound (k+1) (f i) (g i) B 1 ε) →
      (∀ η ∈ J, μ ≤ f 0 η) → (∀ η ∈ J, μ ≤ g 0 η) →
      ∀ i, Bound k (fun η => stocks h X P₀ g i η - stocks h X P₀ f i η) (C*ε)

name: NavierStokes.SeedHandbackJets.stocks_formulas
statement:
theorem stocks_formulas (h X : ℝ) (P₀ : ℝ → ℝ) (f : Curves) (η : ℝ) :
    let p := packet P₀ f
    let W := (X-2*NaturalAxisData.D h*η*p 2 η-NaturalAxisData.d η*p 3 η)/X
    stocks h X P₀ f 0 η = -W+
      ((1-h)*p 4 η-NaturalAxisData.D h*η*p 5 η-NaturalAxisData.d η*p 7 η+
        2*(h-NaturalAxisData.D h)*η*p 6 η)/(X*Real.sqrt (2*X)*p 0 η) ∧
    stocks h X P₀ f 1 η = -W*p 1 η+
      (NaturalAxisData.D h*(p 2 η-η*p 3 η)+4*h*η*p 8 η-NaturalAxisData.d η*p 9 η)/X+
      4*NaturalAxisData.A h*η*p 10 η-NaturalAxisData.d η*p 11 η ∧
    stocks h X P₀ f 2 η = X/NaturalAxisData.L h η*stocks h X P₀ f 0 η ∧
    stocks h X P₀ f 3 η = X/(NaturalAxisData.L h η*p 0 η)*stocks h X P₀ f 1 η

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.angular_after_reset_clock
statement:
theorem angular_after_reset_clock {C P T y : ℝ} (hC : 0 < C) (hP : 0 < P)
    (hT : 0 < T) (hy : T ≤ y) (li : ℝ → ℝ) (eta : ℝ) :
    angular C T li (y, eta) = idealAngular P (resetClock C P y, eta)

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.angular_before
statement:
theorem angular_before {C T y : ℝ} (hC : 0 < C) (hT : 0 < T) (hy : y ≤ 0)
    (li : ℝ → ℝ) (eta : ℝ) :
    angular C T li (y, eta) = C⁻¹ * Real.exp (y / 10 + li eta)

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.angular_contDiff
statement:
theorem angular_contDiff (C T : ℝ) {li : ℝ → ℝ} (hli : ContDiff ℝ ∞ li) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (angular C T li)

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.angular_eq_inv_mul
statement:
theorem angular_eq_inv_mul {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 < C) (T : ℝ) (li : ℝ → ℝ)
    (p : ℝ × ℝ) : angular C T li p = C⁻¹ * amplitude T li p

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.angular_initial
statement:
theorem angular_initial {C T : ℝ} (hC : 0 < C) (hT : 0 < T)
    (li : ℝ → ℝ) (eta : ℝ) :
    angular C T li (0, eta) = C⁻¹ * Real.exp (li eta)

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.angular_iteratedDeriv
statement:
theorem angular_iteratedDeriv {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 < C) (T y : ℝ)
    {li : ℝ → ℝ} (hli : ContDiff ℝ ∞ li) (n : ℕ) (eta : ℝ) :
    iteratedDeriv n (fun e => angular C T li (y, e)) eta =
      C⁻¹ * iteratedDeriv n (fun e => amplitude T li (y, e)) eta

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.angular_jet_bound
statement:
theorem angular_jet_bound {C T y B : ℝ} (hC : 0 < C)
    {li : ℝ → ℝ} (hli : ContDiff ℝ ∞ li) (hB : 1 ≤ B) (hy : y ≤ T)
    (n : ℕ) (eta : ℝ)
    (hl : ∀ i ≤ n, |iteratedDeriv i li eta| ≤ B)
    (hf : ∀ i ≤ n, |iteratedDeriv i logShape eta| ≤ B) :
    |iteratedDeriv n (fun e => angular C T li (y, e)) eta| ≤
      (n.factorial * Real.exp (T / 10 + B) * B ^ n) / C

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.angular_jets_after
statement:
theorem angular_jets_after {C T y : ℝ} (hC : 0 < C) (hT : 0 < T) (hy : T < y)
    (li : ℝ → ℝ) (eta : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    iteratedDeriv n (fun s => angular C T li (s, eta)) y =
      iteratedDeriv n (fun s => C⁻¹ * Real.exp (s / 10) *
        OutgoingSchedule.shape eta) y

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.angular_jets_before
statement:
theorem angular_jets_before {C T y : ℝ} (hC : 0 < C) (hT : 0 < T) (hy : y < 0)
    (li : ℝ → ℝ) (eta : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    iteratedDeriv n (fun s => angular C T li (s, eta)) y =
      iteratedDeriv n (fun s => C⁻¹ * Real.exp (s / 10 + li eta)) y

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.angular_pos
statement:
theorem angular_pos (C T : ℝ) (li : ℝ → ℝ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) :
    0 < angular C T li p

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.axial_contDiff
statement:
theorem axial_contDiff {Gi : ℝ → ℝ} (hGi : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Gi) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (axial Gi)

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.blend_abs_le
statement:
theorem blend_abs_le {T B : ℝ} {li : ℝ → ℝ} {y eta : ℝ}
    (hli : |li eta| ≤ B) (hf : |logShape eta| ≤ B) : |blend T li (y, eta)| ≤ B

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.blend_contDiff
statement:
theorem blend_contDiff (T : ℝ) {li : ℝ → ℝ} (hli : ContDiff ℝ ∞ li) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (blend T li)

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.blend_iteratedDeriv
statement:
theorem blend_iteratedDeriv (T y : ℝ) {li : ℝ → ℝ} (hli : ContDiff ℝ ∞ li)
    (n : ℕ) (eta : ℝ) :
    iteratedDeriv n (fun e => blend T li (y, e)) eta =
      (1 - OutgoingSchedule.sigma (y / T)) * iteratedDeriv n li eta +
        OutgoingSchedule.sigma (y / T) * iteratedDeriv n logShape eta

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.blend_jet_bound
statement:
theorem blend_jet_bound (T y : ℝ) {li : ℝ → ℝ} (hli : ContDiff ℝ ∞ li)
    (n : ℕ) {eta B : ℝ} (hl : |iteratedDeriv n li eta| ≤ B)
    (hf : |iteratedDeriv n logShape eta| ≤ B) :
    |iteratedDeriv n (fun e => blend T li (y, e)) eta| ≤ B

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.constructed_prefix_bound
statement:
theorem constructed_prefix_bound {Xi C T P B BJ K : ℝ} (hXi : 0 < Xi) (hC : 1 ≤ C)
    (hT : 0 < T) (hP : 0 < P) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hBJ : 1 ≤ BJ) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    {li Gi : ℝ → ℝ} {oldU oldF : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ}
    (hli : ContDiff ℝ ∞ li) (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ oldU) (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ oldF)
    (n : ℕ) (eta : ℝ) (hsep : separation T C P ≤ 1)
    (hAxisU : ∀ X ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) Xi, ∀ k ≤ n, |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => oldU (X, e)) eta| ≤ B)
    (hGi : ∀ k ≤ n, |iteratedDeriv k Gi eta| ≤ B)
    (hHoldU : ∀ X, Xi ≤ X → ∀ e, oldU (X, e) = Gi e)
    (hAxisF : ∀ X ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) Xi, ∀ k ≤ n, |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => oldF (X, e)) eta| ≤ K / C)
    (hHoldF : ∀ X, Xi ≤ X → ∀ e, oldF (X, e) =
      C⁻¹ * Real.exp (Real.log (X / Xi) / 10 + li e) / Real.sqrt (2 * X))
    (hl : ∀ i ≤ n, |iteratedDeriv i li eta| ≤ BJ)
    (hshape : ∀ i ≤ n, |iteratedDeriv i logShape eta| ≤ BJ) :
    prefixJetSize n (resetRadius Xi C P) (separation T C P)
      (scaledFamily (resetRadius Xi C P) oldU)
      (scaledFamily (resetRadius Xi C P) (shapeField Xi T li oldF)) eta ≤
      prefixCoefficient n B (shapeJetConstant n Xi T BJ K) (Xi * Real.exp T) * separation T C P +
        (2 ^ n * (Xi * Real.exp T) * (shapeJetConstant n Xi T BJ K) ^ 2) / C ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.convex_abs_le
statement:
theorem convex_abs_le {s a b B : ℝ} (hs0 : 0 ≤ s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1)
    (ha : |a| ≤ B) (hb : |b| ≤ B) : |(1 - s) * a + s * b| ≤ B

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.eventually_small_prefix
statement:
theorem eventually_small_prefix (n : ℕ) {B K Xi T P : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hXi : 0 < Xi) (hP : 0 < P) (S : Set ℝ)
    (u f : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ → ℝ)
    (hu : ∀ C, 1 ≤ C → ContDiff ℝ ∞ (u C))
    (hf : ∀ C, 1 ≤ C → ContDiff ℝ ∞ (f C))
    (hub : ∀ C, 1 ≤ C → ∀ eta ∈ S, ∀ x ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) (separation T C P),
      ∀ k ≤ n, |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => u C (x, e)) eta| ≤ B)
    (hfb : ∀ C, 1 ≤ C → ∀ eta ∈ S, ∀ x ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) (separation T C P),
      ∀ k ≤ n, |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => f C (x, e)) eta| ≤ K / C)
    {eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 < eps) :
    ∀ᶠ C : ℝ in atTop, ∀ eta ∈ S,
      prefixJetSize n (resetRadius Xi C P) (separation T C P) (u C) (f C) eta < eps

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.eventually_vanishingDebtBound_lt
statement:
theorem eventually_vanishingDebtBound_lt (n : ℕ) (B K L BG KA T : ℝ)
    {P eps : ℝ} (hP : P ≠ 0) (heps : 0 < eps) :
    ∀ᶠ C : ℝ in atTop, vanishingDebtBound n B K L BG KA (separation T C P) C < eps

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.exists_duration
statement:
theorem exists_duration (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) :
    ∃ T : ℝ, 0 < T ∧ ∀ (li : ℝ → ℝ) (C y eta : ℝ),
      |logShape eta - li eta| ≤ B →
      11 / 20 ≤ 1 / 2 + deriv (fun s => logProfile C T li (s, eta)) y ∧
      1 / 2 + deriv (fun s => logProfile C T li (s, eta)) y ≤ 13 / 20

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.exp_logShape
statement: theorem exp_logShape (eta : ℝ) : Real.exp (logShape eta) = OutgoingSchedule.shape eta

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.idealAngular_contDiff
statement: theorem idealAngular_contDiff (P : ℝ) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (idealAngular P)

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.idealPrefixJetSize_bound
statement:
theorem idealPrefixJetSize_bound {r B K : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hr1 : r ≤ 1)
    (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hK : 0 ≤ K) {G A : ℝ → ℝ} (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G)
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (n : ℕ) (eta : ℝ)
    (hGb : ∀ k ≤ n, |iteratedDeriv k G eta| ≤ B)
    (hAb : ∀ k ≤ n, |iteratedDeriv k A eta| ≤ K) :
    idealPrefixJetSize n r G A eta ≤ idealPrefixCoefficient n B K * r +
      (5 / 2) * (2 ^ n * K ^ 2) * r ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ)

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.idealWeightI_bound
statement:
theorem idealWeightI_bound {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hr1 : r ≤ 1) :
    |idealWeightI r| ≤ 2 * r

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.idealWeightP_eq
statement:
theorem idealWeightP_eq {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    idealWeightP r = (5 / 2) * r ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ)

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.idealWeightS_bound
statement:
theorem idealWeightS_bound {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hr1 : r ≤ 1) :
    |idealWeightS r| ≤ r / 2

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.ideal_power_square
statement:
theorem ideal_power_square {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    (x ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ)) ^ 2 = x ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ)

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.ideal_rows_are_integrals
statement:
theorem ideal_rows_are_integrals {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (G A : ℝ → ℝ) (eta : ℝ) :
    idealM G r eta = (∫ _x in (0 : ℝ)..r, G eta) ∧
    idealI A r eta = (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..r, Real.sqrt (2 * x) * (A eta * x ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ))) ∧
    idealJ G A r eta = (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..r, G eta * Real.sqrt (2 * x) *
      (A eta * x ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ))) ∧
    idealS G A r eta = (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..r, G eta ^ 2 - (A eta * x ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ)) ^ 2 / 2) ∧
    idealP A r eta = (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..r, (A eta * x ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ)) ^ 2 / (2 * x))

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.ideal_rows_contDiff
statement:
theorem ideal_rows_contDiff (r : ℝ) {G A : ℝ → ℝ} (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G)
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (idealM G r) ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ (idealI A r) ∧
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (idealJ G A r) ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ (idealS G A r) ∧
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (idealP A r)

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.integral_debt_split
statement:
theorem integral_debt_split {r b : ℝ} {F G : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hF0 : IntervalIntegrable F volume 0 r) (hFr : IntervalIntegrable F volume r b)
    (hG0 : IntervalIntegrable G volume 0 r) (hGr : IntervalIntegrable G volume r b) :
    (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..b, F x - G x) =
      (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..r, F x) - (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..r, G x) +
        (∫ x in r..b, F x - G x)

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.integral_iteratedDeriv
statement:
theorem integral_iteratedDeriv {F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (n : ℕ) (eta : ℝ) :
    iteratedDeriv n (fun e => ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..r, F (x, e)) eta =
      ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..r, iteratedDeriv n (fun e => F (x, e)) eta

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.integral_jet_bound
statement:
theorem integral_jet_bound {F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F)
    {r B : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (n : ℕ) (eta : ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ x ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) r, |iteratedDeriv n (fun e => F (x, e)) eta| ≤ B) :
    |iteratedDeriv n (fun e => ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..r, F (x, e)) eta| ≤ B * r

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.integral_jet_bound_on
statement:
theorem integral_jet_bound_on {a b B : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) {F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ}
    (hF : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, ∀ e, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ F (x, e)) (n : ℕ) (eta : ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ x ∈ Ioc a b, |iteratedDeriv n (fun e => F (x, e)) eta| ≤ B) :
    |iteratedDeriv n (fun e => ∫ x in a..b, F (x, e)) eta| ≤ B * (b - a)

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.logProfile_contDiff
statement:
theorem logProfile_contDiff (C T : ℝ) {li : ℝ → ℝ} (hli : ContDiff ℝ ∞ li) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (logProfile C T li)

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.logProfile_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem logProfile_hasDerivAt (C T : ℝ) (li : ℝ → ℝ) (y eta : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => logProfile C T li (s, eta))
      (logarithmicSlope T li (y, eta) - 1 / 2) y

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.logShape_contDiff
statement: theorem logShape_contDiff : ContDiff ℝ ∞ logShape

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.log_angular
statement:
theorem log_angular (C T : ℝ) (li : ℝ → ℝ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) :
    Real.log (angular C T li p) = logProfile C T li p

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.logarithmicSlope_bounds
statement:
theorem logarithmicSlope_bounds {T K B : ℝ} {li : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hT : 0 < T) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (_ : 0 ≤ B)
    (hSigma : ∀ x, |deriv OutgoingSchedule.sigma x| ≤ K)
    (hDuration : 20 * K * B ≤ T) {y eta : ℝ}
    (hData : |logShape eta - li eta| ≤ B) :
    11 / 20 ≤ logarithmicSlope T li (y, eta) ∧
      logarithmicSlope T li (y, eta) ≤ 13 / 20

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.logarithmicSlope_eq
statement:
theorem logarithmicSlope_eq (C T : ℝ) (li : ℝ → ℝ) (y eta : ℝ) :
    logarithmicSlope T li (y, eta) =
      1 / 2 + deriv (fun s => logProfile C T li (s, eta)) y

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.logarithmicSlope_eq_actual
statement:
theorem logarithmicSlope_eq_actual (C T : ℝ) (li : ℝ → ℝ) (y eta : ℝ) :
    logarithmicSlope T li (y, eta) =
      1 / 2 + deriv (fun s => Real.log (angular C T li (s, eta))) y

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.partial_jet_continuous
statement:
theorem partial_jet_continuous {F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F) (n : ℕ) :
    Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedDeriv n (fun e => F (p.1, e)) p.2)

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.prefixJetSize_bound
statement:
theorem prefixJetSize_bound {R r L B K C : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hr1 : r ≤ 1)
    (hRL : R * r = L) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hC : 1 ≤ C)
    {u f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (n : ℕ) (eta : ℝ)
    (hub : ∀ x ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) r, ∀ k ≤ n, |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => u (x, e)) eta| ≤ B)
    (hfb : ∀ x ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) r, ∀ k ≤ n, |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => f (x, e)) eta| ≤ K / C) :
    prefixJetSize n R r u f eta ≤
      prefixCoefficient n B K L * r + (2 ^ n * L * K ^ 2) / C ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.prefix_bound_tendsto
statement:
theorem prefix_bound_tendsto (n : ℕ) (B K L T P : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun C : ℝ => prefixCoefficient n B K L * separation T C P +
      (2 ^ n * L * K ^ 2) / C ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.product_jet_bound
statement:
theorem product_jet_bound {f g : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g)
    (n : ℕ) (eta : ℝ) {A B : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (_ : 0 ≤ B)
    (hfb : ∀ k ≤ n, |iteratedDeriv k f eta| ≤ A)
    (hgb : ∀ k ≤ n, |iteratedDeriv k g eta| ≤ B) :
    |iteratedDeriv n (fun e => f e * g e) eta| ≤ 2 ^ n * A * B

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.radialSwitch_contDiff
statement:
theorem radialSwitch_contDiff {Xi T : ℝ} (hXi : 0 < Xi) (hT : 0 < T) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (radialSwitch Xi T)

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.radialSwitch_eq
statement:
theorem radialSwitch_eq {Xi T X : ℝ} (hXi : 0 < Xi) (hT : 0 < T) (hX : 0 < X) :
    radialSwitch Xi T X = OutgoingSchedule.sigma (Real.log (X / Xi) / T)

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.radialSwitch_zero
statement:
theorem radialSwitch_zero {Xi T X : ℝ} (hXi : 0 < Xi) (hT : 0 < T) (hX : X ≤ Xi) :
    radialSwitch Xi T X = 0

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.resetDebtJetSize_bound
statement:
theorem resetDebtJetSize_bound {R r b L B K C BG KA delta : ℝ}
    (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hr : 0 < r) (hrb : r ≤ b) (hb : b ≤ 1) (hRL : R * r = L)
    (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hC : 1 ≤ C) (hBG : 0 ≤ BG) (hKA : 0 ≤ KA) (hd : 0 ≤ delta)
    {u f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} {Gi A : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hGi : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Gi) (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A)
    (n : ℕ) (eta : ℝ)
    (hub : ∀ x ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) r, ∀ k ≤ n, |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => u (x, e)) eta| ≤ B)
    (hfb : ∀ x ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) r, ∀ k ≤ n, |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => f (x, e)) eta| ≤ K / C)
    (hgb : ∀ k ≤ n, |iteratedDeriv k (fun e : ℝ => 4 * e) eta| ≤ BG)
    (habound : ∀ k ≤ n, |iteratedDeriv k A eta| ≤ KA)
    (hdef : ∀ k ≤ n, |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => Gi e - 4 * e) eta| ≤ delta) :
    resetDebtJetSize n R r b u f Gi A eta ≤
      vanishingDebtBound n B K L BG KA r C + restorationBound n BG KA delta

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.resetDebtJetSize_le_parts
statement:
theorem resetDebtJetSize_le_parts {R r b : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hr : 0 < r) (hrb : r ≤ b)
    {u f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} {Gi A : ℝ → ℝ} (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hGi : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Gi) (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (n : ℕ) (eta : ℝ) :
    resetDebtJetSize n R r b u f Gi A eta ≤ prefixJetSize n R r u f eta +
      idealPrefixJetSize n r (fun e => 4 * e) A eta + restoreJetSize n Gi A r b eta

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.resetRadius_mul_separation
statement:
theorem resetRadius_mul_separation (Xi T C P : ℝ) (hCP : C * P ≠ 0) :
    resetRadius Xi C P * separation T C P = Xi * Real.exp T

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.restoreDensityJ_eq
statement:
theorem restoreDensityJ_eq (Gi A : ℝ → ℝ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) :
    restoreDensityJ Gi A p =
      restore Gi (Real.log p.1, p.2) * Real.sqrt (2 * p.1) * (A p.2 * p.1 ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ)) -
        (4 * p.2) * Real.sqrt (2 * p.1) * (A p.2 * p.1 ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ))

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.restoreDensityS_eq
statement:
theorem restoreDensityS_eq (Gi : ℝ → ℝ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) :
    restoreDensityS Gi p = restore Gi (Real.log p.1, p.2) ^ 2 - (4 * p.2) ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.restoreJetSize_bound
statement:
theorem restoreJetSize_bound {a b B K delta : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) (hb : b ≤ 1)
    (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hd : 0 ≤ delta)
    {Gi A : ℝ → ℝ} (hGi : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Gi) (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A)
    (n : ℕ) (eta : ℝ)
    (hgb : ∀ k ≤ n, |iteratedDeriv k (fun e : ℝ => 4 * e) eta| ≤ B)
    (habound : ∀ k ≤ n, |iteratedDeriv k A eta| ≤ K)
    (hdef : ∀ k ≤ n, |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => Gi e - 4 * e) eta| ≤ delta) :
    restoreJetSize n Gi A a b eta ≤
      delta * (1 + 2 * (2 ^ n * K) + 2 ^ n * (delta + 2 * B))

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.restore_after
statement:
theorem restore_after {z : ℝ} (hz : -7 ≤ z) (Gi : ℝ → ℝ) (eta : ℝ) :
    restore Gi (z, eta) = 4 * eta

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.restore_before
statement:
theorem restore_before {z : ℝ} (hz : z ≤ -8) (Gi : ℝ → ℝ) (eta : ℝ) :
    restore Gi (z, eta) = Gi eta

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.restore_contDiff
statement:
theorem restore_contDiff {Gi : ℝ → ℝ} (hGi : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Gi) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (restore Gi)

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.restore_error_jet
statement:
theorem restore_error_jet (Gi : ℝ → ℝ) (hGi : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Gi) (z eta : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    iteratedDeriv n (fun e => restore Gi (z, e) - 4 * e) eta =
      (1 - OutgoingSchedule.sigma (z + 8)) * iteratedDeriv n (fun e => Gi e - 4 * e) eta

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.restore_error_jet_le
statement:
theorem restore_error_jet_le (Gi : ℝ → ℝ) (hGi : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Gi) (z eta : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    |iteratedDeriv n (fun e => restore Gi (z, e) - 4 * e) eta| ≤
      |iteratedDeriv n (fun e => Gi e - 4 * e) eta|

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.restore_error_le
statement:
theorem restore_error_le (Gi : ℝ → ℝ) (z eta : ℝ) :
    |restore Gi (z, eta) - 4 * eta| ≤ |Gi eta - 4 * eta|

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.restore_local_smooth
statement:
theorem restore_local_smooth {Gi A : ℝ → ℝ} (hGi : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Gi) (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (eta : ℝ) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (restoreDefect Gi) (x, eta) ∧
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (restoreDensityJ Gi A) (x, eta) ∧
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (restoreDensityS Gi) (x, eta)

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.restore_sub
statement:
theorem restore_sub (Gi : ℝ → ℝ) (z eta : ℝ) :
    restore Gi (z, eta) - 4 * eta =
      (1 - OutgoingSchedule.sigma (z + 8)) * (Gi eta - 4 * eta)

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.rowI_normalized
statement:
theorem rowI_normalized {R r : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (eta : ℝ) :
    rowI R f r eta = ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..r, (2 * Real.sqrt R * x) * f (x, eta)

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.rowJ_normalized
statement:
theorem rowJ_normalized {R r : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (u f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (eta : ℝ) :
    rowJ R u f r eta =
      ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..r, (2 * Real.sqrt R * x) * (u (x, eta) * f (x, eta))

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.rowP_normalized
statement:
theorem rowP_normalized {R r : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (eta : ℝ) :
    rowP R f r eta = ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..r, R * f (x, eta) ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.rowS_normalized
statement:
theorem rowS_normalized {R r : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (u f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (eta : ℝ) :
    rowS R u f r eta =
      ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..r, u (x, eta) ^ 2 - (R * x) * f (x, eta) ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.rows_contDiff
statement:
theorem rows_contDiff {R r : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hr : 0 ≤ r) {u f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ}
    (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (rowM u r) ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ (rowI R f r) ∧
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (rowJ R u f r) ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ (rowS R u f r) ∧
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (rowP R f r)

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.rows_jet_bounds
statement:
theorem rows_jet_bounds {R r B K C : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hC : 0 < C)
    {u f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (n : ℕ) (eta : ℝ)
    (hub : ∀ x ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) r, ∀ k ≤ n, |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => u (x, e)) eta| ≤ B)
    (hfb : ∀ x ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) r, ∀ k ≤ n, |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => f (x, e)) eta| ≤ K / C) :
    |iteratedDeriv n (rowM u r) eta| ≤ B * r ∧
    |iteratedDeriv n (rowI R f r) eta| ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt R * (K / C) * r ^ 2 ∧
    |iteratedDeriv n (rowJ R u f r) eta| ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt R * (2 ^ n * B * (K / C)) * r ^ 2 ∧
    |iteratedDeriv n (rowS R u f r) eta| ≤
      (2 ^ n * B ^ 2 + R * r * (2 ^ n * (K / C) ^ 2)) * r ∧
    |iteratedDeriv n (rowP R f r) eta| ≤ R * (2 ^ n * (K / C) ^ 2) * r

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.scaledE_sq
statement:
theorem scaledE_sq {R x : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hx : 0 ≤ x)
    (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (eta : ℝ) :
    scaledE R f (x, eta) ^ 2 = 2 * R * x * f (x, eta) ^ 2

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.scaledFamily_contDiff
statement:
theorem scaledFamily_contDiff (R : ℝ) {F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (scaledFamily R F)

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.separation_eventually_before
statement:
theorem separation_eventually_before (T : ℝ) {P : ℝ} (hP : 0 < P) (clock : ℝ) :
    ∀ᶠ C : ℝ in atTop, separation T C P < Real.exp clock

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.separation_fifth_tendsto
statement:
theorem separation_fifth_tendsto (T : ℝ) {P : ℝ} (hP : P ≠ 0) :
    Tendsto (fun C : ℝ => separation T C P ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.separation_pos
statement:
theorem separation_pos (T : ℝ) {C P : ℝ} (hC : 0 < C) (hP : 0 < P) :
    0 < separation T C P

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.separation_tendsto
statement:
theorem separation_tendsto (T : ℝ) {P : ℝ} (_ : P ≠ 0) :
    Tendsto (fun C : ℝ => separation T C P) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.shapeField_before
statement:
theorem shapeField_before {Xi T X : ℝ} (hXi : 0 < Xi) (hT : 0 < T) (hX : X ≤ Xi)
    (li : ℝ → ℝ) (old : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (eta : ℝ) :
    shapeField Xi T li old (X, eta) = old (X, eta)

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.shapeField_contDiff
statement:
theorem shapeField_contDiff {Xi T : ℝ} (hXi : 0 < Xi) (hT : 0 < T)
    {li : ℝ → ℝ} {old : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} (hli : ContDiff ℝ ∞ li)
    (hold : ContDiff ℝ ∞ old) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (shapeField Xi T li old)

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.shapeField_eq_profile
statement:
theorem shapeField_eq_profile {Xi C T X : ℝ} (hXi : 0 < Xi) (hC : 0 < C)
    (hT : 0 < T) (hX : 0 < X) (li : ℝ → ℝ) (old : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (eta : ℝ)
    (hold : old (X, eta) = C⁻¹ * Real.exp (Real.log (X / Xi) / 10 + li eta) /
      Real.sqrt (2 * X)) :
    shapeField Xi T li old (X, eta) =
      angular C T li (Real.log (X / Xi), eta) / Real.sqrt (2 * X)

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.shapeField_jet_bound
statement:
theorem shapeField_jet_bound {Xi C T X B K : ℝ} (hXi : 0 < Xi) (hC : 0 < C)
    (hT : 0 < T) (_ : 0 ≤ X) (hXL : X ≤ Xi * Real.exp T)
    {li : ℝ → ℝ} {old : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} (hli : ContDiff ℝ ∞ li) (hB : 1 ≤ B)
    (hK : 0 ≤ K) (n : ℕ) (eta : ℝ)
    (hAxis : X ≤ Xi → |iteratedDeriv n (fun e => old (X, e)) eta| ≤ K / C)
    (hHold : Xi ≤ X → ∀ e, old (X, e) =
      C⁻¹ * Real.exp (Real.log (X / Xi) / 10 + li e) / Real.sqrt (2 * X))
    (hl : ∀ i ≤ n, |iteratedDeriv i li eta| ≤ B)
    (hf : ∀ i ≤ n, |iteratedDeriv i logShape eta| ≤ B) :
    |iteratedDeriv n (fun e => shapeField Xi T li old (X, e)) eta| ≤
      (K + (n.factorial * Real.exp (T / 10 + B) * B ^ n) / Real.sqrt (2 * Xi)) / C

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.shapeField_jets_uniform
statement:
theorem shapeField_jets_uniform {Xi C T X B K : ℝ} (hXi : 0 < Xi) (hC : 0 < C)
    (hT : 0 < T) (hX : 0 ≤ X) (hXL : X ≤ Xi * Real.exp T)
    {li : ℝ → ℝ} {old : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} (hli : ContDiff ℝ ∞ li) (hB : 1 ≤ B)
    (hK : 0 ≤ K) (n : ℕ) (eta : ℝ)
    (hAxis : X ≤ Xi → ∀ k ≤ n, |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => old (X, e)) eta| ≤ K / C)
    (hHold : Xi ≤ X → ∀ e, old (X, e) =
      C⁻¹ * Real.exp (Real.log (X / Xi) / 10 + li e) / Real.sqrt (2 * X))
    (hl : ∀ i ≤ n, |iteratedDeriv i li eta| ≤ B)
    (hf : ∀ i ≤ n, |iteratedDeriv i logShape eta| ≤ B) :
    ∀ k ≤ n, |iteratedDeriv k (fun e => shapeField Xi T li old (X, e)) eta| ≤
      shapeJetConstant n Xi T B K / C

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.shapeJetConstant_nonneg
statement:
theorem shapeJetConstant_nonneg (n : ℕ) {Xi T B K : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hK : 0 ≤ K) :

statement:
theorem sigma_deriv_zero_left {x : ℝ} (hx : x < 0) :

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.sigma_deriv_zero_right
statement:
theorem sigma_deriv_zero_right {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 < x) :

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.smooth_parameter_interval
statement:
theorem smooth_parameter_interval {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) {F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ}
    (hF : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, ∀ e, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ F (x, e)) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun e => ∫ x in a..b, F (x, e)) ∧
    ∀ n e, iteratedDeriv n (fun q => ∫ x in a..b, F (x, q)) e =
      ∫ x in a..b, iteratedDeriv n (fun q => F (x, q)) e

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.sqrt_scaled_product
statement:
theorem sqrt_scaled_product {R x : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :

name: NavierStokes.ShapeTransition.vanishingDebtBound_tendsto
statement:
theorem vanishingDebtBound_tendsto (n : ℕ) (B K L BG KA T : ℝ) {P : ℝ} (hP : P ≠ 0) :

      atTop (𝓝 0)

name: NavierStokes.SharpGraphBounds.graphRestriction_jet_bound
statement:
theorem graphRestriction_jet_bound {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {h a b : ℝ} (hh : 0 ≤ h) (ha : 0 < a) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, 4 ≤ n → ∀ p : SpaceTime,
      scaledRadial n p ∈ annulus a b → |p.1| ≤ 1 →
      ∀ F : LiftPoint → E, ContDiff ℝ ∞ F → ∀ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B →
      (∀ k ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k F (physicalLift h n p)‖ ≤ B) →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (F ∘ physicalLift h n) p‖ ≤
        C * B * ChartScales.Q n ^ (-(m : ℝ) * (1 + h))

name: NavierStokes.SharpGraphBounds.nativeGraph_positive_jet_bound
statement:
theorem nativeGraph_positive_jet_bound {h a b : ℝ} (hh : 0 ≤ h) (ha : 0 < a)
    (m : ℕ) : ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, 4 ≤ n → ∀ p : SpaceTime,
      scaledRadial n p ∈ annulus a b → |p.1| ≤ 1 → ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ m →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (nativeGraph h n) p‖ ≤
        C * ChartScales.Q n ^ (-(k : ℝ) * (1 + h))

name: NavierStokes.SharpGraphBounds.native_radial_power_le
statement:
theorem native_radial_power_le {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 ≤ h)

name: NavierStokes.SharpGraphBounds.physicalLift_positive_jet_bound
statement:
theorem physicalLift_positive_jet_bound {h a b : ℝ} (hh : 0 ≤ h) (ha : 0 < a)
    (m : ℕ) : ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, 4 ≤ n → ∀ p : SpaceTime,

      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (physicalLift h n) p‖ ≤

name: NavierStokes.SharpPhaseJetAlgebra.composition_geometric
statement:
theorem composition_geometric {F G : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
    [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] {f : E → F} {g : F → G}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g) (x : E) (m : ℕ)
    {B D : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hgb : ∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i g (f x)‖ ≤ B)
    (hfb : ∀ i, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ m → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f x‖ ≤ D ^ i) :
    ∀ k ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (g ∘ f) x‖ ≤ (m.factorial : ℝ) * B * D ^ k

name: NavierStokes.SharpPhaseJetAlgebra.composition_geometric_on
statement:
theorem composition_geometric_on {F G : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
    [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] {f : E → F} {g : F → G} {U : Set E}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U) (hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g)
    {x : E} (hx : x ∈ U) (m : ℕ) {B D : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hgb : ∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i g (f x)‖ ≤ B)
    (hfb : ∀ i, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ m → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f x‖ ≤ D ^ i) :
    ∀ k ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (g ∘ f) x‖ ≤ (m.factorial : ℝ) * B * D ^ k

name: NavierStokes.SharpPhaseJetAlgebra.product_geometric
statement:
theorem product_geometric {V : Type*} [NormedRing V] [NormedAlgebra ℝ V]
    {f g : E → V} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g)
    (x : E) (k : ℕ) {A B D : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hfb : ∀ i ≤ k, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f x‖ ≤ A * D ^ i)
    (hgb : ∀ i ≤ k, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i g x‖ ≤ B * D ^ i) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun y => f y * g y) x‖ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ k * A * B * D ^ k

name: NavierStokes.SharpPhaseJetAlgebra.product_geometric_on
statement:
theorem product_geometric_on {V : Type*} [NormedRing V] [NormedAlgebra ℝ V]
    {f g : E → V} {U : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U)
    (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U) {x : E} (hx : x ∈ U) (k : ℕ) {A B D : ℝ}
    (hA : 0 ≤ A) (_hB : 0 ≤ B) (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hfb : ∀ i ≤ k, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f x‖ ≤ A * D ^ i)
    (hgb : ∀ i ≤ k, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i g x‖ ≤ B * D ^ i) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun y => f y * g y) x‖ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ k * A * B * D ^ k

name: NavierStokes.SharpPhysicalPhase.axial_scale
statement:
theorem axial_scale (h : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    (ChartScales.epsilon h n)⁻¹ * ChartScales.Q n ^ (-CoordinateAlgebra.D h) =
      ChartScales.Q n ^ (-(1/2 : ℝ))

name: NavierStokes.SharpPhysicalPhase.phase_formula
statement:
theorem phase_formula (κ : Plane → Plane) (h : ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    (center : Plane) (r0 p pz x0 : ℝ) (F G : Slow → ℝ) (w : SpaceTime) :
    liftedPhase κ h n center r0 p pz x0 F G (physicalLift h n w) =
      p * (polarMap κ n w).2 + pz * ChartScales.Q n ^ (-(1/2 : ℝ)) * w.2 2 +
        x0 * (polarMap κ n w).1 -
      slotTime h n center r0 w * (p * F (slowMap κ h n w) + pz * G (slowMap κ h n w))

name: NavierStokes.SharpPhysicalPhase.physicalPhase_geometric_bound
statement:
theorem physicalPhase_geometric_bound {h K V P B d : ℝ}
    (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hK : 1 ≤ K) (hV : 1 ≤ V) (hP : 1 ≤ P) (hB : 1 ≤ B)
    (hd : 0 ≤ d) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧ ∀ κ : Plane → Plane, ContDiff ℝ ∞ κ →
      ∀ n : ℕ, 4 ≤ n → ∀ (center : Plane) (r0 p pz x0 : ℝ),
      |p| ≤ P → |pz| ≤ P → |x0| ≤ P → ∀ F G : Slow → ℝ,
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ F → ContDiff ℝ ∞ G → ∀ w : SpaceTime,
      (∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i κ (scaledRadial n w)‖ ≤ K) →
      |slotTime h n center r0 w| ≤ V * ChartScales.S n →
      (∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F (slowMap κ h n w)‖ ≤ B * ChartScales.S n ^ d) →
      (∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i G (slowMap κ h n w)‖ ≤ B * ChartScales.S n ^ d) →
      ∀ i, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ m →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i
        (liftedPhase κ h n center r0 p pz x0 F G ∘ physicalLift h n) w‖ ≤
        (C * ChartScales.S n ^ (d+1) * ChartScales.Q n ^ (-(1+h))) ^ i

name: NavierStokes.SharpPhysicalPhase.physicalPhase_positive_jets
statement:
theorem physicalPhase_positive_jets {κ : Plane → Plane} (hκ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ κ)
    {h K V B : ℝ} (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hK : 1 ≤ K) (hV : 1 ≤ V) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (n m : ℕ) (center : Plane) (r0 p pz x0 : ℝ) {F G : Slow → ℝ}
    (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (w : SpaceTime)
    (hκb : ∀ k ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k κ (scaledRadial n w)‖ ≤ K)
    (hv : |slotTime h n center r0 w| ≤ V)
    (hFb : ∀ k ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k F (slowMap κ h n w)‖ ≤ B)
    (hGb : ∀ k ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k G (slowMap κ h n w)‖ ≤ B) :
    ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ m →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k
        (liftedPhase κ h n center r0 p pz x0 F G ∘ physicalLift h n) w‖ ≤
      ((|p|+|x0|)*K + |pz| + (2:ℝ)^m * V * ((|p|+|pz|)*(m.factorial:ℝ)*B)) *
        (K * ChartScales.Q n ^ (-(1+h))) ^ k

name: NavierStokes.SharpPhysicalPhase.physicalPhase_smooth
statement:
theorem physicalPhase_smooth {κ : Plane → Plane} (hκ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ κ)
    (h : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (center : Plane) (r0 p pz x0 : ℝ) {F G : Slow → ℝ}
    (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (liftedPhase κ h n center r0 p pz x0 F G ∘ physicalLift h n)

name: NavierStokes.SharpPhysicalPhase.polarMap_jets
statement:
theorem polarMap_jets {κ : Plane → Plane} (hκ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ κ)
    {h K : ℝ} (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (n m : ℕ) (w : SpaceTime)
    (hκb : ∀ k ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k κ (scaledRadial n w)‖ ≤ K) :
    ∀ k ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (polarMap κ n) w‖ ≤
      K * (ChartScales.Q n ^ (-(1+h))) ^ k

name: NavierStokes.SharpPhysicalPhase.polarMap_smooth
statement:
theorem polarMap_smooth {κ : Plane → Plane} (hκ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ κ) (n : ℕ) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (polarMap κ n)

name: NavierStokes.SharpPhysicalPhase.slotTime_jets
statement:
theorem slotTime_jets {h K V : ℝ} (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hK : 1 ≤ K) (hV : 1 ≤ V)
    (n : ℕ) (center : Plane) (r0 : ℝ) (w : SpaceTime)
    (hv : |slotTime h n center r0 w| ≤ V) (k : ℕ) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (slotTime h n center r0) w‖ ≤
      V * (K * ChartScales.Q n ^ (-(1+h))) ^ k

name: NavierStokes.SharpPhysicalPhase.slotTime_smooth
statement:
theorem slotTime_smooth (h : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (center : Plane) (r0 : ℝ) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (slotTime h n center r0)

name: NavierStokes.SharpPhysicalPhase.slowMap_eq_slot
statement:
theorem slowMap_eq_slot (κ : Plane → Plane) (h : ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    (center : Plane) (r0 : ℝ) (w : SpaceTime) :
    slowMap κ h n w =
      (slotMap κ (ChartScales.timeCoefficient h n) center r0 (physicalLift h n w)).1

name: NavierStokes.SharpPhysicalPhase.slowMap_formula
statement:
theorem slowMap_formula (κ : Plane → Plane) (h : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (w : SpaceTime) :
    slowMap κ h n w = ((κ (scaledRadial n w)).1,
      (ChartScales.Q n ^ (-CoordinateAlgebra.D h) * w.2 2, (1-w.1)/ChartScales.Q n))

name: NavierStokes.SharpPhysicalPhase.slowMap_positive_jets
statement:

name: NavierStokes.SharpPhysicalCarrier.carrier_geometric_bound
statement:
theorem carrier_geometric_bound {h a b : ℝ} (hh : 0 ≤ h) (ha : 0 < a)
    (m : ℕ) (g d e A B H : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 1 ≤ B)
    (he : 0 ≤ e) (hH : 0 ≤ H) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, 4 ≤ n → ∀ w : SpaceTime,
      scaledRadial n w ∈ annulus a b → |w.1| ≤ 1 →
      ∀ (amp : LiftPoint → ℂ) (Φ : SpaceTime → ℝ) (j : ℤ),
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ amp → ContDiff ℝ ∞ Φ → |(j:ℝ)| ≤ H →
      (∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i amp (physicalLift h n w)‖ ≤
        A * ChartScales.Q n ^ g * ChartScales.S n ^ d) →
      (∀ i, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ m → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i Φ w‖ ≤
        (B * ChartScales.S n ^ e * ChartScales.Q n ^ (-(1+h))) ^ i) →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z => amp (physicalLift h n z) *
        character ((ChartScales.carrier h n:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)) (Φ z)) w‖ ≤
        C * ChartScales.Q n ^ (g-(m:ℝ)*derivativeCost h) *
          ChartScales.S n ^ (d+e*(m:ℝ))

name: NavierStokes.SharpPhysicalCarrier.native_carrier_bound
statement:
theorem native_carrier_bound {h a b r0 P B dBase : ℝ}
    (hh : 0 ≤ h) (ha : 0 < a) (hr0 : 0 ≤ r0) (hP : 1 ≤ P) (hB : 1 ≤ B)
    (hdBase : 0 ≤ dBase) (m : ℕ) (g dAmp A H : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hH : 0 ≤ H) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, 4 ≤ n → ∀ w : SpaceTime,
      scaledRadial n w ∈ annulus a b → |w.1| ≤ 1 →
      ∀ (chart : PolarCharts.Index) (center : Plane) (p pz x0 : ℝ),
      |p| ≤ P → |pz| ≤ P → |x0| ≤ P →
      |etaCoordinate (nativeGraph h n w - center)| ≤ r0 →
      ∀ (amp : LiftPoint → ℂ) (F G : Slow → ℝ) (j : ℤ),
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ amp → ContDiff ℝ ∞ F → ContDiff ℝ ∞ G → |(j:ℝ)| ≤ H →
      (∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i amp (physicalLift h n w)‖ ≤
        A * ChartScales.Q n^g * ChartScales.S n^dAmp) →
      (∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F
        (slowMap (PolarCharts.chart a chart) h n w)‖ ≤ B*ChartScales.S n^dBase) →
      (∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i G
        (slowMap (PolarCharts.chart a chart) h n w)‖ ≤ B*ChartScales.S n^dBase) →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m ((fun y => amp y *
        character ((ChartScales.carrier h n:ℝ)*(j:ℝ))
          (liftedPhase (PolarCharts.chart a chart) h n center r0 p pz x0 F G y)) ∘
            physicalLift h n) w‖ ≤
      C*ChartScales.Q n^(g-(m:ℝ)*derivativeCost h)*
        ChartScales.S n^(dAmp+(dBase+1)*(m:ℝ))

name: NavierStokes.SharpLogWeights.chart_weight_bound
statement:
theorem chart_weight_bound (g e : ℝ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ P : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ q : ℝ,
      0 < q → q/2 ≤ ChartScales.Q n → ChartScales.Q n ≤ 2*q →
      ChartScales.Q n^g * ChartScales.S n^e ≤ C*q^g*(1+|Real.log q|)^P

name: NavierStokes.SharpLogWeights.slow_power_log_bound
statement:
theorem slow_power_log_bound (e : ℝ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ P : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ q : ℝ,
      0 < q → q/2 ≤ ChartScales.Q n →
      ChartScales.S n^e ≤ C*(1+|Real.log q|)^P

name: NavierStokes.SharpPhysicalLoss.native_rescaled_log_bound
statement:
theorem native_rescaled_log_bound {h a b r0 P B dBase : ℝ}
    (hh : 0 ≤ h) (ha : 0 < a) (hr0 : 0 ≤ r0) (hP : 1 ≤ P) (hB : 1 ≤ B)
    (hdBase : 0 ≤ dBase) (m : ℕ) (σ g dAmp A H : ℝ)
    (hσ : -(2*CoordinateAlgebra.A h) ≤ σ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hH : 0 ≤ H) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, 4 ≤ n → ∀ w : SpaceTime,
      scaledRadial n w ∈ annulus a b → |w.1| ≤ 1 →
      ∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → q/2 ≤ ChartScales.Q n → ChartScales.Q n ≤ 2*q →
      ∀ (chart : PolarCharts.Index) (center : Plane) (p pz x0 : ℝ),
      |p| ≤ P → |pz| ≤ P → |x0| ≤ P →
      |etaCoordinate (nativeGraph h n w-center)| ≤ r0 →
      ∀ (amp : LiftPoint → ℂ) (F G : Slow → ℝ) (j : ℤ),
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ amp → ContDiff ℝ ∞ F → ContDiff ℝ ∞ G → |(j:ℝ)| ≤ H →
      (∀ i ≤ m+1, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i amp (physicalLift h n w)‖ ≤
        A*ChartScales.Q n^g*ChartScales.S n^dAmp) →
      (∀ i ≤ m+1, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F
        (slowMap (PolarCharts.chart a chart) h n w)‖ ≤ B*ChartScales.S n^dBase) →
      (∀ i ≤ m+1, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i G
        (slowMap (PolarCharts.chart a chart) h n w)‖ ≤ B*ChartScales.S n^dBase) →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m+1) (fun z => ChartScales.Q n^σ •
        ((fun y => amp y * character ((ChartScales.carrier h n:ℝ)*(j:ℝ))
          (liftedPhase (PolarCharts.chart a chart) h n center r0 p pz x0 F G y)) ∘
            physicalLift h n) z) w‖ ≤
      C*q^(g-physicalLoss h m)*(1+|Real.log q|)^N

name: NavierStokes.SharpPhysicalLoss.physical_prefactors
statement:
theorem physical_prefactors (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 ≤ h) :
    -(2*CoordinateAlgebra.A h) ≤ -CoordinateAlgebra.A h ∧
    -(2*CoordinateAlgebra.A h) ≤ -(2*CoordinateAlgebra.A h) ∧
    -(2*CoordinateAlgebra.A h) ≤ 1/2-CoordinateAlgebra.A h

name: NavierStokes.SharpPhysicalLoss.rescale_with_common_loss
statement:
theorem rescale_with_common_loss {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {h σ g e C : ℝ} (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hσ : -(2*CoordinateAlgebra.A h) ≤ σ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (n m k : ℕ) (hkm : k ≤ m+1) {f : SpaceTime → E} {w : SpaceTime}
    (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f w)
    (hb : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f w‖ ≤ C*ChartScales.Q n^(g-(k:ℝ)*derivativeCost h)*ChartScales.S n^e) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => ChartScales.Q n^σ • f z) w‖ ≤
      C*ChartScales.Q n^(g-physicalLoss h m)*ChartScales.S n^e

statement:
theorem angular_bump_identity (P : Patch) (ε : ℝ)
    {v radialFlux axialFlux virtualFlux : MeanField}
    (hv : SmoothShell P.a P.b v) (hr : SmoothShell P.a P.b radialFlux)
    (hz : SmoothShell P.a P.b axialFlux) (hT : SmoothShell P.a P.b virtualFlux)
    (hmass : radialMoment 2 v = 0) (z : MeanPoint) :
    bumpCorrection P 2 (angularBalance ε v radialFlux axialFlux virtualFlux) z =
      momentDensity P 2 z.1 * (ε * fderiv ℝ (radialMoment 2 axialFlux) z.2 (0, 1))

name: NavierStokes.SignedStressPrimitive.angular_bump_improvedClass
statement:
theorem angular_bump_improvedClass (P : Patch) {cL cR : ℝ} (hcL : 0 < cL) (hcR : 0 < cR)
    (ε slow : ℕ → ℝ) (hε : ∀ n, 0 < ε n) (hε1 : ∀ n, ε n ≤ 1) (hslow : ∀ n, 1 ≤ slow n)
    (α : ℝ) (v radialFlux axialFlux virtualFlux : ℕ → MeanField)
    (hv : ∀ n, SmoothShell P.a P.b (v n)) (hr : ∀ n, SmoothShell P.a P.b (radialFlux n))
    (hz : ∀ n, SmoothShell P.a P.b (axialFlux n)) (hT : ∀ n, SmoothShell P.a P.b (virtualFlux n))
    (hmass : ∀ n, radialMoment 2 (v n) = 0)
    (hclass : WeightedClasses.UnweightedClass
      (WeightedRadialPrimitive.logStripData P.a P.b cL cR P.a_pos hcL hcR ε slow hε hε1 hslow)
      α (fun n (z : MeanPoint) => radialMoment 2 (axialFlux n) z.2)) :
    WeightedClasses.MeanClass
      (WeightedRadialPrimitive.logStripData P.a P.b cL cR P.a_pos hcL hcR ε slow hε hε1 hslow)
      (α + 1) (fun n => bumpCorrection P 2
        (angularBalance (ε n) (v n) (radialFlux n) (axialFlux n) (virtualFlux n)))

NavierStokes.SignedStressPrimitive.axial_bump_constructed_pressure_identity
statement:
theorem axial_bump_constructed_pressure_identity (P : Patch) {d M : ℝ}
    (hd : 0 < d) (ε : ℝ) (v : ℝ × ℝ)
    {f : PressureStream.Lift MeanParameter → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hs : RadialAlias.RadiallySupported P.a P.b f) (hper : PressureStream.TorusPeriodicLift f)
    {γ radialFlux axialFlux virtualFlux : MeanField}
    (hγ : SmoothShell P.a P.b γ) (hr : SmoothShell P.a P.b radialFlux)
    (hz : SmoothShell P.a P.b axialFlux) (hT : SmoothShell P.a P.b virtualFlux)
    (hmass : radialMoment 1 γ = 0) (z : MeanPoint) :
    bumpCorrection P 1 (axialBalance ε γ radialFlux axialFlux
      (reconstructedMeanPressure d P.a P.b M P.a_lt_b v f) virtualFlux) z =
      momentDensity P 1 z.1 * (ε * fderiv ℝ (axialMomentPotential axialFlux
        (averagedRadialSource f) (normalizedMeanDensity P.a P.b P.a_lt_b)) z.2 (0, 1))

name: NavierStokes.SignedStressPrimitive.axial_bump_identity
statement:
theorem axial_bump_identity (P : Patch) (ε : ℝ)
    {γ radialFlux axialFlux pressure virtualFlux gr ρ : MeanField}
    (hγ : SmoothShell P.a P.b γ) (hr : SmoothShell P.a P.b radialFlux)
    (hz : SmoothShell P.a P.b axialFlux) (hp : SmoothShell P.a P.b pressure)
    (hT : SmoothShell P.a P.b virtualFlux) (hg : SmoothShell P.a P.b gr)
    (hρ : SmoothShell P.a P.b ρ) (hmass : radialMoment 1 γ = 0)
    (hderiv : ∀ r p, deriv (fun s => pressure (s, p)) r =
      gr (r, p) - ρ (r, p) * pressureTotal gr p) (z : MeanPoint) :
    bumpCorrection P 1 (axialBalance ε γ radialFlux axialFlux pressure virtualFlux) z =
      momentDensity P 1 z.1 * (ε * fderiv ℝ (axialMomentPotential axialFlux gr ρ) z.2 (0, 1))

name: NavierStokes.SignedStressPrimitive.axial_bump_improvedClass
statement:
theorem axial_bump_improvedClass (P : Patch) {cL cR : ℝ} (hcL : 0 < cL) (hcR : 0 < cR)
    (ε slow : ℕ → ℝ) (hε : ∀ n, 0 < ε n) (hε1 : ∀ n, ε n ≤ 1) (hslow : ∀ n, 1 ≤ slow n)
    (α : ℝ) (γ radialFlux axialFlux pressure virtualFlux gr ρ : ℕ → MeanField)
    (hγ : ∀ n, SmoothShell P.a P.b (γ n)) (hr : ∀ n, SmoothShell P.a P.b (radialFlux n))
    (hz : ∀ n, SmoothShell P.a P.b (axialFlux n)) (hp : ∀ n, SmoothShell P.a P.b (pressure n))
    (hT : ∀ n, SmoothShell P.a P.b (virtualFlux n)) (hg : ∀ n, SmoothShell P.a P.b (gr n))
    (hρ : ∀ n, SmoothShell P.a P.b (ρ n)) (hmass : ∀ n, radialMoment 1 (γ n) = 0)
    (hderiv : ∀ n r p, deriv (fun s => pressure n (s, p)) r =
      gr n (r, p) - ρ n (r, p) * pressureTotal (gr n) p)
    (hclass : WeightedClasses.UnweightedClass
      (WeightedRadialPrimitive.logStripData P.a P.b cL cR P.a_pos hcL hcR ε slow hε hε1 hslow)
      α (fun n (z : MeanPoint) => axialMomentPotential (axialFlux n) (gr n) (ρ n) z.2)) :
    WeightedClasses.MeanClass
      (WeightedRadialPrimitive.logStripData P.a P.b cL cR P.a_pos hcL hcR ε slow hε hε1 hslow)
      (α + 1) (fun n => bumpCorrection P 1
        (axialBalance (ε n) (γ n) (radialFlux n) (axialFlux n) (pressure n) (virtualFlux n)))

statement:

    (hcL : 0 < cL) (hcR : 0 < cR) (ε slow : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hε : ∀ n, 0 < ε n) (hε1 : ∀ n, ε n ≤ 1) (hslow : ∀ n, 1 ≤ slow n)
    (α : ℝ) (F : ℕ → ℝ × E → ℝ) (D : ℕ → E → ℝ) (v : E)

    (hclass : WeightedClasses.UnweightedClass
      (WeightedRadialPrimitive.logStripData P.a P.b cL cR P.a_pos hcL hcR ε slow hε hε1 hslow)

    (hmoment : ∀ n p, mass e (F n) p = ε n * fderiv ℝ (D n) p v) :

      (WeightedRadialPrimitive.logStripData P.a P.b cL cR P.a_pos hcL hcR ε slow hε hε1 hslow)

statement:
theorem chart_change_finiteJets {ρ : E → ℝ} (hρ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ρ) (hpos : ∀ p, 0 < ρ p)
    (A : ℝ) {K : Set (ℝ × E)} (hK : IsCompact K) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ F : ℝ × E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ F → ∀ z ∈ K, ∀ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B →
      ((∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F (z.1 / Real.sqrt (ρ z.2), z.2)‖ ≤ B) →
        ∀ j ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (changeChart ρ A F) z‖ ≤ C * B) ∧
      ((∀ i ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i F (Real.sqrt (ρ z.2) * z.1, z.2)‖ ≤ B) →
        ∀ j ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (inverseChangeChart ρ A F) z‖ ≤ C * B)

statement:
theorem fixedQ_density_common_ratio (P : Patch) (e : ℕ) {ρ : E → ℝ}
    (hρ : ∀ p, 0 < ρ p) {Q : ℝ} (hQ : 0 < Q) (z : ℝ × E) :
    Real.sqrt Q ^ (e + 1) *
      physicalDensity P e (fun p => Q * ρ p) (Real.sqrt Q * z.1, z.2) =
      physicalDensity P e ρ z

name: NavierStokes.SignedStressPrimitive.fixedQ_density_finiteJets
statement:
theorem fixedQ_density_finiteJets (P : Patch) (e : ℕ) {ρ : E → ℝ}
    (hρ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ρ) (hpos : ∀ p, 0 < ρ p)
    {K : Set (ℝ × E)} (hK : IsCompact K) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ Q : ℝ, 0 < Q → ∀ i ≤ m, ∀ z ∈ K,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun y : ℝ × E => Real.sqrt Q ^ (e + 1) *
        physicalDensity P e (fun p => Q * ρ p) (Real.sqrt Q * y.1, y.2)) z‖ ≤ C

name: NavierStokes.SignedStressPrimitive.fixedQ_density_identity
statement:
theorem fixedQ_density_identity (P : Patch) (e : ℕ) (q : E → ℝ)
    (Q R : ℝ) (p : E) :
    Real.sqrt Q ^ (e + 1) * physicalDensity P e q (Real.sqrt Q * R, p) =
      (Real.sqrt Q / Real.sqrt (q p)) ^ (e + 1) *
        momentDensity P e ((Real.sqrt Q / Real.sqrt (q p)) * R)

name: NavierStokes.SignedStressPrimitive.fixedQ_tensor_common_ratio
statement:
theorem fixedQ_tensor_common_ratio (P : Patch) (e : ℕ) {ρ : E → ℝ} (hρ : ∀ p, 0 < ρ p)
    {Q : ℝ} (hQ : 0 < Q) (A : ℝ) (F : ℝ × E → ℝ) (z : ℝ × E) :
    Q ^ (2 * A) * physicalSigma P e (fun p => Q * ρ p) F (Real.sqrt Q * z.1, z.2) =
      changeChart ρ A (sigma P e (normalizedResidual (fun p => Q * ρ p) A F)) z

name: NavierStokes.SignedStressPrimitive.fixedQ_tensor_identity
statement:
theorem fixedQ_tensor_identity (P : Patch) (e : ℕ) {q : E → ℝ} (hq : ∀ p, 0 < q p)
    {Q : ℝ} (hQ : 0 < Q) (A : ℝ) (F : ℝ × E → ℝ) (R : ℝ) (p : E) :
    Q ^ (2 * A) * physicalSigma P e q F (Real.sqrt Q * R, p) =
      (Q / q p) ^ (2 * A) * sigma P e (normalizedResidual q A F)
        ((Real.sqrt Q / Real.sqrt (q p)) * R, p)

theorem partialX_radialFlux (Ω : RadialDomain) {U : Field}
    (hU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ U Ω.carrier) (h lam : ℝ) {p : Point} (hp : p ∈ Ω.carrier)
    (hL : CoordinateAlgebra.L h p.2 ≠ 0) :

    (lam : ℝ) {p : SimilarityProfile.PhysicalPoint} (hp : p.1 < 1)
    (hi : SimilarityProfile.inner h p ∈ Ω.carrier) :
    SimilarityProfile.partialS (SimilarityProfile.pullback h lam (radialFlux h lam U)) p +
      SimilarityProfile.partialZ (SimilarityProfile.pullback h (-CoordinateAlgebra.A h + lam) U) p = 0

statement:
theorem radialFlux_div_radial (h lam : ℝ) (U : Field) {p : Point} (hX : p.1 ≠ 0) :
    radialFlux h lam U p / p.1 = (CoordinateAlgebra.L h p.2)⁻¹ *
      (2 * p.2 * U p - 2 * p.2 * (CoordinateAlgebra.D h + lam) * average U p -
        CoordinateAlgebra.d p.2 * SimilarityProfile.partialEta (average U) p)

name: NavierStokes.SlowDivergence.radialFlux_eq_histories
statement:
theorem radialFlux_eq_histories (Ω : RadialDomain) {U : Field}
    (hU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ U Ω.carrier) (h lam : ℝ) {p : Point} (hp : p ∈ Ω.carrier) :
    radialFlux h lam U p =
      (2 * p.2 * (p.1 * U p) -
        2 * p.2 * (CoordinateAlgebra.D h + lam) * primitive U p -
          CoordinateAlgebra.d p.2 * primitive (parameterPartial U) p) /
            CoordinateAlgebra.L h p.2

name: NavierStokes.SlowDivergence.radialFlux_eq_integral

    radialFlux h lam U p =

statement:
theorem fderiv_applyMultiplier {m : Frequency → ℂ} (hm : PolynomialGrowth m)

    fderiv ℝ (applyMultiplier m f) z =

      torusLiftX (applyMultiplier (multiplierX m) f z) +
      torusLiftY (applyMultiplier (multiplierY m) f z)

    (hzero : ∀ p ∈ S, ∀ x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ‖parameterJet q f (p, (x, y))‖ ≤ C)
    (hfirst : ∀ p ∈ S, ∀ x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,

        (fun Y => parameterJet q f (p, Y)) (x, y)‖ ≤ C)
    (hsecond : ∀ p ∈ S, ∀ x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ‖tensorTorusWord (List.replicate (w.length + 5) false)
        (fun Y => parameterJet q f (p, (Y.2, Y.1))) (x, y)‖ ≤ C)
    (p : P) (hps : p ∈ S) (Y : Plane) :

    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ (f : ℝ × (S × Plane) → ℂ), Admissible a b f →
      ∀ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C → FiniteJetBound (m + 6 * p) f (Prod.fst ⁻¹' Icc a b) C →
      ∀ M : ℝ, M ≠ 0 → ∀ j ≤ m, ∀ z : ℝ × (S × Plane),

    (hab : a ≤ b) (hχ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ)
    (hleft : ∀ u ≤ a, χ u = 0) (hright : ∀ u, b ≤ u → χ u = 1) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ (M : ℝ) (v : E) (J : (ℝ × E → F) → ℝ × E → F)
      (f : ℝ × E → F) (p : ℕ) (C : ℝ), M ≠ 0 → 0 ≤ C →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ f → RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b f →
      (∀ n < p, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (J (RadialAlias.sourceJet J f n))) →
      (∀ n < p, RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b (J (RadialAlias.sourceJet J f n))) →
      (∀ n < p, RadialAlias.directionalDeriv v (J (RadialAlias.sourceJet J f n)) =
        RadialAlias.sourceJet J f n) →
      FiniteJetBound m (RadialAlias.sourceJet J f p) (Prod.fst ⁻¹' Icc a b) C →
      ∀ j ≤ m, ∀ z : ℝ × E,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (exactAlias χ M v f) z‖ ≤ K * C * (|M|⁻¹) ^ p

name: NavierStokes.UniformFourierAlias.exactAlias_supported
NavierStokes.UniformFourierAlias.exactAlias_uniform_of_inverse
statement:
theorem exactAlias_uniform_of_inverse {a b : ℝ} {v : E} {χ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (G : (ℝ × E → F) → Prop) (J : (ℝ × E → F) → ℝ × E → F) (loss : ℕ)
    (hab : a ≤ b) (hχ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ)
    (hleft : ∀ u ≤ a, χ u = 0) (hright : ∀ u, b ≤ u → χ u = 1)
    (hregular : ∀ f, G f → ContDiff ℝ ∞ f ∧ RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b f)
    (hsmooth : ∀ f, G f → ContDiff ℝ ∞ (J f))
    (hsupport : ∀ f, G f → RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b (J f))
    (hsolve : ∀ f, G f → RadialAlias.directionalDeriv v (J f) = f)
    (hclosed : ∀ f, G f → G (RadialAlias.slowDeriv (J f)))
    (htame : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ f, G f → ∀ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C →
      FiniteJetBound (m + loss) f (Prod.fst ⁻¹' Icc a b) C →
        FiniteJetBound m (J f) (Prod.fst ⁻¹' Icc a b) (K * C)) (m p : ℕ) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ f, G f → ∀ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C →
      FiniteJetBound (m + (loss + 1) * p) f (Prod.fst ⁻¹' Icc a b) C →
      ∀ M : ℝ, M ≠ 0 → ∀ j ≤ m, ∀ z : ℝ × E,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (exactAlias χ M v f) z‖ ≤ K * C * (|M|⁻¹) ^ p
